author: andrew-murray
fields.title: Wamu ne Kristo mu Ssomero ly’Okusaba
fields.description: Amasomo amakumi asatu mu limu, buli limu nga litandika n’ekigambo kya Yesu ku kusaba, ebyawandiikibwa Murray ng’akakasa nti ekifo n’amaanyi g’okusaba mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo tebitegeerekeka kimala. Agoberera enjigiriza ya Mukama mutendera ku mutendera — okuva ku “Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba” okutuuka ku bisuubizo by’ekiro ekyasembayo — era aggumiza amazima gamu agatali makakali: nti Katonda ayagala okusaba kuddibwemu. Enkomerero yaakwo kwe kwegayiririra abalala, omulimu gw’Ekkanisa ogusinga obukulu, ne Kristo yennyini, Omwegayirizi abeera omulamu ennaku zonna, ng’obulamu bw’okusaba kwaffe. Ebigambo ebisembayo ku George Müller biraga amasomo gano nga gatambuziddwa mu bulamu.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Mu bisuubizo byonna ebigattiddwa ku kiragiro, ‘MUBEERE MU NZE,’ tewali kisinga, era tewali kireeta mangu okwatula nti, ‘Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira,’ okusinga kino: ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Obuyinza ewa Katonda kye kintu ekisingayo obulamu obw’okubeera mu Kristo mu bujjuvu kye busobola okutuukako.

Era mu mpisa zonna ez’obulamu OBUFAANANA KRISTO tewali esinga bukulu na kitiibwa okusinga okumufaanana mu mulimu gw’akola kati awatali kulekeraawo mu maaso ga Kitaffe—okwegayiririra abalala kwe, okuwangula byonna. Gye tukoma okubeera mu Ye n’okukula nga tumufaanana, obulamu bwe obw’obwakabona gye bunaakoma okukola n’amaanyi mu ffe, n’obulamu bwaffe ne bufuuka nga bwe buli obubwe: obulamu obutayosa kwegayirira na kuwangula ku lw’abantu.

‘Watufuula obwakabaka ne bakabona ba Katonda.’ Mu kabaka ne mu kabona ekisinga obukulu bwe buyinza, okukwata ku bantu, n’omukisa. Mu kabaka buyinza obukka wansi; mu kabona buyinza obulinnya waggulu, obuwangula ewa Katonda. Mu Kabona-Kabaka waffe omutendereze, Yesu Kristo, obuyinza obw’obwakabaka buzimbiddwa ku bw’obwakabona: ‘Ayinza okulokolera ddala, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.’ Ne mu ffe, bakabona be era bakabaka be, tekiri kirala: mu kwegayiririra abalala Ekkanisa mw’eteekwa okusanga n’okukozesa obuyinza bwayo obusingayo, era buli muntu ow’omu Kkanisa mw’ateekwa okukakasa nti ava mu Isirayiri, eyali ng’omulangira, eyamegganya ne Katonda, awamu n’abantu n’awangula.

Ekitabo kino kyawandiikibwa nga ndi mukakafu nnyo nti ekifo n’obuyinza bw’okusaba mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo tebitegeerwa kimala. Nkakasa nti kasita tukyatwala okusaba okusinga ng’ekkubo ery’okukuuma obulamu bwaffe ffekka obw’Ekikristaayo, tetujja kutegeera mu bujjuvu kye kyategekebwa okubeera. Naye bwe tuliyiga okukutwala ng’ekitundu ekisingayo obukulu eky’omulimu gwe twakwasibwa, ekikolo n’amaanyi g’emirimu emirala gyonna, tujja kulaba nti tewali kye twetaaga nnyo okuyiga n’okukolerako ng’omulimu gw’okusaba obulungi. Bwe mba nga nsobodde n’akatono okulaga engeri Mukama waffe gye yayigirizaamu ku kusaba mu mitendera egyeyongerayo, n’engeri ebisuubizo eby’ekitalo eby’ekiro ekisembayo (Yokaana 14:16) gye bikwataganamu n’emirimu gye tuteekwa okukola mu Linnya lye, n’emirimu egisinga, n’okubala ebibala ebingi, ffenna tujja kukkiriza nti Ekkanisa bw’erimala okwewaayo eri omulimu guno omutukuvu ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, olwo lwe tusobola okusuubira obuyinza bwa Kristo okweyoleka ku lwayo. Nsaba Katonda akozese akatabo kano okutangaaza eri abamu ku baana be ekifo eky’ekitalo eky’obuyinza n’okukwata ku bantu ky’abalindiridde okutuulamu, era ensi ekooye nayo ky’erindiridde.

Ku nsonga eno waliwo amazima amalala agaanjijira n’obutangaavu obw’ekitalo nga nsoma okuyigiriza kwa Yesu ku kusaba. Gano: nti Kitaffe alindirira okuwulira buli kusaba okw’okukkiriza, okutuwa buli kye twagala, na buli kye tusaba mu linnya lya Yesu. Twamanyiira nnyo okukomya okwagala okw’ekitalo n’ebisuubizo ebinene ebya Katonda waffe, ne kiba nti tetusobola kusoma bigambo bya Mukama waffe ebyangu era ebitegeerekeka obulungi awatali kubiteekako bukwakkulizo bwe tukozesa okubikuuma n’okubinnyonnyola. Bwe wabaawo ekintu kimu kye ndowooza nti Ekkanisa yeetaaga okuyiga, kye kino: nti Katonda ayagala okusaba kuddibwemu, era nti omutima gw’omuntu tegulowoozangako Katonda by’alikolera omwana we eyeewaayo okukkiriza nti okusaba kwe kujja kuwulirwa. Katonda awulira okusaba; gano mazima buli muntu g’akkiriza, naye abatono ennyo be bategeera amakulu gaago, oba abalaba obuyinza bwago mu bulamu bwabwe. Ebyo bye mpandiise bwe binaaleetera omusomi wange okugenda eri ebigambo by’Omusomesa, n’okutwala ebisuubizo bye eby’ekitalo nga bwe biri, mu bwangu era nga bwe byogera, ekigendererwa kyange kinaaba kituukiddwako.

Era ekintu ekirala kimu kyokka. Mu myaka gino egisembyeyo, abantu nkumi na nkumi bafunye omukisa ogutayogerekeka mu kuyiga nga Kristo bw’ali obulamu bwaffe mu bujjuvu, n’engeri gy’asuubiza okubeera n’okukola mu ffe byonna bye twetaaga. Simanyi oba nga tumaze okuyiga okukozesa amazima gano mu bulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba. Bangi beemulugunya nti tebalina maanyi kusaba mu kukkiriza, okusaba okw’omutima omumalirivu okubeera n’obuyinza bungi. Obubaka bwe nandyagadde okubaleetera bwe buno: nti Yesu omutendereze alindirira, era ayaayaanira, okubayigiriza kino. Kristo bwe bulamu bwaffe: mu ggulu abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okusaba; obulamu bwe mu ffe bulamu obutayosa kusaba, singa tumwesiga ku nsonga eyo. Kristo atuyigiriza okusaba si mu kyakulabirako kyokka, mu kuyigiriza, mu kiragiro, mu bisuubizo, wabula mu kutulaga YE YENNYINI, Omwegayirizi abeera omulamu ennaku zonna, ng’Obulamu bwaffe. Bwe tukkiriza kino, ne tugenda ne tubeera mu Ye ne ku lw’obulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba, olwo okutya kwaffe okw’obutasobola kusaba bulungi lwe kunaggwaawo, era tunaayesiga Mukama waffe n’essanyu n’obuwanguzi okutuyigiriza okusaba, Ye yennyini okubeera obulamu n’obuyinza bw’okusaba kwaffe.

Katonda atuzibule amaaso tulabe obuweereza obutukuvu obw’okwegayiririra abalala bwe buli, bwe twayawulirwa nga bakabona bw’obwakabaka be. Atuwe omutima omunene era ogw’amaanyi okukkiriza obuyinza obw’amaanyi okusaba kwaffe bwe kuyinza okuleeta. Era okutya kwonna okw’obanga tunaasobola okutuukiriza omulimu gwe twayitibwa kuggweewo nga tulaba Yesu, abeera omulamu ennaku zonna okusaba, abeera mu ffe okusaba, era omweyimirizi w’obulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba.

ANDREW MURRAY

WELLINGTON, 28 Okitobba 1885

fields.title: Omuyigiriza Yekka
fields.body_html:
‘Awo olwatuuka Yesu ng’ali mu kifo ekimu ng’asaba, bwe yamaliriza, omu ku bayigirizwa be n’amugamba nti, Mukama waffe, naawe tuyigirize okusaba.’—Lukka 11:1.

ABAYIGIRIZWA baali babeera ne Kristo, era nga bamulaba ng’asaba. Baali bayize okutegeera ekitundu ku kakwate akaali wakati w’obulamu bwe obw’ekitalo mu lujjudde n’obulamu bwe obw’ekyama obw’okusaba. Baali bayize okumukkiriza ng’Omusomesa mu bukugu bw’okusaba—tewali yali ayinza kusaba nga ye. Bwe batyo ne bajja gy’ali ne bamusaba nti, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Era mu myaka egyaddirira bandibadde batugamba nti mu bintu bye yabayigiriza, bitono nnyo ebyali eby’ekitalo oba eby’omukisa okusinga amasomo ge ku kusaba.

Era ne kaakano kikyatuukirira: bw’aba ng’asaba mu kifo ekimu, abayigirizwa abamulaba ng’akola bw’atyo bawulira obwetaavu bw’okuddamu okusaba kwe kumu, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Nga bwe tukula mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, ekirowoozo n’okukkiriza ku Musomesa Omwagalwa mu kwegayiririra kwe okutaggwaawo bigenda bifuuka bya muwendo nnyo gye tuli, n’essuubi ery’okufaanana nga Kristo mu kwegayiririra kwe ne lyeyongera okutusikiriza nga bwe kitaabangako. Era bwe tumulaba ng’asaba, ne tujjukira nti tewali ayinza kusaba nga ye, era tewali ayinza kuyigiriza nga ye, tuwulira nti okusaba kw’abayigirizwa, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba,’ kye kyennyini kye twetaaga. Era bwe tulowooza nti byonna by’ali ne by’alina, nti ye yennyini wa ffe ddala, nti ye yennyini bwe bulamu bwaffe, tuba bakakafu nti twetaaga kusaba busabi, era ajja kusanyuka nnyo okututwala mu kussa ekimu naye okw’oku lusegere, n’atuyigiriza okusaba nga naye bw’asaba.

Mujje, baganda bange! Tetuligenda eri Omusomesa Omutendereze ne tumusaba awandiike n’amannya gaffe buggya mu ssomero eryo ly’aggulawo bulijjo eri abo abeegomba okweyongera okusoma obukugu obw’okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala obuva eri Katonda? Weewaawo, ka leero lwennyini tugambe Omusomesa, nga bwe baakola edda, nti, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Bwe tunaafumiitiriza, tujja kulaba nga buli kigambo ky’okusaba kwe tuleeta kijjudde amakulu.

‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Weewaawo, okusaba. Kino kye twetaaga okuyigirizibwa. Wadde nga mu ntandikwa yaakwo okusaba kwangu nnyo ne kiba nti n’omwana asinga obunafu ayinza okusaba, kyokka mu kiseera kye kimu gwe mulimu ogusinga obugulumivu n’obutukuvu omuntu gw’ayinza okutuukako. Kwe kussa ekimu n’Oyo Atalabika era Omutukuvu Ennyo. Amaanyi g’ensi ey’emirembe n’emirembe gateekeddwa mu buyinza bwakwo. Gwe mutima gwennyini ogw’eddiini ey’amazima, omukutu gw’emikisa gyonna, ekyama ky’amaanyi n’obulamu. Si ku lwaffe ffekka, naye ne ku lw’abalala, ku lw’Ekkanisa, ku lw’ensi, okusaba Katonda kwe yawa obuyinza okumunyweza ye n’amaanyi ge. Ku kusaba ebisuubizo kwe birindirira okutuukirizibwa, obwakabaka okujja kwabwo, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda okubikkulwa kwakyo okujjuvu. Naye ku mulimu guno ogw’omukisa, nga tuli bagayaavu era nga tetugusaanira. Omwoyo wa Katonda yekka y’ayinza okutusobozesa okugukola obulungi. Nga tulimbibwa mangu okumatira n’ekifaananyi ky’okusaba, ng’amaanyi gaakwo tegaliiwo. Okutendekebwa kwaffe okw’edda, okuyigiriza kw’Ekkanisa, empisa ze tumanyidde, okusiikuuka kw’enneewulira—bino nga bitutwala mangu mu kusaba okutaliimu maanyi ga mwoyo, era okugasa katono. Okusaba okw’amazima, okunyweza amaanyi ga Katonda, okubeera n’obuyinza bungi, okuggulirwawo ddala enzigi z’eggulu—ani atandikaabye nti, Woowe, singa wabaddewo anjigiriza okusaba bwe ntyo?

Yesu yaggulawo essomero, mw’atendekera abanunule be, abo abakyegomba ennyo, okuba n’amaanyi mu kusaba. Tetuliyingiramu nga tusaba nti, Mukama! kino kyennyini kye twetaaga okuyigirizibwa! Woowe, tuyigirize okusaba.

‘Mukama, tuyigirize ffe okusaba.’ Weewaawo, ffe, Mukama. Twasoma mu Kigambo kyo amaanyi abantu bo abakkiriza ab’edda ge baasabanga nago, n’eby’amagero eby’amaanyi ebyakolebwa okuddamu okusaba kwabwe. Era obanga kino kyaliwo mu Ndagaano Enkadde, mu kiseera eky’okwetegekera, kale kaakano, mu nnaku zino ez’okutuukirira, tolisingawo nnyo okuwa abantu bo akabonero kano akakakafu ak’okubeerawo kwo wakati mu bo? Twawulira ebisuubizo bye wawa abatume bo ku maanyi g’okusaba mu linnya lyo, era twalaba nga bwe baakakasa mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa nti bya mazima: tumanyi ddala nti nabyo bisobola okutuukirira gye tuli. Tuwulira buli kiseera, ne mu nnaku zino, obubonero obw’ekitiibwa obw’amaanyi go bw’okyawa abo abakwesiga ddala. Mukama! bano bonna bantu ddala nga ffe; tuyigirize naffe okusaba bwe tutyo. Ebisuubizo bya ffe, amaanyi n’ebirabo by’ensi ey’omu ggulu bya ffe. Woowe, tuyigirize ffe okusaba tulyoke tufune mu bungi. Naffe watukwasa omulimu gwo, ku kusaba kwaffe naffe okujja kw’obwakabaka bwo kwe kwesigamye, ne mu kusaba kwaffe naffe oyinza okugulumiza erinnya lyo; ‘Mukama tuyigirize okusaba.’ Weewaawo, ffe, Mukama; twewaayo ng’abayizi; twagala ddala okuyigirizibwa ggwe. ‘Mukama, tuyigirize ffe okusaba.’

‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Weewaawo, kaakano tuwulira obwetaavu bw’okuyigirizibwa okusaba. Mu kusooka tewali mulimu gulabika nga mwangu nga guno; oluvannyuma, tewali gusinga kuzibu; era ne tukakkibwa okwatula nti: Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira. Kituufu tulina Ekigambo kya Katonda n’ebisuubizo byakyo ebitangaavu era ebikakafu; naye ekibi kizikizza nnyo amagezi gaffe, ne kiba nti tetumanya buli kiseera ngeri ya kukozesa kigambo. Mu by’omwoyo tetunoonya buli kiseera ebisinga okwetaagibwa, oba tulemererwa okusaba ng’etteeka ly’awatukuvu bwe liragira. Mu by’ensi tetusobola na kusingawo kweyambisa ddembe ery’ekitalo Kitaffe lye yatuwa okusaba bye twetaaga. Era ne bwe tumanya kye tusaba, nga kikyetaagisa bingi okufuula okusaba okusiimibwa! Kuteekwa kubeera ku lw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, mu kwewaayo okujjuvu eri by’ayagala, mu bukakafu obujjuvu obw’okukkiriza, mu linnya lya Yesu, era n’obugumiikiriza obugaana okugaanibwa, bwe kiba kyetaagisa. Bino byonna biteekwa kuyigibwa. Biyinza kuyigibwa mu ssomero ly’okusaba okungi kwokka, kubanga okwegezaamu kwe kuleeta obukugu. Wakati mu kuwulira okulumya okw’obutamanya n’obutasaana, mu kulwanagana wakati w’okukkiriza n’okubuusabuusa, obukugu obw’omu ggulu obw’okusaba okulimu amaanyi bwe buyigibwa. Kubanga, ne bwe tutakijjukira, waliwo Omu, eyatandika okukkiriza n’okusaba era y’abituukiriza, alabirira okusaba kwaffe, era akakasa nti mu bonna abamwesiga olw’ekyo okuyigirizibwa kwabwe mu ssomero ly’okusaba kujja kutuusibwa ku kutuukirira. Kale eddoboozi erya wansi mu kusaba kwaffe kwonna libeere obwetegefu bw’okuyigirizibwa obuva mu kutegeera obutamanya bwaffe, ne mu kumukkiriza ng’omuyigiriza atuukiridde, tuyinza okuba abakakafu nti tujja kuyigirizibwa, tujja kuyiga okusaba n’amaanyi. Weewaawo, tuyinza okukyesiga: ayigiriza okusaba.

‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Tewali ayinza kuyigiriza nga Yesu, tewali wabula Yesu; kyetuva tumukoowoola nti, ‘MUKAMA, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Omuyizi yeetaaga omuyigiriza amanyi omulimu gwe, alina ekirabo ky’okuyigiriza, era ayinza okukka n’obugumiikiriza n’okwagala okutuuka ku byetaago by’omuyizi. Katonda yeebazibwe! Yesu bino byonna, n’okusingawo. Amanyi okusaba kye ki. Yesu yennyini, ng’asaba, y’ayigiriza okusaba. Amanyi okusaba kye ki. Yakuyiga wakati mu kugezesebwa n’amaziga eby’obulamu bwe ku nsi. Mu ggulu kikyali mulimu gw’ayagala ennyo: obulamu bwe eyo kusaba. Tewali kimusanyusa okusinga okulaba abo b’ayinza okutwala naye mu maaso ga Kitaffe, b’ayinza okwambaza amaanyi okusabira omukisa gwa Katonda okukka ku abo ababeetoolodde, b’ayinza okutendeka okuba bakozi banne mu kwegayiririra abalala obwakabaka mwe bunaabikkulirwa ku nsi. Amanyi okuyigiriza. Oluusi ng’akozesa obwetaavu obuluma, oluusi obwesige essanyu bwe lireeta. Wano ng’akozesa okuyigiriza kw’Ekigambo, eri ng’akozesa obujulirwa bw’omukkiriza omulala amanyi kye kitegeeza okuwulirwa okusaba kwe. Ku bw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, ayinza okutuuka ku mutima gwaffe, era atuyigiriza okusaba ng’atulaga ekibi ekiziyiza okusaba, oba ng’atuwa obukakafu nti tusanyusa Katonda. Ayigiriza si mu kutuwa birowoozo bya kye tusaba oba engeri gye tusaba byokka, naye mu kussa munda mu ffe omwoyo gwennyini ogw’okusaba, ng’abeera munda mu ffe ng’Omwegayirizi Omukulu. Tuyinza ddala okugamba n’essanyu lingi nti, ‘Ani ayigiriza nga ye?’ Yesu teyayigiriza bayigirizwa be ngeri ya kubuulira, wabula ngeri ya kusaba yokka. Teyayogera nnyo ku bwetaagisa okubuulira obulungi, wabula yayogera nnyo ku kusaba obulungi. Okumanya okwogera ne Katonda kusinga okumanya okwogera n’abantu. Si buyinza eri abantu, wabula buyinza eri Katonda kye kintu ekisooka. Yesu ayagala nnyo okutuyigiriza okusaba.

Mulowooza mutya, bayigirizwa bannange abaagalwa! Tekyandibadde kye twetaaga ddala, okusaba Omusomesa okumala omwezi gumu atuwe amasomo ag’enjawulo ku bukugu bw’okusaba? Nga bwe tufumiitiriza ku bigambo bye yayogera ku nsi, ka tweweeyo eri okuyigiriza kwe nga tuli bakakafu ddala nti, n’omuyigiriza ali bw’atyo, tujja kukulaakulana. Ka tuwe obudde si kufumiitiriza kwokka, naye n’okusaba, okulindirira wansi w’entebe ey’obwakabaka, n’okutendekebwa mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala. Ka tukikole nga tuli bakakafu nti wakati mu kwogera kwaffe okutategeerekeka n’okutya kwaffe, akola omulimu gwe mu ngeri ennungi ennyo. Alitufuuyira obulamu bwe bwennyini, obuli okusaba kwokka. Nga bw’atufuula abagabana ku butuukirivu bwe n’obulamu bwe, bw’atyo alitufuula abagabana ne ku kwegayiririra kwe. Ng’ebitundu by’omubiri gwe, ng’obwakabona obutukuvu, tujja kwetaba mu mulimu gwe ogw’obwakabona ogw’okwegayirira Katonda n’okuwangula mu maaso ge ku lw’abantu. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Mukama Omutendereze! ggwe abeera omulamu ennaku zonna okusaba, oyinza okunjigiriza nange okusaba, nange okubeera omulamu bulijjo okusaba. Mu kino oyagala okumpa okugabana ku kitiibwa kyo eky’omu ggulu, nsabenga obutayosa, era nnyimirirenga bulijjo nga kabona mu maaso ga Katonda wange.

Mukama Yesu! Nkusaba leero owandiike erinnya lyange mu abo abaatula nti tebamanyi kusaba nga bwe kibagwanira, era naddala nkusaba amasomo ag’okuyigirizibwa okusaba. Mukama! njigiriza okulindirira naawe mu ssomero, n’okukuwa obudde ontendeke. Okutegeera okw’omunda obutamanya bwange, n’ekirabo eky’ekitalo n’amaanyi g’okusaba, n’obwetaavu bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’Omwoyo ow’okusaba, ka bindeetere okusuula ebirowoozo byange ku kye ndowooza nti mmanyi, era bimfukamize mu maaso go mu buyizi obw’amazima n’obwavu bw’omwoyo.

Era njjuza, Mukama, obwesige nti n’omuyigiriza nga ggwe ndiyiga okusaba. Mu bukakafu nti nnina Yesu ng’omuyigiriza wange, asaba Kitaffe buli kiseera, era olw’okusaba kwe afuga ebiseera eby’omu maaso eby’Ekkanisa ye n’eby’ensi, sijja kutya. Byonna bye nneetaaga okumanya ku byama by’ensi ey’okusaba, olibimbikkulira. Era bwe ndiba nga sisobola kumanya, olinjigiriza okuba ow’amaanyi mu kukkiriza, nga ngulumiza Katonda.

Mukama Omutendereze! Toliswaza muyizi wo akwesiga, era naye, olw’ekisa kyo, talikuswaza. Amiina.
fields.body_text: ‘Awo olwatuuka Yesu ng’ali mu kifo ekimu ng’asaba, bwe yamaliriza, omu ku bayigirizwa be n’amugamba nti, Mukama waffe, naawe tuyigirize okusaba.’—Lukka 11:1. ABAYIGIRIZWA baali babeera ne Kristo, era nga bamulaba ng’asaba. Baali bayize okutegeera ekitundu ku kakwate akaali wakati w’obulamu bwe obw’ekitalo mu lujjudde n’obulamu bwe obw’ekyama obw’okusaba. Baali bayize okumukkiriza ng’Omusomesa mu bukugu bw’okusaba—tewali yali ayinza kusaba nga ye. Bwe batyo ne bajja gy’ali ne bamusaba nti, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Era mu myaka egyaddirira bandibadde batugamba nti mu bintu bye yabayigiriza, bitono nnyo ebyali eby’ekitalo oba eby’omukisa okusinga amasomo ge ku kusaba. Era ne kaakano kikyatuukirira: bw’aba ng’asaba mu kifo ekimu, abayigirizwa abamulaba ng’akola bw’atyo bawulira obwetaavu bw’okuddamu okusaba kwe kumu, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Nga bwe tukula mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, ekirowoozo n’okukkiriza ku Musomesa Omwagalwa mu kwegayiririra kwe okutaggwaawo bigenda bifuuka bya muwendo nnyo gye tuli, n’essuubi ery’okufaanana nga Kristo mu kwegayiririra kwe ne lyeyongera okutusikiriza nga bwe kitaabangako. Era bwe tumulaba ng’asaba, ne tujjukira nti tewali ayinza kusaba nga ye, era tewali ayinza kuyigiriza nga ye, tuwulira nti okusaba kw’abayigirizwa, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba,’ kye kyennyini kye twetaaga. Era bwe tulowooza nti byonna by’ali ne by’alina, nti ye yennyini wa ffe ddala, nti ye yennyini bwe bulamu bwaffe, tuba bakakafu nti twetaaga kusaba busabi, era ajja kusanyuka nnyo okututwala mu kussa ekimu naye okw’oku lusegere, n’atuyigiriza okusaba nga naye bw’asaba. Mujje, baganda bange! Tetuligenda eri Omusomesa Omutendereze ne tumusaba awandiike n’amannya gaffe buggya mu ssomero eryo ly’aggulawo bulijjo eri abo abeegomba okweyongera okusoma obukugu obw’okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala obuva eri Katonda? Weewaawo, ka leero lwennyini tugambe Omusomesa, nga bwe baakola edda, nti, ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Bwe tunaafumiitiriza, tujja kulaba nga buli kigambo ky’okusaba kwe tuleeta kijjudde amakulu. ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba.’ Weewaawo, okusaba. Kino kye twetaaga okuyigirizibwa. Wadde nga mu ntandikwa yaakwo okusaba kwangu nnyo ne kiba nti n’omwana asinga obunafu ayinza okusaba, kyokka mu kiseera kye kimu gwe mulimu ogusinga obugulumivu n’obutukuvu omuntu gw’ayinza okutuukako. Kwe kussa ekimu n’Oyo Atalabika era Omutukuvu Ennyo. Amaanyi g’ensi ey’emirembe n’emirembe gateekeddwa mu buyinza bwakwo. Gwe mutima gwennyini ogw’eddiini ey’amazima, omukutu gw’emikisa gyonna, ekyama ky’amaanyi n’obulamu. Si ku lwaffe ffekka, naye ne ku lw’abalala, ku lw’Ekkanisa, ku lw’ensi, okusaba Katonda kwe yawa obuyinza okumunyweza ye n’amaanyi ge. Ku kusaba ebisuubizo kwe birindirira okutuukirizibwa, obwakabaka okujja kwabwo, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda okubikkulwa kwakyo okujjuvu. fields.title: Abasinza ab’Amazima
fields.body_html:
‘Naye ekiseera kijja, era kituuse, abo abasinziza mu mazima bwe banaasinzizanga Kitaffe mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Kitaffe anoonya abo abamusinza era n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinzanga mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Katonda Mwoyo n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.’—Yokaana 4:23-24.

EBIGAMBO bino Yesu bye yagamba omukazi Omusamaliya kwe kuyigiriza kwe okusooka okuwandiikiddwa ku nsonga y’okusaba. Bituwa okulengera okusooka okw’ekitalo mu nsi y’okusaba. Kitaffe anoonya abamusinza: okusinza kwaffe kumatiza omutima gwe ogujjudde okwagala, era kumusanyusa. Anoonya abasinza ab’amazima, naye asanga bangi abatali nga bw’ayagala babeere. Okusinza okw’amazima kwe kwo okuli mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Omwana azze okuggulawo ekkubo ly’okusinza kuno mu mwoyo ne mu mazima, n’okukutuyigiriza. Noolwekyo erimu ku masomo gaffe agasooka mu ssomero ly’okusaba liteekwa okuba okutegeera kye kitegeeza okusaba mu mwoyo ne mu mazima, n’okumanya engeri gye tuyinza okukutuukako.

Mukama waffe yayogera n’omukazi Omusamaliya ku kusinza okw’engeri ssatu. Ekisooka, waliwo okusinza okw’obutamanya okw’Abasamaliya: ‘Mmwe musinza kye mutamanyi.’ Eky’okubiri, okusinza okw’amagezi okw’Omuyudaaya, alina okumanya okw’amazima okwa Katonda: ‘Ffe tusinza kye tumanyi kubanga obulokozi buva mu Buyudaaya.’ N’eky’okusatu, okusinza okuggya, okw’omwoyo, Ye yennyini kw’azze okuleeta: ‘Naye ekiseera kijja, era kituuse, abo abasinziza mu mazima bwe banaasinzizanga Kitaffe mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.’ Okusinziira ku byogerwako, kyeyoleka nti ebigambo ‘mu mwoyo ne mu mazima’ tebitegeeza, nga bwe kitera okulowoozebwa, n’obunyiikivu, okuva ku mutima, mu bwesimbu. Abayudaaya baalina okubikkulirwa okw’amazima era okujjuvu okwa Katonda mu kigambo kye, okwali kuweereddwa okutuusa olwo; mu bo mwalimu abantu abatya Katonda, abaakoowoolanga Katonda n’omutima gwabwe gwonna. Mu kibinja eky’okusatu mwe tuteekwa okusaba Mukama waffe Yesu atuyingize; tuteekwa okuyigirizibwa Ye engeri y’okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kuno kwokka kwe kusinza okw’omwoyo; kuno kwe kutufuula abasinza nga Kitaffe b’anoonya. Mu kusaba, buli kimu kinaasinziiranga ku kutegeera bulungi n’okutambuliza mu nkola okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.

Kino kituukana n’etteeka erifuga obutonde bwonna: tunoonya okukwatagana wakati w’ekintu n’ekitundu ky’omubiri kye kyeyolekera oba kye kyewaayo. Eriiso lyakolebwa munda okutuukagana n’omusana, n’okutu n’eddoboozi. Omuntu ayagala okusinza Katonda mu mazima, okuzuula Katonda, okumumanya, okuba naye n’okumusanyukira, ateekwa okukwatagana naye, ateekwa okuba n’obusobozi okumusembeza. Kino kitegeeza ki? Omukazi yali abuuzizza Mukama waffe oba Samaliya oba Yerusaalemi kye kifo ekituufu eky’okusinzizangamu. Lino ssomo lya mugaso munene nnyo. Obukristaayo bwaffe nga bufiirwa nnyo olw’okukugirwa ku biseera n’ebifo ebimu. Omuntu agezaako okusaba n’obunyiikivu mu kkanisa oba mu kisenge kye eky’ekyama, amala ekitundu ekisinga obunene ekya wiiki oba ekya lunaku mu mwoyo ogwawukana ddala n’ogwo gwe yasabiramu. Okusinza kwe kwali mulimu gwa kifo kigere oba ssaawa entongole, so si gwa bulamu bwe bwonna. Katonda Mwoyo: Ye Ataggwaawo era Atakyukakyuka; ky’ali, ky’ali bulijjo era mu mazima. Katonda Mwoyo: Ye yekka y’alina Omwoyo ow’okugaba. Kyeyava atuma Omwana we, okututeekateeka olw’okusinza okw’omwoyo okw’engeri eyo, ng’atuwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Yesu ayogera ku mulimu gwe ye yennyini bw’agamba emirundi ebiri nti, ‘Ekiseera kijja,’ n’alyoka ayongerako nti, ‘era kituuse.’ Yajja okubatiza n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu; Omwoyo yali tayinza kukulukuta okutuusa Ye lwe yandigulumiziddwa (Yokaana 1:33; 7:37-38; 16:7). Bwe yamala okukomya ekibi, n’ayingira mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu n’omusaayi gwe, n’eyo ku lwaffe n’aweebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:33), olwo n’alyoka asobola okumutuweereza ng’Omwoyo wa Kitaffe. Kristo bwe yamala okutununula, ffe ne tufuna mu Ye ekifo ky’abaana, Kitaffe n’alyoka atuma Omwoyo w’Omwana we mu mitima gyaffe okukoowoola nti, ‘Aba, Kitaffe.’ Okusinza mu mwoyo kwe kusinza Kitaffe mu Mwoyo wa Kristo, Omwoyo ow’obwana.

Eno y’ensonga lwaki Yesu wano akozesa erinnya erya Kitaffe. Tetulaba n’omu ku batukuvu b’Endagaano Enkadde eyeetwalira erinnya ly’omwana, oba eyayita Katonda nti Kitange. Okusinza Kitaffe kusoboka eri abo bokka abaweereddwa Omwoyo w’Omwana. Okusinza mu mwoyo kusoboka eri abo bokka Omwana be yabikkulira Kitaffe, era abaafuna omwoyo ow’obwana. Kristo yekka y’aggulawo ekkubo era y’ayigiriza okusinza mu mwoyo.

Era mu mazima. Kino tekitegeeza kyokka mu bwesimbu. So tekitegeeza kyokka okutuukagana n’amazima g’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Ekigambo kino kirina amakulu ag’omunda era aga Katonda. Ebyo Yesu bye yagamba omukazi Omusamaliya, teyasobola kubitegeerera mangwago. Pentekoote yali yeetaagisa okubikkula amakulu gaabyo amajjuvu. Naffe nga twakayingira mu ssomero ly’okusaba, tetunnaba kweteekateeka kutegeera kuyigiriza ng’okwo. Tujja kukutegeera bulungi oluvannyuma. Ka tutandike butandisi, tukwate essomo nga bw’alituwa. Tuli ba mubiri, era tetusobola kuleetera Katonda kusinza kw’anoonya. Naye Yesu yajja okugaba Omwoyo: era atumuwadde. Embeera y’omutima gye tusabiramu ebeerenga nga ebigambo bya Kristo bwe bituyigirizza. Wabeewo okwatula okw’omunda nti tetusobola kuleetera Katonda kusinza okumusanyusa; obuwombeefu bw’omwana obulindirira Ye okutuyigiriza; n’okukkiriza okwangu okwewaayo eri okussa kw’Omwoyo. Okusinga byonna, ka tunywerere ku mazima gano ag’omukisa—tujja kulaba nga Mukama alina bingi by’alituddamu okutugamba ku go—nti okumanya Katonda nga Kitaffe, okubikkulirwa mu mitima gyaffe obwakitaffe bwe obutaliiko kkomo, okukkiriza okwagala okutaliiko kkomo okutuwa Omwana we n’Omwoyo we okutufuula abaana, ddala kye kyama ky’okusaba mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Lino lye ekkubo eriggya era eddamu Kristo lye yatuggulirawo. Okuba ne Kristo Omwana, n’Omwoyo w’Omwana, nga babeera munda mu ffe era nga batubikkulira Kitaffe, kino kye kitufuula abasinza ab’amazima, ab’omwoyo.

Mukama Omutendereze! Nsinza okwagala kwe wayigirizaamu omukazi, eyali akugaanyi ekikopo ky’amazzi, okusinza Katonda bwe kuteekwa okuba. Nsanyuka nga nkakasa nti ne kaakano tolirema kuyigiriza muyigirizwa wo ajja gy’oli n’omutima ogwegomba okusaba mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Ayi Musomesa wange Omutukuvu! Nkwegayiridde, njigiriza ekyama kino eky’omukisa.

Njigiriza nti okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima tekuva mu muntu, wabula kuva gy’oli wekka; nti si kintu kya biseera na nnaku byokka, wabula kwe kukulukuta okuva mu bulamu obuli mu Ggwe. Njigiriza okusemberera Katonda mu kusaba nga ntegeera nnyo obutamanya bwange n’obutaba na kintu kyonna mu nze kye nnyinza kumuwa, era mu kiseera kye kimu nga ntegeera n’ebyo by’ontegekera, Ggwe Omulokozi wange, olw’okussa kw’Omwoyo mu kunaanaagira kwange okw’omwana omuto. Nkutendereza kubanga mu Ggwe ndi mwana, era nnina eddembe ly’omwana okusembera; nti mu Ggwe nnina omwoyo ow’obwana n’ow’okusinza mu mazima. Okusinga byonna, Ggwe Omwana wa Kitaffe Omutendereze, njigiriza engeri okubikkulirwa kwa Kitaffe gye kuwa obuvumu mu kusaba; era obwakitaffe obutaliiko kkomo obw’Omutima gwa Katonda bubeere essanyu lyange n’amaanyi gange olw’obulamu obw’okusaba n’obw’okusinza. Amiina.

Njigiriza nti okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima tekuva mu muntu, wabula kuva gy’oli wekka; nti si kintu kya biseera na nnaku byokka, wabula kwe kukulukuta okuva mu bulamu obuli mu Ggwe. Njigiriza okusemberera Katonda mu kusaba nga ntegeera nnyo obutamanya bwange n’obutaba na kintu kyonna mu nze kye nnyinza kumuwa, era mu kiseera kye kimu nga ntegeera n’ebyo by’ontegekera, Ggwe Omulokozi wange, olw’okussa kw’Omwoyo mu kunaanaagira kwange okw’omwana omuto. Nkutendereza kubanga mu Ggwe ndi mwana, era nnina eddembe ly’omwana okusembera; nti mu Ggwe nnina omwoyo ow’obwana n’ow’okusinza mu mazima. Okusinga byonna, Ggwe Omwana wa Kitaffe Omutendereze, njigiriza engeri okubikkulirwa kwa Kitaffe gye kuwa obuvumu mu kusaba; era obwakitaffe obutaliiko kkomo obw’Omutima gwa Katonda bubeere essanyu lyange n’amaanyi gange olw’obulamu obw’okusaba n’obw’okusinza. Amiina.

fields.title: Wekka ne Katonda
fields.body_html:
‘Naye ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye.’—Matayo 6:6.

Mu bwakabaka obwo Katonda si Kabaka yekka, naye era Kitaffe; tawa byonna byokka, naye ye yennyini ye byonna. Omukisa gwabwo guli mu kumumanya n’okussa ekimu naye yekka. Musa teyawa kiragiro wadde etteeka ku kusaba; ne bannabbi boogera katono nnyo butereevu ku mulimu gw’okusaba; Kristo ye ayigiriza okusaba.

Era ekintu ekisooka Mukama ky’ayigiriza abayigirizwa be kiri nti bateekwa okuba n’ekifo eky’ekyama eky’okusabiramu; buli muntu ateekwa okuba n’ekifo eky’ekyama gy’ayinza okubeera yekka ne Katonda we. Buli muyigiriza ateekwa okuba n’ekisenge eky’okusomeseramu. Tuyize okumanya Yesu n’okumukkiriza ng’Omuyigiriza waffe yekka mu ssomero ly’okusaba. Yatuyigiriza dda e Samaliya nti okusinza tekukyasibiddwa ku biseera na bifo; nti okusinza, okusinza okw’amazima okw’omwoyo, kintu kya mwoyo n’obulamu; omuntu yenna mu bulamu bwe bwonna ateekwa okuba okusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kyokka ayagala buli muntu yeerondere ekifo ekigere w’ayinza okumusisinkana buli lunaku. Ekisenge ekyo eky’omunda, ekifo ekyo eky’ekyama, lye ssomero lya Yesu. Ekifo ekyo kiyinza okuba wonna wonna; kiyinza n’okukyuka buli lunaku bwe tuba nga tukyusa aw’okubeera; naye ekifo ekyo eky’ekyama kiteekwa okubaawo, wamu n’ekiseera eky’akasirise omuyizi mw’atuukira mu maaso g’Omusomesa, amuteeketeeke okusinza Kitaffe. Eyo yokka, naye eyo awatali kubuusabuusa, Yesu w’atujjira okutuyigiriza okusaba.

Omuyigiriza bulijjo yeegomba ekisenge kye eky’okusomeseramu kibeere kitangaavu era kisikiriza, nga kijjudde ekitangaala n’empewo ey’omu ggulu, ekifo abayizi gye beegomba okujja era gye baagala okusigala. Mu bigambo bye ebisooka ku kusaba mu Kubuulira okw’oku Lusozi, Yesu anoonya okututeekera ekisenge eky’omunda mu kitangaala kyakyo ekisinga okusikiriza. Bwe tuwuliriza n’obwegendereza, mangu ddala tulaba ekisinga obukulu ky’ayagala okutubuulira ku kulwayo kwaffe eyo. Emirundi esatu akozesa erinnya Kitaffe: ‘Saba Kitaawo;’ ‘Kitaawo alikuwa;’ ‘Kitammwe amanyidde ddala byonna bye mwetaaga.’ Ekisooka mu kusaba okw’omu kisenge kye kino: Nteekwa okusisinkana Kitange. Ekitangaala ekyaka mu kisenge kiteekwa okuba: ekitangaala ky’amaaso ga Kitaffe. Empewo empya ey’omu ggulu Yesu gy’ayagala ekijjuze, empewo mwe nteekwa okussiza omukka n’okusabira, ye: okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe, obukitaawe bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo. Bwe kityo buli kirowoozo oba buli kye tusaba kinaabanga okwesiga Kitaffe okwangu, okw’omutima gwonna, okw’omwana omuto. Bw’atyo Omusomesa bw’atuyigiriza okusaba: atutuusa mu maaso ga Kitaffe agalamu. Kye tusabira eyo kiteekwa okugasa. Ka tuwulirize n’obwegendereza tuwulire Mukama ky’ayagala okutugamba.

Okusooka, ‘Saba Kitaawo ali mu kyama.’ Katonda ye Katonda eyeekweka eri eriiso ery’omubiri. Ng’okusinza kwaffe Katonda bwe kukyamalibwa okusinga ku birowoozo byaffe n’ebikolwa byaffe, tetujja kusisinkana Oyo ali Mwoyo, Atalabika. Naye omuntu eyeeyawula ku byonna eby’ensi n’eby’abantu, ne yeeteekateeka okulindirira Katonda yekka, Kitaffe alimweyoleka. Bw’aleka ensi n’obulamu bw’ensi, n’abyesonyiwa, n’abiggalira ebweru, ne yeewaayo Kristo amukulembere mu kyama ky’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, ekitangaala ky’okwagala kwa Kitaffe kirimwakira. Ekyama ky’ekisenge eky’omunda n’oluggi oluggaddwa, okwawukana okujjuvu ku byonna ebitwetoolodde, kifaananyi, era bwe kityo buyambi, eri awatukuvu awo ow’omunda ow’omwoyo, ekyama ky’eweema ya Katonda, munda w’eggigi, omwoyo gwaffe we gutuukira ddala ku Oyo Atalabika. Bwe kityo tuyigirizibwa, ku ntandikwa yennyini ey’okunoonya ekyama ky’okusaba okuvaamu ebibala, okujjukira nti mu kisenge eky’omunda, gye tuba ffekka ne Kitaffe, gye tulyoyiga okusaba obulungi. Kitaffe ali mu kyama: mu bigambo bino Yesu atuyigiriza w’atulindirira, w’asangibwa bulijjo. Abakristaayo batera okwemulugunya nti okusaba kwabwe okw’ekyama si nga bwe kwandibadde. Bawulira nga banafu era nga boonoonyi, omutima nga munnyogovu era nga gwa kizikiza; kiba ng’abalina kitono nnyo eky’okusaba, era ne mu kitono ekyo nga tewali kukkiriza wadde essanyu. Baggwaamu amaanyi era balemesebwa okusaba olw’ekirowoozo nti tebasobola kujja eri Kitaffe nga bwe kibagwanidde oba nga bwe bandyagadde. Mwana wa Katonda! wuliriza Omuyigiriza wo. Akugamba nti bw’ogenda okusaba mu kyama, ekirowoozo kyo ekisooka kiteekwa kuba: Kitaffe ali mu kyama, Kitaffe andindirira eyo. Olw’okuba omutima gwo munnyogovu era tegulina kusaba, kyova oyingira mu maaso ga Kitaffe ow’okwagala. Kitaawe w’abaana nga bw’asaasira abaana be, ne Mukama bw’atyo bw’akusaasira. Tolowooza ku katono k’olina okuleetera Katonda, wabula ku bingi by’ayagala okukuwa. Weeteeke mu maaso ge, otunule waggulu mu maaso ge; lowooza ku kwagala kwe, okwagala kwe okw’ekitalo, okw’obukkakkamu, okw’okusaasira. Mubuulire butereevu nga byonna bwe biri eby’ekibi, ebinnyogovu era eby’ekizikiza: omutima gwa Kitaffe ogw’okwagala gwe guliwa ogugwo ekitangaala n’ebbugumu. Kale kola Yesu ky’agamba: Ggalawo oluggi, osabe Kitaawo ali mu kyama. Ekyo si kya kitalo? Okusobola okugenda wekka ne Katonda, Katonda ataliiko kkomo. Olwo n’otunula waggulu n’ogamba nti: Kitange!

‘Era Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye.’ Wano Yesu atukakasa nti okusaba okw’ekyama tekuyinza kubulwa bibala: omukisa gwakwo gulyeyoleka mu bulamu bwaffe. Kye twetaaga kyokka kwe kumukwasa, mu kyama, nga tuli ffekka naye, obulamu bwaffe mu maaso g’abantu; ye alitusasula mu lwatu; alifaayo okulaba ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kweyoleka mu mukisa gw’atuwa. Bw’atyo Mukama waffe ayagala okutuyigiriza nti nga Katonda bw’atusisinkana mu kyama n’obukitaawe n’obwesigwa obutaliiko kkomo, bwe kityo ku ludda lwaffe wabeerewo obwangu bw’okukkiriza obw’omwana omuto, obwesige nti okusaba kwaffe ddala kuleeta omukisa. ‘Buli ajja eri Katonda kimugwanira okukkiriza nti Katonda waali era n’abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera.’ Omukisa gw’ekisenge tegwesigama ku nneewulira ey’amaanyi oba ey’obunyiikivu gye nsaba nayo, wabula ku kwagala n’amaanyi ga Kitaffe gwe nkwasa eyo ebyetaago byange. Noolwekyo Omusomesa alina okwegomba kumu kwokka: Jjukira nti Kitaawo gy’ali, era alaba era awulira mu kyama; genda eyo, beera eyo, era ovaayo nate ng’olina obwesige buno: Alikusasula. Mwesige mu nsonga eno; mwesigame: okusaba eri Kitaffe tekuyinza kuba kwa bwereere; alikusasula mu lwatu.

Okwongera okunyweza okukkiriza kuno mu kwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe, Kristo ayogera ekigambo eky’okusatu: ‘Kitammwe amanyidde ddala byonna bye mwetaaga ne bwe muba nga temunnamusaba.’ Ku kulaba okusooka kiyinza okulabika ng’ekirowoozo kino kifuula okusaba okuba nga tekwetaagisa nnyo: Katonda amanyi bulungi nnyo okusinga ffe bye twetaaga. Naye bwe tweyongera okutegeera okusaba kye kuli ddala, amazima gano gajja kuyamba nnyo okunyweza okukkiriza kwaffe. Gajja kutuyigiriza nti tetwetaaga, ng’abatamanyi Katonda, okukaka Katonda atayagala okutuwuliriza olw’obungi n’obunyiikivu bw’ebigambo byaffe. Gajja kutuleetera okufumiitiriza okutukuvu n’okusirika mu kusaba, nga gatuleetera okwebuuza nti: Kitange amanyi ddala nti kino nkyetaaga? Era Omwoyo bw’amala okututuusa ku bukakafu nti kye tusaba ddala kye twetaaga ku lw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ng’Ekigambo bwe kigamba, gajja kutuwa obuvumu obw’ekitalo okugamba nti: Kitange amanyi nti nkyetaaga era nteekwa okukifuna. Ne bwe wabaawo okulwawo mu kuddibwamu, gajja kutuyigiriza okunyiikira mu kasirise: KITANGE! OMANYI nti nkyetaaga. Woowe, eddembe eryo ery’omukisa n’obwangu bw’omwana Kristo Omuyigiriza waffe by’ayagala okukuza mu ffe nga tusemberera Katonda! Ka tutunuulire Kitaffe okutuusa Omwoyo we lw’alibikola mu ffe. Oluusi mu kusaba kwaffe, bwe tuba mu kabi ak’okwemalira ku kwegayirira kwaffe okw’amaanyi era okw’okunyiikira ne twerabira nti Kitaffe amanyi era awulira, ka tusirike tugambe mpola nti: Kitange alaba, Kitange awulira, Kitange amanyi; kino kijja kuyamba okukkiriza kwaffe okutwala okuddibwamu, n’okugamba nti: Tutegeera nti buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.

Kale kaakano, mmwe mwenna abaakayingira obuggya mu ssomero lya Kristo okuyigirizibwa okusaba, mutwale amasomo gano, mugakole, era mumwesige okubatuukiriza mu go. Mubeerenga nnyo mu kisenge eky’omunda, n’oluggi nga luggaddwa—nga muggaddwa ebweru w’abantu, nga muggaliddwa wamu ne Katonda; eyo Kitaffe gy’abalindirira, eyo Yesu gy’alibayigiriza okusaba. Okubeera mu kyama nga muli mwekka ne KITAFFE: lino libe ssanyu lyammwe erisinga. Okukakasibwa nti KITAFFE alisasula mu lwatu okusaba okw’ekyama, kale nga tekuyinza kusigala nga tekuliiko mukisa: gano gabe maanyi gammwe buli lunaku. N’okumanya nti KITAFFE amanyi nti mwetaaga kye musaba: lino libe ddembe lyammwe okuleeta buli kyetaago, nga mukakasa nti Katonda wammwe alikibawa ng’obugagga bwe obungi obw’ekitiibwa obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Omulokozi Omutendereze! n’omutima gwange gwonna nkutendereza olw’okuteekawo ekisenge eky’omunda, ng’essomero mw’osisinkanira buli muyizi wo yekka, n’omubikkulira Kitaffe. Ai Mukama wange! nyweza okukkiriza kwange mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe okw’obukkakkamu n’ekisa kye, nti buli lwe mpulira nga ndi mwonoonyi oba nga ntawaanyizibwa, ekirowoozo kyange ekisooka kibeere okugenda gye mmanyi nga Kitaffe gy’andindirira, era okusaba gye kutayinza kuvaayo nga tekufunye mukisa. Ekirowoozo nti amanyi bye nneetaaga nga sinnaba kusaba, kindeetere, mu kuwummula okunene okw’okukkiriza, okwesiga nti alimpa omwana we by’ayetaaga. Ai, ekifo eky’okusabira mu kyama kifuuke gye ndi ekifo ekisinga okwagalibwa ku nsi.

Era, Mukama! mpulira nga nkusaba owe omukisa ebisenge by’abantu bo abakkiriza wonna wonna. Okubikkulirwa kwo okw’ekitalo okw’obukkakkamu bwa Kitaffe kununule Abakristaayo bonna abato okuva mu kirowoozo kyonna eky’okutwala okusaba mu kyama ng’obuvunaanyizibwa oba omugugu, era kubaleete okukutwala ng’enkizo esinga obukulu mu bulamu bwabwe, essanyu era omukisa. Komyawo bonna abaggwaamu amaanyi kubanga tebalaba kye bayinza kukuleetera mu kusaba. Ai, bawe okutegeera nti beetaaga kujja bujja n’obwereere bwabwe eri Oyo alina byonna eby’okuwa, era asanyuka okubiwa. Ekirowoozo kyabwe kimu kibeere, si kye balina okuleetera Kitaffe, wabula Kitaffe ky’alindirira okubawa.

Era owe omukisa naddala ekisenge eky’omunda eky’abaweereza bo bonna abakukolera, ng’ekifo amazima ga Katonda n’ekisa kya Katonda we bibabikkulirwa, gye bafukibwako amafuta amaggya buli lunaku, gye bazzibwamu amaanyi, era gye bafunira mu kukkiriza emikisa gye balina okuwa nagyo abantu bannaabwe. Mukama, tusembeze ffenna mu kisenge eky’omunda tusemberere ggwe ne Kitaffe. Amiina.

Bw’atyo Mukama waffe ayagala okutuyigiriza nti nga Katonda bw’atusisinkana mu kyama n’obukitaawe n’obwesigwa obutaliiko kkomo, bwe kityo ku ludda lwaffe wabeerewo obwangu bw’okukkiriza obw’omwana omuto, obwesige nti okusaba kwaffe ddala kuleeta omukisa. ‘Buli ajja eri Katonda kimugwanira okukkiriza nti Katonda waali era n’abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera.’ Omukisa gw’ekisenge tegwesigama ku nneewulira ey’amaanyi oba ey’obunyiikivu gye nsaba nayo, wabula ku kwagala n’amaanyi ga Kitaffe gwe nkwasa eyo ebyetaago byange. Noolwekyo Omusomesa alina okwegomba kumu kwokka: Jjukira nti Kitaawo gy’ali, era alaba era awulira mu kyama; genda eyo, beera eyo, era ovaayo nate ng’olina obwesige buno: Alikusasula. Mwesige mu nsonga eno; mwesigame: okusaba eri Kitaffe tekuyinza kuba kwa bwereere; alikusasula mu lwatu. Okwongera okunyweza okukkiriza kuno mu kwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe, Kristo ayogera ekigambo eky’okusatu: ‘Kitammwe amanyidde ddala byonna bye mwetaaga ne bwe muba nga temunnamusaba.’ Ku kulaba okusooka kiyinza okulabika ng’ekirowoozo kino kifuula okusaba okuba nga tekwetaagisa nnyo: Katonda amanyi bulungi nnyo okusinga ffe bye twetaaga. Naye bwe tweyongera okutegeera okusaba kye kuli ddala, amazima gano gajja kuyamba nnyo okunyweza okukkiriza kwaffe. Gajja kutuyigiriza nti tetwetaaga, ng’abatamanyi Katonda, okukaka Katonda atayagala okutuwuliriza olw’obungi n’obunyiikivu bw’ebigambo byaffe. Gajja kutuleetera okufumiitiriza okutukuvu n’okusirika mu kusaba, nga gatuleetera okwebuuza nti: Kitange amanyi ddala nti kino nkyetaaga? Era Omwoyo bw’amala okututuusa ku bukakafu nti kye tusaba ddala kye twetaaga ku lw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ng’Ekigambo bwe kigamba, gajja kutuwa obuvumu obw’ekitalo okugamba nti: Kitange amanyi nti nkyetaaga era nteekwa okukifuna. Ne bwe wabaawo okulwawo mu kuddibwamu, gajja kutuyigiriza okunyiikira mu kasirise: KITANGE! OMANYI nti nkyetaaga. Woowe, eddembe eryo ery’omukisa n’obwangu bw’omwana Kristo Omuyigiriza waffe by’ayagala okukuza mu ffe nga tusemberera Katonda! Ka tutunuulire Kitaffe okutuusa Omwoyo we lw’alibikola mu ffe. Oluusi mu kusaba kwaffe, bwe tuba mu kabi ak’okwemalira ku kwegayirira kwaffe okw’amaanyi era okw’okunyiikira ne twerabira nti Kitaffe amanyi era awulira, ka tusirike tugambe mpola nti: Kitange alaba, Kitange awulira, Kitange amanyi; kino kijja kuyamba okukkiriza kwaffe okutwala okuddibwamu, n’okugamba nti: Tutegeera nti buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa. Kale kaakano, mmwe mwenna abaakayingira obuggya mu ssomero lya Kristo okuyigirizibwa okusaba, mutwale amasomo gano, mugakole, era mumwesige okubatuukiriza mu go. Mubeerenga nnyo mu kisenge eky’omunda, n’oluggi nga luggaddwa—nga muggaddwa ebweru w’abantu, nga muggaliddwa wamu ne Katonda; eyo Kitaffe gy’abalindirira, eyo Yesu gy’alibayigiriza okusaba. Okubeera mu kyama nga muli mwekka ne KITAFFE: lino libe ssanyu lyammwe erisinga. Okukakasibwa nti KITAFFE alisasula mu lwatu okusaba okw’ekyama, kale nga tekuyinza kusigala nga tekuliiko mukisa: gano gabe maanyi gammwe buli lunaku. N’okumanya nti KITAFFE amanyi nti mwetaaga kye musaba: lino libe ddembe lyammwe okuleeta buli kyetaago, nga mukakasa nti Katonda wammwe alikibawa ng’obugagga bwe obungi obw’ekitiibwa obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Omulokozi Omutendereze! n’omutima gwange gwonna nkutendereza olw’okuteekawo ekisenge eky’omunda, ng’essomero mw’osisinkanira buli muyizi wo yekka, n’omubikkulira Kitaffe. Ai Mukama wange! nyweza okukkiriza kwange mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe okw’obukkakkamu n’ekisa kye, nti buli lwe mpulira nga ndi mwonoonyi oba nga ntawaanyizibwa, ekirowoozo kyange ekisooka kibeere okugenda gye mmanyi nga Kitaffe gy’andindirira, era okusaba gye kutayinza kuvaayo nga tekufunye mukisa. Ekirowoozo nti amanyi bye nneetaaga nga sinnaba kusaba, kindeetere, mu kuwummula okunene okw’okukkiriza, okwesiga nti alimpa omwana we by’ayetaaga. Ai, ekifo eky’okusabira mu kyama kifuuke gye ndi ekifo ekisinga okwagalibwa ku nsi. Era, Mukama! mpulira nga nkusaba owe omukisa ebisenge by’abantu bo abakkiriza wonna wonna. Okubikkulirwa kwo okw’ekitalo okw’obukkakkamu bwa Kitaffe kununule Abakristaayo bonna abato okuva mu kirowoozo kyonna eky’okutwala okusaba mu kyama ng’obuvunaanyizibwa oba omugugu, era kubaleete okukutwala ng’enkizo esinga obukulu mu bulamu bwabwe, essanyu era omukisa. Komyawo bonna abaggwaamu amaanyi kubanga tebalaba kye bayinza kukuleetera mu kusaba. Ai, bawe okutegeera nti beetaaga kujja bujja n’obwereere bwabwe eri Oyo alina byonna eby’okuwa, era asanyuka okubiwa. Ekirowoozo kyabwe kimu kibeere, si kye balina okuleetera Kitaffe, wabula Kitaffe ky’alindirira okubawa. Era owe omukisa naddala ekisenge eky’omunda eky’abaweereza bo bonna abakukolera, ng’ekifo amazima ga Katonda n’ekisa kya Katonda we bibabikkulirwa, gye bafukibwako amafuta amaggya buli lunaku, gye bazzibwamu amaanyi, era gye bafunira mu kukkiriza emikisa gye balina okuwa nagyo abantu bannaabwe. Mukama, tusembeze ffenna mu kisenge eky’omunda tusemberere ggwe ne Kitaffe. Amiina.

fields.title: Okusaba okw’Ekyokulabirako
fields.body_html:
‘Noolwekyo mumusabenga bwe muti nti, Kitaffe ali mu ggulu.’—Matayo 6:9.

BULI muyigiriza amanyi amaanyi g’ekyokulabirako. Tagamba busa mwana ky’alina okukola n’engeri y’okukikolamu, wabula amulaga engeri gye kiyinza ddala okukolebwamu. Olw’okukkakkana eri obunafu bwaffe, Omuyigiriza waffe ow’omu ggulu atuwadde ebigambo byennyini bye tulina okutwala nga tusembera eri Kitaffe. Mu byo tulina enkola y’okusaba erimu obuggya n’obujjuvu bw’Obulamu Obutaggwaawo. Nnyangu nnyo nga n’omwana omuto asobola okugyogera, naye ngagga nnyo mu bwa Katonda nga etwaliramu byonna Katonda by’asobola okuwa. Enkola y’okusaba efuuka ekyokulabirako n’ensibuko y’okusaba okulala kwonna, naye bulijjo n’etuzza gy’eri ng’okwatula okusingayo obuziba okw’emmeeme zaffe mu maaso ga Katonda waffe.

‘Kitaffe ali mu ggulu!’ Okusiima bulungi ekigambo kino eky’okusinza, nteekwa okujjukira nti tewali n’omu ku batukuvu mu Byawandiikibwa eyali agezezzaako okuyita Katonda Kitaabwe. Okukoowoola kuno kututeeka amangu ago wakati mu kubikkulirwa okw’ekitalo Omwana kwe yajja okuleeta: nti Kitaawe ye Kitaffe naffe. Kutwaliramu ekyama ky’okununulibwa—Kristo ng’atununula okuva mu kikolimo tulyoke tufuuke abaana ba Katonda. Ekyama ky’okuzaalibwa obuggya—Omwoyo ng’atuwa obulamu obuggya mu kuzaalibwa okuggya. N’ekyama ky’okukkiriza—okununulibwa nga tekunnaba kutuukirizibwa wadde okutegeerebwa, ekigambo kiteekebwa ku mimwa gy’abayigirizwa okubateekateeka olw’omukisa gwe baali bagenda okulaba. Ebigambo bino kye kisumuluzo ky’okusaba kuno kwonna, era eky’okusaba kwonna. Kitwala obudde, kitwala obulamu bwonna okubiyiga; kiritwala obutaggwaawo okubitegeera mu bujjuvu. Okumanya okwagala Katonda kw’atwagala nga Kitaffe lye ssomo erisooka era erisinga obwangu, naye era ery’enkomerero era erisinga obugulumivu mu ssomero ly’okusaba. Mu nkolagana ey’omuntu ku bubwe ne Katonda omulamu, ne mu kussa ekimu okw’okwagala n’Oyo yennyini nga tukimanyi, okusaba mwe kutandikira. Mu kumanya Katonda nga Kitaffe, nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’amubikkula, amaanyi g’okusaba mwe galisangibwa nga gasimba emirandira era nga gakula. Mu kisa n’okusaasira n’obugumiikiriza ebitaliiko kkomo ebya Kitaffe ataliiko kkomo, mu bwetegefu bwe obw’okwagala okuwulira n’okuyamba, obulamu bw’okusaba mwe busanga essanyu lyabwo. Ayi, ka twewe obudde, okutuusa Omwoyo lw’alifuula ebigambo bino gye tuli omwoyo n’amazima, nga bijjuza omutima n’obulamu: ‘Kitaffe ali mu ggulu.’ Olwo tuba ddala munda w’eggigi, mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’amaanyi, okusaba gye kuwangulira bulijjo.

‘Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’ Waliwo ekintu wano ekitukwatako amangu ago. Wadde nga bulijjo tusooka kuleeta byetaago byaffe eri Katonda mu kusaba, ne tulyoka tulowooza ku ebyo ebya Katonda n’ebimukwatako, Omusomesa akyusa entegeka eyo. Okusooka, Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka Bwo, By’oyagala Ggwe; oluvannyuma, otuwe ffe, otusonyiwe ffe, otukulembere ffe, otulokole ffe. Isomo lino lya mugaso okusinga bwe tulowooza. Mu kusinza okw’amazima, Kitaffe ateekwa okusooka, ateekwa okuba byonna. Gye nkoma okwanguwa okuyiga okwerabira nze kennyini mu kwegomba nti YE agulumizibwe, gye gukoma okugaggawala omukisa okusaba gwe kunaandeetera. Tewali n’omu yali afiiriddwa olw’ekyo kye yeefiiriza ku lwa Kitaffe.

Kino kiteekwa okukwata ku kusaba kwaffe kwonna. Waliwo engeri bbiri ez’okusaba: okw’omuntu ku bubwe n’okwegayiririra abalala. Okw’okubiri kutera okutwala ekitundu ekitono ku budde n’amaanyi gaffe. Kino tekisaanidde kuba bwe kityo. Kristo yaggulawo essomero ly’okusaba okusingira ddala okutendeka abeegayirizi olw’omulimu omunene ogw’okussa wansi, olw’okukkiriza n’okusaba kwabwe, emikisa gy’omulimu gwe n’okwagala kwe ku nsi ebeetoolodde. Tewayinza kubaawo kukula kwa maanyi mu kusaba okuggyako nga kino tukifudde kigendererwa kyaffe. Omwana omuto ayinza okusaba kitaawe ekyo kyokka ky’ayetaaga ye yennyini; naye mangu ayiga okugamba nti, Mpa n’ekya mwannyinaze. Naye omwana omukulu, abeerawo ku lw’ebya kitaawe byokka era alabirira emirimu gya kitaawe, asaba bingi, era afuna byonna by’asaba. Era Yesu ayagala okututendeka mu bulamu obw’omukisa obw’okwewaayo n’okuweereza, mwe tussa ebyaffe byonna wansi w’Erinnya, n’Obwakabaka, n’Ebyo Kitaffe by’ayagala. Ayi, ka tubeerewo olw’ekyo, era ku buli kikolwa eky’okusinza, Kitaffe! wagoberewo mu mukka gwe gumu Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka Bwo, By’oyagala Ggwe;—kino kye tutunuulira waggulu era kye twegomba.

‘Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’ Linnya ki? Erinnya lino eriggya: Kitaffe. Ekigambo Mutukuvu kye kigambo ekikulu mu Ndagaano Enkadde; erinnya Kitaffe kye kikulu mu Mpya. Mu linnya lino ery’Okwagala, obutukuvu bwonna n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda kaakano biteekwa okubikkulwa. Era erinnya litukuzibwa litya? Katonda yennyini y’alitukuza: ‘Ndiraga obutukuvu bw’erinnya lyange ekkulu, erinnya lye mwavumisa.’ Okusaba kwaffe kuteekwa okuba nti mu ffe ffennyini, mu baana ba Katonda bonna, mu maaso g’ensi, Katonda yennyini abikkule obutukuvu, amaanyi ag’Obwakatonda, n’ekitiibwa ekikwekeddwa eky’erinnya Kitaffe. Omwoyo wa Kitaffe ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu: bwe twewaayo okukulemberwa Ye, olwo lwokka erinnya lwe liritukuzibwa mu kusaba kwaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe. Ka tuyige okusaba kuno: ‘Kitaffe, Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’

‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje.’ Kitaffe ye Kabaka era alina obwakabaka. Omwana era omusika wa kabaka talina kye yeegomba kisinga ekitiibwa ky’obwakabaka bwa kitaawe. Mu biseera eby’olutalo oba eby’akabi kino kifuuka kye yeegomba ennyo; tayinza kulowooza ku kirala kyonna. Abaana ba Kitaffe bali wano mu nsi y’omulabe, obwakabaka, obuli mu ggulu, gye butannalabisibwa mu bujjuvu. Kiki ekyandisinze okuba eky’obutonde okusinga nti, bwe bayiga okutukuza erinnya Kitaffe, beegomba era ne bakaaba n’obunyiikivu bungi: ‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje.’ Okujja kw’obwakabaka kye kintu ekimu ekikulu okubikkulwa kw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, omukisa gw’abaana be, n’obulokozi bw’ensi kwe byesigamye. Era n’okujja kw’obwakabaka kulindirira okusaba kwaffe. Tetulyegatta ku kukaaba okw’okwegomba okw’ennyo okw’abanunule: ‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje’? Ka tukuyigire mu ssomero lya Yesu.

‘By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.’ Okusaba kuno emirundi mingi nnyo kutwalibwa nti kukwata ku kugumira by’ayagala Katonda kwokka. Mu ggulu by’ayagala Katonda bikolebwa, era Omusomesa ayigiriza omwana okusaba nti by’ayagala bikolebwe mu nsi nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu: mu mwoyo ogw’okwewombeeka okw’okusinza n’obuwulize obwangu. Kubanga by’ayagala Katonda kye kitiibwa ky’eggulu, okubikola gwe mukisa gw’eggulu. Nga by’ayagala bwe bikolebwa, obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bujja mu mutima. Era buli okukkiriza we kukkirizza okwagala kwa Kitaffe, obuwulize bukkiriza by’ayagala Kitaffe. Okwewaayo eri, n’okusaba olw’obulamu obw’obuwulize obufaanana n’obw’omu ggulu, gwe mwoyo gw’okusaba okw’abaana.

‘Otuwenga emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku.’ Omwana bw’amala okwewaayo eri Kitaffe mu kufaayo ku Linnya lye, ku Bwakabaka bwe, ne ku By’ayagala, aba n’eddembe lyonna okusaba emmere ye eya buli lunaku. Omwami alabirira emmere y’omuddu we, omuduumizi alabirira abasirikale be, kitaawe w’omwana alabirira omwana we. Era Kitaffe ali mu ggulu talirabirira mwana eyeewaddeyo mu kusaba eri ebimukwatako? Tuyinza ddala okugamba n’obwesige bwonna nti: Kitaffe, mbeerawo ku lw’ekitiibwa kyo n’omulimu gwo; mmanyi ng’ondabirira. Okwewaayo eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala kuwa eddembe ery’ekitalo mu kusaba olw’ebintu by’ensi eno: obulamu bwonna obw’oku nsi buba buweereddwayo mu kulabirira kwa Kitaffe okw’okwagala.

‘Tusonyiwe ebyonoono byaffe nga naffe bwe tusonyiwa abatwonoona.’ Nga emmere bw’eri ekyetaago ekisooka eky’omubiri, bwe kutyo n’okusonyiyibwa bwe kuli eri emmeeme. Era nga bwe tukakasa okuweebwa ekimu, bwe tutyo bwe tukakasa n’ekirala. Tuli baana naye era tuli boonoonyi; eddembe lyaffe ery’okutuuka mu maaso ga Kitaffe tulifuna lwa musaayi ogw’omuwendo n’okusonyiyibwa gwe gwatufunira. Ka twegendereze okusaba okw’okusonyiyibwa kuleme kufuuka mukolo bukolo: ekyo kyokka ekyatulwa ddala kye kisonyiyibwa ddala. Ka tukkirize mu kukkiriza okusonyiyibwa nga bwe kwasuubizibwa: ng’ekintu eky’amazima eky’omwoyo, ng’ekikolwa ekyennyini wakati wa Katonda naffe, kwe kuyingira mu kwagala kwonna okwa Kitaffe ne mu nkizo zonna ez’abaana. Okusonyiyibwa ng’okwo, ng’ekintu kye tulaba mu bulamu, tekusoboka nga tetulina mwoyo gwa kusonyiwa balala: nga okusonyiyibwa bwe kulaga enkolagana y’omwana wa Katonda eri eggulu, bwe kutyo okusonyiwa bwe kulaga enkolagana ye eri ensi. Mu buli kusaba eri Kitaffe nteekwa okusobola okugamba nti simanyi muntu n’omu gwe saagala n’omutima gwange gwonna.

‘Totuganya kukemebwa naye tulokole eri omubi.’ Emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku, okusonyiyibwa ebibi byaffe, n’oluvannyuma okukuumibwa obutayingira mu kibi kyonna n’obuyinza bw’omubi: mu kusaba kuno okusatu mwe mutwaliddwa ebyetaago byaffe byonna eby’omuntu ku bubwe. Okusaba olw’emmere n’olw’okusonyiyibwa kuteekwa okugenda awamu n’okwewaayo okubeera mu buwulize obutukuvu mu byonna eri by’ayagala Kitaffe, n’okusaba okw’okukkiriza mu buli kimu tukuumibwe amaanyi g’Omwoyo abeera mu ffe okuva mu buyinza bw’omubi.

Abaana ba Katonda! bwe kityo Yesu bw’ayagala tusabenga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Ayi, Erinnya lye, n’Obwakabaka bwe, ne By’ayagala, bifune ekifo ekisooka mu kwagala kwaffe; okwagala kwe okutugabira, okutusonyiwa n’okutukuuma kujja kuba mugabo gwaffe ogukakafu. Bwe kityo okusaba kuno kunaatutuusa ku bulamu obw’obwana obw’amazima: Kitaffe byonna eri omwana, Kitaffe byonna ku lw’omwana. Tujja kutegeera nga Kitaffe n’omwana, Ebibyo n’Ebyaffe, bwe biri ekintu kimu, era nga omutima ogutandika okusaba kwagwo n’EBIBYO ebyewaddeyo eri Katonda, gujja kuba n’amaanyi mu kukkiriza okwogera ne EBYAFFE. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo kujja kuba ddala okussa ekimu n’okuwaanyisiganya okwagala, nga bulijjo kutuzza mu bwesige ne mu kusinza eri Oyo atali Lubereberye kyokka wabula n’Enkomerero: ‘KUBANGA OBWAKABAKA BWE BWO, N’AMAANYI, N’EKITIIBWA, EMIREMBE N’EMIREMBE, AMIINA.’ Mwana wa Kitaffe, tuyigirize okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Ayi Ggwe Omwana omu yekka eyazaalibwa, tuyigirize, tukwegayiridde, okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’ Tukwebaza, Mukama, olw’Ebigambo bino Ebiramu era Eby’Omukisa by’otuwadde. Tukwebaza olw’obukadde n’obukadde bw’abantu abaabiyigiramu okumanya n’okusinza Kitaffe, n’olw’ebyo bye babadde gye tuli. Mukama! kiringa twetaaga ennaku ne wiiki nnyingi mu ssomero lyo ku buli kusaba kwa kinnakwo; kubanga kwa buziba nnyo era kujjuvu nnyo. Naye tutunuulira Ggwe okututwala mu makulu gaakwo agasinga obuziba: kikole, tukwegayiridde, ku lw’Erinnya lyo; Erinnya lyo ye Mwana wa Kitaffe.

Mukama! Wali ogambye nti: ‘Tewali amanyi Kitange wabula Omwana awamu n’abo Omwana b’asiima okubamubikkulira.’ Era nate: ‘Mbayigirizza ne bamanya erinnya lyo, era nzija kwongera okubamanyisa okwagala kwo kw’onjagala, kulyoke kubeerenga mu bo.’ Mukama Yesu! tubikkulire Kitaffe. Erinnya lye, okwagala kwe okutaliiko kkomo nga Kitaffe, okwagala kwe yakwagala, nga bwe wasaba, KUBEERE MU FFE. Olwo tunaayogera bulungi nti, ‘KITAFFE!’ Olwo tunaategeera okuyigiriza kwo, era omukka ogusooka omutima gwaffe gwe gunaassa awatali kuwalirizibwa gujja kuba: ‘Kitaffe, Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka bwo, By’oyagala.’ Era tunaaleetanga ebyetaago byaffe n’ebibi byaffe n’okukemebwa kwaffe gy’ali nga tukakasa nti okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’engeri eyo kulabirira byonna.

Mukama Omutendereze! tuli bayizi bo, tukwesiga; tuyigirize okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’ Amiina.

Enkola y’okusaba efuuka ekyokulabirako n’ensibuko y’okusaba okulala kwonna, naye bulijjo n’etuzza gy’eri ng’okwatula okusingayo obuziba okw’emmeeme zaffe mu maaso ga Katonda waffe. ‘Kitaffe ali mu ggulu!’ Okusiima bulungi ekigambo kino eky’okusinza, nteekwa okujjukira nti tewali n’omu ku batukuvu mu Byawandiikibwa eyali agezezzaako okuyita Katonda Kitaabwe. Okukoowoola kuno kututeeka amangu ago wakati mu kubikkulirwa okw’ekitalo Omwana kwe yajja okuleeta: nti Kitaawe ye Kitaffe naffe. Kutwaliramu ekyama ky’okununulibwa—Kristo ng’atununula okuva mu kikolimo tulyoke tufuuke abaana ba Katonda. Ekyama ky’okuzaalibwa obuggya—Omwoyo ng’atuwa obulamu obuggya mu kuzaalibwa okuggya. N’ekyama ky’okukkiriza—okununulibwa nga tekunnaba kutuukirizibwa wadde okutegeerebwa, ekigambo kiteekebwa ku mimwa gy’abayigirizwa okubateekateeka olw’omukisa gwe baali bagenda okulaba. Ebigambo bino kye kisumuluzo ky’okusaba kuno kwonna, era eky’okusaba kwonna. Kitwala obudde, kitwala obulamu bwonna okubiyiga; kiritwala obutaggwaawo okubitegeera mu bujjuvu. Okumanya okwagala Katonda kw’atwagala nga Kitaffe lye ssomo erisooka era erisinga obwangu, naye era ery’enkomerero era erisinga obugulumivu mu ssomero ly’okusaba. Mu nkolagana ey’omuntu ku bubwe ne Katonda omulamu, ne mu kussa ekimu okw’okwagala n’Oyo yennyini nga tukimanyi, okusaba mwe kutandikira. Mu kumanya Katonda nga Kitaffe, nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’amubikkula, amaanyi g’okusaba mwe galisangibwa nga gasimba emirandira era nga gakula. Mu kisa n’okusaasira n’obugumiikiriza ebitaliiko kkomo ebya Kitaffe ataliiko kkomo, mu bwetegefu bwe obw’okwagala okuwulira n’okuyamba, obulamu bw’okusaba mwe busanga essanyu lyabwo. Ayi, ka twewe obudde, okutuusa Omwoyo lw’alifuula ebigambo bino gye tuli omwoyo n’amazima, nga bijjuza omutima n’obulamu: ‘Kitaffe ali mu ggulu.’ Olwo tuba ddala munda w’eggigi, mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’amaanyi, okusaba gye kuwangulira bulijjo. ‘Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’ Waliwo ekintu wano ekitukwatako amangu ago. Wadde nga bulijjo tusooka kuleeta byetaago byaffe eri Katonda mu kusaba, ne tulyoka tulowooza ku ebyo ebya Katonda n’ebimukwatako, Omusomesa akyusa entegeka eyo. Okusooka, Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka Bwo, By’oyagala Ggwe; oluvannyuma, otuwe ffe, otusonyiwe ffe, otukulembere ffe, otulokole ffe. Isomo lino lya mugaso okusinga bwe tulowooza. Mu kusinza okw’amazima, Kitaffe ateekwa okusooka, ateekwa okuba byonna. Gye nkoma okwanguwa okuyiga okwerabira nze kennyini mu kwegomba nti YE agulumizibwe, gye gukoma okugaggawala omukisa okusaba gwe kunaandeetera. Tewali n’omu yali afiiriddwa olw’ekyo kye yeefiiriza ku lwa Kitaffe. Kino kiteekwa okukwata ku kusaba kwaffe kwonna. Waliwo engeri bbiri ez’okusaba: okw’omuntu ku bubwe n’okwegayiririra abalala. Okw’okubiri kutera okutwala ekitundu ekitono ku budde n’amaanyi gaffe. Kino tekisaanidde kuba bwe kityo. Kristo yaggulawo essomero ly’okusaba okusingira ddala okutendeka abeegayirizi olw’omulimu omunene ogw’okussa wansi, olw’okukkiriza n’okusaba kwabwe, emikisa gy’omulimu gwe n’okwagala kwe ku nsi ebeetoolodde. Tewayinza kubaawo kukula kwa maanyi mu kusaba okuggyako nga kino tukifudde kigendererwa kyaffe. Omwana omuto ayinza okusaba kitaawe ekyo kyokka ky’ayetaaga ye yennyini; naye mangu ayiga okugamba nti, Mpa n’ekya mwannyinaze. Naye omwana omukulu, abeerawo ku lw’ebya kitaawe byokka era alabirira emirimu gya kitaawe, asaba bingi, era afuna byonna by’asaba. Era Yesu ayagala okututendeka mu bulamu obw’omukisa obw’okwewaayo n’okuweereza, mwe tussa ebyaffe byonna wansi w’Erinnya, n’Obwakabaka, n’Ebyo Kitaffe by’ayagala. Ayi, ka tubeerewo olw’ekyo, era ku buli kikolwa eky’okusinza, Kitaffe! wagoberewo mu mukka gwe gumu Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka Bwo, By’oyagala Ggwe;—kino kye tutunuulira waggulu era kye twegomba. ‘Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’ Linnya ki? Erinnya lino eriggya: Kitaffe. Ekigambo Mutukuvu kye kigambo ekikulu mu Ndagaano Enkadde; erinnya Kitaffe kye kikulu mu Mpya. Mu linnya lino ery’Okwagala, obutukuvu bwonna n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda kaakano biteekwa okubikkulwa. Era erinnya litukuzibwa litya? Katonda yennyini y’alitukuza: ‘Ndiraga obutukuvu bw’erinnya lyange ekkulu, erinnya lye mwavumisa.’ Okusaba kwaffe kuteekwa okuba nti mu ffe ffennyini, mu baana ba Katonda bonna, mu maaso g’ensi, Katonda yennyini abikkule obutukuvu, amaanyi ag’Obwakatonda, n’ekitiibwa ekikwekeddwa eky’erinnya Kitaffe. Omwoyo wa Kitaffe ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu: bwe twewaayo okukulemberwa Ye, olwo lwokka erinnya lwe liritukuzibwa mu kusaba kwaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe. Ka tuyige okusaba kuno: ‘Kitaffe, Erinnya Lyo litukuzibwe.’ ‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje.’ Kitaffe ye Kabaka era alina obwakabaka. Omwana era omusika wa kabaka talina kye yeegomba kisinga ekitiibwa ky’obwakabaka bwa kitaawe. Mu biseera eby’olutalo oba eby’akabi kino kifuuka kye yeegomba ennyo; tayinza kulowooza ku kirala kyonna. Abaana ba Kitaffe bali wano mu nsi y’omulabe, obwakabaka, obuli mu ggulu, gye butannalabisibwa mu bujjuvu. Kiki ekyandisinze okuba eky’obutonde okusinga nti, bwe bayiga okutukuza erinnya Kitaffe, beegomba era ne bakaaba n’obunyiikivu bungi: ‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje.’ Okujja kw’obwakabaka kye kintu ekimu ekikulu okubikkulwa kw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, omukisa gw’abaana be, n’obulokozi bw’ensi kwe byesigamye. Era n’okujja kw’obwakabaka kulindirira okusaba kwaffe. Tetulyegatta ku kukaaba okw’okwegomba okw’ennyo okw’abanunule: ‘Obwakabaka bwo bujje’? Ka tukuyigire mu ssomero lya Yesu. ‘By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu.’ Okusaba kuno emirundi mingi nnyo kutwalibwa nti kukwata ku kugumira by’ayagala Katonda kwokka. Mu ggulu by’ayagala Katonda bikolebwa, era Omusomesa ayigiriza omwana okusaba nti by’ayagala bikolebwe mu nsi nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu: mu mwoyo ogw’okwewombeeka okw’okusinza n’obuwulize obwangu. Kubanga by’ayagala Katonda kye kitiibwa ky’eggulu, okubikola gwe mukisa gw’eggulu. Nga by’ayagala bwe bikolebwa, obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bujja mu mutima. Era buli okukkiriza we kukkirizza okwagala kwa Kitaffe, obuwulize bukkiriza by’ayagala Kitaffe. Okwewaayo eri, n’okusaba olw’obulamu obw’obuwulize obufaanana n’obw’omu ggulu, gwe mwoyo gw’okusaba okw’abaana. ‘Otuwenga emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku.’ Omwana bw’amala okwewaayo eri Kitaffe mu kufaayo ku Linnya lye, ku Bwakabaka bwe, ne ku By’ayagala, aba n’eddembe lyonna okusaba emmere ye eya buli lunaku. Omwami alabirira emmere y’omuddu we, omuduumizi alabirira abasirikale be, kitaawe w’omwana alabirira omwana we. Era Kitaffe ali mu ggulu talirabirira mwana eyeewaddeyo mu kusaba eri ebimukwatako? Tuyinza ddala okugamba n’obwesige bwonna nti: Kitaffe, mbeerawo ku lw’ekitiibwa kyo n’omulimu gwo; mmanyi ng’ondabirira. Okwewaayo eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala kuwa eddembe ery’ekitalo mu kusaba olw’ebintu by’ensi eno: obulamu bwonna obw’oku nsi buba buweereddwayo mu kulabirira kwa Kitaffe okw’okwagala. ‘Tusonyiwe ebyonoono byaffe nga naffe bwe tusonyiwa abatwonoona.’ Nga emmere bw’eri ekyetaago ekisooka eky’omubiri, bwe kutyo n’okusonyiyibwa bwe kuli eri emmeeme. Era nga bwe tukakasa okuweebwa ekimu, bwe tutyo bwe tukakasa n’ekirala. Tuli baana naye era tuli boonoonyi; eddembe lyaffe ery’okutuuka mu maaso ga Kitaffe tulifuna lwa musaayi ogw’omuwendo n’okusonyiyibwa gwe gwatufunira. Ka twegendereze okusaba okw’okusonyiyibwa kuleme kufuuka mukolo bukolo: ekyo kyokka ekyatulwa ddala kye kisonyiyibwa ddala. Ka tukkirize mu kukkiriza okusonyiyibwa nga bwe kwasuubizibwa: ng’ekintu eky’amazima eky’omwoyo, ng’ekikolwa ekyennyini wakati wa Katonda naffe, kwe kuyingira mu kwagala kwonna okwa Kitaffe ne mu nkizo zonna ez’abaana. Okusonyiyibwa ng’okwo, ng’ekintu kye tulaba mu bulamu, tekusoboka nga tetulina mwoyo gwa kusonyiwa balala: nga okusonyiyibwa bwe kulaga enkolagana y’omwana wa Katonda eri eggulu, bwe kutyo okusonyiwa bwe kulaga enkolagana ye eri ensi. Mu buli kusaba eri Kitaffe nteekwa okusobola okugamba nti simanyi muntu n’omu gwe saagala n’omutima gwange gwonna. ‘Totuganya kukemebwa naye tulokole eri omubi.’ Emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku, okusonyiyibwa ebibi byaffe, n’oluvannyuma okukuumibwa obutayingira mu kibi kyonna n’obuyinza bw’omubi: mu kusaba kuno okusatu mwe mutwaliddwa ebyetaago byaffe byonna eby’omuntu ku bubwe. Okusaba olw’emmere n’olw’okusonyiyibwa kuteekwa okugenda awamu n’okwewaayo okubeera mu buwulize obutukuvu mu byonna eri by’ayagala Kitaffe, n’okusaba okw’okukkiriza mu buli kimu tukuumibwe amaanyi g’Omwoyo abeera mu ffe okuva mu buyinza bw’omubi. Abaana ba Katonda! bwe kityo Yesu bw’ayagala tusabenga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Ayi, Erinnya lye, n’Obwakabaka bwe, ne By’ayagala, bifune ekifo ekisooka mu kwagala kwaffe; okwagala kwe okutugabira, okutusonyiwa n’okutukuuma kujja kuba mugabo gwaffe ogukakafu. Bwe kityo okusaba kuno kunaatutuusa ku bulamu obw’obwana obw’amazima: Kitaffe byonna eri omwana, Kitaffe byonna ku lw’omwana. Tujja kutegeera nga Kitaffe n’omwana, Ebibyo n’Ebyaffe, bwe biri ekintu kimu, era nga omutima ogutandika okusaba kwagwo n’EBIBYO ebyewaddeyo eri Katonda, gujja kuba n’amaanyi mu kukkiriza okwogera ne EBYAFFE. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo kujja kuba ddala okussa ekimu n’okuwaanyisiganya okwagala, nga bulijjo kutuzza mu bwesige ne mu kusinza eri Oyo atali Lubereberye kyokka wabula n’Enkomerero: ‘KUBANGA OBWAKABAKA BWE BWO, N’AMAANYI, N’EKITIIBWA, EMIREMBE N’EMIREMBE, AMIINA.’ Mwana wa Kitaffe, tuyigirize okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Ayi Ggwe Omwana omu yekka eyazaalibwa, tuyigirize, tukwegayiridde, okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’ Tukwebaza, Mukama, olw’Ebigambo bino Ebiramu era Eby’Omukisa by’otuwadde. Tukwebaza olw’obukadde n’obukadde bw’abantu abaabiyigiramu okumanya n’okusinza Kitaffe, n’olw’ebyo bye babadde gye tuli. Mukama! kiringa twetaaga ennaku ne wiiki nnyingi mu ssomero lyo ku buli kusaba kwa kinnakwo; kubanga kwa buziba nnyo era kujjuvu nnyo. Naye tutunuulira Ggwe okututwala mu makulu gaakwo agasinga obuziba: kikole, tukwegayiridde, ku lw’Erinnya lyo; Erinnya lyo ye Mwana wa Kitaffe. Mukama! Wali ogambye nti: ‘Tewali amanyi Kitange wabula Omwana awamu n’abo Omwana b’asiima okubamubikkulira.’ Era nate: ‘Mbayigirizza ne bamanya erinnya lyo, era nzija kwongera okubamanyisa okwagala kwo kw’onjagala, kulyoke kubeerenga mu bo.’ Mukama Yesu! tubikkulire Kitaffe. Erinnya lye, okwagala kwe okutaliiko kkomo nga Kitaffe, okwagala kwe yakwagala, nga bwe wasaba, KUBEERE MU FFE. Olwo tunaayogera bulungi nti, ‘KITAFFE!’ Olwo tunaategeera okuyigiriza kwo, era omukka ogusooka omutima gwaffe gwe gunaassa awatali kuwalirizibwa gujja kuba: ‘Kitaffe, Erinnya Lyo, Obwakabaka bwo, By’oyagala.’ Era tunaaleetanga ebyetaago byaffe n’ebibi byaffe n’okukemebwa kwaffe gy’ali nga tukakasa nti okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’engeri eyo kulabirira byonna. Mukama Omutendereze! tuli bayizi bo, tukwesiga; tuyigirize okusaba, ‘KITAFFE.’ Amiina.

fields.title: Obukakafu bw’Okuddibwamu kw’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
‘Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo. Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo,’—Matayo 7:7-8.

‘Era ne bwe mubisaba, temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu.’—Yakobo 4:3.

MUKAMA waffe wano, mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, akomawo omulundi ogwokubiri okwogera ku kusaba. Omulundi ogwasooka yali ayogedde ku Kitaffe asangibwa mu kyama era asasula mu lwatu, n’atuwa n’okusaba okw’ekyokulabirako (Matayo 6:5-15). Wano ayagala okutuyigiriza ekyo Ebyawandiikibwa byonna kye bitwala ng’ekikulu mu kusaba: obukakafu nti okusaba kujja kuwulirwa era kuddibwemu. Weetegereze engeri gy’akozesaamu ebigambo ebitegeeza kumpi ekintu kye kimu, era buli mulundi n’addamu ekisuubizo kyennyini mu ngeri ennyonnyofu bw’eti: ‘Munaaweebwa, munaazuula, munaggulirwawo;’ n’oluvannyuma n’awa etteeka ly’obwakabaka ng’omusingi gw’obukakafu obwo: ‘Buli asaba, aweebwa; anoonya, azuula; akonkona, aggulirwawo.’ Tetuyinza butawulira nti mu kuddiŋŋana kuno emirundi mukaaga ayagala okusimba wansi ennyo mu mitima gyaffe amazima gano gamu: nti tuyinza era tuteekwa okusuubira n’obwesige bwonna nti okusaba kwaffe kujja kuddibwamu. Oluvannyuma lw’okubikkulirwa kw’okwagala kwa Kitaffe, mu ssomero lyonna ery’okusaba temuli ssomo likulu okusinga lino: Buli asaba aweebwa.

Mu bigambo ebisatu Mukama by’akozesa, saba, noonya, konkona, abamu banoonyezza mu byo enjawulo mu makulu. Obanga ddala ekyo kye yali agenderera, kale ekisooka, SABA, kikwata ku birabo bye tusaba. Naye nnyinza okusaba ne nfuna ekirabo nga sifunye Agaba. NOONYA kye kigambo Ebyawandiikibwa kye bikozesa ku Katonda yennyini; Kristo ankakasa nti nnyinza okuzuula Ye yennyini. Naye tekimala kuzuula Katonda mu kiseera eky’obwetaavu nga totuuse ku kussa ekimu naye okw’olubeerera: KONKONA kyogera ku kukkirizibwa okuyingira okubeera naye era mu Ye. Bwe kityo okusaba n’okufuna ekirabo kwandituusizza ku kunoonya n’okuzuula Agaba, ate ekyo ne kituusa ku kukonkona n’okuggulirwawo oluggi lw’ennyumba ya Kitaffe n’okwagala kwe. Ekintu kimu kikakafu: Mukama ayagala ddala tukwesigire ddala nti okusaba, okunoonya n’okukonkona tebiyinza kuba bwereere: okuddibwamu, okuzuula Katonda, omutima n’ennyumba ya Katonda ebiggule, bye bibala ebikakafu eby’okusaba.

Okuba nti Mukama yalaba nga kyetaagisa okuddiŋŋana amazima gano mu ngeri nnyingi bwe zityo, lye ssomo ery’amakulu amazito. Kiraga nti amanyi omutima gwaffe: engeri okubuusabuusa n’obuteesiga Katonda gye bitujjira mu buzaaliranwa, n’engeri gye twanguwa okumatira n’okusaba ng’omulimu gw’eddiini awatali kuddibwamu. Amanyi era nti, ne bwe tukkiriza nti Katonda y’Awulira okusaba, okusaba okw’okukkiriza okunyweza ekisuubizo kintu kya mwoyo, ekigulumivu era ekizibu ennyo eri omuyigirizwa ow’omutima ogw’ebitundu. Noolwekyo ku ntandikwa ddala ey’okuyigiriza kwe eri abo abaagala okuyiga okusaba, anoonya okusimba amazima gano wansi mu mitima gyabwe: okusaba kubeera n’obuyinza bungi; musabe munaaweebwa; buli asaba aweebwa. Lino lye tteeka ly’obwakabaka eritakyuka era ery’emirembe gyonna: bw’osaba n’otofuna, kiteekwa kuba nti waliwo ekikyamu oba ekibulamu mu kusaba. Gumiikiriza; leka Ekigambo n’Omwoyo bikuyigirize okusaba obulungi, naye toleka bwesige bw’ayagala okuzuukusa: Buli asaba aweebwa.

‘Musabe, munaaweebwa.’ Kristo talina kikubiriza kya maanyi kusinga kino eky’okunyiikira mu kusaba mu ssomero lye. Ng’omwana bw’ateekwa okukakasa nti okubala kwe kutuufu, bwe kityo n’ekiraga nti tusabye bulungi kwe kuddibwamu. Bwe tusaba ne tutafuna, kiba kubanga tetunnayiga kusaba bulungi. Kale buli muyizi mu ssomero lya Kristo akkirize ekigambo ky’Omusomesa nga bwe kiri, mu bwesimbu bwonna: Buli asaba aweebwa. Yalina ensonga ennungi okwogera bw’atyo awatali kakwakkulizo. Twekuume obutanafuya Kigambo n’amagezi gaffe ag’obuntu. Bw’atubuulira eby’omu ggulu, tumukkirize: Ekigambo kye kijja kwenyonnyola kyokka eri oyo akikkiriza mu bujjuvu. Ebibuuzo n’ebizibu bwe bijja, tuleme kunoonya kubimalawo nga tetunnakkiriza Kigambo. Nedda; byonna tubimukwase: kye kikye okubigonjoola; omulimu gwaffe kwe kusooka okukkiriza mu bujjuvu n’okunyweza ekisuubizo kye. Mu kisenge kyaffe eky’omunda, ne mu kisenge eky’omunda eky’omutima gwaffe, Ekigambo kino kiwandiikibwe mu nnukuta ez’ekitangaala: Buli asaba aweebwa.

Okusinziira ku kuyigiriza kuno okw’Omusomesa, okusaba kulina ebitundu bibiri, enjuyi bbiri: olw’omuntu n’olwa Katonda. Olw’omuntu kwe kusaba, olwa Katonda kwe kuwa. Oba, bwe tubitunuulira byombi ku ludda lw’omuntu, waliwo okusaba n’okufuna—ebitundu ebibiri ebikola ekimu ekijjuvu. Kiringa ayagala okutubuulira nti tetulina kuwummula nga tetunnaddibwamu, kubanga ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala, lye tteeka mu maka ga Kitaffe: buli kusaba okw’obwana era okw’okukkiriza kuddibwamu. Bwe watabaawo kuddibwamu, tetulina kutuula mu bugayaavu obwefuula okugondera, ne tulowooza nti Katonda tayagala kuddamu. Nedda; mu kusaba muteekwa okubaamu ekitali nga Katonda bw’ayagala kibeere, eky’obwana era eky’okukkiriza; tuteekwa okunoonya ekisa okusaba mu ngeri okuddibwamu mwe kuyinza okujjira. Kyangu nnyo eri omubiri okugondera awatali kuddibwamu okusinga okwewaayo okukeberebwa n’okutukuzibwa Omwoyo, okutuusa lwe guyize okusaba okusaba okw’okukkiriza.

Kye kimu ku bubonero obw’entiisa obw’obulwadde obuli mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo mu nnaku zino, nti bangi nnyo bamatira nga tebalina kumanya kwa ddala okw’okuddibwamu okusaba. Basaba buli lunaku, basaba ebintu bingi, era beesiga nti ebimu ku byo binaawulirwa, naye bamanyi kitono ku kuddibwamu okw’olwatu era okutegeerekeka ng’etteeka ly’obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Ate kino Kitaffe ky’ayagala: anoonya okussa ekimu n’abaana be buli lunaku ng’abawuliriza era ng’abawa bye basaba. Ayagala nzije gy’ali buli lunaku n’okusaba okutegeerekeka; ayagala buli lunaku ankolere kye nsaba. Abatukuvu ab’edda baayiga okumanya Katonda ng’Omulamu nga bayita mu kuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwabwe, ne bakubirizibwa okutendereza n’okwagala (Zabbuli 34; 66:19; 116:1). Omuyigiriza waffe alindirira okukisimba mu mitima gyaffe: okusaba n’okuddibwamu kwakwo, omwana ng’asaba ne kitaawe ng’awa, bigendera wamu.

Wayinza okubaawo embeera ng’okuddibwamu kwe kugaanibwa, kubanga ekisabibwa tekituukagana na Kigambo kya Katonda, nga Musa bwe yasaba okuyingira Kanani. Naye era waliwo okuddibwamu: Katonda teyaleka muddu we mu kubuusabuusa ku by’ayagala. Bakatonda b’amawanga bakasiru era tebayinza kwogera. Kitaffe amanyisa omwana we bw’atayinza kumuwa ky’asaba, n’omwana n’aggyayo okusaba kwe, ng’Omwana bwe yakola mu Gesusemane. Musa omuddu ne Kristo Omwana bombi baamanya nti kye baali basaba tekyali nga Mukama bwe yali ayogedde: okusaba kwabwe kwali kwegayirira okw’obuwombeefu oba nga tekisoboka ekyasalibwawo okukyusibwa. Katonda ajja kuyigiriza abo abayigirizika era abamuwa ebbanga, ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye n’Omwoyo we, oba kye basaba kituukagana n’ebyo by’ayagala oba nedda. Tuggyeyo okusaba kwaffe, bwe kiba nga tekituukagana na ndowooza ya Katonda, oba tunyiikire okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja. Okusaba kwateekebwawo okufuna okuddibwamu. Mu kusaba n’okuddibwamu kwakwo mwe mubeera okuwaanyisiganya okwagala wakati wa Kitaffe n’omwana we.

Nga omutima gwaffe guteekwa okuba nga gweyawudde nnyo ku Katonda, nti tukizuula nga kizibu nnyo okukwata ebisuubizo nga bino. Ne bwe tukkiriza ebigambo era ne tukkiriza amazima gaabyo, okukkiriza okw’omutima, okubirina mu bujjuvu ne kubisanyukira, kujja mpola nnyo. Kiri bwe kityo kubanga obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo bukyali bunafu nnyo, n’obusobozi bw’okutwala ebirowoozo bya Katonda tebulina maanyi. Naye katutunuulire Yesu atuyigirize nga tewali mulala ayinza kuyigiriza nga Ye. Bwe tukkiriza ebigambo bye mu bwesimbu, ne tumwesiga okubifuula mu ffe obulamu n’amaanyi ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, bijja kuyingira bwe bityo munda mu ffe, amazima ga Katonda ag’omwoyo ge birimu ne gatwefuga ddala, era tetugenda kumatira okutuusa buli kusaba kwe tuwaayo nga kusitulibwa okugenda mu ggulu ku bigambo bya Yesu yennyini: ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa.’

Abayigirizwa bannange mu ssomero lya Yesu! twemalire ku kuyiga essomo lino obulungi. Tukwate ebigambo bino nga bwe byayogerwa. Tuleme kukkiriza magezi ga buntu kunafuya maanyi gaabyo. Tubikwate nga Yesu bw’abituwa, tubikkirize. Ajja kutuyigiriza mu kiseera ekituufu okubitegeera mu bujjuvu: katutandike n’okubikkiriza awatali kubuusabuusa. Tuwengayo obudde, buli lwe tusaba, okuwuliriza eddoboozi lye: Buli asaba aweebwa. Tunoonye, si mu biseera byaffe eby’okusaba byokka, naye mu biseera byonna, okunyweza obukakafu obw’essanyu: okusaba kw’omuntu ku nsi n’okuddamu kwa Katonda mu ggulu byategekebwa okugendera wamu. Twesige Yesu atuyigirize okusaba bwe tutyo okuddibwamu kulyoke kusobole okujja. Ajja kukikola, bwe tunaanyweza ekigambo ky’atuwa leero: ‘Musabe, mujja kuweebwa.’

Ayi Mukama Yesu! nnyigiriza okutegeera n’okukkiriza ky’onsuubizza kaakano. Tekikukwekeddwa, Ayi Mukama wange, n’empaka ki omutima gwange ze gunoonya okwematiza nazo, nga sifunye kuddibwamu. Waliwo ekirowoozo nti okusaba kwange tekukwatagana na kuteesa kwa Kitaffe okw’ekyama; nti oboolyawo waliwo ekisingako obulungi ky’oyagala okumpa; oba nti okusaba ng’okussa ekimu ne Katonda gwe mukisa ogumala awatali kuddibwamu. Naye, Mukama wange Omutendereze, nsanga mu kuyigiriza kwo ku kusaba nga toyogera ku bintu bino, wabula wagamba lwatu ddala nti okusaba kuyinza era kuteekwa okusuubira okuddibwamu. Otukakasa nti kuno kwe kussa ekimu kw’omwana ne Kitaffe: omwana asaba ne Kitaffe n’awa.

Mukama Omutendereze! Ebigambo byo byesigwa era bya mazima. Kiteekwa okuba nti olw’okuba nsaba bubi, kyenva sirina bukakafu bulungi bwa kuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwange. Kiteekwa okuba nti olw’okuba mbeera kitono nnyo mu Mwoyo, okusaba kwange kwe kuva kubeera kitono mu Mwoyo, n’amaanyi g’okusaba okw’okukkiriza ne gabula.

Mukama! nnyigiriza okusaba. Mukama Yesu! nkwesiga olw’ekyo; nnyigiriza okusaba mu kukkiriza. Mukama! nnyigiriza essomo lino erya leero: Buli asaba aweebwa. Amiina.
fields.body_text: ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo. Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo,’—Matayo 7:7-8. ‘Era ne bwe mubisaba, temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu.’—Yakobo 4:3. MUKAMA waffe wano, mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, akomawo omulundi ogwokubiri okwogera ku kusaba. Omulundi ogwasooka yali ayogedde ku Kitaffe asangibwa mu kyama era asasula mu lwatu, n’atuwa n’okusaba okw’ekyokulabirako (Matayo 6:5-15). Wano ayagala okutuyigiriza ekyo Ebyawandiikibwa byonna kye bitwala ng’ekikulu mu kusaba: obukakafu nti okusaba kujja kuwulirwa era kuddibwemu. Weetegereze engeri gy’akozesaamu ebigambo ebitegeeza kumpi ekintu kye kimu, era buli mulundi n’addamu ekisuubizo kyennyini mu ngeri ennyonnyofu bw’eti: ‘Munaaweebwa, munaazuula, munaggulirwawo;’ n’oluvannyuma n’awa etteeka ly’obwakabaka ng’omusingi gw’obukakafu obwo: ‘Buli asaba, aweebwa; anoonya, azuula; akonkona, aggulirwawo.’ Tetuyinza butawulira nti mu kuddiŋŋana kuno emirundi mukaaga ayagala okusimba wansi ennyo mu mitima gyaffe amazima gano gamu: nti tuyinza era tuteekwa okusuubira n’obwesige bwonna nti okusaba kwaffe kujja kuddibwamu. Oluvannyuma lw’okubikkulirwa kw’okwagala kwa Kitaffe, mu ssomero lyonna ery’okusaba temuli ssomo likulu okusinga lino: Buli asaba aweebwa. Mu bigambo ebisatu Mukama by’akozesa, saba, noonya, konkona, abamu banoonyezza mu byo enjawulo mu makulu. Obanga ddala ekyo kye yali agenderera, kale ekisooka, SABA, kikwata ku birabo bye tusaba. Naye nnyinza okusaba ne nfuna ekirabo nga sifunye Agaba. NOONYA kye kigambo Ebyawandiikibwa kye bikozesa ku Katonda yennyini; Kristo ankakasa nti nnyinza okuzuula Ye yennyini. Naye tekimala kuzuula Katonda mu kiseera eky’obwetaavu nga totuuse ku kussa ekimu naye okw’olubeerera: KONKONA kyogera ku kukkirizibwa okuyingira okubeera naye era mu Ye. Bwe kityo okusaba n’okufuna ekirabo kwandituusizza ku kunoonya n’okuzuula Agaba, ate ekyo ne kituusa ku kukonkona n’okuggulirwawo oluggi lw’ennyumba ya Kitaffe n’okwagala kwe. Ekintu kimu kikakafu: Mukama ayagala ddala tukwesigire ddala nti okusaba, okunoonya n’okukonkona tebiyinza kuba bwereere: okuddibwamu, okuzuula Katonda, omutima n’ennyumba ya Katonda ebiggule, bye bibala ebikakafu eby’okusaba. Okuba nti Mukama yalaba nga kyetaagisa okuddiŋŋana amazima gano mu ngeri nnyingi bwe zityo, lye ssomo ery’amakulu amazito. Kiraga nti amanyi omutima gwaffe: engeri okubuusabuusa n’obuteesiga Katonda gye bitujjira mu buzaaliranwa, n’engeri gye twanguwa okumatira n’okusaba ng’omulimu gw’eddiini awatali kuddibwamu. Amanyi era nti, ne bwe tukkiriza nti Katonda y’Awulira okusaba, okusaba okw’okukkiriza okunyweza ekisuubizo kintu kya mwoyo, ekigulumivu era ekizibu ennyo eri omuyigirizwa ow’omutima ogw’ebitundu. Noolwekyo ku ntandikwa ddala ey’okuyigiriza kwe eri abo abaagala okuyiga okusaba, anoonya okusimba amazima gano wansi mu mitima gyabwe: okusaba kubeera n’obuyinza bungi; musabe munaaweebwa; buli asaba aweebwa. Lino lye tteeka ly’obwakabaka eritakyuka era ery’emirembe gyonna: bw’osaba n’otofuna, kiteekwa kuba nti waliwo ekikyamu oba ekibulamu mu kusaba. Gumiikiriza; leka Ekigambo n’Omwoyo bikuyigirize okusaba obulungi, naye toleka bwesige bw’ayagala okuzuukusa: Buli asaba aweebwa. ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa.’ Kristo talina kikubiriza kya maanyi kusinga kino eky’okunyiikira mu kusaba mu ssomero lye. Ng’omwana bw’ateekwa okukakasa nti okubala kwe kutuufu, bwe kityo n’ekiraga nti tusabye bulungi kwe kuddibwamu. Bwe tusaba ne tutafuna, kiba kubanga tetunnayiga kusaba bulungi. Kale buli muyizi mu ssomero lya Kristo akkirize ekigambo ky’Omusomesa nga bwe kiri, mu bwesimbu bwonna: Buli asaba aweebwa. Yalina ensonga ennungi okwogera bw’atyo awatali kakwakkulizo.
