Bwe watabaawo kuddibwamu, tetulina kutuula mu bugayaavu obwefuula okugondera, ne tulowooza nti Katonda tayagala kuddamu. Nedda; mu kusaba muteekwa okubaamu ekitali nga Katonda bw’ayagala kibeere, eky’obwana era eky’okukkiriza; tuteekwa okunoonya ekisa okusaba mu ngeri okuddibwamu mwe kuyinza okujjira. Kyangu nnyo eri omubiri okugondera awatali kuddibwamu okusinga okwewaayo okukeberebwa n’okutukuzibwa Omwoyo, okutuusa lwe guyize okusaba okusaba okw’okukkiriza. Kye kimu ku bubonero obw’entiisa obw’obulwadde obuli mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo mu nnaku zino, nti bangi nnyo bamatira nga tebalina kumanya kwa ddala okw’okuddibwamu okusaba. Ate kino Kitaffe ky’ayagala: anoonya okussa ekimu n’abaana be buli lunaku ng’abawuliriza era ng’abawa bye basaba. Ayagala nzije gy’ali buli lunaku n’okusaba okutegeerekeka; ayagala buli lunaku ankolere kye nsaba. Abatukuvu ab’edda baayiga okumanya Katonda ng’Omulamu nga bayita mu kuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwabwe, ne bakubirizibwa okutendereza n’okwagala (Zabbuli 34; 66:19; 116:1). fields.title: Obukitaawe bwa Katonda Obutaliiko Kkomo
fields.body_html:
‘Oba muntu ki mu mmwe singa omwana we amusaba omugaati, ayinza okumuwa ejjinja? Oba singa asabye ekyennyanja, kitaawe ayinza okumuwa omusota? Obanga mmwe abantu ababi musobola okuwa abaana bammwe ebirabo ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisingawo okubawa ebirungi bye mumusaba?’—Matayo 7:9-11

MU bigambo bino Mukama waffe yeeyongera okukakasa kye yali ayogedde ku kukakafu nti okusaba kuddibwamu. Okuggyawo okubuusabuusa kwonna, n’okutulaga omusingi omunywevu ekisuubizo kye kwe kyesigamye, ajulira ku ebyo buli muntu by’alabye era by’ayiseemu wano ku nsi. Ffenna tuli baana, era tumanyi kye twasuubiranga okuva eri bakitaffe. Tuli bazadde, oba tubalaba buli kiseera; era buli wamu tukitwala ng’ekintu ekisinga okuba eky’obutonde, kitaawe w’omwana okuwulira omwana we. Era Mukama atusaba okuyimusa amaaso okuva ku bazadde ab’oku nsi, abo abasinga obulungi nabo nga babi, tubalirire OKUSINGAWO ENNYO bwe kutyo Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu bw’aliwa ebirabo ebirungi abo abamusaba. Yesu ayagala okututwala waggulu tulabe nti nga Katonda bw’asinga omuntu omwonoonyi obukulu, bwe kutyo bwe kusinga obunene obukakafu bwaffe nti ajja kutuwa bye tumusaba ng’abaana okusinga kitaawe yenna ow’oku nsi. Nga Katonda bw’asinga omuntu obukulu, bwe kutyo bwe kisinga okukakasibwa nti okusaba kuwulirwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu okusinga kitaawe w’omwana ow’oku nsi.

Olugero luno nga bwe luli olwangu era olutegeerekeka, n’enjigiriza gye lulimu bw’etyo bw’eri ey’ebuziba era ey’omwoyo. Mukama ayagala okutujjukiza nti okusaba kw’omwana amaanyi gaakwo gonna gava mu nkolagana gy’alina ne kitaawe. Okusaba kuyinza okuba n’amaanyi ago kasita omwana ddala abeera mu nkolagana eyo: mu maka, mu kwagala, ne mu buweereza bwa kitaawe. Amaanyi g’ekisuubizo nti, ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa,’ gali mu nkolagana ey’okwagala wakati waffe ng’abaana ne Kitaffe ali mu ggulu; bwe tubeera era ne tutambulira mu nkolagana eyo, okusaba okw’okukkiriza n’okuddibwamu kwakwo bijjirawo byokka. Noolwekyo essomo lye tufuna leero mu ssomero ly’okusaba lye lino: Beeranga ng’omwana wa Katonda, olwo onoosobola okusaba ng’omwana, era ng’omwana tolema kuwulirwa.

Kale obulamu bw’omwana obw’amazima bwe buliwa? Okuddibwamu kuyinza okulabibwa mu maka gonna. Omwana alondawo okuleka ennyumba ya kitaawe, atasanyukira kubeera ne kitaawe, n’okumwagala, n’okumugondera, naye n’alowooza nti ayinza okusaba n’afuna ky’ayagala, ddala ajja kuggwamu essuubi. Wabula oyo okwogera ne kitaawe, n’okwagala kwe, n’ekitiibwa kye n’okukola by’ayagala bye bimuleetera essanyu mu bulamu, ajja kukizuula nti kitaawe asanyuka okumuwa by’asaba. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, ‘Abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda:’ enkizo y’abaana ey’okusaba byonna teyawukana ku bulamu bw’abaana obukulemberwa Omwoyo. Oyo eyeewaayo okukulemberwa Omwoyo mu bulamu bwe, ajja kumukulembera ne mu kusaba kwe. Era ajja kukizuula nti okugaba okw’obukitaawe kwe kuddamu kwa Katonda eri obulamu obw’omwana.

Okulaba obulamu buno obw’omwana bwe buli, okusaba n’okukkiriza okw’omwana mwe bisimbye emirandira, twetaaga kwetegereza bye Mukama waffe ayigiriza mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi ebikwata ku Kitaffe n’abaana be. Omwo ebisuubizo by’okusaba biteekeddwa wakati mu biragiro by’obulamu; byombi tebyawukana. Bikola ekintu kimu; era oyo yekka ayinza okwesiga okutuukirizibwa kw’ekisuubizo, akkiriza ne byonna Mukama bye yakigatta nabyo. Kiba nga, bw’ayogera ekigambo nti, ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa,’ agamba nti: Ebisuubizo bino mbiwa abo be nnyogeddeko mu birabo by’omukisa mu bwavu n’obulongoofu bwabwe obw’abaana, era be nnagambyeko nti, ‘Baliyitibwa baana ba Katonda’ (Matayo 5:3-9): eri abaana abagambibwa nti ‘ebikolwa byammwe ebirungi byakirenga abantu bonna, babirabenga, bagulumize Kitammwe ali mu ggulu:’ eri abo abatambulira mu kwagala, ‘bwe mulikola bwe mutyo muliba baana ba Kitammwe ali mu ggulu,’ era abanoonya okuba abatuukirivu ‘nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw’ali Omutuukirivu’ (5:45): eri abo okusiiba kwabwe n’okusaba kwabwe n’okugaba kwabwe (6:1-18) tebiri mu maaso g’abantu, wabula ‘mu maaso ga Kitaawo ali mu ggulu era alaba mu kyama;’ abasonyiwa ‘nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw’abasonyiwa’ (6:15); abeesiga Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu mu buli kwetaaga kw’oku nsi, nga basooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe (6:26-32); abatagamba bugambi nti, Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, wabula abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala (7:21). Abo be baana ba Kitaffe, era obwo bwe bulamu mu kwagala ne mu buweereza bwa Kitaffe; mu bulamu obw’omwana obw’engeri eyo okusaba kuddibwamu mu bukakafu era mu bungi.

Naye enjigiriza ng’eyo tegenda kumalamu maanyi omunafu? Bwe tuba nga tulina okusooka okufaanana ekifaananyi kino eky’omwana, bangi tebateekwa kuggwamu ssuubi lyonna ery’okuddibwamu okusaba? Obuzibu buggwaawo bwe tuddamu okulowooza ku mannya ag’omukisa aga kitaawe n’omwana. Omwana munafu; abaana baawukana nnyo mu myaka ne mu birabo. Mukama tatusaba kutuukiriza mateeka mu bujjuvu; nedda, wabula okwewaayo okw’omwana n’omutima gwonna okubeera naye ng’omwana mu buwulize ne mu mazima. Tewali kirala kisingawo. Omuntu yenna ka atandike mu bwangu n’amazima okusoma Okubuulira ku Lusozi n’akufuula omulagirizi we mu bulamu, era ajja kusanga, wadde nga waliwo obunafu n’okulemererwa, eddembe eryeyongera buli lukya okusaba okutuukirizibwa kw’ebisuubizo byakwo ebikwata ku kusaba. Mu mannya ga kitaawe n’omwana alina omusingo nti by’asaba bijja kumuweebwa.

Eno y’ensonga enkulu emu Yesu gy’anyweza wano, era gy’ayagala abayizi be bonna bategeere. Ayagala tulabe nti ekyama ky’okusaba okulimu amaanyi kiri mu kino: omutima okujjula okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe. Tekimala ffe okumanya nti Katonda Kitaffe: ayagala twewe obudde, amakulu gonna erinnya eryo ge lirimu gatukwateko ddala. Tuteekwa okulowooza ku kitaawe w’abaana asinga obulungi gwe tumanyi; tuteekwa okulowooza ku bukkakkamu n’okwagala by’atunuuliza ekyo omwana we ky’amusaba, okwagala n’essanyu by’amuwa nabyo buli kyagala kye eky’amagezi; olwo, nga tulowooza mu kusinza ku Kwagala n’Obukitaawe bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo, tulowooze obukkakkamu n’essanyu ebisingawo ennyo Ye by’atulaba nabyo nga tujja gy’ali, n’atuwa bye tumusaba mu ngeri entuufu. Era olwo, bwe tulaba engeri okubalirira kuno okwa Katonda gye kusukkiramu okutegeera kwaffe, ne tuwulira nga bwe kitasoboka ffe okutegeera Katonda bw’ayagala ennyo okutuwulira, ayagala tujje tuggulewo omutima gwaffe Omwoyo Omutukuvu agujjuzemu okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe. Ka tukole kino si mu kiseera kyokka bwe twagala okusaba, naye ka tuwaayo omutima n’obulamu okubeera mu kwagala okwo. Omwana ayagala okumanya okwagala kwa kitaawe lw’aba alina ky’asaba kyokka, ajja kuggwamu essuubi. Naye oyo aleka Katonda okuba Kitaffe bulijjo ne mu buli kintu, ayagala okumalira obulamu bwe bwonna mu maaso ga Kitaffe ne mu kwagala kwe, aleka Katonda mu bukulu bwonna obw’okwagala kwe okumubeerera Kitaffe, oh! ajja kulaba mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa ennyo nti obulamu mu Bukitaawe bwa Katonda obutaliiko kkomo n’okuddibwamu okusaba buli kiseera tebyawukana.

Muyizi munnange omwagalwa! tutandika okulaba ensonga lwaki tumanyi kitono nnyo ku kuddibwamu okusaba buli lunaku, n’essomo erisinga obukulu Mukama ly’atulinako mu ssomero lye. Byonna biri mu linnya lya Kitaffe. Twalowooza nti kye tujja okufuna mu ssomero lya Kristo kwe kutegeera okuggya era okw’ebuziba ku byama ebimu eby’ensi y’okusaba; Ye atugamba nti erisooka lye ssomo erisinga obukulu; tuteekwa okuyiga okwogera obulungi nti, ‘Aba, Kitaffe!’ ‘Kitaffe ali mu ggulu.’ Oyo ayinza okwogera kino, alina ekisumuluzo ky’okusaba kwonna. Mu kusaasira kwonna kitaawe w’abaana kw’awuliriza nakwo omwana we omunafu oba omulwadde, mu ssanyu lyonna ly’awulira nalyo omwana we akyayiga okwogera, mu bugumiikiriza bwonna obw’obukkakkamu bw’agumiikiriza nabwo omwana atafaayo, tuteekwa, nga mu ndabirwamu nnyingi, okwekenneenya omutima gwa Kitaffe, okutuusa buli kusaba lwe kunaasitulibwa waggulu ku kukkiriza mu kigambo kino ekya Katonda: ‘Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisingawo okubawa ebirungi bye mumusaba.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Mukama Omutendereze! Omanyi nti kino, wadde nga lye limu ku masomo agasooka, agasinga obwangu era agasinga ekitiibwa mu ssomero lyo, eri emitima gyaffe lye limu ku agasinga obuzibu okuyiga: tumanyi kitono nnyo ku kwagala kwa Kitaffe. Mukama! tuyigirize okubeera ne Kitaffe bwe tutyo, okwagala kwe kubeere gye tuli kumpi nnyo, kweyolefu, era kwa muwendo okusinga okwagala kwa kitaawe w’abaana yenna ow’oku nsi. Era obukakafu nti awulira okusaba kwaffe businge nnyo obwesige bwe tulina mu muzadde ow’oku nsi, nga eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, nga Katonda bw’asinga omuntu awatali kkomo. Mukama! tulage nti ekitwesuula ewala ne Kitaffe, ekitali kya mwana, kye kyokka ekiziyiza okusaba okuddibwamu, era otukulembere mu bulamu obw’amazima obw’abaana ba Katonda. Mukama Yesu! okwagala okw’obukitaawe kwe kuzuukusa obwesige obw’omwana. Ayi, tubikkulire Kitaffe, n’okwagala kwe okw’obukkakkamu era okusaasira, tulyoke tufuuke ng’abaana, tulabe nti mu bulamu obw’omwana mwe muli amaanyi g’okusaba.

Omwana wa Katonda Omutendereze! Kitaffe akwagala era yakukwasa byonna. Era naawe oyagala Kitaffe, era wakola byonna bye yakulagira, n’olwekyo olina obuyinza okusaba byonna. Mukama! tuwe Omwoyo wo wennyini, Omwoyo w’Omwana. Tufuule ng’abaana, nga bwe wali ku nsi. Era buli kusaba kwogerwe mu kukkiriza nti nga eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, bwe kutyo okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe, n’okwagala kwe okutuwa bye tusaba, bisinga byonna bye tuyinza okulowooza oba okutegeera. Amiina.

EKYONGEREZO.

‘Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.’ Woowe! tukyogerako ng’ekigambo eky’okussaamu ekitiibwa kyokka. Tukirowooza ng’ekifaananyi ekyewolebwa okuva mu bulamu obw’oku nsi, era ekiyinza okukozesebwa ku Katonda mu makulu amatono era agatali ga buziba. Tutya okutwala Katonda nga kitaffe ffennyini ow’obukkakkamu era omusaasizi. Tumutwala ng’omukulu w’essomero, oba ali ewala n’okusinga awo, era atatumanyiiko nnyo—omulambuzi, atatumanyiiko kintu kyonna okuggyako mu masomo gaffe. Amaaso ge tegali ku muyizi, wabula ku kitabo, era bonna kibagwanira okutuuka ku mutindo gwe gumu.

Kale ggulawo amatu g’omutima, ggwe omwana wa Katonda atya; kireke kikke wansi ddala mu buziba obw’omunda ennyo obw’emmeeme. Wano we wali entandikwa y’obutukuvu, mu kwagala n’obugumiikiriza n’okusaasira kwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Tetulina kuyiga kuba batukuvu ng’essomo ezzibu ku ssomero, tulyoke tuleetere Katonda okutulowoozaako obulungi; tulina kukiyigira waka nga Kitaffe atuyamba. Katonda akwagala si lwa kuba ng’oli mugezi, si lwa kuba ng’oli mulungi, wabula kubanga Ye Kitaawo. Omusaalaba gwa Kristo teguleetera Katonda kutwagala; gwe kibala n’ekipimo ky’okwagala kwe gye tuli. Ayagala abaana be bonna, abasinga okusobya, abasinga obutategeera, abasinga obubi ku baana be. Okwagala kwe kwe kuli emabega wa buli kintu, era tuteekwa okuyimirira ku ekyo ng’omusingi omugumu ogw’obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini, nga tetukula kukutuukako, wabula nga tukula nga tuva mu kwo. Tuteekwa okutandikira awo oba entandikwa yaffe tejja kuvaamu kintu. Kwata kino n’amaanyi go gonna. Tuteekwa okuva mu ffe ffennyini okufuna essuubi lyonna, oba amaanyi gonna, oba obwesige bwonna. Era essuubi ki, amaanyi ki, obwesige ki obuyinza okuba obwaffe kaakano bwe tutandikira wano, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu!

Twetaaga okuyingira mu bukkakkamu n’obuyambi ebiri mu bigambo bino, ne tubiwummuliramu—Kitammwe. Byogere gy’oli wekka emirundi mingi okutuusa ng’ekitundu ky’amazima gano ag’ekitalo tukiwulira. Kitegeeza nti nsibiddwa eri Katonda mu nkolagana esinga okuba ey’okumpi era ey’obukkakkamu; nti nnina eddembe ku kwagala kwe, n’amaanyi ge, n’omukisa gwe, nga tewali kirala kyonna kyandimpadde. Ayi, obuvumu bwe tuyinza okusembera nabwo! Ayi, ebintu ebinene bye tulina eddembe okusaba! Kitammwe. Kitegeeza nti okwagala kwe kwonna okutaliiko kkomo, n’obugumiikiriza bwe, n’amagezi ge bikutama ku nze okuyamba nze. Mu nkolagana eno temuli busobozi bwa butukuvu bwokka; mulimu ebisingawo awatali kkomo.

Wano we tulina okutandikira, mu kwagala okugumiikiriza okwa Kitaffe. Lowooza nga bw’atumanyi buli omu ku bubwe, mu mpisa zaffe zonna ez’enjawulo, ne mu bunafu bwaffe bwonna n’obuzibu bwaffe. Omukulu w’essomero asala omusango okusinziira ku bivuddemu, naye Kitaffe asala okusinziira ku kufuba. Okulemererwa si bulijjo nti kye kibi. Amanyi ebintu bye bisaasaanya, era abipima ku minzaani ng’abalala bapima buwanvu bwokka. KITAMMWE. Lowooza okwagala kwe nga bwe kutwala ng’ebikulu nnyo entandikwa ennafu ez’abato, wadde nga zirabika nga za busiru era nga tezirina makulu eri abalala. Bino byonna biri mu nkolagana eno ey’omukisa, n’ebisingawo awatali kkomo. Totya kubitwala byonna nga bibyo.

Kiggiddwa mu Thoughts on Holiness, ekya Mark Guy Pearse. Ekyo ekyogeddwa obulungi ennyo ku kumanya Obukitaawe bwa Katonda ng’entandikwa y’obutukuvu, kiri kituufu kye kimu ne ku kusaba.

Obanga mmwe abantu ababi musobola okuwa abaana bammwe ebirabo ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisingawo okubawa ebirungi bye mumusaba?’—Matayo 7:9-11 MU bigambo bino Mukama waffe yeeyongera okukakasa kye yali ayogedde ku kukakafu nti okusaba kuddibwamu. Okuggyawo okubuusabuusa kwonna, n’okutulaga omusingi omunywevu ekisuubizo kye kwe kyesigamye, ajulira ku ebyo buli muntu by’alabye era by’ayiseemu wano ku nsi. Ffenna tuli baana, era tumanyi kye twasuubiranga okuva eri bakitaffe. Tuli bazadde, oba tubalaba buli kiseera; era buli wamu tukitwala ng’ekintu ekisinga okuba eky’obutonde, kitaawe w’omwana okuwulira omwana we. Era Mukama atusaba okuyimusa amaaso okuva ku bazadde ab’oku nsi, abo abasinga obulungi nabo nga babi, tubalirire OKUSINGAWO ENNYO bwe kutyo Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu bw’aliwa ebirabo ebirungi abo abamusaba. Yesu ayagala okututwala waggulu tulabe nti nga Katonda bw’asinga omuntu omwonoonyi obukulu, bwe kutyo bwe kusinga obunene obukakafu bwaffe nti ajja kutuwa bye tumusaba ng’abaana okusinga kitaawe yenna ow’oku nsi. Nga Katonda bw’asinga omuntu obukulu, bwe kutyo bwe kisinga okukakasibwa nti okusaba kuwulirwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu okusinga kitaawe w’omwana ow’oku nsi. Olugero luno nga bwe luli olwangu era olutegeerekeka, n’enjigiriza gye lulimu bw’etyo bw’eri ey’ebuziba era ey’omwoyo. Mukama ayagala okutujjukiza nti okusaba kw’omwana amaanyi gaakwo gonna gava mu nkolagana gy’alina ne kitaawe. Okusaba kuyinza okuba n’amaanyi ago kasita omwana ddala abeera mu nkolagana eyo: mu maka, mu kwagala, ne mu buweereza bwa kitaawe. Amaanyi g’ekisuubizo nti, ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa,’ gali mu nkolagana ey’okwagala wakati waffe ng’abaana ne Kitaffe ali mu ggulu; bwe tubeera era ne tutambulira mu nkolagana eyo, okusaba okw’okukkiriza n’okuddibwamu kwakwo bijjirawo byokka. Noolwekyo essomo lye tufuna leero mu ssomero ly’okusaba lye lino: Beeranga ng’omwana wa Katonda, olwo onoosobola okusaba ng’omwana, era ng’omwana tolema kuwulirwa. Kale obulamu bw’omwana obw’amazima bwe buliwa? Okuddibwamu kuyinza okulabibwa mu maka gonna. Omwana alondawo okuleka ennyumba ya kitaawe, atasanyukira kubeera ne kitaawe, n’okumwagala, n’okumugondera, naye n’alowooza nti ayinza okusaba n’afuna ky’ayagala, ddala ajja kuggwamu essuubi. Wabula oyo okwogera ne kitaawe, n’okwagala kwe, n’ekitiibwa kye n’okukola by’ayagala bye bimuleetera essanyu mu bulamu, ajja kukizuula nti kitaawe asanyuka okumuwa by’asaba. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, ‘Abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda:’ enkizo y’abaana ey’okusaba byonna teyawukana ku bulamu bw’abaana obukulemberwa Omwoyo. Omwo ebisuubizo by’okusaba biteekeddwa wakati mu biragiro by’obulamu; byombi tebyawukana. Era buli kusaba kwogerwe mu kukkiriza nti nga eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, bwe kutyo okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obukitaawe, n’okwagala kwe okutuwa bye tusaba, bisinga byonna bye tuyinza okulowooza oba okutegeera. Amiina. EKYONGEREZO. ‘Kitammwe ali mu ggulu.’ Woowe! tukyogerako ng’ekigambo eky’okussaamu ekitiibwa kyokka. Tukirowooza ng’ekifaananyi ekyewolebwa okuva mu bulamu obw’oku nsi, era ekiyinza okukozesebwa ku Katonda mu makulu amatono era agatali ga buziba. Tutya okutwala Katonda nga kitaffe ffennyini ow’obukkakkamu era omusaasizi. Tumutwala ng’omukulu w’essomero, oba ali ewala n’okusinga awo, era atatumanyiiko nnyo—omulambuzi, atatumanyiiko kintu kyonna okuggyako mu masomo gaffe. Amaaso ge tegali ku muyizi, wabula ku kitabo, era bonna kibagwanira okutuuka ku mutindo gwe gumu. Kale ggulawo amatu g’omutima, ggwe omwana wa Katonda atya; kireke kikke wansi ddala mu buziba obw’omunda ennyo obw’emmeeme. Wano we wali entandikwa y’obutukuvu, mu kwagala n’obugumiikiriza n’okusaasira kwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Tetulina kuyiga kuba batukuvu ng’essomo ezzibu ku ssomero, tulyoke tuleetere Katonda okutulowoozaako obulungi; tulina kukiyigira waka nga Kitaffe atuyamba. Katonda akwagala si lwa kuba ng’oli mugezi, si lwa kuba ng’oli mulungi, wabula kubanga Ye Kitaawo. Omusaalaba gwa Kristo teguleetera Katonda kutwagala; gwe kibala n’ekipimo ky’okwagala kwe gye tuli. Ayagala abaana be bonna, abasinga okusobya, abasinga obutategeera, abasinga obubi ku baana be. Okwagala kwe kwe kuli emabega wa buli kintu, era tuteekwa okuyimirira ku ekyo ng’omusingi omugumu ogw’obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini, nga tetukula kukutuukako, wabula nga tukula nga tuva mu kwo. Tuteekwa okutandikira awo oba entandikwa yaffe tejja kuvaamu kintu. Kwata kino n’amaanyi go gonna. Tuteekwa okuva mu ffe ffennyini okufuna essuubi lyonna, oba amaanyi gonna, oba obwesige bwonna. Era essuubi ki, amaanyi ki, obwesige ki obuyinza okuba obwaffe kaakano bwe tutandikira wano, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu! Twetaaga okuyingira mu bukkakkamu n’obuyambi ebiri mu bigambo bino, ne tubiwummuliramu—Kitammwe. Byogere gy’oli wekka emirundi mingi okutuusa ng’ekitundu ky’amazima gano ag’ekitalo tukiwulira. Kitegeeza nti nsibiddwa eri Katonda mu nkolagana esinga okuba ey’okumpi era ey’obukkakkamu; nti nnina eddembe ku kwagala kwe, n’amaanyi ge, n’omukisa gwe, nga tewali kirala kyonna kyandimpadde. Ayi, obuvumu bwe tuyinza okusembera nabwo! Ayi, ebintu ebinene bye tulina eddembe okusaba! Kitammwe. Kitegeeza nti okwagala kwe kwonna okutaliiko kkomo, n’obugumiikiriza bwe, n’amagezi ge bikutama ku nze okuyamba nze. Mu nkolagana eno temuli busobozi bwa butukuvu bwokka; mulimu ebisingawo awatali kkomo. Wano we tulina okutandikira, mu kwagala okugumiikiriza okwa Kitaffe. Lowooza nga bw’atumanyi buli omu ku bubwe, mu mpisa zaffe zonna ez’enjawulo, ne mu bunafu bwaffe bwonna n’obuzibu bwaffe. Omukulu w’essomero asala omusango okusinziira ku bivuddemu, naye Kitaffe asala okusinziira ku kufuba. Okulemererwa si bulijjo nti kye kibi. Amanyi ebintu bye bisaasaanya, era abipima ku minzaani ng’abalala bapima buwanvu bwokka. KITAMMWE. Lowooza okwagala kwe nga bwe kutwala ng’ebikulu nnyo entandikwa ennafu ez’abato, wadde nga zirabika nga za busiru era nga tezirina makulu eri abalala. Bino byonna biri mu nkolagana eno ey’omukisa, n’ebisingawo awatali kkomo. Totya kubitwala byonna nga bibyo. Kiggiddwa mu Thoughts on Holiness, ekya Mark Guy Pearse. Ekyo ekyogeddwa obulungi ennyo ku kumanya Obukitaawe bwa Katonda ng’entandikwa y’obutukuvu, kiri kituufu kye kimu ne ku kusaba.

fields.title: Ekirabo Ekizingiramu Byonna
fields.body_html:
‘Kale obanga mmwe ababi muwa abaana bammwe ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisinga nnyo okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba?’—Lukka 11:13.

MU Kubuulira okw’oku Lusozi, Mukama yali yayogera dda ekibuuzo kye eky’ekitalo nti TALISINGA NNYO? Wano mu Lukka, w’akiddiramu, waliwo enjawulo. Mu kifo ky’okwogera ku kuwa ebirabo ebirungi nga bwe yakola olwo, agamba nti, ‘Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisinga nnyo okubawa MWOYO MUTUKUVU?’ Bw’atyo atuyigiriza nti ekisinga obukulu n’obulungi mu birabo ebyo ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu, oba okusingawo, nti mu kirabo kino mwe muzingirwa ebirala byonna. Omwoyo Omutukuvu kye kirabo kya Kitaffe ekisooka, era kye kimusanyusa okusinga okugaba. N’olwekyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu kye kirabo kye tusaanidde okusooka okunoonya n’okusinga byonna.

Omuwendo gw’ekirabo kino ogutayogerekeka tusobola okugutegeera mangu. Yesu yayogera ku Mwoyo nti ye ‘kye kisuubizo kya Kitaawe;’ ekisuubizo ekimu mwe mwalabikira obwakitaffe bwa Katonda. Ekirabo ekisinga obulungi kitaawe omulungi era ow’amagezi ky’ayinza okuwa omwana we ku nsi gwe mwoyo gwe yennyini. Kino kye kigendererwa ekikulu eky’omuzadde mu kukuza omwana—okulaba nga mu mwana we muvaamu endowooza ye n’empisa ze. Omwana bw’aba ow’okumanya n’okutegeera kitaawe; bw’aba, nga bw’akula, ow’okuyingira mu by’ayagala byonna ne mu nteekateeka ze; bw’aba ow’okufuna essanyu lye erisinga mu kitaawe, ne kitaawe mu ye,—kimugwanira okuba n’endowooza emu n’omwoyo gumu ne kitaawe. Kale tekiyinzika na kulowoozebwa nti Katonda yandiwadde omwana we ekirabo ekisinga kino, Omwoyo we yennyini. Katonda ali bw’ali olw’Omwoyo we; Omwoyo bwe bulamu bwa Katonda bwennyini. Lowooza kino kye kitegeeza—Katonda okuwa omwana we ali ku nsi Omwoyo we yennyini.

Oba kino si kye kyali ekitiibwa kya Yesu ng’Omwana ku nsi, nti Omwoyo wa Kitaawe yali mu ye? Bwe yabatizibwa mu Yoludaani ebintu ebyo ebibiri byagattibwa wamu,—eddoboozi eryamulangirira nti ye Mwana Omwagalwa, n’Omwoyo eyamukkako. Era bw’atyo omutume ayogera ku ffe nti, ‘Era kubanga tuli baana, Katonda yatuma Omwoyo w’Omwana we okubeera mu mitima gyaffe, era kaakano tuyinza okwogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, Aba, Kitaffe.’ Kabaka mu kugunjula mutabani we kwonna anoonya okuzuukusa mu ye omwoyo ogw’obwakabaka. Kitaffe ali mu ggulu ayagala okutugunjula ng’abaana be olw’obulamu obutukuvu, obw’omu ggulu, mw’abeera, era olw’ekyo atuwa, okuva mu buziba bw’omutima gwe, Omwoyo we yennyini. Kino kye kyali ekigendererwa kya Yesu kyonna, bwe yamala okutangirira n’omusaayi gwe yennyini, n’ayingira ku lwaffe mu maaso ga Katonda, alyoke atufunire, era atuweereze okubeera mu ffe, Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Nga ye Mwoyo wa Kitaffe n’Omwana, obulamu bwonna n’okwagala kwonna okwa Kitaffe n’Omwana biri mu ye; era bw’akka mu ffe, atusitula n’atuyingiza mu kussa ekimu nabo. Nga Mwoyo wa Kitaffe, ajjuza emitima gyaffe okwagala kwa Kitaffe, kwe yayagala nakwo Omwana, era atuyigiriza okubeera mu kwo. Nga Mwoyo w’Omwana, assa mu ffe eddembe ly’omwana, n’okwewaayo, n’obuwulize Omwana bwe yalimu ng’ali ku nsi. Kitaffe tayinza kuwa kirabo kisinga kino obukulu oba okwewuunyisa: Omwoyo we Omutukuvu yennyini, Omwoyo ow’obwana.

Amazima gano gatuleetera mangu ekirowoozo nti ekirabo kino ekisooka era ekisinga obukulu ekya Katonda kiteekwa okuba ekintu ekisooka era ekisinga obukulu mu kusaba kwonna. Ku buli kyetaago ky’obulamu obw’omwoyo, kino kye kintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa: Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Okujjula kwonna kuli mu Yesu; okujjula kw’ekisa n’amazima, ku kujjula okwo ffenna kwe twagabana ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mutuusi eyalondebwa, alina omulimu ogw’enjawulo ogw’okufuula Yesu n’ebyo byonna ebiri mu ye ku lwaffe okuba ebyaffe, nga tubyefunira ffekka, nga tubirabira mu bulamu obw’omukisa. Ye Mwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu; obulamu obwo nga bwe buli obw’ekitalo, n’enteekateeka eyateekawo omukozi ow’engeri eyo okubututuusaako bw’etyo bw’eri ey’ekitalo. Singa twewaayo ddala eri Omwoyo atufuge, ne tumuleka akole naffe nga bw’ayagala, aliraga obulamu bwa Kristo munda mu ffe. Ekyo alikikola n’amaanyi ga Katonda, ng’akuuma obulamu bwa Kristo mu ffe obutayosa. Mazima, bwe waba nga waliwo okusaba kumu okusaanidde okutusembeza ku ntebe ya Kitaffe n’okutukuumirayo, kwe kuno: okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, gwe twafuna ng’abaana, ayiike mu ffe era akulukute okuva mu ffe mu kujjula okusingawo.

Mu birabo eby’enjawulo Omwoyo by’agaba, atuukiriza buli kyetaago ky’omukkiriza. Lowooza ku mannya g’ayitibwa. Omwoyo ow’ekisa, okubikkula n’okugaba ekisa kyonna ekiri mu Yesu. Omwoyo ow’okukkiriza, atuyigiriza okutandika, okweyongerayo n’okukula mu kukkiriza obutakoma. Omwoyo atufuula abaana era atukakasa, akakasa nga bwe tuli abaana ba Katonda, era atuleetera okukoowoola n’obwesige n’obuvumu nti, Aba, Kitaffe! Omwoyo ow’amazima, atuluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna, okufuula buli kigambo kya Katonda ekyaffe mu bikolwa ne mu mazima. Omwoyo ow’okusaba, ku bw’oyo twogera ne Kitaffe; okusaba okuteekwa okuwulirwa. Omwoyo ogusala ensonga n’omwoyo ogwokya, okukebera omutima n’okulumiriza ekibi. Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, alaga era atuwa okubeerawo kwa Kitaffe okutukuvu munda mu ffe. Omwoyo ow’amaanyi, ku bw’oyo tufuna amaanyi okutegeeza n’obuvumu n’okukola n’obuwanguzi mu buweereza bwa Kitaffe. Omwoyo ow’ekitiibwa, omusingo gw’obusika bwaffe, okweteekateeka n’okuloza ku kitiibwa ekigenda okujja. Mazima omwana wa Katonda yeetaaga kintu kimu kyokka okusobola okubeera ddala ng’omwana: kwe kujjuzibwa Omwoyo ono.

Kale, essomo Yesu ly’atuyigiriza leero mu ssomero lye lye lino: nti Kitaffe yeegomba nnyo okumutuwa singa tusaba nga twesigama ng’abaana ku by’ayogera: ‘Obanga mmwe musobola okuwa abaana bammwe ebirabo ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu TALISINGA NNYO okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba.’ Mu bigambo by’ekisuubizo kya Katonda, ‘Ndifuka Omwoyo wange mu bungi;’ ne mu by’ekiragiro kye, ‘Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe’ mwe tulabira ekigera kya Katonda ky’ayagala okuwa, n’ekyo kye tuyinza okufuna. Ng’abaana ba Katonda, twafuna dda Omwoyo. Naye tukyetaaga okusaba okufuna ebirabo bye eby’enjawulo n’emirimu gye nga bwe tubyetaaga. So si ekyo kyokka, naye tusaba ye yennyini atwefunire ddala ffenna; atuluŋŋamye buli kaseera awatali kuwummula. Ng’ettabi, newaakubadde nga lijjudde dda amazzi g’omuzabbibu, bwe lyegomba bulijjo amazzi ago okweyongera okulikulukutiramu, lisobole okwengeza ebibala byalyo, n’omukkiriza bw’atyo, ng’asanyuka olw’okuba n’Omwoyo, bulijjo alumwa ennyonta era akaabirira okufuna ebisingawo. Era Omuyigiriza omukulu ky’ayagala tuyige kye kino: nti tewali kitono ku kisuubizo kya Katonda n’ekiragiro kye ekiyinza okuba ekigera ky’essuubi lyaffe n’okusaba kwaffe; tuteekwa okujjuzibwa mu bungi. Ayagala tusabe kino nga tukakasa nti TALISINGA NNYO ey’ekitalo ey’okwagala kwa Katonda nga Kitaffe gwe musingo nti bwe tusaba, mazima ddala tufuna.

Kale tukkirize kino kaakano. Bwe tusaba okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, tuleme kunoonya kuddibwamu mu nneewulira zaffe. Emikisa gyonna egy’omwoyo giteekwa okufunibwa, kwe kugamba, okukkirizibwa oba okutwalibwa olw’okukkiriza.1 Nkkirize nti Kitaffe awa omwana we asaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kaakano kennyini, nga nsaba, kinsaanidde okwogera olw’okukkiriza nti: Nfunye kye nsaba, okujjula kw’Omwoyo kwange. Tunywerere mu kukkiriza kuno. Olw’amaanyi g’Ekigambo kya Katonda tumanyi nti tulina kye tusaba. Nga twebaza nti tuwuliddwa, nga twebaza olw’ebyo bye twafuna ne twetwalira era kaakano bye tukwata ng’ebyaffe, tunywerere mu kusaba okw’okukkiriza, omukisa gwe twaweebwa dda, era gwe tukwata olw’okukkiriza, gweyabize gujjuze obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Mu kwebaza n’okusaba okw’okukkiriza okw’engeri eyo, emmeeme yaffe mw’eggukira Omwoyo atwefunire ddala awatali kutaataaganyizibwa. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo, okutasaba kyokka n’okusuubira, naye okutwala n’okukwata, kwe kusikira omukisa gwonna. Mu kusaba kwaffe kwonna tujjukirenga essomo Omulokozi ly’ayagala okutuyigiriza leero, nti, bwe waba nga waliwo ekintu kimu ku nsi kye tuyinza okukakasa, kye kino, nti Kitaffe ayagala tujjuzibwe Omwoyo we, nti asanyuka okutuwa Omwoyo we.

Era bwe tumala okuyiga okukkiriza bwe tutyo ku lwaffe, na buli lunaku okuggya mu ggwanika lye tulina mu ggulu, nga tufuna eddembe n’amaanyi okusaba Omwoyo afukibwe ku Kkanisa ya Katonda, ku bantu bonna, ku bantu kinnoomu, oba ku mirimu egy’enjawulo! Oyo amaze okuyiga okumanya Kitaffe mu kusaba ku lulwe, ayiga n’okusabira abalala n’obwesige obungi. Kitaffe awa Omwoyo Omutukuvu abo abamusaba, si kitono, wabula nnyo ddala, bwe basabira abalala.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Kitaffe ali mu ggulu! Watuma Omwana wo okutubikkulira ggwe wennyini, okwagala kwo okw’obukitaffe, ne byonna okwagala okwo bye kututeekeddeyo. Era yatuyigiriza nti ekirabo ekisinga ebirabo byonna ky’oyagala okugaba ng’oddamu okusaba, ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Ai Kitaffe! Nzija gy’oli n’okusaba kuno; tewali kye nandyagadde—oba siyinza kugamba nti, kye njagala—okusinga okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Emikisa gy’aleeta tegyogerekeka, era gye nneetaaga ddala. Ajjuza omutima okwagala kwo, era agujjuza ggwe wennyini. Nkyegomba nnyo. Assa mu nze endowooza n’obulamu bwa Kristo, ndyoke mbeere nga ye bwe yali, mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe era ku lw’okwagala okwo. Nkyegomba nnyo. Ayambaza amaanyi agava mu ggulu olw’entambula yange yonna n’omulimu gwange. Nkyegomba nnyo. Ai Kitaffe! Nkwegayiridde, mpa leero okujjula kw’Omwoyo wo.

Kitaffe! Nsaba kino nga nneesigama ku bigambo bya Mukama wange: ‘TALISINGA NNYO OKUBAWA MWOYO MUTUKUVU.’ Nzikiriza ddala nti owulira okusaba kwange; kaakano nfuna kye nsaba; Kitaffe! Nkyetwalira era nkikwata: okujjula kw’Omwoyo wo kwange. Nfuna ekirabo kino leero nate ng’ekirabo eky’okukkiriza; olw’okukkiriza mbala nti Kitaffe akola, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo, byonna bye yasuubiza. Kitaffe asanyuka okufuuwa Omwoyo we mu mwana we amulindirira, ng’amaliddeyo ebiseera mu kussa ekimu naye. Amiina.

Omwoyo ow’okukkiriza, atuyigiriza okutandika, okweyongerayo n’okukula mu kukkiriza obutakoma. Omwoyo atufuula abaana era atukakasa, akakasa nga bwe tuli abaana ba Katonda, era atuleetera okukoowoola n’obwesige n’obuvumu nti, Aba, Kitaffe! Omwoyo ow’amazima, atuluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna, okufuula buli kigambo kya Katonda ekyaffe mu bikolwa ne mu mazima. Omwoyo ow’okusaba, ku bw’oyo twogera ne Kitaffe; okusaba okuteekwa okuwulirwa. Omwoyo ogusala ensonga n’omwoyo ogwokya, okukebera omutima n’okulumiriza ekibi. Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, alaga era atuwa okubeerawo kwa Kitaffe okutukuvu munda mu ffe. Omwoyo ow’amaanyi, ku bw’oyo tufuna amaanyi okutegeeza n’obuvumu n’okukola n’obuwanguzi mu buweereza bwa Kitaffe. Omwoyo ow’ekitiibwa, omusingo gw’obusika bwaffe, okweteekateeka n’okuloza ku kitiibwa ekigenda okujja. Mazima omwana wa Katonda yeetaaga kintu kimu kyokka okusobola okubeera ddala ng’omwana: kwe kujjuzibwa Omwoyo ono. Kale, essomo Yesu ly’atuyigiriza leero mu ssomero lye lye lino: nti Kitaffe yeegomba nnyo okumutuwa singa tusaba nga twesigama ng’abaana ku by’ayogera: ‘Obanga mmwe musobola okuwa abaana bammwe ebirabo ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu TALISINGA NNYO okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba.’ Mu bigambo by’ekisuubizo kya Katonda, ‘Ndifuka Omwoyo wange mu bungi;’ ne mu by’ekiragiro kye, ‘Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe’ mwe tulabira ekigera kya Katonda ky’ayagala okuwa, n’ekyo kye tuyinza okufuna. Ng’abaana ba Katonda, twafuna dda Omwoyo. Naye tukyetaaga okusaba okufuna ebirabo bye eby’enjawulo n’emirimu gye nga bwe tubyetaaga. So si ekyo kyokka, naye tusaba ye yennyini atwefunire ddala ffenna; atuluŋŋamye buli kaseera awatali kuwummula. Ng’ettabi, newaakubadde nga lijjudde dda amazzi g’omuzabbibu, bwe lyegomba bulijjo amazzi ago okweyongera okulikulukutiramu, lisobole okwengeza ebibala byalyo, n’omukkiriza bw’atyo, ng’asanyuka olw’okuba n’Omwoyo, bulijjo alumwa ennyonta era akaabirira okufuna ebisingawo. Era Omuyigiriza omukulu ky’ayagala tuyige kye kino: nti tewali kitono ku kisuubizo kya Katonda n’ekiragiro kye ekiyinza okuba ekigera ky’essuubi lyaffe n’okusaba kwaffe; tuteekwa okujjuzibwa mu bungi. Ayagala tusabe kino nga tukakasa nti TALISINGA NNYO ey’ekitalo ey’okwagala kwa Katonda nga Kitaffe gwe musingo nti bwe tusaba, mazima ddala tufuna. Kale tukkirize kino kaakano. Bwe tusaba okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, tuleme kunoonya kuddibwamu mu nneewulira zaffe. Emikisa gyonna egy’omwoyo giteekwa okufunibwa, kwe kugamba, okukkirizibwa oba okutwalibwa olw’okukkiriza.1 Nkkirize nti Kitaffe awa omwana we asaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kaakano kennyini, nga nsaba, kinsaanidde okwogera olw’okukkiriza nti: Nfunye kye nsaba, okujjula kw’Omwoyo kwange. Tunywerere mu kukkiriza kuno. Olw’amaanyi g’Ekigambo kya Katonda tumanyi nti tulina kye tusaba. Nga twebaza nti tuwuliddwa, nga twebaza olw’ebyo bye twafuna ne twetwalira era kaakano bye tukwata ng’ebyaffe, tunywerere mu kusaba okw’okukkiriza, omukisa gwe twaweebwa dda, era gwe tukwata olw’okukkiriza, gweyabize gujjuze obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Mu kwebaza n’okusaba okw’okukkiriza okw’engeri eyo, emmeeme yaffe mw’eggukira Omwoyo atwefunire ddala awatali kutaataaganyizibwa. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo, okutasaba kyokka n’okusuubira, naye okutwala n’okukwata, kwe kusikira omukisa gwonna. Mu kusaba kwaffe kwonna tujjukirenga essomo Omulokozi ly’ayagala okutuyigiriza leero, nti, bwe waba nga waliwo ekintu kimu ku nsi kye tuyinza okukakasa, kye kino, nti Kitaffe ayagala tujjuzibwe Omwoyo we, nti asanyuka okutuwa Omwoyo we. Era bwe tumala okuyiga okukkiriza bwe tutyo ku lwaffe, na buli lunaku okuggya mu ggwanika lye tulina mu ggulu, nga tufuna eddembe n’amaanyi okusaba Omwoyo afukibwe ku Kkanisa ya Katonda, ku bantu bonna, ku bantu kinnoomu, oba ku mirimu egy’enjawulo! Oyo amaze okuyiga okumanya Kitaffe mu kusaba ku lulwe, ayiga n’okusabira abalala n’obwesige obungi. Kitaffe awa Omwoyo Omutukuvu abo abamusaba, si kitono, wabula nnyo ddala, bwe basabira abalala. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Kitaffe ali mu ggulu! Watuma Omwana wo okutubikkulira ggwe wennyini, okwagala kwo okw’obukitaffe, ne byonna okwagala okwo bye kututeekeddeyo. Era yatuyigiriza nti ekirabo ekisinga ebirabo byonna ky’oyagala okugaba ng’oddamu okusaba, ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Ai Kitaffe! Nzija gy’oli n’okusaba kuno; tewali kye nandyagadde—oba siyinza kugamba nti, kye njagala—okusinga okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Emikisa gy’aleeta tegyogerekeka, era gye nneetaaga ddala. Ajjuza omutima okwagala kwo, era agujjuza ggwe wennyini. Nkyegomba nnyo. Assa mu nze endowooza n’obulamu bwa Kristo, ndyoke mbeere nga ye bwe yali, mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe era ku lw’okwagala okwo. Nkyegomba nnyo. Ayambaza amaanyi agava mu ggulu olw’entambula yange yonna n’omulimu gwange. Nkyegomba nnyo. Ai Kitaffe! Nkwegayiridde, mpa leero okujjula kw’Omwoyo wo. Kitaffe! Nsaba kino nga nneesigama ku bigambo bya Mukama wange: ‘TALISINGA NNYO OKUBAWA MWOYO MUTUKUVU.’ Nzikiriza ddala nti owulira okusaba kwange; kaakano nfuna kye nsaba; Kitaffe! Nkyetwalira era nkikwata: okujjula kw’Omwoyo wo kwange. Nfuna ekirabo kino leero nate ng’ekirabo eky’okukkiriza; olw’okukkiriza mbala nti Kitaffe akola, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo, byonna bye yasuubiza. Kitaffe asanyuka okufuuwa Omwoyo we mu mwana we amulindirira, ng’amaliddeyo ebiseera mu kussa ekimu naye. Amiina.

fields.title: Obuvumu bwa Mikwano gya Katonda
fields.body_html:
‘Ate n’abagamba nti, Singa omu ku mmwe alina mukwano gwe, n’ajja gy’ali ekiro mu ttumbi n’amugamba nti, Mukwano gwange, nkusaba ompoleyo emigaati esatu, kubanga nfunye omugenyi, mukwano gwange avudde lugendo, naye sirina kyakulya kya kumuwa.’ Oli ali munda mu nju bw’ayanukula nti, Tonteganya. Twasibyewo dda, ffenna n’abaana bange twebisse. Noolwekyo siyinza kugolokoka kaakano ne mbaako kye nkuwa. Naye mbategeeza nti, Newaakubadde nga tagolokoka n’amuyamba nga mukwano gwe, naye, singa akonkona n’amwetayirira, alwaddaaki agolokoka n’amuwa by’amusabye.’—Lukka 11:5-8.

OKUYIGIRIZA okusooka ku kusaba, Mukama waffe yakuwa abayigirizwa be mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi. Nga wayise kumpi omwaka mulamba, abayigirizwa ne basaba Yesu abayigirize okusaba. Mu kubaddamu, n’abawa omulundi ogwokubiri Essaala ya Mukama, bw’atyo n’abayigiriza kye balina okusaba. Oluvannyuma n’ayogera ku ngeri gye basaanidde okusaba, n’addamu bye yali ayogedde edda ku Katonda okuba Kitaffe, n’okukakasa nti okuddibwamu kujja. Naye wakati w’ebyo n’ayongerako olugero olulungi olwa mukwano eyajja mu ttumbi, abayigirize essomo ery’emiteeko ebiri: nti Katonda tayagala tusabire ffekka, wabula ne ku lw’abo ababula abatwetoolodde; era nti mu kwegayiririra abalala okwo, obuvumu obungi mu kwegayirira butera okwetaagisa, era bulijjo bukkirizibwa, weewaawo, busanyusa Katonda.

Olugero luno tterekero ddamu ery’okuyigiriza ku kwegayiririra abalala okwa nnamaddala. Ekisooka, waliwo okwagala okunoonya okuyamba abali mu bwetaavu abatwetoolodde: ‘mukwano gwange avudde lugendo.’ Ne kuddako obwetaavu obusindiikiriza omuntu okukaaba nti ‘sirina kyakulya kya kumuwa.’ Ne kulyoka kuddako obwesige nti obuyambi busobola okufunika: ‘omu ku mmwe alina mukwano gwe, n’amugamba nti, Mukwano gwange, nkusaba ompoleyo emigaati esatu.’ Ne wajja okugaana okutaali kusuubire: ‘siyinza kugolokoka ne mbaako kye nkuwa.’ Ate ne wabaawo okunyiikira okutakkiriza kugaanibwa: ‘singa akonkona n’amwetayirira.’ Era ekisembayo, empeera y’okusaba okw’engeri eyo: ‘agolokoka n’amuwa by’amusabye.’ Kino kyolesa bulungi nnyo ekkubo ly’okusaba n’okukkiriza, omukisa gwa Katonda mwe gunoonyezeddwa era mwe gufuniddwa emirundi mingi nnyo.

Ka tweyunire ku ndowooza enkulu: okusaba ng’okwesiga omukwano gwa Katonda; tujja kulaba nga mulimu amasomo abiri agalagibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Erimu, nti bwe tuba mikwano gya Katonda, ne tujja gy’ali nga mikwano gye, tulina okweraga nga tuli mikwano gy’abo abali mu bwetaavu; omukwano Katonda gw’atulinamu n’ogwo gwe tulina eri abalala bitambulira wamu. Eddala, nti bwe tujja mu ngeri eyo, tuyinza okukozesa eddembe lyonna mu kusaba okuddibwamu.

Okusaba kulina emigaso ebiri: ogumu, okufuna amaanyi n’omukisa ku lw’obulamu bwaffe; ogw’okubiri, ogusinga obukulu, ekitiibwa ekyannamaddala eky’okusaba, Kristo kye yatuyingiza mu kussa ekimu naye ne mu kuyigiriza kwe, kwe kwegayiririra abalala, okusaba we kufuukira obuyinza obw’obwakabaka omwana wa Katonda bw’akozesa mu ggulu ku lw’abalala, era ne ku lw’obwakabaka bwonna. Tukiraba mu Byawandiikibwa: mu kwegayiririra abalala Ibulayimu ne Musa, Samwiri ne Eriya, wamu n’abantu abatukuvu bonna ab’edda, mwe baalagira nti beegezaanya ne Katonda era ne bawangula. Bwe tweweerayo okuba omukisa eri abalala, lwe tusobola okwesiga ennyo omukisa gwa Katonda. Bwe tusemberera Katonda nga tuli mikwano gy’abaavu n’ababula, lwe tusobola okwesiga ekisa kye eky’omukwano; omutuukirivu ali mukwano gw’abaavu, ddala ye mukwano gwa Katonda ow’enjawulo. Kino kireeta eddembe ery’ekitalo mu kusaba. Mukama! Nnina mukwano gwange ali mu bwetaavu gwe nteekwa okuyamba. Nga mukwano gwe, neeyamye okumuyamba. Mu ggwe nnina Mukwano, gwe mmanyi ng’ekisa kye n’obugagga bwe tebirina kkomo: nkakasa nti ojja kumpa kye nsaba. Obanga nze omubi ndi mwetegefu okukolera mukwano gwange kye nsobola, ggwe, Ayi Mukwano gwange ow’omu ggulu, tolisinga nnyo kaakano okukolera mukwano gwo ky’akusaba?

Omuntu ayinza okwebuuza obanga Katonda okuba Kitaffe tekiwa bwesige bungi bwe butyo mu kusaba, n’okulowooza ku mukwano gwe ne kutasobola kutuyigiriza kirala kyonna: taata asinga mukwano. Naye bwe tukirowoozaako, okwesiga omukwano gwa Katonda kutubikkulira ebyewuunyo ebipya. Omwana okufuna ky’asaba taata we kirabika nga kya buzaaliranwa ddala, kumpi ne tukibala ng’obuvunaanyizibwa bwa taata okumuwa. Naye ku mukwano, ekisa kiringa ekiweebwa ku bwereere, nga tekyesigamye ku buzaaliranwa, wabula ku kuwulirira awamu n’empisa. Ate era omwana ali mu kwesigama okujjuvu; so nga mikwano ebiri baba kumpi ku ddaala limu. Noolwekyo Mukama waffe, bw’aba atubikkulira ekyama eky’omwoyo eky’okusaba, ayagala tusemberere Katonda ne mu nkolagana eno, nga abo be yakkiriza okuba mikwano gye, abalina endowooza n’obulamu ebikwatagana n’ebibye.

Naye kale tulina okubeera mu bulamu nga mikwano gye. Nkyali mwana ne bwe mba nga nkyamye; naye omukwano gwesigamye ku nneeyisa. ‘Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.’ ‘Mulaba nga Ibulayimu bwe yalina okukkiriza, era okukkiriza kwe ne kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa bye, n’ekyawandiikibwa ne kituukirizibwa ekigamba nti, Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda, ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era n’ayitibwa mukwano gwa Katonda.’ Omwoyo, ‘Omwoyo yennyini,’ atukulembera, y’omu atukakasa nti Katonda atukkiriza; ‘bw’atyo,’ Omwoyo oyo atuyamba mu kusaba. Obulamu obw’omuntu ali mukwano gwa Katonda bwe buwa eddembe ery’ekitalo okugamba nti: Nnina mukwano gwe nsobola okugendako ne mu ttumbi. Era kino kyeyongera nnyo bwe ngenda nga nnina omwoyo gwennyini ogw’omukwano ogwo, nga nze kennyini nnyoleka ekisa kye nnoonya okuva eri Katonda, nga nnoonya okuyamba mukwano gwange nga bwe njagala Katonda annyambe. Bwe nzija eri Katonda mu kusaba, bulijjo atunuulira ekigendererwa ky’okusaba kwange. Bwe mba nnoonya ekisa kye olw’okubudaabudibwa oba essanyu lyange ku bwange, sifuna. Naye bwe nsobola okugamba nti njagala agulumizibwe nga ngabira abalala emikisa gye, sijja kusaba bwereere. Oba bwe nsabira abalala naye ne njagala okulinda okutuusa Katonda lw’alimpa obugagga bungi, okuyamba abalala ne kutaba kwefiiriza wadde ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza, sijja kufuna. Naye bwe nsobola okugamba nti nneeyamye dda okuyamba mukwano gwange ali mu bwetaavu, nti mu bwavu bwange ntandise dda omulimu ogw’okwagala, kubanga mmanyi nti nnina mukwano anannyamba, okusaba kwange kujja kuwulirwa. Ayi, tetumanyi bwe kuli kwa maanyi okwegayirira okwo: omukwano ogw’oku nsi, mu bwetaavu bwagwo, nga gutunuulira omukwano ogw’omu ggulu: ‘Alimuwa by’amusabye.’

Naye si bulijjo nti kiba mangu ago. Ekintu kimu omuntu ky’ayinza okussaamu Katonda we ekitiibwa n’okumusanyukiramu, kwe kukkiriza. Okwegayiririra abalala kitundu ku ssomero okukkiriza mwe kutendekerwa. Eyo omukwano gwaffe n’abantu ne Katonda we gugezesebwa. Eyo we kirabikira obanga omukwano gwange n’abali mu bwetaavu gwa nnamaddala, nga ndi mwetegefu okuwaayo obudde n’okwefiiriza okuwummula kwange, okugenda ne mu ttumbi, nga sikoma okutuusa nga mbafunidde kye nneetaaga. Eyo we kirabikira obanga omukwano gwange ne Katonda gutangaavu, nga nsobola okumwesiga nti tajja kunzigyayo, era bwe ntyo ne neeyongera okusaba okutuusa lw’anaawa.

Ayi, nga kino kyama kya mu ggulu ekiwanvu, eky’okusaba okunyiikira! Katonda eyasuubiza, ayagala ennyo, era ekigendererwa kye ekinywevu kwe kugaba omukisa, agulwisaawo. Kikulu nnyo gy’ali mikwano gye ku nsi okumanya n’okwesiga ddala Mukwano gwabwe omugagga ali mu ggulu, n’abatendeka, mu ssomero ly’okuddibwamu okulwawo, okuzuula engeri okunyiikira kwabwe gye kuwangulamu ddala, n’obuyinza obungi bwe basobola okukozesa mu ggulu, singa beemalirira okukikola. Waliwo okukkiriza okulaba ekisuubizo, ne kukiwambaatira, naye ne kutakifuna (Abaebbulaniya 11:13, 39). Okuddibwamu bwe kulwawo, n’ekisuubizo kye twesiga ennyo ne kirabika ng’ekitaliiko kye kigasa, olwo okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza, okw’omuwendo omungi okusinga zaabu, we kubeerawo. Mu kugezesebwa kuno okukkiriza okwakwata ekisuubizo mwe kulongoosebwa, ne kunywezebwa, ne kutegekebwa mu kussa ekimu okw’omuntu ku bubwe, okutukuvu, ne Katonda omulamu, okulaba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Kukwata ekisuubizo ne kukinyweza okutuusa lwe kufuna okutuukirizibwa kw’ekyo kye kwasaba mu mazima amalamu okuva eri Katonda atalabika naye omulamu.

Buli mwana wa Katonda anoonya okukola omulimu ogw’okwagala mu buweereza bwa Kitaffe, ka agume omwoyo. Omuzadde n’omwana we, omusomesa n’ekibiina kye, omukyalizi n’ekitundu ky’akyalira, omusomi wa Bayibuli n’ekibinja kye, omubuulizi n’abamuwuliriza, buli muntu, mu kitundu kye ekitono, akkirizza era asitudde omugugu gw’emmeeme ezirumwa enjala era ezibula,—bonna ka bagume omwoyo. Tewali kitusooka kwewuunyisa nga Katonda okwetaagira ddala okusaba okunyiikira, nti waliwo ddala obwetaavu obw’omwoyo obw’okwetayirira. Okukituyigiriza, Omusomesa akozesa olugero luno olw’ekyewuunyo. Obanga obutaba na kisa bwa mukwano ow’oku nsi eyeefaako yekka busobola okuwangulwa n’okwetayirira, okwetayirira tekulisinga nnyo okugasa eri Mukwano ow’omu ggulu, ayagala ennyo okugaba, naye aziyizibwa obutasaanira bwaffe obw’omwoyo, obutasobola bwaffe okufuna by’alina okutuwa? Ayi, ka tumwebaze nti bw’alwisaawo okutuddamu, aba atuyimusa okutuuka ku kifo kyaffe ekituufu n’okukozesa obuyinza bwaffe bwonna gy’ali, ng’atutendeka okubeera naye mu kussa ekimu okw’okukkiriza n’obwesige obutabuusabuusa, okuba ddala mikwano gya Katonda. Era ka tunyweze omuguwa ogw’emiyondo esatu ogutakutuka: mukwano alumwa enjala eyeetaaga obuyambi, ne mukwano asaba anoonya obuyambi, ne Mukwano ow’Amaanyi, ayagala okumuwa byonna by’ayetaaga.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Ayi Mukama wange Omutendereze era Omuyigiriza wange! Nteekwa okujja gy’oli mu kusaba. Okuyigiriza kwo kwa kitiibwa nnyo, naye kugulumivu nnyo nze okukutegeera. Nteekwa okwatula nti omutima gwange mutono nnyo okusobola okuyingiza ebirowoozo bino eby’obuvumu obw’ekitalo bwe nsobola okukozesa eri Kitaawo ng’ali Mukwano gwange. Mukama Yesu! Nkwesiga ompe Omwoyo wo wamu n’Ekigambo kyo, era ofuule Ekigambo okuba ekiramu era ekikola mu mutima gwange. Njagala okukwata Ekigambo kyo eky’olwaleero: ‘Singa akonkona n’amwetayirira, alwaddaaki agolokoka n’amuwa by’amusabye.’

Mukama! Nnyigiriza okumanya ennyo obuyinza bw’okusaba okunyiikira. Mmanyi nti mu kwo Kitaffe yeetereeza okukwatagana n’obwetaavu bwaffe obw’obudde, obulamu obw’omunda bulyoke bukule era bwengere, ekisa kye kiryoke kituyingire ddala kifuuke kyaffe ddala. Mmanyi nti ayagala nnyo okututendeka bw’atyo okukozesa okukkiriza okw’amaanyi okutamuta ne bwe wabaawo okuggwaamu essuubi okulabika obulabisi. Mmanyi ng’ayagala okutuyimusa okutuuka ku ddembe eryo ery’ekitalo, mwe tutegeerera nga bwe yateeka ddala okugaba ekirabo kye okwesigama ku kusaba kwaffe. Mukama! Kino nkimanyi: Ayi, nnyigiriza okukiraba mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.

Era kaakano essanyu ly’obulamu bwange libe okufuuka omugabi w’ebirabo bya Mukwano gwange Omugagga ali mu ggulu, okulabirira bonna abalumwa enjala n’ababula, ne mu ttumbi, kubanga mmanyi MUKWANO GWANGE, bulijjo agabira oyo anyiikira, olw’okwetayirira kwe, byonna by’ayetaaga. Amiina.

Mu kubaddamu, n’abawa omulundi ogwokubiri Essaala ya Mukama, bw’atyo n’abayigiriza kye balina okusaba. Oluvannyuma n’ayogera ku ngeri gye basaanidde okusaba, n’addamu bye yali ayogedde edda ku Katonda okuba Kitaffe, n’okukakasa nti okuddibwamu kujja. Naye wakati w’ebyo n’ayongerako olugero olulungi olwa mukwano eyajja mu ttumbi, abayigirize essomo ery’emiteeko ebiri: nti Katonda tayagala tusabire ffekka, wabula ne ku lw’abo ababula abatwetoolodde; era nti mu kwegayiririra abalala okwo, obuvumu obungi mu kwegayirira butera okwetaagisa, era bulijjo bukkirizibwa, weewaawo, busanyusa Katonda. Olugero luno tterekero ddamu ery’okuyigiriza ku kwegayiririra abalala okwa nnamaddala. Ekisooka, waliwo okwagala okunoonya okuyamba abali mu bwetaavu abatwetoolodde: ‘mukwano gwange avudde lugendo.’ Ne kuddako obwetaavu obusindiikiriza omuntu okukaaba nti ‘sirina kyakulya kya kumuwa.’ Ne kulyoka kuddako obwesige nti obuyambi busobola okufunika: ‘omu ku mmwe alina mukwano gwe, n’amugamba nti, Mukwano gwange, nkusaba ompoleyo emigaati esatu.’ Ne wajja okugaana okutaali kusuubire: ‘siyinza kugolokoka ne mbaako kye nkuwa.’ Ate ne wabaawo okunyiikira okutakkiriza kugaanibwa: ‘singa akonkona n’amwetayirira.’ Era ekisembayo, empeera y’okusaba okw’engeri eyo: ‘agolokoka n’amuwa by’amusabye.’ Kino kyolesa bulungi nnyo ekkubo ly’okusaba n’okukkiriza, omukisa gwa Katonda mwe gunoonyezeddwa era mwe gufuniddwa emirundi mingi nnyo. Ka tweyunire ku ndowooza enkulu: okusaba ng’okwesiga omukwano gwa Katonda; tujja kulaba nga mulimu amasomo abiri agalagibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Erimu, nti bwe tuba mikwano gya Katonda, ne tujja gy’ali nga mikwano gye, tulina okweraga nga tuli mikwano gy’abo abali mu bwetaavu; omukwano Katonda gw’atulinamu n’ogwo gwe tulina eri abalala bitambulira wamu. Eddala, nti bwe tujja mu ngeri eyo, tuyinza okukozesa eddembe lyonna mu kusaba okuddibwamu. Okusaba kulina emigaso ebiri: ogumu, okufuna amaanyi n’omukisa ku lw’obulamu bwaffe; ogw’okubiri, ogusinga obukulu, ekitiibwa ekyannamaddala eky’okusaba, Kristo kye yatuyingiza mu kussa ekimu naye ne mu kuyigiriza kwe, kwe kwegayiririra abalala, okusaba we kufuukira obuyinza obw’obwakabaka omwana wa Katonda bw’akozesa mu ggulu ku lw’abalala, era ne ku lw’obwakabaka bwonna. Tukiraba mu Byawandiikibwa: mu kwegayiririra abalala Ibulayimu ne Musa, Samwiri ne Eriya, wamu n’abantu abatukuvu bonna ab’edda, mwe baalagira nti beegezaanya ne Katonda era ne bawangula. Bwe tweweerayo okuba omukisa eri abalala, lwe tusobola okwesiga ennyo omukisa gwa Katonda. Bwe tusemberera Katonda nga tuli mikwano gy’abaavu n’ababula, lwe tusobola okwesiga ekisa kye eky’omukwano; omutuukirivu ali mukwano gw’abaavu, ddala ye mukwano gwa Katonda ow’enjawulo. Kino kireeta eddembe ery’ekitalo mu kusaba. Mukama! Nnina mukwano gwange ali mu bwetaavu gwe nteekwa okuyamba. Nga mukwano gwe, neeyamye okumuyamba. Mu ggwe nnina Mukwano, gwe mmanyi ng’ekisa kye n’obugagga bwe tebirina kkomo: nkakasa nti ojja kumpa kye nsaba. Obanga nze omubi ndi mwetegefu okukolera mukwano gwange kye nsobola, ggwe, Ayi Mukwano gwange ow’omu ggulu, tolisinga nnyo kaakano okukolera mukwano gwo ky’akusaba? Omuntu ayinza okwebuuza obanga Katonda okuba Kitaffe tekiwa bwesige bungi bwe butyo mu kusaba, n’okulowooza ku mukwano gwe ne kutasobola kutuyigiriza kirala kyonna: taata asinga mukwano. Naye bwe tukirowoozaako, okwesiga omukwano gwa Katonda kutubikkulira ebyewuunyo ebipya. Omwana okufuna ky’asaba taata we kirabika nga kya buzaaliranwa ddala, kumpi ne tukibala ng’obuvunaanyizibwa bwa taata okumuwa. Naye ku mukwano, ekisa kiringa ekiweebwa ku bwereere, nga tekyesigamye ku buzaaliranwa, wabula ku kuwulirira awamu n’empisa. Ate era omwana ali mu kwesigama okujjuvu; so nga mikwano ebiri baba kumpi ku ddaala limu. Noolwekyo Mukama waffe, bw’aba atubikkulira ekyama eky’omwoyo eky’okusaba, ayagala tusemberere Katonda ne mu nkolagana eno, nga abo be yakkiriza okuba mikwano gye, abalina endowooza n’obulamu ebikwatagana n’ebibye. Naye kale tulina okubeera mu bulamu nga mikwano gye. Nkyali mwana ne bwe mba nga nkyamye; naye omukwano gwesigamye ku nneeyisa. ‘Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.’ ‘Mulaba nga Ibulayimu bwe yalina okukkiriza, era okukkiriza kwe ne kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa bye, n’ekyawandiikibwa ne kituukirizibwa ekigamba nti, Ibulayimu yakkiriza Katonda, ne kimubalirwa okuba obutuukirivu, era n’ayitibwa mukwano gwa Katonda.’ Omwoyo, ‘Omwoyo yennyini,’ atukulembera, y’omu atukakasa nti Katonda atukkiriza; ‘bw’atyo,’ Omwoyo oyo atuyamba mu kusaba. Obulamu obw’omuntu ali mukwano gwa Katonda bwe buwa eddembe ery’ekitalo okugamba nti: Nnina mukwano gwe nsobola okugendako ne mu ttumbi. Era kino kyeyongera nnyo bwe ngenda nga nnina omwoyo gwennyini ogw’omukwano ogwo, nga nze kennyini nnyoleka ekisa kye nnoonya okuva eri Katonda, nga nnoonya okuyamba mukwano gwange nga bwe njagala Katonda annyambe. Bwe nzija eri Katonda mu kusaba, bulijjo atunuulira ekigendererwa ky’okusaba kwange. Bwe mba nnoonya ekisa kye olw’okubudaabudibwa oba essanyu lyange ku bwange, sifuna. Naye bwe nsobola okugamba nti njagala agulumizibwe nga ngabira abalala emikisa gye, sijja kusaba bwereere. Oba bwe nsabira abalala naye ne njagala okulinda okutuusa Katonda lw’alimpa obugagga bungi, okuyamba abalala ne kutaba kwefiiriza wadde ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza, sijja kufuna. Naye bwe nsobola okugamba nti nneeyamye dda okuyamba mukwano gwange ali mu bwetaavu, nti mu bwavu bwange ntandise dda omulimu ogw’okwagala, kubanga mmanyi nti nnina mukwano anannyamba, okusaba kwange kujja kuwulirwa. Ayi, tetumanyi bwe kuli kwa maanyi okwegayirira okwo: omukwano ogw’oku nsi, mu bwetaavu bwagwo, nga gutunuulira omukwano ogw’omu ggulu: ‘Alimuwa by’amusabye.’ Naye si bulijjo nti kiba mangu ago. Ekintu kimu omuntu ky’ayinza okussaamu Katonda we ekitiibwa n’okumusanyukiramu, kwe kukkiriza. Okwegayiririra abalala kitundu ku ssomero okukkiriza mwe kutendekerwa. Eyo omukwano gwaffe n’abantu ne Katonda we gugezesebwa. Eyo we kirabikira obanga omukwano gwange n’abali mu bwetaavu gwa nnamaddala, nga ndi mwetegefu okuwaayo obudde n’okwefiiriza okuwummula kwange, okugenda ne mu ttumbi, nga sikoma okutuusa nga mbafunidde kye nneetaaga. Eyo we kirabikira obanga omukwano gwange ne Katonda gutangaavu, nga nsobola okumwesiga nti tajja kunzigyayo, era bwe ntyo ne neeyongera okusaba okutuusa lw’anaawa. Ayi, nga kino kyama kya mu ggulu ekiwanvu, eky’okusaba okunyiikira! Katonda eyasuubiza, ayagala ennyo, era ekigendererwa kye ekinywevu kwe kugaba omukisa, agulwisaawo. Kikulu nnyo gy’ali mikwano gye ku nsi okumanya n’okwesiga ddala Mukwano gwabwe omugagga ali mu ggulu, n’abatendeka, mu ssomero ly’okuddibwamu okulwawo, okuzuula engeri okunyiikira kwabwe gye kuwangulamu ddala, n’obuyinza obungi bwe basobola okukozesa mu ggulu, singa beemalirira okukikola. Waliwo okukkiriza okulaba ekisuubizo, ne kukiwambaatira, naye ne kutakifuna (Abaebbulaniya 11:13, 39). Okuddibwamu bwe kulwawo, n’ekisuubizo kye twesiga ennyo ne kirabika ng’ekitaliiko kye kigasa, olwo okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza, okw’omuwendo omungi okusinga zaabu, we kubeerawo. Mu kugezesebwa kuno okukkiriza okwakwata ekisuubizo mwe kulongoosebwa, ne kunywezebwa, ne kutegekebwa mu kussa ekimu okw’omuntu ku bubwe, okutukuvu, ne Katonda omulamu, okulaba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Kukwata ekisuubizo ne kukinyweza okutuusa lwe kufuna okutuukirizibwa kw’ekyo kye kwasaba mu mazima amalamu okuva eri Katonda atalabika naye omulamu. Buli mwana wa Katonda anoonya okukola omulimu ogw’okwagala mu buweereza bwa Kitaffe, ka agume omwoyo. Omuzadde n’omwana we, omusomesa n’ekibiina kye, omukyalizi n’ekitundu ky’akyalira, omusomi wa Bayibuli n’ekibinja kye, omubuulizi n’abamuwuliriza, buli muntu, mu kitundu kye ekitono, akkirizza era asitudde omugugu gw’emmeeme ezirumwa enjala era ezibula,—bonna ka bagume omwoyo. Tewali kitusooka kwewuunyisa nga Katonda okwetaagira ddala okusaba okunyiikira, nti waliwo ddala obwetaavu obw’omwoyo obw’okwetayirira. Okukituyigiriza, Omusomesa akozesa olugero luno olw’ekyewuunyo. Obanga obutaba na kisa bwa mukwano ow’oku nsi eyeefaako yekka busobola okuwangulwa n’okwetayirira, okwetayirira tekulisinga nnyo okugasa eri Mukwano ow’omu ggulu, ayagala ennyo okugaba, naye aziyizibwa obutasaanira bwaffe obw’omwoyo, obutasobola bwaffe okufuna by’alina okutuwa? Ayi, ka tumwebaze nti bw’alwisaawo okutuddamu, aba atuyimusa okutuuka ku kifo kyaffe ekituufu n’okukozesa obuyinza bwaffe bwonna gy’ali, ng’atutendeka okubeera naye mu kussa ekimu okw’okukkiriza n’obwesige obutabuusabuusa, okuba ddala mikwano gya Katonda. Era ka tunyweze omuguwa ogw’emiyondo esatu ogutakutuka: mukwano alumwa enjala eyeetaaga obuyambi, ne mukwano asaba anoonya obuyambi, ne Mukwano ow’Amaanyi, ayagala okumuwa byonna by’ayetaaga. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Ayi Mukama wange Omutendereze era Omuyigiriza wange! Nteekwa okujja gy’oli mu kusaba. Okuyigiriza kwo kwa kitiibwa nnyo, naye kugulumivu nnyo nze okukutegeera. Nteekwa okwatula nti omutima gwange mutono nnyo okusobola okuyingiza ebirowoozo bino eby’obuvumu obw’ekitalo bwe nsobola okukozesa eri Kitaawo ng’ali Mukwano gwange. Mukama Yesu! Nkwesiga ompe Omwoyo wo wamu n’Ekigambo kyo, era ofuule Ekigambo okuba ekiramu era ekikola mu mutima gwange. Njagala okukwata Ekigambo kyo eky’olwaleero: ‘Singa akonkona n’amwetayirira, alwaddaaki agolokoka n’amuwa by’amusabye.’ Mukama! Nnyigiriza okumanya ennyo obuyinza bw’okusaba okunyiikira. Mmanyi nti mu kwo Kitaffe yeetereeza okukwatagana n’obwetaavu bwaffe obw’obudde, obulamu obw’omunda bulyoke bukule era bwengere, ekisa kye kiryoke kituyingire ddala kifuuke kyaffe ddala. Mmanyi nti ayagala nnyo okututendeka bw’atyo okukozesa okukkiriza okw’amaanyi okutamuta ne bwe wabaawo okuggwaamu essuubi okulabika obulabisi. Mmanyi ng’ayagala okutuyimusa okutuuka ku ddembe eryo ery’ekitalo, mwe tutegeerera nga bwe yateeka ddala okugaba ekirabo kye okwesigama ku kusaba kwaffe. Mukama! Kino nkimanyi: Ayi, nnyigiriza okukiraba mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Era kaakano essanyu ly’obulamu bwange libe okufuuka omugabi w’ebirabo bya Mukwano gwange Omugagga ali mu ggulu, okulabirira bonna abalumwa enjala n’ababula, ne mu ttumbi, kubanga mmanyi MUKWANO GWANGE, bulijjo agabira oyo anyiikira, olw’okwetayirira kwe, byonna by’ayetaaga. Amiina.

fields.title: Okusaba Kuleeta Abakozi
fields.body_html:
‘N’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.’—Matayo 9:37-38.

Mukama yayigirizanga abayigirizwa be emirundi mingi nti bateekwa okusaba, era engeri y’okusabamu; naye ebiseera bitono n’abalaga kye balina okusaba. Ekyo yakirekera okuwulira kwabwe okw’obwetaavu n’okukulemberwa Omwoyo. Naye wano tulabawo ekintu kimu ky’abalagira mu bulambulukufu okujjukira: nga balaba amakungula amangi n’obwetaavu bw’abakungula, balina okukaabirira Nannyini nnimiro aweereze abakozi. Nga mu lugero lwa mukwano gw’omuntu mu ttumbi bwe yayagala bategeere nti okusaba tekulina kuba kwa kwefaako, ne wano okusaba ge maanyi omukisa mwe guyinza okutuukira ku balala. Kitaffe ye Nannyini nnimiro; bwe tusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tuteekwa okumusaba ateeketeeke era aweereze abakozi mu mulimu.

Kyewuunyisa, si bwe kiri, okuba nga yasaba abayigirizwa be okusabira kino? Ye yennyini teyandisobodde kusaba? Era essaala ye emu teyandisinzizza amaanyi essaala zaabwe lukumi? Ne Katonda, Nannyini nnimiro, teyalaba bwetaavu? Era mu kiseera kye ekituufu teyandiweerezza bakozi awatali kusaba kwabwe? Ebibuuzo ng’ebyo bituyingiza mu byama ebisingayo obuziba eby’okusaba, n’amaanyi gaakwo mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okuddibwamu kw’ebibuuzo ebyo kujja kutukakasa nti okusaba ddala maanyi, era nti okukungula amakungula n’okujja kw’Obwakabaka mu mazima ddala byesigamye ku kwo.

Okusaba si kya mpisa oba kwolesa bwolesa. Mukama Yesu yennyini ye yali amazima; buli kye yayogeranga kyali mazima agasingayo obuziba. Bwe (laba olunyiriri 36) ‘yatunuulira ekibiina ky’abantu, n’abasaasira nnyo, kubanga baali basaasaanye ng’endiga ezitalina musumba,’ we yayitira abayigirizwa okusaba abakozi baweerezebwe gye bali. Yakola bw’atyo kubanga ddala yakkiriza nti okusaba kwabwe kwali kwetaagisa era nti kwandiyambye. Olutimbe olutukweka ennyo ensi etalabika lwali lutangaala nnyo eri emmeeme entukuvu ey’obuntu bwa Yesu. Yali atunudde okumala ebbanga, mu buziba era wala, mu nkolagana ekwekeddwa wakati w’ensibuko n’ekigiva mu nsi ey’omwoyo. Yali alabye mu Kigambo kya Katonda engeri Katonda bwe yayitanga abantu nga Ibulayimu ne Musa, Yoswa ne Samwiri ne Danyeri, n’abawa obuyinza ku bantu mu linnya lye, era mu kiseera kye kimu n’abawa obuyinza n’eddembe okuyita amaanyi ag’omu ggulu okubayamba nga bwe baagetaaga. Yamanya nti nga bwe gwali guteereddwa mu mikono gy’abasajja abo ab’edda, era ne mu gage okumala ekiseera wano ku nsi, omulimu gwa Katonda kati gwali gunaatera okuyisibwa mu mikono gy’abayigirizwa be. Yamanya nti omulimu guno bwe gunaabakwasibwa, tegwandibadde kya mpisa oba kwolesa bwolesa, wabula nti ku bo, ne ku bwesigwa oba obutali bwesigwa bwabwe, obuwanguzi bw’omulimu bwe bwandyesigamye ddala. Nga muntu omu, ali mu kkomo ly’omubiri gw’omuntu n’obulamu bw’omuntu, Yesu awulira nti okukyala okumpi kuyinza kukola kitono nnyo mu ndiga zino ezibungeeta z’alaba okumwetooloola, era ayagala nnyo obuyambi zirabirirwe bulungi. Kyava agamba abayigirizwa be okutandika okusaba kati, era, bwe banaaba bamaze okutwala omulimu okuva gy’ali ku nsi, okufuula kino kimu ku byetaago ebikulu mu kusaba kwabwe: Nannyini nnimiro yennyini aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye. Katonda eyabakwasa omulimu, n’agufuula okwesigama ennyo ku bo, abawa obuyinza okumusaba abakozi okubayamba, era afuula okufuna abakozi okwesigama ku kusaba kwabwe.

Abakristaayo bawulira kitono nnyo era tebakungubagira bwetaavu bw’abakozi mu nnimiro z’ensi ezengedde dda okukungulwa. Era bakkiriza kitono nnyo nti okufuna abakozi kwesigamye ku kusaba, nti okusaba ddala kujja kuleeta ‘bonna b’aba yeetaaga.’ Si nti obutaba na bakozi tebumanyiddwa oba tebwogerwako. Si nti tewabaawo kufuba oluusi okujjuza ebbula eryo. Naye omugugu gw’endiga ezibungeeta ezitalina Musumba gusitulwa kitono nnyo mu kukkiriza nti Nannyini nnimiro ajja, olw’okuddamu okusaba, kuweereza abakozi, era mu kukakasa okw’amaanyi nti awatali kusaba kuno ennimiro ezengedde okukungulwa zijja kulekebwa zivunde. Naye bwe kiri bwe kityo. Okuwaayo omulimu gwe mu mikono gy’Ekkanisa ye kwewuunyisa nnyo, Mukama yeefudde okwesigama ennyo ku bo ng’omubiri gwe, omulimu gwe mwe guyinza okukolerwa gwokka, n’amaanyi Mukama g’awa abantu be okukozesa mu ggulu ne ku nsi ga ddala nnyo, ne kiba nti omuwendo gw’abakozi n’obungi bw’amakungula ddala byesigamye ku kusaba kwabwe.

Kirowoozo kya maanyi! Ai, lwaki tetugondera kiragiro kya Musomesa n’omutima gwonna, ne tukaabirira abakozi n’obunyiikivu obusingawo? Waliwo ensonga bbiri. Esooka eri nti: Tubulwa okusaasira kwa Yesu, okwaleeta okusaba kuno. Abakkiriza bwe bayiga nti okwagala baliraanwa baabwe nga bwe beeyagala, n’okubeerawo ddala olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu bantu bannaabwe, kye kiragiro kya Kitaffe ekisooka eri abanunule be, bajja kukkiriza abo ababula ng’omulimu Mukama waabwe gw’abakwasizza. Era nga babakkiriza si ng’ennimiro ey’okukoleramu yokka, naye ng’abantu ab’okwagala n’okufiibwako, tekiritwala kiseera kinene okusaasira abo ababula awatali ssuubi ne kukwata ku mutima gwabwe, n’okukaaba ne kulinnya n’obunyiikivu obutamanyiddwangako: Mukama! weereza abakozi. Ensonga endala ey’okulagajjalira ekiragiro kino, okubulwa okukkiriza, olwo eneeyoleka, naye ejja kuwangulwa ng’okusaasira kwaffe kwegayirira obuyambi. Tukkiriza kitono nnyo mu maanyi g’okusaba okuleeta ebibala ebitegeerekeka. Tetubeera kumpi kimala ne Katonda, era tetwewaddeyo ddala kimala eri obuweereza bwe n’Obwakabaka bwe, okusobola okuba n’obwesige nti ajja kubiwa olw’okuddamu okusaba kwaffe. Ai, tusabe obulamu obuli obumu ne Kristo bwe butyo, okusaasira kwe kukulukute mu ffe, n’Omwoyo we asobole okutukakasa nti okusaba kwaffe kukola.

Okusaba ng’okwo kujja kusaba era kufune omukisa ogw’emirundi ebiri. Ogusooka kwe kwegomba abantu abeewaddeyo ddala eri obuweereza bwa Katonda beeyongere obungi. Kya nsonyi nnyo eri Ekkanisa ya Kristo nti waliwo ebiseera abantu bwe batasangibwa ddala okuweereza Omusomesa ng’abasumba, abaminsani, oba abayigiriza b’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Abaana ba Katonda bwe banaafuula kino ensonga ey’okwegayirira ku lw’ekibinja kyabwe oba Ekkanisa yaabwe, kujja kubaweebwa. Mukama Yesu kati ye Nannyini nnimiro. Yagulumizibwa okugaba ebirabo—ebirabo by’Omwoyo. Ebirabo bye ebikulu be bantu abajjudde Omwoyo. Naye okufunibwa n’okugabibwa kw’ebirabo kwesigamye ku kukolera wamu kw’Omutwe n’ebitundu. Okusaba kwe kuleeta okukolera wamu okwo; abasaba abakkiriza bajja kukubirizibwa okunoonya abantu n’ebyetaagisa olw’omulimu.

Omukisa omulala ogw’okusaba tegulibeera mutono. Buli mukkiriza mukozi; tewali n’omu ku baana ba Katonda atanunulibwa olw’okuweereza, era atalina mulimu gwe gumulindiridde. Kiteekwa okuba okusaba kwaffe nti Mukama ajjuze abantu be bonna omwoyo ogw’okwewaayo, waleme kubaawo n’omu asangibwa ng’ayimiridde awo nga talina ky’akola mu nnimiro y’emizabbibu. Wonna awali okwemulugunya olw’obutaba na bayambi, oba abayambi abasaanidde mu mulimu gwa Katonda, okusaba kulina ekisuubizo ky’okufuna. Tewali ssomero lya Sande oba okukyalira amaka mu kitundu, tewali kusoma Bayibuli oba mulimu gwa kununula babuze, Katonda w’atali mwetegefu era asobola okugaba. Kiyinza okutwala ekiseera n’okwetayirira, naye ekiragiro kya Kristo eky’okusaba Nannyini nnimiro kye kikakasa nti okusaba kujja kuwulirwa: ‘Mbategeeza nti, agolokoka n’amuwa bonna b’aba yeetaaga.’

Kirowoozo kya maanyi era kya mukisa! amaanyi gano gatuweereddwa mu kusaba okuwaayo ku bwetaavu bw’ensi, okufunira omulimu gwa Katonda abaweereza. Nannyini nnimiro ajja kuwulira. Kristo, eyatuyita mu ngeri ey’enjawulo okusaba bwe tutyo, ajja kuwagira okusaba kwaffe okuweebwayo mu linnya lye n’olw’ebigendererwa bye. Tweyawulire ekiseera era twewaayo eri ekitundu kino eky’omulimu gwaffe ogw’okwegayiririra abalala. Kujja kutuyingiza mu kussa ekimu n’omutima gwe ogusaasira ogwamuleetera okutuyita okusaba. Kujja kutusitula okutegeera ekifo kyaffe eky’obwakabaka, ng’abo okwagala kwabwe kwe kulina kye kugamba eri Katonda omukulu mu kukulaakulanya Obwakabaka bwe. Kujja kutuleetera okuwulira nga ddala bwe tuli bakozi wamu ne Katonda ku nsi, abaakwasibwa ddala ekitundu ku mulimu gwe. Kujja kutufuula abagabana mu bulumi bw’emmeeme, naye era ne mu kumatira kw’emmeeme ya Yesu, nga tumanyi engeri, olw’okuddamu okusaba kwaffe, omukisa bwe guweereddwa ogutandijjidde.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Mukama Omutendereze! Leero otuwadde nate ekimu ku bisomo byo eby’ekitalo okuyiga. Tukwegayirira n’obwetoowaze, Ai, tuwe okulaba obulungi ebintu eby’omwoyo eby’amazima by’obadde oyogerako. Waliwo amakungula, amangi ennyo, era agafa, nga galindirira abayigirizwa abakwatiddwa otulo okuwa akabonero abakozi bajje. Mukama, tuyigirize okugatunuulira n’omutima ogusaasira era ogukwatibwako. Waliwo abakozi, batono nnyo. Mukama, tulage obubi bw’ekibi ky’obutasaba n’obutakkiriza, kino kye kabonero kaakyo. Era waliwo Nannyini nnimiro, asobola ennyo era omwetegefu okubaweereza. Mukama, tulage engeri gy’alindirira ddala okusaba kwe yasibako okuddamu kwe. Era waliwo abayigirizwa, abaweereddwa omulimu gw’okusaba: Mukama, tulage engeri gy’oyinza okufuka Omwoyo wo n’obafuuwako, okusaasira kwo n’okukkiriza mu kisuubizo kyo bibazuukuse okusaba okutakoma era okuwangula.

Ai Mukama waffe! tetusobola kutegeera ngeri gy’oyinza kukwasa mulimu ng’ogwo n’okuwa amaanyi ng’ago abantu abagayaavu era abatali beesigwa bwe batyo. Tukwebaza ku lwa bonna b’oyigiriza okukaaba emisana n’ekiro abakozi baweerezebwe. Mukama, fuuwa Omwoyo wo ku baana bo bonna, bayige okubeera abalamu olw’ekintu kino kimu kyokka—Obwakabaka n’ekitiibwa kya Mukama waabwe—era bazuukuke ddala mu kukkiriza ku ekyo okusaba kwabwe kye kuyinza okutuukiriza. Era emitima gyaffe gyonna mu kino, nga mu buli kusaba, gijjule obukakafu nti okusaba, okuweebwayo mu kukkiriza okw’okwagala mu Katonda omulamu, kujja kuleeta okuddibwamu okukakafu era okungi. Amiina.
fields.body_text: ‘N’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.’—Matayo 9:37-38. Mukama yayigirizanga abayigirizwa be emirundi mingi nti bateekwa okusaba, era engeri y’okusabamu; naye ebiseera bitono n’abalaga kye balina okusaba. Ekyo yakirekera okuwulira kwabwe okw’obwetaavu n’okukulemberwa Omwoyo. Naye wano tulabawo ekintu kimu ky’abalagira mu bulambulukufu okujjukira: nga balaba amakungula amangi n’obwetaavu bw’abakungula, balina okukaabirira Nannyini nnimiro aweereze abakozi. Nga mu lugero lwa mukwano gw’omuntu mu ttumbi bwe yayagala bategeere nti okusaba tekulina kuba kwa kwefaako, ne wano okusaba ge maanyi omukisa mwe guyinza okutuukira ku balala. Kitaffe ye Nannyini nnimiro; bwe tusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tuteekwa okumusaba ateeketeeke era aweereze abakozi mu mulimu. Kyewuunyisa, si bwe kiri, okuba nga yasaba abayigirizwa be okusabira kino? Ye yennyini teyandisobodde kusaba? Era essaala ye emu teyandisinzizza amaanyi essaala zaabwe lukumi? Ne Katonda, Nannyini nnimiro, teyalaba bwetaavu? Era mu kiseera kye ekituufu teyandiweerezza bakozi awatali kusaba kwabwe? Ebibuuzo ng’ebyo bituyingiza mu byama ebisingayo obuziba eby’okusaba, n’amaanyi gaakwo mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Okuddibwamu kw’ebibuuzo ebyo kujja kutukakasa nti okusaba ddala maanyi, era nti okukungula amakungula n’okujja kw’Obwakabaka mu mazima ddala byesigamye ku kwo. Okusaba si kya mpisa oba kwolesa bwolesa. Mukama Yesu yennyini ye yali amazima; buli kye yayogeranga kyali mazima agasingayo obuziba. Bwe (laba olunyiriri 36) ‘yatunuulira ekibiina ky’abantu, n’abasaasira nnyo, kubanga baali basaasaanye ng’endiga ezitalina musumba,’ we yayitira abayigirizwa okusaba abakozi baweerezebwe gye bali. Yakola bw’atyo kubanga ddala yakkiriza nti okusaba kwabwe kwali kwetaagisa era nti kwandiyambye. Olutimbe olutukweka ennyo ensi etalabika lwali lutangaala nnyo eri emmeeme entukuvu ey’obuntu bwa Yesu. Yali atunudde okumala ebbanga, mu buziba era wala, mu nkolagana ekwekeddwa wakati w’ensibuko n’ekigiva mu nsi ey’omwoyo. Yali alabye mu Kigambo kya Katonda engeri Katonda bwe yayitanga abantu nga Ibulayimu ne Musa, Yoswa ne Samwiri ne Danyeri, n’abawa obuyinza ku bantu mu linnya lye, era mu kiseera kye kimu n’abawa obuyinza n’eddembe okuyita amaanyi ag’omu ggulu okubayamba nga bwe baagetaaga. Yamanya nti nga bwe gwali guteereddwa mu mikono gy’abasajja abo ab’edda, era ne mu gage okumala ekiseera wano ku nsi, omulimu gwa Katonda kati gwali gunaatera okuyisibwa mu mikono gy’abayigirizwa be. Yamanya nti omulimu guno bwe gunaabakwasibwa, tegwandibadde kya mpisa oba kwolesa bwolesa, wabula nti ku bo, ne ku bwesigwa oba obutali bwesigwa bwabwe, obuwanguzi bw’omulimu bwe bwandyesigamye ddala. Nga muntu omu, ali mu kkomo ly’omubiri gw’omuntu n’obulamu bw’omuntu, Yesu awulira nti okukyala okumpi kuyinza kukola kitono nnyo mu ndiga zino ezibungeeta z’alaba okumwetooloola, era ayagala nnyo obuyambi zirabirirwe bulungi. Kyava agamba abayigirizwa be okutandika okusaba kati, era, bwe banaaba bamaze okutwala omulimu okuva gy’ali ku nsi, okufuula kino kimu ku byetaago ebikulu mu kusaba kwabwe: Nannyini nnimiro yennyini aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye. Katonda eyabakwasa omulimu, n’agufuula okwesigama ennyo ku bo, abawa obuyinza okumusaba abakozi okubayamba, era afuula okufuna abakozi okwesigama ku kusaba kwabwe. Abakristaayo bawulira kitono nnyo era tebakungubagira bwetaavu bw’abakozi mu nnimiro z’ensi ezengedde dda okukungulwa. Era bakkiriza kitono nnyo nti okufuna abakozi kwesigamye ku kusaba, nti okusaba ddala kujja kuleeta ‘bonna b’aba yeetaaga.’ Si nti obutaba na bakozi tebumanyiddwa oba tebwogerwako. Si nti tewabaawo kufuba oluusi okujjuza ebbula eryo. Naye omugugu gw’endiga ezibungeeta ezitalina Musumba gusitulwa kitono nnyo mu kukkiriza nti Nannyini nnimiro ajja, olw’okuddamu okusaba, kuweereza abakozi, era mu kukakasa okw’amaanyi nti awatali kusaba kuno ennimiro ezengedde okukungulwa zijja kulekebwa zivunde. Naye bwe kiri bwe kityo. Okuwaayo omulimu gwe mu mikono gy’Ekkanisa ye kwewuunyisa nnyo, Mukama yeefudde okwesigama ennyo ku bo ng’omubiri gwe, omulimu gwe mwe guyinza okukolerwa gwokka, n’amaanyi Mukama g’awa abantu be okukozesa mu ggulu ne ku nsi ga ddala nnyo, ne kiba nti omuwendo gw’abakozi n’obungi bw’amakungula ddala byesigamye ku kusaba kwabwe. Kirowoozo kya maanyi! Ai, lwaki tetugondera kiragiro kya Musomesa n’omutima gwonna, ne tukaabirira abakozi n’obunyiikivu obusingawo? Waliwo ensonga bbiri. Esooka eri nti: Tubulwa okusaasira kwa Yesu, okwaleeta okusaba kuno. Abakkiriza bwe bayiga nti okwagala baliraanwa baabwe nga bwe beeyagala, n’okubeerawo ddala olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu bantu bannaabwe, kye kiragiro kya Kitaffe ekisooka eri abanunule be, bajja kukkiriza abo ababula ng’omulimu Mukama waabwe gw’abakwasizza. Era nga babakkiriza si ng’ennimiro ey’okukoleramu yokka, naye ng’abantu ab’okwagala n’okufiibwako, tekiritwala kiseera kinene okusaasira abo ababula awatali ssuubi ne kukwata ku mutima gwabwe, n’okukaaba ne kulinnya n’obunyiikivu obutamanyiddwangako: Mukama! weereza abakozi. Ensonga endala ey’okulagajjalira ekiragiro kino, okubulwa okukkiriza, olwo eneeyoleka, naye ejja kuwangulwa ng’okusaasira kwaffe kwegayirira obuyambi. Tukkiriza kitono nnyo mu maanyi g’okusaba okuleeta ebibala ebitegeerekeka. Tetubeera kumpi kimala ne Katonda, era tetwewaddeyo ddala kimala eri obuweereza bwe n’Obwakabaka bwe, okusobola okuba n’obwesige nti ajja kubiwa olw’okuddamu okusaba kwaffe. Ai, tusabe obulamu obuli obumu ne Kristo bwe butyo, okusaasira kwe kukulukute mu ffe, n’Omwoyo we asobole okutukakasa nti okusaba kwaffe kukola. Okusaba ng’okwo kujja kusaba era kufune omukisa ogw’emirundi ebiri. Ogusooka kwe kwegomba abantu abeewaddeyo ddala eri obuweereza bwa Katonda beeyongere obungi. Kya nsonyi nnyo eri Ekkanisa ya Kristo nti waliwo ebiseera abantu bwe batasangibwa ddala okuweereza Omusomesa ng’abasumba, abaminsani, oba abayigiriza b’Ekigambo kya Katonda. Abaana ba Katonda bwe banaafuula kino ensonga ey’okwegayirira ku lw’ekibinja kyabwe oba Ekkanisa yaabwe, kujja kubaweebwa. Mukama Yesu kati ye Nannyini nnimiro. Yagulumizibwa okugaba ebirabo—ebirabo by’Omwoyo. Ebirabo bye ebikulu be bantu abajjudde Omwoyo. Naye okufunibwa n’okugabibwa kw’ebirabo kwesigamye ku kukolera wamu kw’Omutwe n’ebitundu. Okusaba kwe kuleeta okukolera wamu okwo; abasaba abakkiriza bajja kukubirizibwa okunoonya abantu n’ebyetaagisa olw’omulimu. Omukisa omulala ogw’okusaba tegulibeera mutono. Buli mukkiriza mukozi; tewali n’omu ku baana ba Katonda atanunulibwa olw’okuweereza, era atalina mulimu gwe gumulindiridde. Kiteekwa okuba okusaba kwaffe nti Mukama ajjuze abantu be bonna omwoyo ogw’okwewaayo, waleme kubaawo n’omu asangibwa ng’ayimiridde awo nga talina ky’akola mu nnimiro y’emizabbibu. Wonna awali okwemulugunya olw’obutaba na bayambi, oba abayambi abasaanidde mu mulimu gwa Katonda, okusaba kulina ekisuubizo ky’okufuna. Tewali ssomero lya Sande oba okukyalira amaka mu kitundu, tewali kusoma Bayibuli oba mulimu gwa kununula babuze, Katonda w’atali mwetegefu era asobola okugaba. Kiyinza okutwala ekiseera n’okwetayirira, naye ekiragiro kya Kristo eky’okusaba Nannyini nnimiro kye kikakasa nti okusaba kujja kuwulirwa: ‘Mbategeeza nti, agolokoka n’amuwa bonna b’aba yeetaaga.’ Kirowoozo kya maanyi era kya mukisa! amaanyi gano gatuweereddwa mu kusaba okuwaayo ku bwetaavu bw’ensi, okufunira omulimu gwa Katonda abaweereza.
