Okwagala kuno kwa mugaso nnyo naddala bwe tukolera abantu ng’abo era ne tubasabira. Oluusi twewaayo okukolera Kristo olw’obunyiikivu ku lw’omulimu gwe, nga bwe tukiyita, oba olw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, naye nga tetwewaddeyo mu kwagala okw’omuntu ku bubwe, okwefiiriza, eri abo emyoyo gyabwe gye tunoonya. Tekyewuunyisa nti okukkiriza kwaffe kunafu era tekuwangula. Okutunuulira buli munaku, ne bw’aba nga tayagalikika atya, mu kitangaala ky’okwagala okw’ekisa okwa Yesu Omusumba anoonya ebyabula; okulaba Yesu Kristo mu ye, n’okumusitula, ku lwa Yesu, mu mutima ogwagala ddala, —kino, kino kye kyama ky’okusaba okw’okukkiriza n’okufuba okubala ebibala. Yesu, bw’ayogera ku kusonyiwa, ayogera ku kwagala ng’ekikolo kyakwo. Nga mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi bwe yagatta okuyigiriza kwe n’ebisuubizo bye ebikwata ku kusaba n’okuyita okubeera ab’ekisa, nga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu bw’ali ow’ekisa (Matayo 5:7, 9, 22, 38-48), bwe tukiraba ne wano: obulamu obw’okwagala kye kisaanyizo ky’okusaba okw’okukkiriza. Kyagambibwa nti: Tewali kintu kikebera mutima nga kusaba okw’okukkiriza, wadde okufuba okw’amazima okusaba mu kukkiriza. Kale ka tuleme kuziyiza kwekebera okwo nga tulowooza nti Katonda tawulira kusaba kwaffe olw’ensonga ze yekka z’amanyi. Nedda n’akatono. ‘Era ne bwe mubisaba, temubifuna kubanga ekigendererwa kyammwe kikyamu.’ Ekigambo ekyo ekya Katonda kitukebere. Twebuuze obanga okusaba kwaffe ddala kulaga obulamu obwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda by’ayagala n’eri okwagala abantu. Okwagala lye ttaka lyokka okukkiriza mwe kuyinza okusimba emirandira ne kukula. Bwe kuyimusa emikono gyakwo waggulu, ne kuggulawo omutima gwakwo eri eggulu, Kitaffe bulijjo atunula okulaba obanga nabyo kubiggulidde n’ababi n’abatasaanira. Mu kwagala okwo, si kwagala okwatuukirira ddala, wabula okwagala okw’ekigendererwa ekinywevu n’obuwulize obw’amazima, mwe mwokka okukkiriza mwe kuyinza okufunira omukisa. Oyo eyeewaayo okuleka okwagala kwa Katonda okubeera mu ye, n’okwagala nga Katonda bw’ayagala mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku, y’alifuna amaanyi okukkiriza mu Kwagala okuwulira buli kusaba kwe. Ye Omwana gw’Endiga, ali wakati w’entebe ey’obwakabaka: kwe kwagala okubonaabona era okugumiikiriza okuwangula mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba. Ab’ekisa balikwatirwa ekisa; abeetoowaze balisikira ensi. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Kitaffe Omutendereze! Ggwe oli Kwagala, era oyo yekka abeera mu kwagala y’abeera mu ggwe era mu kussa ekimu naawe. Omwana Omutendereze olwa leero anjigirizza nate ng’ekyo bwe kiri eky’amazima ennyo ku kussa ekimu kwange naawe mu kusaba. Ai Katonda wange! okwagala kwo, okufukiddwa mu mutima gwange olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kubeere mu nze ensulo y’okwagala eri bonna abanneetoolodde, amaanyi g’okusaba okw’okukkiriza galyoke gave mu bulamu obw’okwagala. Ai Kitaffe! mpa olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kino kibeere kye mbeeramu, nti obulamu obw’okwagala bonna abanneetoolodde gwe mulyango ogw’obulamu mu kwagala kwa Katonda wange. Era mpa naddala okulaba mu ssanyu lye nsonyiwamu buli lunaku buli ansobya, obukakafu nti okusonyiwa kwo gye ndi maanyi era bulamu. Mukama Yesu! Omuyigiriza wange Omutendereze! njigiriza okusonyiwa n’okwagala. Amaanyi g’omusaayi gwo gafuule okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi byange okw’amazima ennyo, okusonyiwa, ggwe kw’ondaze, nange kwe ndaga abalala, kubeere essanyu ddala ery’eggulu. Ndaga kyonna mu kukolagana kwange n’abantu bannange ekiyinza okulemesa okussa ekimu kwange ne Katonda, obulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku mu maka gange ne mu bantu bubeere essomero mwe nkuŋŋaanyiza amaanyi n’obuvumu olw’okusaba okw’okukkiriza. Amiina.

fields.title: Amaanyi g’Okusabira Awamu
fields.body_html:
‘Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.—Matayo 18:19-20.

ERIMU ku masomo agasooka Mukama waffe ge yatuyigiriza mu ssomero lye ery’okusaba lyali: Obutasaba kulabibwa bantu. Yingira mu kisenge kyo eky’omunda; beera wekka ne Kitaffe. Bw’amala okutuyigiriza bw’atyo nti amakulu g’okusaba kwe kukwatagana kw’omuntu kinnoomu ne Katonda, ajja n’essomo ery’okubiri: Teweetaaga kusaba kwa kyama okw’omuntu ali yekka kwokka, wabula n’okusaba okw’awamu mu lujjudde. Era atuwa ekisuubizo eky’enjawulo ennyo olw’okusaba okw’awamu okw’abantu ababiri oba abasatu abakkiriziganya ku kye basaba. Ng’omuti bwe gulina emirandira gyagwo egikwekeddwa mu ttaka n’enduli yaagwo ng’ekula ng’eraga waggulu mu musana, bwe kityo n’okusaba, okusobola okukula mu bujjuvu, kwetaaga byombi mu kigero kye kimu: ekyama ekikwekeddwa emmeeme mw’esisinkanira ne Katonda yekka, n’okussa ekimu mu lujjudde n’abo abafuna mu linnya lya Yesu ekifo kyabwe eky’awamu eky’okukuŋŋaanirangamu.

Ensonga lwaki kino kiteekwa okuba bwe kityo etegeerekeka bulungi. Omukago ogugatta omuntu ne bantu banne nagwo gwa ddala era gunywevu nga ogwo ogumugatta ne Katonda: ali omu nabo. Ekisa tekizza buggya nkolagana yaffe ne Katonda yokka, wabula n’ey’abantu nayo. Tetuyiga kugamba nti ‘Kitange,’ kyokka, wabula n’okugamba nti ‘Kitaffe.’ Tewali kyandibadde kikyamu okusinga abaana b’amaka okusisinkananga kitaabwe kinnoomu bulijjo, naye nga tebamulaga wamu bye beegomba oba okwagala kwabwe. Abakkiriza si bammemba ba maka gamu gokka, wabula era bitundu bya mubiri gumu. Nga buli kitundu ky’omubiri bwe kyesigama ku kinnaakyo, era n’omwoyo obeera mu mubiri okukola mu bujjuvu bwe kwesigama ku bumu n’okukolera awamu kw’ebitundu byonna, bwe kityo n’Abakristaayo tebasobola kutuuka ku mukisa omujjuvu Katonda gw’ayagala okubawa ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, okuggyako nga bagunoonya era nga bagufunira wamu mu kussa ekimu. Mu bumu n’okussa ekimu kw’abakkiriza Omwoyo mw’asobola okulaga amaanyi ge mu bujjuvu. Abantu kikumi mu abiri abaali babeera wamu mu kifo kimu, nga basaba n’omutima gumu, be Omwoyo yajjira okuva ku ntebe ya Mukama eyagulumizibwa.

Obubonero bw’okusaba okw’awamu okwa nnamaddala butuweebwa mu bigambo bino ebya Mukama waffe. Akabonero akasooka kwe kukkiriziganya ku kintu ekisabibwa. Tekimala kukkiriza mu ngeri ya bulijjo kwegatta ku kyonna omulala ky’ayinza okusaba: wateekwa okubaawo ekintu ekimu eky’enjawulo, ekyetaago ekitegeerekeka bulungi kye mwegomba mwenna awamu; okukkiriziganya okwo kuteekwa okuba, ng’okusaba kwonna, mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Mu kukkiriziganya ng’okwo kijja kututegeerekera bulungi ddala kye tusaba, oba nga tuyinza okukisaba n’obuvumu nga kituukana n’okwagala kwa Katonda, era oba nga tuli beetegefu okukkiriza nti kye tusabye tukifunye.

Akabonero ak’okubiri kwe kukuŋŋaanira mu Linnya lya Yesu. Oluvannyuma tujja kuyiga bingi nnyo ku bwetaavu n’amaanyi g’Erinnya lya Yesu mu kusaba; wano Mukama waffe atuyigiriza nti Erinnya eryo liteekwa okuba ekifo eky’omu makkati abakkiriza mwe bakuŋŋaanira, omukago ogubagatta ne bafuuka omu, ng’ennyumba bw’ezingiramu era n’egatta bonna abagirimu. ‘Erinnya lya Mukama kigo ky’amaanyi, omutuukirivu addukira omwo n’afuna emirembe.’ Erinnya eryo kintu kya ddala nnyo eri abo abalitegeera era abalikkiriza, ne kiba nti okukuŋŋaanira mu lyo kwe kubeera naye Yennyini. Okwagala n’obumu bw’abayigirizwa be bimusikiriza Yesu nnyo nnyo: ‘Abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.’ Okubeerawo kwa Yesu okulamu, mu kussa ekimu kw’abayigirizwa be abaagalana era abasaba, kwe kuwa okusaba okw’awamu amaanyi gaakwo.

Akabonero ak’okusatu kwe kuddibwamu okutaliimu kubuusabuusa: ‘Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera.’ Olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olw’okukuuma enkolagana mu by’eddiini, oba olw’okwezimba ffekka, luyinza okuba n’omugaso gwalwo; naye ekyo si kye Omulokozi yali agenderera bwe yaluteekawo. Yali ayagala lubeere ekkubo ery’okufuna okuddibwamu okw’enjawulo mu kusaba. Olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olutaliimu kuddibwamu okulabika lwandibadde kintu kikyamu ekitasaanidde. Bwe wabaawo omu ku ffe alina ebyetaago ebimanyiddwa bulungi, naye ne yeewulira nga munafu nnyo okukozesa okukkiriza okwetaagisa, tusaanidde okunoonya amaanyi mu buyambi bw’abalala. Mu bumu bw’okukkiriza, n’obw’okwagala, n’obw’Omwoyo, amaanyi g’Erinnya n’Okubeerawo kwa Yesu bikola nga tebiriiko kiziyiza, era okuddibwamu kujja mu ngeri ekakafu. Akabonero akalaga nti wabaddewo okusaba okw’awamu okwa nnamaddala kye kibala, kwe kuddibwamu, kwe kufuna ekyo kye twasabye: ‘Mbagamba nti, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera.’

Nga kino eky’okusabira awamu kya kitiibwa ekitayogerekeka, era nga kyandibadde maanyi ga kitalo! Singa omwami n’omukyala abakkiriza bamanya nti bagattiddwa wamu mu Linnya lya Yesu okulaba okubeerawo kwe n’amaanyi ge mu kusabira awamu (1 Peetero); singa ab’emikwano bakkiriza obuyambi obw’amaanyi ababiri oba abasatu abasabira awamu bwe bayinza okuwaŋŋana; singa mu buli lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba okukuŋŋaanira mu Linnya, okukkiriza mu Kubeerawo kwe, n’okusuubira okuddibwamu byali bisooka mu maaso; singa mu buli Kkanisa okusaba okw’awamu okw’amaanyi kwatwalibwa ng’ekimu ku bigendererwa ebikulu bye beegattira, era ng’omulimu ogw’oku ntikko ogw’amaanyi gaabwe ng’Ekkanisa; singa mu Kkanisa ey’ensi yonna okujja kw’obwakabaka, okujja kwa Kabaka Yennyini, okusooka mu kufukibwa okw’amaanyi okw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, oluvannyuma mu buntu bwe obw’ekitiibwa, ddala kwali nsonga ya kukaabirira Katonda wamu awatali kuwummula;—Ai, ani ayinza okwogera omukisa oguyinza okujjira abo, n’okuyita mu bo, abakkiriziganya batyo okugezesa Katonda mu kutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye.

Mu mutume Pawulo tulaba bulungi nnyo nga okukkiriza kwe mu maanyi g’okusabira awamu bwe kwali okwa nnamaddala. Eri Abaruumi awandiika (15:30): ‘Mbakuutira abooluganda, mu kwagala kw’Omwoyo, okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda.’ Asuubira, ng’okuddibwamu, okuwonyezebwa abalabe be, n’omulimu gwe okukulaakulana. Eri Abakkolinso (2 Abakkolinso 1:11), ‘Katonda anaatulokolanga, nammwe nga mutusabira;’ okusaba kwabwe kulina okuba n’omugabo gwa ddala mu kuwonyezebwa kwe. Eri Abaefeso awandiika: ‘Nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera, nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, era nange munsabirenga mpeebwe eby’okwogera.’ Amaanyi ge n’obuwanguzi mu buweereza bwe abifuula okwesigama ku kusaba kwabwe. Ku Bafiripi (1:19) asuubira nti ebizibu bye birifuuka obulokozi bwe n’okukulaakulana kw’enjiri ‘olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo.; Eri Abakkolosaayi (4:3) ku kiragiro eky’okunyiikiriranga mu kusaba ayongerako: ‘Era nga mwenna awamu mutusabira Katonda atuggulirewo oluggi okubuulira Enjiri.’ Era eri Abasessaloniika (2 Basessaloniika 3:1) awandiika: ‘Abooluganda, eky’enkomerero, mutusabirenga, ekigambo kya Mukama kibune mangu era Mukama agulumizibwenga, tulyoke tununulibwe okuva mu bakozi b’ebibi.’ Kyeyoleka buli wamu nti Pawulo yeetwala ng’ekitundu ky’omubiri, ogw’okusaasira n’okukolera awamu kwagwo kwe yali yeesigamye, era nti yali yeesiga okusaba kw’Ekkanisa zino okumufunira ebyo ebitandibadde bimuweebwa. Eri ye, okusaba kw’Ekkanisa kwali kintu kya ddala mu mulimu gw’obwakabaka, nga amaanyi ga Katonda bwe gali.

Ani ayinza okwogera amaanyi Ekkanisa ge yandisobodde okukulaakulanya n’okukozesa, singa yeewaayo eri omulimu gw’okusaba emisana n’ekiro olw’okujja kw’obwakabaka, olw’amaanyi ga Katonda ku baweereza be n’ekigambo kye, olw’okugulumizibwa kwa Katonda mu kulokolebwa kw’emmeeme? Ekkanisa ezisinga obungi zirowooza nti bammemba baazo bakuŋŋaanyizibwa wamu lwa kulabiriragana n’okuzimbagana kyokka. Tezimanyi nti Katonda afuga ensi ng’ayita mu kusaba kw’abatukuvu be; nti okusaba ge maanyi agawangula Setaani; nti olw’okusaba Ekkanisa ku nsi efuna obuyinza ku maanyi ag’ensi ey’omu ggulu. Tezijjukira nti Yesu, olw’ekisuubizo kye, yatukuza buli lukuŋŋaana mu Linnya lye okubeera omulyango gw’eggulu, Okubeerawo kwe gye kuwulirirwa, n’Amaanyi ge gye gamanyirwa nga Kitaffe atuukiriza bye beegomba.

Tetuyinza kumala kwebaza Katonda olwa wiiki ey’omukisa ey’okusabira awamu, Obukristaayo mu biseera byaffe bw’eggulawo nayo buli mwaka. Ng’obukakafu bw’obumu bwaffe n’okukkiriza kwaffe mu maanyi g’okusabira awamu, ng’essomero ery’okugaziya emitima gyaffe gisobole okuzingiramu ebyetaago byonna eby’Ekkanisa ey’ensi yonna, era ng’obuyambi eri okusabira awamu n’obugumiikiriza, ya mugaso ogutayogerekeka. Naye okusinga ennyo ng’ekikubiriza okwongera okwegatta mu kusaba mu bibinja ebitono, omukisa gwayo gubadde munene. Era gujja kweyongera okuba omunene, ng’abantu ba Katonda bategedde kye kitegeeza, bonna okukuŋŋaana nga omu mu Linnya lya Yesu okufuna okubeerawo kwe wakati mu mubiri ogwegasse gwonna mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n’okwesigamiza n’obuvumu ku kisuubizo nti Kitaffe alibakolera kye bakkiriziganyizzaako okusaba.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA’

Mukama Omutendereze! ggwe eyasaba ennyo mu kusaba kwo okwa Kabona Asinga Obukulu olw’obumu bw’abantu bo, tuyigirize engeri gy’otuyita era gy’otukubiriza okubeera mu bumu buno olw’ekisuubizo kyo eky’omuwendo ekiweereddwa okusabira awamu. Bwe tuba omu mu kwagala ne mu bye twegomba, okukkiriza kwaffe lwe kufuna okubeerawo kwo n’okuddibwamu kwa Kitaffe.

Ai Kitaffe! tusabira abantu bo, na buli kibinja ekitono eky’abo abakuŋŋaana awamu, babeerenga omu. Tukwegayiridde, ggyawo okwefaako kwonna n’okwenoonyeza ebyaffe, obufunda bw’omutima bwonna n’okwawukana, ebiziyiza obumu obwo. Goba omwoyo gw’ensi n’ogw’omubiri, ebireetera ekisuubizo kyo okufiirwa amaanyi gaakyo gonna. Ai, ekirowoozo eky’okubeerawo kwo n’ekisa kya Kitaffe kitusembeze ffenna kumpi buli omu ku munne.

Okusinga byonna, Mukama Omutendereze, wa Ekkanisa yo ekkirize nti olw’amaanyi g’okusabira awamu esobola okusiba n’okusumulula mu ggulu; nti Setaani asobola okugobebwa; nti emmeeme zisobola okulokolebwa; nti ensozi zisobola okusiguukululwa; nti obwakabaka busobola okwanguyizibwa. Era wa, Mukama omulungi! mu kibinja kye nsabira nakyo, okusaba kw’Ekkanisa kubeerere ddala amaanyi Erinnya lyo n’Ekigambo kyo mwe bigulumizibwa. Amiina.

Oluvannyuma tujja kuyiga bingi nnyo ku bwetaavu n’amaanyi g’Erinnya lya Yesu mu kusaba; wano Mukama waffe atuyigiriza nti Erinnya eryo liteekwa okuba ekifo eky’omu makkati abakkiriza mwe bakuŋŋaanira, omukago ogubagatta ne bafuuka omu, ng’ennyumba bw’ezingiramu era n’egatta bonna abagirimu. ‘Erinnya lya Mukama kigo ky’amaanyi, omutuukirivu addukira omwo n’afuna emirembe.’ Erinnya eryo kintu kya ddala nnyo eri abo abalitegeera era abalikkiriza, ne kiba nti okukuŋŋaanira mu lyo kwe kubeera naye Yennyini. Okwagala n’obumu bw’abayigirizwa be bimusikiriza Yesu nnyo nnyo: ‘Abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.’ Okubeerawo kwa Yesu okulamu, mu kussa ekimu kw’abayigirizwa be abaagalana era abasaba, kwe kuwa okusaba okw’awamu amaanyi gaakwo. Akabonero ak’okusatu kwe kuddibwamu okutaliimu kubuusabuusa: ‘Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera.’ Olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olw’okukuuma enkolagana mu by’eddiini, oba olw’okwezimba ffekka, luyinza okuba n’omugaso gwalwo; naye ekyo si kye Omulokozi yali agenderera bwe yaluteekawo. Yali ayagala lubeere ekkubo ery’okufuna okuddibwamu okw’enjawulo mu kusaba. Olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olutaliimu kuddibwamu okulabika lwandibadde kintu kikyamu ekitasaanidde. Bwe wabaawo omu ku ffe alina ebyetaago ebimanyiddwa bulungi, naye ne yeewulira nga munafu nnyo okukozesa okukkiriza okwetaagisa, tusaanidde okunoonya amaanyi mu buyambi bw’abalala. Mu bumu bw’okukkiriza, n’obw’okwagala, n’obw’Omwoyo, amaanyi g’Erinnya n’Okubeerawo kwa Yesu bikola nga tebiriiko kiziyiza, era okuddibwamu kujja mu ngeri ekakafu. Akabonero akalaga nti wabaddewo okusaba okw’awamu okwa nnamaddala kye kibala, kwe kuddibwamu, kwe kufuna ekyo kye twasabye: ‘Mbagamba nti, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera.’ Nga kino eky’okusabira awamu kya kitiibwa ekitayogerekeka, era nga kyandibadde maanyi ga kitalo! Singa omwami n’omukyala abakkiriza bamanya nti bagattiddwa wamu mu Linnya lya Yesu okulaba okubeerawo kwe n’amaanyi ge mu kusabira awamu (1 Peetero); singa ab’emikwano bakkiriza obuyambi obw’amaanyi ababiri oba abasatu abasabira awamu bwe bayinza okuwaŋŋana; singa mu buli lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba okukuŋŋaanira mu Linnya, okukkiriza mu Kubeerawo kwe, n’okusuubira okuddibwamu byali bisooka mu maaso; singa mu buli Kkanisa okusaba okw’awamu okw’amaanyi kwatwalibwa ng’ekimu ku bigendererwa ebikulu bye beegattira, era ng’omulimu ogw’oku ntikko ogw’amaanyi gaabwe ng’Ekkanisa; singa mu Kkanisa ey’ensi yonna okujja kw’obwakabaka, okujja kwa Kabaka Yennyini, okusooka mu kufukibwa okw’amaanyi okw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, oluvannyuma mu buntu bwe obw’ekitiibwa, ddala kwali nsonga ya kukaabirira Katonda wamu awatali kuwummula;—Ai, ani ayinza okwogera omukisa oguyinza okujjira abo, n’okuyita mu bo, abakkiriziganya batyo okugezesa Katonda mu kutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye. Mu mutume Pawulo tulaba bulungi nnyo nga okukkiriza kwe mu maanyi g’okusabira awamu bwe kwali okwa nnamaddala. Eri Abaruumi awandiika (15:30): ‘Mbakuutira abooluganda, mu kwagala kw’Omwoyo, okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda.’ Asuubira, ng’okuddibwamu, okuwonyezebwa abalabe be, n’omulimu gwe okukulaakulana. Eri Abakkolinso (2 Abakkolinso 1:11), ‘Katonda anaatulokolanga, nammwe nga mutusabira;’ okusaba kwabwe kulina okuba n’omugabo gwa ddala mu kuwonyezebwa kwe. Eri Abaefeso awandiika: ‘Nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera, nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, era nange munsabirenga mpeebwe eby’okwogera.’ Amaanyi ge n’obuwanguzi mu buweereza bwe abifuula okwesigama ku kusaba kwabwe. Ku Bafiripi (1:19) asuubira nti ebizibu bye birifuuka obulokozi bwe n’okukulaakulana kw’enjiri ‘olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo.; Eri Abakkolosaayi (4:3) ku kiragiro eky’okunyiikiriranga mu kusaba ayongerako: ‘Era nga mwenna awamu mutusabira Katonda atuggulirewo oluggi okubuulira Enjiri.’ Era eri Abasessaloniika (2 Basessaloniika 3:1) awandiika: ‘Abooluganda, eky’enkomerero, mutusabirenga, ekigambo kya Mukama kibune mangu era Mukama agulumizibwenga, tulyoke tununulibwe okuva mu bakozi b’ebibi.’ Kyeyoleka buli wamu nti Pawulo yeetwala ng’ekitundu ky’omubiri, ogw’okusaasira n’okukolera awamu kwagwo kwe yali yeesigamye, era nti yali yeesiga okusaba kw’Ekkanisa zino okumufunira ebyo ebitandibadde bimuweebwa. Eri ye, okusaba kw’Ekkanisa kwali kintu kya ddala mu mulimu gw’obwakabaka, nga amaanyi ga Katonda bwe gali. Ani ayinza okwogera amaanyi Ekkanisa ge yandisobodde okukulaakulanya n’okukozesa, singa yeewaayo eri omulimu gw’okusaba emisana n’ekiro olw’okujja kw’obwakabaka, olw’amaanyi ga Katonda ku baweereza be n’ekigambo kye, olw’okugulumizibwa kwa Katonda mu kulokolebwa kw’emmeeme? Ekkanisa ezisinga obungi zirowooza nti bammemba baazo bakuŋŋaanyizibwa wamu lwa kulabiriragana n’okuzimbagana kyokka. Tezimanyi nti Katonda afuga ensi ng’ayita mu kusaba kw’abatukuvu be; nti okusaba ge maanyi agawangula Setaani; nti olw’okusaba Ekkanisa ku nsi efuna obuyinza ku maanyi ag’ensi ey’omu ggulu. Tezijjukira nti Yesu, olw’ekisuubizo kye, yatukuza buli lukuŋŋaana mu Linnya lye okubeera omulyango gw’eggulu, Okubeerawo kwe gye kuwulirirwa, n’Amaanyi ge gye gamanyirwa nga Kitaffe atuukiriza bye beegomba. Tetuyinza kumala kwebaza Katonda olwa wiiki ey’omukisa ey’okusabira awamu, Obukristaayo mu biseera byaffe bw’eggulawo nayo buli mwaka. Ng’obukakafu bw’obumu bwaffe n’okukkiriza kwaffe mu maanyi g’okusabira awamu, ng’essomero ery’okugaziya emitima gyaffe gisobole okuzingiramu ebyetaago byonna eby’Ekkanisa ey’ensi yonna, era ng’obuyambi eri okusabira awamu n’obugumiikiriza, ya mugaso ogutayogerekeka. Naye okusinga ennyo ng’ekikubiriza okwongera okwegatta mu kusaba mu bibinja ebitono, omukisa gwayo gubadde munene. Era gujja kweyongera okuba omunene, ng’abantu ba Katonda bategedde kye kitegeeza, bonna okukuŋŋaana nga omu mu Linnya lya Yesu okufuna okubeerawo kwe wakati mu mubiri ogwegasse gwonna mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n’okwesigamiza n’obuvumu ku kisuubizo nti Kitaffe alibakolera kye bakkiriziganyizzaako okusaba. ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA’ Mukama Omutendereze! ggwe eyasaba ennyo mu kusaba kwo okwa Kabona Asinga Obukulu olw’obumu bw’abantu bo, tuyigirize engeri gy’otuyita era gy’otukubiriza okubeera mu bumu buno olw’ekisuubizo kyo eky’omuwendo ekiweereddwa okusabira awamu. Bwe tuba omu mu kwagala ne mu bye twegomba, okukkiriza kwaffe lwe kufuna okubeerawo kwo n’okuddibwamu kwa Kitaffe. Ai Kitaffe! tusabira abantu bo, na buli kibinja ekitono eky’abo abakuŋŋaana awamu, babeerenga omu. Tukwegayiridde, ggyawo okwefaako kwonna n’okwenoonyeza ebyaffe, obufunda bw’omutima bwonna n’okwawukana, ebiziyiza obumu obwo. Goba omwoyo gw’ensi n’ogw’omubiri, ebireetera ekisuubizo kyo okufiirwa amaanyi gaakyo gonna. Ai, ekirowoozo eky’okubeerawo kwo n’ekisa kya Kitaffe kitusembeze ffenna kumpi buli omu ku munne. Okusinga byonna, Mukama Omutendereze, wa Ekkanisa yo ekkirize nti olw’amaanyi g’okusabira awamu esobola okusiba n’okusumulula mu ggulu; nti Setaani asobola okugobebwa; nti emmeeme zisobola okulokolebwa; nti ensozi zisobola okusiguukululwa; nti obwakabaka busobola okwanguyizibwa. Era wa, Mukama omulungi! mu kibinja kye nsabira nakyo, okusaba kw’Ekkanisa kubeerere ddala amaanyi Erinnya lyo n’Ekigambo kyo mwe bigulumizibwa. Amiina.

fields.title: Amaanyi g’Okusaba Okunyiikivu
fields.body_html:
‘Awo Yesu n’agerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agamba nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo. . . . Awo Mukama waffe n’agamba nti, Muwulire omulamuzi atali wa mazima bw’agamba. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’—Lukka 18:1-8.

MU byama byonna eby’ensi y’okusaba, obwetaavu bw’okunyiikira mu kusaba kye kimu ku bisinga obunene. Nti Mukama, ajjudde okwagala era eyeegomba okuwa omukisa, yeetaaga okwegayirirwa emirundi n’emirundi, oluusi emyaka n’emyaka, okuddibwamu nga tekunnajja, tekyangu kukitegeera. Era kye kimu ku bizibu ebisinga obunene mu kusaba okw’okukkiriza. Bwe tumala okunyiikira okwegayirira naye okusaba kwaffe ne kutaddibwamu, emirundi mingi omubiri gwaffe omugayaavu gusanga nga kye kyangu, era kirabika ng’okwewombeeka okw’okutya Katonda, okulowooza nti kaakano tulina okulekera awo okusaba, kubanga oboolyawo Katonda alina ensonga ye ey’ekyama emulobera okuddamu kye tumusaba.

Okukkiriza kwokka kwe kuwangula ekizibu kino. Okukkiriza bwe kumala okunywerera ku kigambo kya Katonda ne ku Linnya lya Yesu, ne kwewaayo eri okukulembera kw’Omwoyo okunoonya Katonda by’ayagala n’ekitiibwa kye byokka mu kusaba kwakwo, tekwetaaga kuggwaamu maanyi olw’okulwawo. Kumanyi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa nti amaanyi g’okusaba okw’okukkiriza tegayinza kuziyizibwa; okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala tekuyinza kuswazibwa. Kumanyi nti, ng’amazzi bwe galina okukuŋŋaanyizibwa ne gatuumibwa okutuusa omugga lwe gukka n’amaanyi gaagwo gonna, galyoke gakozese amaanyi gaago agatayinza kuziyizibwa, bwe kityo emirundi mingi okusaba kulina okutuumibwa okutuusa Katonda lw’alaba ng’ekigero kijjudde, okuddibwamu ne kujja. Kumanyi nti, ng’omulimi bw’alina okutambula emitendera omutwalo gumu, n’asiga ensigo omutwalo gumu, buli emu nga kitundu ku kweteekerateekera amakungula ag’enkomerero, bwe kityo waliwo obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu okuddiŋŋanwa emirundi mingi, byonna nga bikola okutuusa omukisa ogwegombebwa. Kumanyi mu butuufu nti tewali kusaba na kumu okw’okukkiriza kuyinza kulemwa kukola mu ggulu, wabula kulina amaanyi gaakwo, era kuterekebwa okuleeta okuddibwamu mu kiseera kyakwo eri oyo anyiikira okutuusa ku nkomerero. Kumanyi nti tekukolagana na birowoozo bya bantu oba ebyo abantu bye basobola, wabula n’ekigambo kya Katonda omulamu. Bwe kityo, nga Ibulayimu bwe yamala emyaka emingi ‘ng’akkiriza mu kusuubira nga tewakyali ssuubi,’ n’oluvannyuma ‘olw’okukkiriza n’obugumiikiriza n’afuna ekyasuubizibwa,’ kutwala okugumiikiriza kwa Mukama nga bwe bulokozi, nga kulindirira era nga kwegomba nnyo okujja kwa Mukama waakwo okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye.

Okusobola, okuddibwamu bwe kutajja mangu, okugatta okugumiikiriza okukkakkamu n’obwesige obw’essanyu mu kusaba kwaffe okunyiikivu, tulina okufuba ennyo okutegeera ebigambo ebibiri Mukama waffe by’akozesa okulaga empisa n’engeri, si ez’omulamuzi atali wa mazima, wabula eza Katonda waffe era Kitaffe eri abo b’aleka okumukaabirira emisana n’ekiro: ‘Ye abagumiikiriza; agenda kubalamula mangu.’

Agenda kubalamula mangu, Omusomesa bw’agamba. Omukisa gwonna gutegekeddwa; tayagala kyokka, naye yeegomba nnyo okubawa kye basaba; okwagala okutaggwaawo kwaka n’okwegomba okwebikkulira ddala abaagalwa baakwo, n’okumalawo ebyetaago byabwe. Katonda tajja kulwawo kaseera na kamu okusukka ku kyetaagisa ddala; ajja kukola kyonna ky’asobola okwanguya n’okusembeza okuddibwamu.

Naye bwe kiba nga kino kituufu, era nga amaanyi ge tegaliiko kkomo, lwaki emirundi mingi okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kulwawo nnyo? Era lwaki abalonde ba Katonda bennyini emirundi mingi, wakati mu kubonaabona n’okulwana, balina okukaaba emisana n’ekiro? ‘Ye abagumiikiriza.’ ‘Laba! omulimi alindirira ebibala eby’omuwendo eby’ensi, ng’abigumiikiriza, okutuusa lwe bifuna enkuba eya ddumbi n’eya ttoggo.’ Omulimi ddala yeegomba amakungula ge, naye amanyi nti galina okufuna ekiseera kyago kyonna eky’omusana n’enkuba, era agumiikiriza ebbanga ddene. Omwana emirundi mingi ayagala okunoga ekibala ekitannaba kwengera; omulimi amanyi okulindirira okutuusa ekiseera ekituufu. Omuntu, ne mu buzaaliranwa bwe obw’omwoyo, ali wansi w’etteeka ly’okukula mpolampola erifuga obulamu bwonna obwatondebwa. Mu kkubo ly’okukula lyokka mw’ayinza okutuukira ku ntuuko ze ez’obwakatonda. Era Kitaffe, alina ebiro n’entuuko mu mikono gye, y’amanyi yekka akaseera emmeeme oba Ekkanisa lwe byengera okutuuka ku kukkiriza okujjuvu okwo mwe bisobolera ddala okutwala n’okukuuma omukisa. Nga taata ayaayaanira omwana we omu yekka okudda awaka okuva ku ssomero, naye n’alindirira n’obugumiikiriza okutuusa ekiseera ky’okusomesebwa lwe kiggwaako, bwe kityo bwe kiri eri Katonda n’abaana be: Ye Mugumiikiriza, era addamu mangu.

Okutegeera amazima gano kuleetera omukkiriza okukuza empisa ezikwatagana nago: obugumiikiriza n’okukkiriza, okulindirira n’okwegomba ennyo, bye byama by’okunyiikira kwe. Olw’okukkiriza ekisuubizo kya Katonda, tumanyi nti tulina bye twamusaba. Okukkiriza kutwala era ne kukwata okuddibwamu mu kisuubizo, ng’ekintu eky’omwoyo ekitalabika, ne kukisanyukira, ne kukitendereza Katonda. Naye waliwo enjawulo wakati w’okukkiriza okukwata bwe kutyo ekigambo ne kumanya nti kulina okuddibwamu, n’okukkiriza okutegeerekeka obulungi, okujjuvu era okwengedde, okufuna ekisuubizo ng’ekintu ekiriwo kaakano. Mu kusaba okunyiikivu—si okw’obutakkiriza, wabula okw’obwesige n’okutendereza—emmeeme mw’ekulira n’etuuka ku kwegatta okujjuvu ne Mukama waayo, mw’esobolera okuyingira mu kufuna omukisa mu ye. Wayinza okubaawo mu abo abatwetoolodde, wayinza okubaawo mu nteekateeka eyo ennene ey’ebitonde gye tuli ekitundu kyayo, wayinza okubaawo mu kufuga kwa Katonda, ebintu ebirina okutereezebwa olw’okusaba kwaffe, okuddibwamu nga tekunnajja mu bujjuvu: okukkiriza okwakkiriza, ng’ekiragiro bwe kiri, nti kufunye, kusobola okuleka Katonda okutwala ekiseera kye: kumanyi nti kuwangudde era kujja kuwangula. Mu kunyiikira okukkakkamu, okutalekulira era okumaliridde, kweyongera okusaba n’okwebaza okutuusa omukisa lwe gujja. Bwe tutyo tulaba nga bigattiddwa wamu ebyo ebirabika ku ntandikwa ng’ebikontana: okukkiriza okusanyukira okuddibwamu kwa Katonda atalabika ng’ekintu ekiriwo kaakano, wamu n’obugumiikiriza obukaaba emisana n’ekiro okutuusa lwe kubikkulwa. Ekya mangu mu bugumiikiriza bwa Katonda kisisinkana okukkiriza okw’obuwanguzi naye okugumiikiriza okw’omwana we alindirira.

Akabi kaffe akasinga obunene mu ssomero lino ery’okuddibwamu okulwawo, kwe kukemebwa okulowooza nti, oboolyawo, Katonda tayagala kutuwa kye tusaba. Okusaba kwaffe bwe kuba nga kukwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda, era nga kukulemberwa Omwoyo, tuleme kuwaŋŋamira kutya kuno. Tuyige okuwa Katonda ekiseera. Katonda yeetaaga ekiseera naffe. Singa tumuwa ekiseera kyokka—kwe kugamba, ekiseera mu kussa ekimu naye buli lunaku, asobole okutukolerako n’amaanyi gonna ag’okubeerawo kwe, n’ekiseera, buli lunaku, nga tukyalindirizibwa, okukkiriza kusobole okukakasa nti kwa nnamaddala era kujjuze obulamu bwaffe bwonna—ye yennyini ajja kututwala okuva mu kukkiriza okutuuka mu kulaba; tuliraba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Okulwawo kwonna kuleme kunyeenya kukkiriza kwaffe. Eby’okukkiriza biri bwe biti: okusooka kumera ekikoola, oluvannyuma ekirimba, oluvannyuma eŋŋaano enkulu mu kirimba. Buli kusaba okw’okukkiriza kuleeta omutendera gumu okusemberera obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero. Buli kusaba okw’okukkiriza kuyamba okwengeza ekibala n’okututuusa okumpi nakyo; kujjuza ekigero ky’okusaba n’okukkiriza Katonda yekka ky’amanyi; kuwangula ebiziyiza mu nsi etalabika; kwanguya enkomerero. Mwana wa Katonda! wa Kitaffe ekiseera. Akugumiikiriza. Ayagala omukisa gubeere mungi, gujjuvu era gukakafu; muwe ekiseera, ng’okaaba emisana n’ekiro. Kyokka jjukira ekigambo: ‘Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’

Omukisa gw’okusaba okunyiikivu ng’okwo tegwogerekeka. Tewali kintu kikebera mutima nga kusaba okw’okukkiriza. Kukuyigiriza okuzuula, okwatula n’okulekayo buli kintu ekiziyiza omukisa okujja; buli kintu ekiyinza okubaawo ekitakwatagana na Kitaffe by’ayagala. Kukutwala mu kussa ekimu okw’okumpi n’oyo yekka ayinza okuyigiriza okusaba, ne mu kwewaayo okujjuvu okusingawo okusembera nga tolina kibikka wabula omusaayi n’Omwoyo. Kukuyita okubeera mu Kristo yekka mu ngeri esingako okusembera n’obwangu. Omukristaayo! wa Katonda ekiseera. Alituukiriza ebyo by’akuteekeddeteekedde. ‘Okugumiikiriza—mangu,’ kino kye kigambo kya Katonda eky’okwekuumisa ng’oyingira mu miryango gy’okusaba: kibeere kyo naawe.

Kibeere bwe kityo, oba osabira ggwe kennyini oba abalala. Omulimu gwonna, ogw’omubiri oba ogw’amagezi, gwetaaga ekiseera n’okufuba: tulina okuguwaayo ffe bennyini. Obutonde bubikkula ebyama byabwo era ne buwaayo eby’obugagga byabwo eri omulimu ogw’obunyiikivu n’okulowooza kwokka. Ne bwe tuba nga tetusobola kukitegeera, mu bulimi obw’omwoyo kiri bwe kityo: ensigo ze tusiga mu ttaka ly’eggulu, okufuba kwe tuteekamu, n’amaanyi ge tunoonya okukozesa mu nsi ey’omu ggulu, byetaaga obulamu bwaffe bwonna: tulina okwewaayo mu kusaba. Naye tunywerere ku bwesige obunene, nti mu kiseera ekituufu tulikungula, bwe tutaggwaamu maanyi.

Era tuyige ennyo essomo lino nga tusabira Ekkanisa ya Kristo. Ddala eri nga nnamwandu omwavu, Mukama waayo nga taliiwo, erabika ng’eri mu buyinza bw’omulabe waayo, nga tesobola kufuna bwenkanya. Bwe tusabira Ekkanisa ye oba ekitundu kyayo kyonna ekiri wansi w’amaanyi g’ensi, nga tumusaba agikyalire n’emirimu egy’amaanyi egy’Omwoyo we era agiteekerateekere okujja kwe, tusabe n’okukkiriza okukakafu: okusaba kuyamba ddala, okusaba bulijjo n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo kujja kuleeta okuddibwamu. Kyokka wa Katonda ekiseera. Era olwo weeyongere okukaaba emisana n’ekiro. ‘Muwulire omulamuzi atali wa mazima bw’agamba. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Ayi Mukama Katonda wange! nnyigiriza kaakano okumanya ekkubo lyo, n’okutegeera mu kukkiriza Omwana wo Omwagalwa kye yayigiriza: ‘Agenda kubalamula mangu.’ Okwagala kwo okw’ekisa, n’essanyu ly’olina mu kuwulira n’okuwa abaana bo omukisa, binnyambe okukkiriza ekisuubizo kyo awatali kubuusabuusa, nti tufuna kye tukkiriza, nti tulina bye tusaba, era nti okuddibwamu kujja kulabika mu kiseera kyakwo. Mukama! tutegeera ebiseera mu butonde, era tumanyi okulindirira n’obugumiikiriza ekibala kye twegomba—Ayi, tujjuze obukakafu nti tolirwawo kaseera na kamu okusukka ku kyetaagisa, era nti okukkiriza kujja kwanguya okuddibwamu.

Omusomesa Omutendereze! Wagamba nti kabonero k’abalonde ba Katonda nti bakaaba emisana n’ekiro. Ayi tuyigirize okutegeera kino. Omanyi bwe tukoowa amangu ne tuggwaamu amaanyi. Kiba ng’Obukulu bwa Katonda buli wala nnyo okusukka obwetaavu oba obusobozi bw’okwegayirira okutakoma, ne kitaba kitusaanira kwetayirira nnyo. Ayi Mukama! nnyigiriza ddala omulimu gw’okusaba bwe guli ogwa nnamaddala. Mmanyi nga wano ku nsi, bwe nnemwa mu kintu kye ntandise, emirundi mingi nsobola okukituukiriza nga nzizeemu okufuba okusingawo era okw’olutentezi, nga mpaayo ekiseera n’okulowooza okusingako: ndaga nga, bwe nneewaayo ddala mu kusaba, okubeera mu kusaba, bwe ndifuna kye nsaba. Era okusinga byonna, Ayi Omuyigiriza wange Omutendereze! Eyatandika okukkiriza era y’akutuukiriza, olw’ekisa kyo obulamu bwange bwonna bubeere obw’okukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange—mu ye okusaba kwange mwe kukkirizibwa, mu ye mwe nfunira obukakafu bw’okuddibwamu, mu ye okuddibwamu mwe kulibeera kwange. Mukama Yesu! mu kukkiriza kuno nja kusabanga bulijjo nga siggwaamu mwoyo. Amiina.

OKUNNYONNYOLA

Obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu okw’okwetayirira abamu kirabika gye bali nga kikontana n’okukkiriza okumanyi nti kufunye kye kusaba (Makko 11:24). Ekimu ku byama by’obulamu obw’obwakatonda kwe kukwatagana wakati w’ekijja mpolampola n’ekijjira omulundi gumu, wakati w’okufuna ekintu kyonna amangu ago, n’okukyetwalira mpolampola mu ngeri etannatuukirira. Bwe kityo ne wano okusaba okunyiikivu kirabika nga lye ssomero emmeeme mw’enywezebwa olw’obuvumu bw’okukkiriza. Era olw’enjawulo z’emirimu gy’Omwoyo, wayinza okubaawo abamu okukkiriza mwe kweyolekera ennyo mu ngeri y’okulindirira okutalekulira; so ng’eri abalala, okwebaza okw’obuwanguzi kwe kulabika ng’engeri yokka entuufu ey’okulaga obukakafu nti bawuliddwa.

Mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu, n’okulinnya mpolampola okutuuka ku bwangu obusingawo mu kufuna okuddibwamu, birabikira mu bulamu bwa Blumhardt. Baali bamuwaabye nti alagajjalira omulimu gwe ng’omuweereza w’enjiri, ne yeemalira ku kuwonya abalwadde; era okusingira ddala nti awonya abalwadde ab’ebibiina ebirala nga talina lukusa. Mu kwewolereza kwe, awandiika nti: ‘Nnagezaako bugezi kukola ekisaanira omuntu alina obuvunaanyizibwa ku mmeeme, n’okusaba ng’ekiragiro kya Mukama bwe kiri mu Yakobo 1:6-7. Mu ngeri yonna saneesiga maanyi gange, wadde okulowooza nti nnalina ekirabo abalala kye batalina. Naye kino kituufu: nneewaayo eri omulimu ng’omuweereza w’enjiri, alina eddembe okusaba. Naye amangu ddala nnazuula nti emiryango gy’eggulu tegyali miggule gye ndi mu bujjuvu. Emirundi mingi nnayagala okuvaako nga mpeddemu essuubi. Naye okulaba abalwadde, abataayinza kufuna buyambi wonna, tekwampa kuwummula. Nnajjukira ekigambo kya Mukama: “musabe munaaweebwa” (Lukka 11:9-10). Era nnalowooza nti, oba Ekkanisa n’abaweereza baayo, olw’obutakkiriza, obugayaavu n’obujeemu, baali bafiiriddwa ekyali kyetaagisa okuwangula amaanyi ga Setaani, olugero lwa mukwano ow’ettumbi n’emigaati gye esatu Mukama yalugerera ddala ebiseera ng’ebyo eby’obukalu n’enjala. Nnawulira nga sisaanira, bwe ntyo mu ttumbi, mu kiseera eky’ekizikiza ekingi, okulabika mu maaso ga Katonda nga mukwano gwe, n’okusabira omu ku b’ekibiina kyange ky’ali yeetaaga. Naye era okumuleka nga talabiriddwa, nnali sisobola. Bwe ntyo ne nneeyongera okukonkona, ng’olugero bwe lulagira, oba, ng’abamu bwe baagamba, n’okwekuluntaza okungi n’okukema Katonda. Ka kibe bwe kityo, nnali sisobola kuleka mugenyi wange nga tafunye kintu. Mu kiseera ekyo olugero lwa nnamwandu lwafuuka lwa muwendo nnyo gye ndi. Nnalaba nti Ekkanisa ye nnamwandu, era nze nnali muweereza w’Ekkanisa. Nnalina eddembe okubeera akamwa kaayo eri omulabe; naye okumala ebbanga ddene Mukama teyakkiriza. Saasaba kirala kyonna wabula emigaati esatu; ebyo bye nnali neetaaga ku lw’omugenyi wange. Ku nkomerero Mukama n’awuliriza omusabi eyamwetayirira, n’annyamba. Kyali kibi nze okusaba bwe ntyo? Engero ezo ebbiri ddala zirina okukwata awantu, era wa awali obwetaavu obusingako awayinza okulowoozebwa?’

Era kiki ekyava mu kusaba kwange? Mukwano gwe ataayagala ku ntandikwa teyagamba nti, Genda kaakano; nze kennyini nja kuwa mukwano gwo ky’ayagala; sikwetaaga; wabula yakimpa nze nga mukwano gwe, nkiwe omugenyi wange. Bwe ntyo ne nkozesa emigaati esatu, ne nfissaawo. Naye ebyaliwo byali bitono, abagenyi abapya ne bajja; kubanga baalaba nti nnina omutima ogw’okubayamba, era nti nnali nneetegefu okwetikka obuzibu ne mu ttumbi okugenda ewa mukwano gwange. Bwe nnabasabira nabo, ne nfuna nate ekyetaagisa, ne wabaawo nate ekisigadde. Nnandiziyizza ntya abali mu bwetaavu okujjanga ewange buli kiseera? Nnandikakanyazizza omutima gwange ne ŋŋamba nti, Lwaki mujja gye ndi? waliwo amaka amanene era amalungi mu kibuga, mugende eyo? Okuddamu kwabwe kwali nti, Ssebo omwagalwa, tetusobola kugenda eyo. Twagenzeeyo: baanakuwala nnyo okutugoba nga tulumwa enjala bwe tutyo, naye baali tebasobola kugenda kusaba mukwano gwabwe bye twetaaga. Tukwegayiridde, genda otufunire emmere kubanga tubonaabona nnyo. Nnandikoze ki? Baayogera mazima, era okubonaabona kwabwe ne kukwata ku mutima gwange. Ne bwe kyantwalira okufuba kungi kutya, nnagendanga buli mulundi nate, ne mfuna emigaati esatu. Emirundi mingi nnafunanga kye nsaba mangu nnyo okusinga ku ntandikwa, era mu bungi okusingawo nnyo. Naye bonna tebaafaayo ku mmere eno, n’olwekyo abamu ne bava ewange nga balumwa enjala.’

Mu ntalo ze ezaasooka n’emyoyo emibi, kyamutwalira emyezi egisoba mu kkumi na munaana egy’okusaba n’okufuba obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero nga tebunnafunika. Oluvannyuma yafuna obwangu bungi okutuuka ku ntebe, era n’abeera mu nkolagana ey’okumpi ennyo n’ensi etalabika, nti emirundi mingi, ebbaluwa bwe zajjanga nga zisaba okusabira abalwadde, yasobolanga, ng’amaze okutunula waggulu akaseera kamu kokka, okufuna okuddibwamu oba nga banaawona.

Okuva mu Johann Christoph Blumhardt, Ein Lebensbild von F. Zündel.
fields.body_text: ‘Awo Yesu n’agerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agamba nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo. . . . Awo Mukama waffe n’agamba nti, Muwulire omulamuzi atali wa mazima bw’agamba. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’—Lukka 18:1-8. MU byama byonna eby’ensi y’okusaba, obwetaavu bw’okunyiikira mu kusaba kye kimu ku bisinga obunene. Nti Mukama, ajjudde okwagala era eyeegomba okuwa omukisa, yeetaaga okwegayirirwa emirundi n’emirundi, oluusi emyaka n’emyaka, okuddibwamu nga tekunnajja, tekyangu kukitegeera. Era kye kimu ku bizibu ebisinga obunene mu kusaba okw’okukkiriza. Bwe tumala okunyiikira okwegayirira naye okusaba kwaffe ne kutaddibwamu, emirundi mingi omubiri gwaffe omugayaavu gusanga nga kye kyangu, era kirabika ng’okwewombeeka okw’okutya Katonda, okulowooza nti kaakano tulina okulekera awo okusaba, kubanga oboolyawo Katonda alina ensonga ye ey’ekyama emulobera okuddamu kye tumusaba. Okukkiriza kwokka kwe kuwangula ekizibu kino. Okukkiriza bwe kumala okunywerera ku kigambo kya Katonda ne ku Linnya lya Yesu, ne kwewaayo eri okukulembera kw’Omwoyo okunoonya Katonda by’ayagala n’ekitiibwa kye byokka mu kusaba kwakwo, tekwetaaga kuggwaamu maanyi olw’okulwawo. Kumanyi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa nti amaanyi g’okusaba okw’okukkiriza tegayinza kuziyizibwa; okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala tekuyinza kuswazibwa. Kumanyi nti, ng’amazzi bwe galina okukuŋŋaanyizibwa ne gatuumibwa okutuusa omugga lwe gukka n’amaanyi gaagwo gonna, galyoke gakozese amaanyi gaago agatayinza kuziyizibwa, bwe kityo emirundi mingi okusaba kulina okutuumibwa okutuusa Katonda lw’alaba ng’ekigero kijjudde, okuddibwamu ne kujja. Kumanyi nti, ng’omulimi bw’alina okutambula emitendera omutwalo gumu, n’asiga ensigo omutwalo gumu, buli emu nga kitundu ku kweteekerateekera amakungula ag’enkomerero, bwe kityo waliwo obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu okuddiŋŋanwa emirundi mingi, byonna nga bikola okutuusa omukisa ogwegombebwa. Kumanyi mu butuufu nti tewali kusaba na kumu okw’okukkiriza kuyinza kulemwa kukola mu ggulu, wabula kulina amaanyi gaakwo, era kuterekebwa okuleeta okuddibwamu mu kiseera kyakwo eri oyo anyiikira okutuusa ku nkomerero. Kumanyi nti tekukolagana na birowoozo bya bantu oba ebyo abantu bye basobola, wabula n’ekigambo kya Katonda omulamu. Bwe kityo, nga Ibulayimu bwe yamala emyaka emingi ‘ng’akkiriza mu kusuubira nga tewakyali ssuubi,’ n’oluvannyuma ‘olw’okukkiriza n’obugumiikiriza n’afuna ekyasuubizibwa,’ kutwala okugumiikiriza kwa Mukama nga bwe bulokozi, nga kulindirira era nga kwegomba nnyo okujja kwa Mukama waakwo okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye. Okusobola, okuddibwamu bwe kutajja mangu, okugatta okugumiikiriza okukkakkamu n’obwesige obw’essanyu mu kusaba kwaffe okunyiikivu, tulina okufuba ennyo okutegeera ebigambo ebibiri Mukama waffe by’akozesa okulaga empisa n’engeri, si ez’omulamuzi atali wa mazima, wabula eza Katonda waffe era Kitaffe eri abo b’aleka okumukaabirira emisana n’ekiro: ‘Ye abagumiikiriza; agenda kubalamula mangu.’ Agenda kubalamula mangu, Omusomesa bw’agamba. Omukisa gwonna gutegekeddwa; tayagala kyokka, naye yeegomba nnyo okubawa kye basaba; okwagala okutaggwaawo kwaka n’okwegomba okwebikkulira ddala abaagalwa baakwo, n’okumalawo ebyetaago byabwe. Katonda tajja kulwawo kaseera na kamu okusukka ku kyetaagisa ddala; ajja kukola kyonna ky’asobola okwanguya n’okusembeza okuddibwamu. Naye bwe kiba nga kino kituufu, era nga amaanyi ge tegaliiko kkomo, lwaki emirundi mingi okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kulwawo nnyo? Era lwaki abalonde ba Katonda bennyini emirundi mingi, wakati mu kubonaabona n’okulwana, balina okukaaba emisana n’ekiro? ‘Ye abagumiikiriza.’ ‘Laba! omulimi alindirira ebibala eby’omuwendo eby’ensi, ng’abigumiikiriza, okutuusa lwe bifuna enkuba eya ddumbi n’eya ttoggo.’ Omulimi ddala yeegomba amakungula ge, naye amanyi nti galina okufuna ekiseera kyago kyonna eky’omusana n’enkuba, era agumiikiriza ebbanga ddene. Omwana emirundi mingi ayagala okunoga ekibala ekitannaba kwengera; omulimi amanyi okulindirira okutuusa ekiseera ekituufu. Omuntu, ne mu buzaaliranwa bwe obw’omwoyo, ali wansi w’etteeka ly’okukula mpolampola erifuga obulamu bwonna obwatondebwa. Mu kkubo ly’okukula lyokka mw’ayinza okutuukira ku ntuuko ze ez’obwakatonda. Era Kitaffe, alina ebiro n’entuuko mu mikono gye, y’amanyi yekka akaseera emmeeme oba Ekkanisa lwe byengera okutuuka ku kukkiriza okujjuvu okwo mwe bisobolera ddala okutwala n’okukuuma omukisa. Nga taata ayaayaanira omwana we omu yekka okudda awaka okuva ku ssomero, naye n’alindirira n’obugumiikiriza okutuusa ekiseera ky’okusomesebwa lwe kiggwaako, bwe kityo bwe kiri eri Katonda n’abaana be: Ye Mugumiikiriza, era addamu mangu. Okutegeera amazima gano kuleetera omukkiriza okukuza empisa ezikwatagana nago: obugumiikiriza n’okukkiriza, okulindirira n’okwegomba ennyo, bye byama by’okunyiikira kwe. Olw’okukkiriza ekisuubizo kya Katonda, tumanyi nti tulina bye twamusaba. Okukkiriza kutwala era ne kukwata okuddibwamu mu kisuubizo, ng’ekintu eky’omwoyo ekitalabika, ne kukisanyukira, ne kukitendereza Katonda. Naye waliwo enjawulo wakati w’okukkiriza okukwata bwe kutyo ekigambo ne kumanya nti kulina okuddibwamu, n’okukkiriza okutegeerekeka obulungi, okujjuvu era okwengedde, okufuna ekisuubizo ng’ekintu ekiriwo kaakano. Mu kusaba okunyiikivu—si okw’obutakkiriza, wabula okw’obwesige n’okutendereza—emmeeme mw’ekulira n’etuuka ku kwegatta okujjuvu ne Mukama waayo, mw’esobolera okuyingira mu kufuna omukisa mu ye. Wayinza okubaawo mu abo abatwetoolodde, wayinza okubaawo mu nteekateeka eyo ennene ey’ebitonde gye tuli ekitundu kyayo, wayinza okubaawo mu kufuga kwa Katonda, ebintu ebirina okutereezebwa olw’okusaba kwaffe, okuddibwamu nga tekunnajja mu bujjuvu: okukkiriza okwakkiriza, ng’ekiragiro bwe kiri, nti kufunye, kusobola okuleka Katonda okutwala ekiseera kye: kumanyi nti kuwangudde era kujja kuwangula. Mu kunyiikira okukkakkamu, okutalekulira era okumaliridde, kweyongera okusaba n’okwebaza okutuusa omukisa lwe gujja. Bwe tutyo tulaba nga bigattiddwa wamu ebyo ebirabika ku ntandikwa ng’ebikontana: okukkiriza okusanyukira okuddibwamu kwa Katonda atalabika ng’ekintu ekiriwo kaakano, wamu n’obugumiikiriza obukaaba emisana n’ekiro okutuusa lwe kubikkulwa. Ekya mangu mu bugumiikiriza bwa Katonda kisisinkana okukkiriza okw’obuwanguzi naye okugumiikiriza okw’omwana we alindirira. Akabi kaffe akasinga obunene mu ssomero lino ery’okuddibwamu okulwawo, kwe kukemebwa okulowooza nti, oboolyawo, Katonda tayagala kutuwa kye tusaba. Okusaba kwaffe bwe kuba nga kukwatagana n’ekigambo kya Katonda, era nga kukulemberwa Omwoyo, tuleme kuwaŋŋamira kutya kuno. Tuyige okuwa Katonda ekiseera. Katonda yeetaaga ekiseera naffe. Singa tumuwa ekiseera kyokka—kwe kugamba, ekiseera mu kussa ekimu naye buli lunaku, asobole okutukolerako n’amaanyi gonna ag’okubeerawo kwe, n’ekiseera, buli lunaku, nga tukyalindirizibwa, okukkiriza kusobole okukakasa nti kwa nnamaddala era kujjuze obulamu bwaffe bwonna—ye yennyini ajja kututwala okuva mu kukkiriza okutuuka mu kulaba; tuliraba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Okulwawo kwonna kuleme kunyeenya kukkiriza kwaffe. Eby’okukkiriza biri bwe biti: okusooka kumera ekikoola, oluvannyuma ekirimba, oluvannyuma eŋŋaano enkulu mu kirimba. Buli kusaba okw’okukkiriza kuleeta omutendera gumu okusemberera obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero. Buli kusaba okw’okukkiriza kuyamba okwengeza ekibala n’okututuusa okumpi nakyo; kujjuza ekigero ky’okusaba n’okukkiriza Katonda yekka ky’amanyi; kuwangula ebiziyiza mu nsi etalabika; kwanguya enkomerero. Mwana wa Katonda! wa Kitaffe ekiseera. Akugumiikiriza. Ayagala omukisa gubeere mungi, gujjuvu era gukakafu; muwe ekiseera, ng’okaaba emisana n’ekiro. Kyokka jjukira ekigambo: ‘Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’ Omukisa gw’okusaba okunyiikivu ng’okwo tegwogerekeka. Tewali kintu kikebera mutima nga kusaba okw’okukkiriza. Kukuyigiriza okuzuula, okwatula n’okulekayo buli kintu ekiziyiza omukisa okujja; buli kintu ekiyinza okubaawo ekitakwatagana na Kitaffe by’ayagala. Kukutwala mu kussa ekimu okw’okumpi n’oyo yekka ayinza okuyigiriza okusaba, ne mu kwewaayo okujjuvu okusingawo okusembera nga tolina kibikka wabula omusaayi n’Omwoyo. Kukuyita okubeera mu Kristo yekka mu ngeri esingako okusembera n’obwangu. Omukristaayo! wa Katonda ekiseera. Alituukiriza ebyo by’akuteekeddeteekedde. ‘Okugumiikiriza—mangu,’ kino kye kigambo kya Katonda eky’okwekuumisa ng’oyingira mu miryango gy’okusaba: kibeere kyo naawe. Kibeere bwe kityo, oba osabira ggwe kennyini oba abalala. Omulimu gwonna, ogw’omubiri oba ogw’amagezi, gwetaaga ekiseera n’okufuba: tulina okuguwaayo ffe bennyini. Obutonde bubikkula ebyama byabwo era ne buwaayo eby’obugagga byabwo eri omulimu ogw’obunyiikivu n’okulowooza kwokka. Ne bwe tuba nga tetusobola kukitegeera, mu bulimi obw’omwoyo kiri bwe kityo: ensigo ze tusiga mu ttaka ly’eggulu, okufuba kwe tuteekamu, n’amaanyi ge tunoonya okukozesa mu nsi ey’omu ggulu, byetaaga obulamu bwaffe bwonna: tulina okwewaayo mu kusaba. Naye tunywerere ku bwesige obunene, nti mu kiseera ekituufu tulikungula, bwe tutaggwaamu maanyi. Era tuyige ennyo essomo lino nga tusabira Ekkanisa ya Kristo. Ddala eri nga nnamwandu omwavu, Mukama waayo nga taliiwo, erabika ng’eri mu buyinza bw’omulabe waayo, nga tesobola kufuna bwenkanya. Bwe tusabira Ekkanisa ye oba ekitundu kyayo kyonna ekiri wansi w’amaanyi g’ensi, nga tumusaba agikyalire n’emirimu egy’amaanyi egy’Omwoyo we era agiteekerateekere okujja kwe, tusabe n’okukkiriza okukakafu: okusaba kuyamba ddala, okusaba bulijjo n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo kujja kuleeta okuddibwamu. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Ayi Mukama Katonda wange! nnyigiriza kaakano okumanya ekkubo lyo, n’okutegeera mu kukkiriza Omwana wo Omwagalwa kye yayigiriza: ‘Agenda kubalamula mangu.’ Okwagala kwo okw’ekisa, n’essanyu ly’olina mu kuwulira n’okuwa abaana bo omukisa, binnyambe okukkiriza ekisuubizo kyo awatali kubuusabuusa, nti tufuna kye tukkiriza, nti tulina bye tusaba, era nti okuddibwamu kujja kulabika mu kiseera kyakwo. Omusomesa Omutendereze! Wagamba nti kabonero k’abalonde ba Katonda nti bakaaba emisana n’ekiro. Ayi tuyigirize okutegeera kino. Omanyi bwe tukoowa amangu ne tuggwaamu amaanyi. Kiba ng’Obukulu bwa Katonda buli wala nnyo okusukka obwetaavu oba obusobozi bw’okwegayirira okutakoma, ne kitaba kitusaanira kwetayirira nnyo. Ayi Mukama! nnyigiriza ddala omulimu gw’okusaba bwe guli ogwa nnamaddala. Mmanyi nga wano ku nsi, bwe nnemwa mu kintu kye ntandise, emirundi mingi nsobola okukituukiriza nga nzizeemu okufuba okusingawo era okw’olutentezi, nga mpaayo ekiseera n’okulowooza okusingako: ndaga nga, bwe nneewaayo ddala mu kusaba, okubeera mu kusaba, bwe ndifuna kye nsaba. Era okusinga byonna, Ayi Omuyigiriza wange Omutendereze! Eyatandika okukkiriza era y’akutuukiriza, olw’ekisa kyo obulamu bwange bwonna bubeere obw’okukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange—mu ye okusaba kwange mwe kukkirizibwa, mu ye mwe nfunira obukakafu bw’okuddibwamu, mu ye okuddibwamu mwe kulibeera kwange. Mukama Yesu! mu kukkiriza kuno nja kusabanga bulijjo nga siggwaamu mwoyo. Amiina. OKUNNYONNYOLA Obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu okw’okwetayirira abamu kirabika gye bali nga kikontana n’okukkiriza okumanyi nti kufunye kye kusaba (Makko 11:24). Ekimu ku byama by’obulamu obw’obwakatonda kwe kukwatagana wakati w’ekijja mpolampola n’ekijjira omulundi gumu, wakati w’okufuna ekintu kyonna amangu ago, n’okukyetwalira mpolampola mu ngeri etannatuukirira. Bwe kityo ne wano okusaba okunyiikivu kirabika nga lye ssomero emmeeme mw’enywezebwa olw’obuvumu bw’okukkiriza. Era olw’enjawulo z’emirimu gy’Omwoyo, wayinza okubaawo abamu okukkiriza mwe kweyolekera ennyo mu ngeri y’okulindirira okutalekulira; so ng’eri abalala, okwebaza okw’obuwanguzi kwe kulabika ng’engeri yokka entuufu ey’okulaga obukakafu nti bawuliddwa. Mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, obwetaavu bw’okusaba okunyiikivu, n’okulinnya mpolampola okutuuka ku bwangu obusingawo mu kufuna okuddibwamu, birabikira mu bulamu bwa Blumhardt. Baali bamuwaabye nti alagajjalira omulimu gwe ng’omuweereza w’enjiri, ne yeemalira ku kuwonya abalwadde; era okusingira ddala nti awonya abalwadde ab’ebibiina ebirala nga talina lukusa. Mu kwewolereza kwe, awandiika nti: ‘Nnagezaako bugezi kukola ekisaanira omuntu alina obuvunaanyizibwa ku mmeeme, n’okusaba ng’ekiragiro kya Mukama bwe kiri mu Yakobo 1:6-7. Mu ngeri yonna saneesiga maanyi gange, wadde okulowooza nti nnalina ekirabo abalala kye batalina. Naye kino kituufu: nneewaayo eri omulimu ng’omuweereza w’enjiri, alina eddembe okusaba. Naye amangu ddala nnazuula nti emiryango gy’eggulu tegyali miggule gye ndi mu bujjuvu. Emirundi mingi nnayagala okuvaako nga mpeddemu essuubi. Naye okulaba abalwadde, abataayinza kufuna buyambi wonna, tekwampa kuwummula. Nnajjukira ekigambo kya Mukama: “musabe munaaweebwa” (Lukka 11:9-10). Era nnalowooza nti, oba Ekkanisa n’abaweereza baayo, olw’obutakkiriza, obugayaavu n’obujeemu, baali bafiiriddwa ekyali kyetaagisa okuwangula amaanyi ga Setaani, olugero lwa mukwano ow’ettumbi n’emigaati gye esatu Mukama yalugerera ddala ebiseera ng’ebyo eby’obukalu n’enjala. Nnawulira nga sisaanira, bwe ntyo mu ttumbi, mu kiseera eky’ekizikiza ekingi, okulabika mu maaso ga Katonda nga mukwano gwe, n’okusabira omu ku b’ekibiina kyange ky’ali yeetaaga. Naye era okumuleka nga talabiriddwa, nnali sisobola. Bwe ntyo ne nneeyongera okukonkona, ng’olugero bwe lulagira, oba, ng’abamu bwe baagamba, n’okwekuluntaza okungi n’okukema Katonda. Ka kibe bwe kityo, nnali sisobola kuleka mugenyi wange nga tafunye kintu. Mu kiseera ekyo olugero lwa nnamwandu lwafuuka lwa muwendo nnyo gye ndi. Nnalaba nti Ekkanisa ye nnamwandu, era nze nnali muweereza w’Ekkanisa. Nnalina eddembe okubeera akamwa kaayo eri omulabe; naye okumala ebbanga ddene Mukama teyakkiriza. Saasaba kirala kyonna wabula emigaati esatu; ebyo bye nnali neetaaga ku lw’omugenyi wange. Ku nkomerero Mukama n’awuliriza omusabi eyamwetayirira, n’annyamba. Kyali kibi nze okusaba bwe ntyo? Engero ezo ebbiri ddala zirina okukwata awantu, era wa awali obwetaavu obusingako awayinza okulowoozebwa?’ Era kiki ekyava mu kusaba kwange? Mukwano gwe ataayagala ku ntandikwa teyagamba nti, Genda kaakano; nze kennyini nja kuwa mukwano gwo ky’ayagala; sikwetaaga; wabula yakimpa nze nga mukwano gwe, nkiwe omugenyi wange. Bwe ntyo ne nkozesa emigaati esatu, ne nfissaawo. Naye ebyaliwo byali bitono, abagenyi abapya ne bajja; kubanga baalaba nti nnina omutima ogw’okubayamba, era nti nnali nneetegefu okwetikka obuzibu ne mu ttumbi okugenda ewa mukwano gwange. Bwe nnabasabira nabo, ne nfuna nate ekyetaagisa, ne wabaawo nate ekisigadde. Nnandiziyizza ntya abali mu bwetaavu okujjanga ewange buli kiseera? Nnandikakanyazizza omutima gwange ne ŋŋamba nti, Lwaki mujja gye ndi? waliwo amaka amanene era amalungi mu kibuga, mugende eyo? Okuddamu kwabwe kwali nti, Ssebo omwagalwa, tetusobola kugenda eyo. Twagenzeeyo: baanakuwala nnyo okutugoba nga tulumwa enjala bwe tutyo, naye baali tebasobola kugenda kusaba mukwano gwabwe bye twetaaga. Tukwegayiridde, genda otufunire emmere kubanga tubonaabona nnyo. Nnandikoze ki? Baayogera mazima, era okubonaabona kwabwe ne kukwata ku mutima gwange. Ne bwe kyantwalira okufuba kungi kutya, nnagendanga buli mulundi nate, ne mfuna emigaati esatu. Emirundi mingi nnafunanga kye nsaba mangu nnyo okusinga ku ntandikwa, era mu bungi okusingawo nnyo. Naye bonna tebaafaayo ku mmere eno, n’olwekyo abamu ne bava ewange nga balumwa enjala.’ Mu ntalo ze ezaasooka n’emyoyo emibi, kyamutwalira emyezi egisoba mu kkumi na munaana egy’okusaba n’okufuba obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero nga tebunnafunika. Oluvannyuma yafuna obwangu bungi okutuuka ku ntebe, era n’abeera mu nkolagana ey’okumpi ennyo n’ensi etalabika, nti emirundi mingi, ebbaluwa bwe zajjanga nga zisaba okusabira abalwadde, yasobolanga, ng’amaze okutunula waggulu akaseera kamu kokka, okufuna okuddibwamu oba nga banaawona. Okuva mu Johann Christoph Blumhardt, Ein Lebensbild von F. Zündel.

fields.title: Okusaba Okukwatagana ne Katonda bw’Ali
fields.body_html:
‘Kitange nkwebaza olw’okumpulira. Mmanyi nti bulijjo ompulira.’—Yokaana 11:41-42.

‘Ggwe oli Mwana wange, olwa leero nfuuse kitaawo. Nsaba, nange ndikuwa.’—Zabbuli 2:7-8.

MU Ndagaano Empya tusangamu enjawulo wakati w’okukkiriza n’okumanya. ‘Omu Omwoyo amuwa okwogera ekigambo eky’amagezi, omulala Omwoyo oyo omu n’amuwa okuyiga n’ategeera. Omulala Omwoyo y’omu n’amuwa okukkiriza.’ Mu mwana oba mu Mukristaayo ow’omutima omwangu wayinza okubaamu okukkiriza kungi n’okumanya kutono. Obwangu obw’omwana bukkiriza amazima awatali kuzibuwalirwa, era emirundi mingi tebufaayo kwewa wadde okuwa abalala ensonga yonna ey’okukkiriza kwabwo okuggyako eno: Katonda yayogera. Naye Katonda ayagala tumwagale era tumuweereze, si na mutima gwonna gwokka, naye era n’amagezi gaffe gonna; tukule tutuuke ku kutegeera amagezi n’obulungi bwa Katonda obuli mu makubo ge gonna, mu bigambo bye ne mu bikolwa bye. Mu ngeri eyo yokka omukkiriza mw’anaasobolera okusemberera ddala n’okusinza mu butuufu ekitiibwa ky’ekisa kya Katonda; era mu ngeri eyo yokka omutima gwaffe mwe guyinza okutegeera obulungi obugagga bw’amagezi n’okumanya ebiri mu kununulibwa, ne gwetegekera okwegatta mu bujjuvu mu ddoboozi erisingayo waggulu ery’oluyimba olulinnya mu maaso g’entebe: ‘Kale nga Katonda wa kitalo, ng’amagezi ge mangi n’okutegeera kwe kungi era n’obugagga bungi!’

Mu bulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba amazima gano gakola mu bujjuvu. Wadde okusaba n’okukkiriza byangu nnyo ne kiba nti omukkiriza akyakazaalibwa ayinza okusaba n’amaanyi, okumanya okw’amazima okw’Ekikristaayo kusanga mu njigiriza y’okusaba ebimu ku bizibu byakwo ebisinga obuziba. Amaanyi g’okusaba ga ddala okutuuka wa? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, Katonda ayinza atya okuwa okusaba amaanyi amangi bwe gatyo? Ekikolwa ky’okusaba kiyinza kitya okukwatagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda n’ebyo bye yasalawo? Obufuzi bwa Katonda n’okwagala kwaffe, eddembe lya Katonda n’eddembe lyaffe, biyinza bitya okutabagana?—ebibuuzo bino n’ebirala ebifaanana bwe bityo bisaanidde Abakristaayo okubifumiitirizaako n’okubinoonyerezaamu. Gye tukoma okusemberera ebyama ebyo n’obunyiikivu n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, gye tujja okukoma okuvunnama nga twewuunya, ne tutendereza Oyo eyawa omuntu amaanyi ag’ekika ekyo mu kusaba.

Ekimu ku bizibu ebyekusifu ebikwata ku kusaba,—ekimu ekitayogerwa, naye emirundi mingi ekiremesa ddala okusaba,—kiva mu butuukirivu bwa Katonda, mu kubeera kwe nga teyeesigama n’akatono ku kintu kyonna ekiri ebweru we. Ye si ye Katonda Atalina kkomo, ali bw’ali ku bubwe yekka, eyeesalirawo yekka, era ow’okwagala okw’amagezi era okutukuvu okwasalawo byonna ebigenda okubaawo? Okusaba kuyinza kutya okumukolako, oba ye okuleetebwa okusaba okukola ekyo ky’atandikoze? Ekisuubizo nti okusaba kuliddibwamu si kwetoowaza bwetoowaza okututuukako mu bunafu bwaffe? Ebyo ebyogerwa ku maanyi—amaanyi amangi ennyo—ag’okusaba, bisingawo ku kwetuukanya n’engeri yaffe ey’okulowooza, kubanga Katonda tayinza n’akatono kwesigama ku kikolwa kyonna eky’ebweru mu by’akola? Era omukisa gw’okusaba si gwe gwokka gwe kukola ku ffe fennyini?

Bwe tunoonya eky’okuddamu ku bibuuzo ng’ebyo, ekisumuluzo tukisanga mu butonde bwa Katonda bwennyini, mu kyama ky’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Singa Katonda yali Muntu omu yekka, eyeggalidde mu ye yekka, tewandibadde kirowoozo kya kumusemberera wadde okumukolako. Naye mu Katonda mulimu Abantu basatu. Mu Katonda tulina Kitaffe n’Omwana, abalina mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu omukago gwabwe omulamu ogw’obumu n’okussa ekimu. Okwagala okutaggwaawo bwe kwazaala Omwana, Kitaffe n’awa Omwana, nga Muntu ow’Okubiri, ekifo okumpi naye ng’Amwenkana era Omuwi we w’amagezi, ekkubo lyaggulwawo okusaba n’amaanyi gaakwo mu bulamu obw’omunda ennyo obwa Katonda yennyini. Nga bwe kiri ku nsi, bwe kityo ne mu ggulu enkolagana yonna wakati wa Kitaffe n’Omwana kwe kuwa n’okutwala. Era obanga okutwala okwo kulina okuba okw’okweyagalira n’okwesalirawo ng’okuwa, kiteekwa okubaawo ku ludda lw’Omwana okusaba n’okufuna. Mu kussa ekimu okutukuvu okw’Abantu ba Katonda, okusaba kuno okw’Omwana kwali kimu ku bikolwa ebikulu eby’Obulamu bwa Katonda Obutendereze Emirundi Esatu. Kye tuva tukisanga mu Zabbuli 2: ‘Olwa leero nfuuse kitaawo: nsaba, nange ndikuwa.’ Kitaffe yawa Omwana ekifo n’obuyinza okumukolako. Okusaba kw’Omwana tekwali kwefuula oba kisiikirize, wabula kyali kimu ku ntambula z’obulamu omwo okwagala kwa Kitaffe n’okw’Omwana mwe kwasisinkanira ne kujjuzagana. Kitaffe yali yasalawo nti tabeera yekka mu magezi ge: waaliwo Omwana ng’okutuukirizibwa kwago kulina okwesigama ku kusaba kwe n’okukkiriza kwe. Bwe kityo mu Butonde n’Obulamu bwa Katonda mwennyini mwalimu okusaba, okusaba ku nsi kwe kwalina okuba ekifaananyi kyakwo n’okukulukuta kwakwo. Ne kino kyalimu Yesu bwe yagamba nti, “Mmanyi nti bulijjo ompulira.’ Ng’Obwana bwa Yesu ku nsi bwe butayinza kwawulwa ku Bwana bwe mu ggulu, bwe kityo n’okusaba kwe ku nsi: kwe kweyongerayo n’ekifaananyi ky’okusaba kwe mu ggulu. Okusaba kw’omuntu Kristo Yesu ye mukago wakati w’okusaba okutaggwaawo okw’Omwana eyazaalibwa omu yekka mu kifuba kya Kitaffe n’okusaba kw’abantu ku nsi. Okusaba kusibuka era kulina ensulo yaakwo esinga obuziba mu Butonde bwa Katonda bwennyini. Mu kifuba kya Katonda tewali kikolebwa awatali kusaba—okusaba kw’Omwana n’okuwa kwa Kitaffe.

Kino kiyinza okutuyamba katono okutegeera engeri okusaba kw’omuntu, nga kuyita mu Mwana, gye kuyinza okukola ku Katonda. Ebyo Katonda bye yasalawo si nsalawo ze yakola awatali kufaayo ku Mwana, oba ku kusaba kwe, oba ku kusaba okulina okutuusibwa nga kuyita mu ye. Nedda n’akatono. Mukama Yesu ye mubereberye, Omutwe era Omusika wa byonna: ebintu byonna byatondebwa nga biyita mu ye era ku lulwe, era ebintu byonna binywezebwa mu ye. Mu magezi Kitaffe g’asala, Omwana, ng’Omukiise w’ebitonde byonna, yabeeranga n’eddoboozi; mu ebyo ebyasalibwawo mu kigendererwa ekitaggwaawo bulijjo mwalekebwamu ekifo eky’eddembe ly’Omwana ng’Omutabaganya era Omwegayirizi, era bwe kityo n’eky’okusaba kw’abo bonna abasemberera Kitaffe mu Mwana.

Era bwe kijja ekirowoozo nti eddembe lino n’obuyinza buno obw’Omwana okukola ku Kitaffe bikontana n’obutakyuka bw’ebyo Katonda bye yasalawo, tetwerabira nti eri Katonda tekiri nga bwe kiri eri omuntu, ng’alina ebyayita by’asibiddwako awatali kusumululwa. Katonda tabeera mu biseera ebirimu ebyayita n’ebigenda okujja; enjawulo z’ebiseera tezikwata ku Oyo abeera mu Butaggwaawo. Era Obutaggwaawo kye Kati ekibeerawo bulijjo, ebyayita mwe bitayitira, n’ebigenda okujja mwe bibeerera bulijjo. Okutuukana n’obunafu bwaffe obw’obuntu, Ebyawandiikibwa biteekwa okwogera ku bye yasalawo edda, n’ebiseera ebigenda okujja. Mu mazima, obutakyuka bw’amagezi ga Katonda bukwatagana bulijjo bulungi ddala n’eddembe lye ery’okukola kyonna ky’ayagala. Okusaba kw’Omwana n’okw’abantu be tekwateekebwa mu ebyo ebyasalibwawo emirembe gyonna kubeere n’amaanyi agalabika obulabisi; wabula kyakolebwa bwe kityo, omutima gwa Kitaffe gusigale nga muggule era nga gwa ddembe okuwulira buli kusaba okulinnya nga kuyita mu Mwana, era Katonda yeekkiriza ddala okusalirwawo okusaba okukola ekyo ky’atandikoze.

Okukwatagana kuno okutuukiridde n’obumu bw’Obufuzi bwa Katonda n’eddembe ly’omuntu kyama gye tuli ekitategeerekeka, kubanga Katonda nga OYO ATAGGWAAWO asinga ebirowoozo byaffe byonna. Naye kibeere okubudaabudibwa kwaffe n’amaanyi gaffe okukakasa nti mu kussa ekimu okutaggwaawo wakati wa Kitaffe n’Omwana amaanyi g’okusaba mwe gasibuka era mwe galina obukakafu bwago, era nti olw’okwegatta kwaffe n’Omwana, okusaba kwaffe kutwalibwa waggulu era kuyinza okukola mu bulamu obw’omunda obw’Obusatu Obutendereze. Ebyo Katonda bye yasalawo si kizimbe kya kyuma eddembe ly’omuntu kye lyandirwanyisizza obwereere. Nedda. Katonda yennyini kwe Kwagala Okulamu, eyayingira mu Mwana we nga muntu mu nkolagana esingayo okwagala n’ebyobuntu byonna, ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu n’atwala byonna eby’obuntu mu bulamu bw’okwagala obwa Katonda, era eyeekuuma nga wa ddembe okuwa buli kusaba kw’omuntu ekifo kyakwo mu bufuzi bwe obw’ensi.

Mu kitangaala ky’emambya eky’ebirowoozo ng’ebyo, enjigiriza y’Obusatu Obutendereze tekyali kuteebereza kwa bwongo bwokka, wabula kye kulabisibwa okulamu okw’engeri omuntu gy’ayinza okutwalibwa mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda, n’okusaba kwe ne kufuuka ekintu ekikola ddala mu bufuzi bwa Katonda obw’ensi eno. Era tuyinza, nga tuli wala, okulengera ekitangaala ekiva mu nsi etaggwaawo ne kyakira ku bigambo nga bino: ‘KU BW’OYO KRISTO ffenna tuyita MU MWOYO OMU okutuuka eri KITAFFE.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Katonda Ataggwaawo! Omu mu Basatu, Omutukuvu Emirundi Esatu! mu kussa ekitiibwa okungi nnandyagadde okusinza nga mbisse amaaso mu maaso g’ekyama ekitukuvu eky’Obwakatonda bwo. Era bw’oba osiima, Ayi Katonda ow’ekitiibwa ekingi, okubikkula ekitundu ku kyama ekyo, nnandyagadde okuvunnama n’okutya n’okukankana, nneme kukwonoona, nga bwe nfumiitiriza ku kitiibwa kyo.

Kitaffe! nkwebaza nti erinnya lino tolirina ng’oli Kitaabwe w’abaana bo abali wano ku nsi kyokka, naye nga bwe wabeerawo okuva emirembe n’emirembe ng’oli Kitaawe w’Omwana wo eyazaalibwa omu yekka. Nkwebaza nti nga Kitaffe oyinza okuwulira okusaba kwaffe, kubanga okuva emirembe n’emirembe wawa okusaba kw’Omwana wo ekifo mu magezi go. Nkwebaza nti twalaba mu ye ku nsi okussa ekimu okw’omukisa kwe yalina naawe mu ggulu; era nti okuva emirembe n’emirembe mu magezi go gonna ne mu by’osalawo mwalekebwamu ekifo eky’okusaba kwe n’okuddibwamu kwakwo. Era okusinga byonna nkwebaza nti olw’obuntu bwe obwa ddala ku ntebe yo waggulu, n’olw’Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu mu buntu bwaffe wano wansi, waggulwawo ekkubo buli kukaaba kw’omuntu mu bwetaavu mwe kuyinza okutwalibwa waggulu ne kutuuka ku Bulamu n’Okwagala kwa Katonda, ne kuddibwamu kyonna kye kunaasaba.

Yesu Omutendereze! mu ggwe ng’Omwana ekkubo ly’okusaba mwe lyaggulirwawo, era atuwa obukakafu bw’okuddibwamu, tukwegayiridde, yigiriza abantu bo okusaba. Ayi, kino kibeerenga buli lunaku akabonero k’obwana bwaffe, nti, nga ggwe, tumanyi nti Kitaffe atuwulira bulijjo. Amiina.

EBIGATTIDDWAKO.

‘“Katonda awulira okusaba.” Endowooza eno esinga obwangu ku kusaba y’etwalibwa mu Byawandiikibwa byonna. Tebimalira ku ngeri okusaba gye kukola ku mutima gwaffe n’obulamu bwaffe, newakubadde nga biraga bulungi enkolagana wakati w’okusaba ng’ekikolwa, n’okusaba ng’embeera. Wabula biteeka essira ddala ku bigendererwa ebya ddala eby’okusaba: okufuna emikisa, ebirabo, n’okununulibwa okuva eri Katonda. ‘Musabe, munaaweebwa,” Yesu bw’agamba.

‘Wadde nga kiyinza okuba eky’amazima era eky’omugaso okulowooza nti Katonda, eyalaba edda era eyateekateeka edda byonna, yalaba edda era n’ateekateeka edda n’okusaba kwaffe ng’empeta mu lujegere lw’ebigenda bibaawo, olw’ensonga n’ekivaamu, nga maanyi ga ddala, naye tukakasa nti eno si y’engeri omutima gye guyinza okufunamu emirembe ku nsonga eno enkulu, era tetulowooza nti wano we wali amaanyi agatusikiriza okusaba. Wabula tuwulira nti okulowooza okwo kukyusa amaaso gaffe ne gava ku Oyo omuva ekisinde, obulamu n’amaanyi g’okusaba. Katonda omulamu, ali naffe mu kiseera kino so si ow’emirembe n’emirembe kyokka, Omulamu, Omusaasizi, Omutukuvu, Katonda eyeeraga eri emmeeme, Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Munnoonye;” kino kye kitusikiriza nga magineti, era kino kyokka kye kiyinza okuggula omutima n’emimwa. . .

‘Mu Yesu Kristo Omwana wa Katonda tufuniramu eky’okuddamu ekijjuvu eky’obuzibu buno. Yasaba ku nsi, so si ng’omuntu yekka, naye ng’Omwana wa Katonda eyafuuka omubiri. Okusaba kwe ku nsi kwe kulabisibwa kwokka okw’okusaba kwe okuva emirembe n’emirembe, bwe yateekebwawo mu magezi ga Katonda okuba Kristo. . . . Omwana yalondebwa okuba omusika wa byonna. Okuva emirembe n’emirembe Omwana wa Katonda ye yali Ekkubo, Omutabaganya. Yali, nga tukozesa olulimi lwaffe olutatuukiridde, okuva emirembe n’emirembe ng’ayogera ne Kitaffe ku lw’ensi.’—SAPHIR, The Hidden Life, essuula 6. Laba ne The Lord’s Prayer, olupapula 12.
