Oyo ayagala okusaba okusaba okw’okukkiriza ateekwa okwewaayo okubeera omulamu ddala mu ngeri nti Kitaffe mu byonna agulumizibwe mu ye. Kino kye kiteekwa okuba ekigendererwa kye: awatali kino tewayinza kubaawo kusaba kwa kukkiriza. ‘Muyinza mutya okukkiriza,’ Yesu bwe yagamba, ‘nga munoonya kusiimibwa bantu bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kusiimibwa Katonda oyo Omu yekka?’ Okwenoonyeza ekitiibwa kyonna mu bantu kufuula okukkiriza okutasoboka: kwe kwefiiriza okw’omunda ennyo okuleka ekitiibwa kyakwo, ne kunoonya ekitiibwa kya Katonda yekka, okuzuukusa mu mmeeme okutegeera okw’omwoyo okw’ebya Katonda, kwe kukkiriza. Okwewaayo eri Katonda okunoonya ekitiibwa kye, n’okusuubira nti ajja kwolesa ekitiibwa kye ng’atuwulira, birina ekikolo kimu: oyo anoonya ekitiibwa kya Katonda ajja kukiraba mu kuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwe, era ye yekka. Era tubuuze nate, tunaakituukako tutya? Ka tutandike n’okwatula. Nga kitono nnyo ekitiibwa kya Katonda bwe kibadde okwegomba kwaffe okusinga byonna ebirala; nga kitono nnyo obulamu bwaffe n’okusaba kwaffe bwe bibadde bikijjudde. Nga kitono nnyo bwe tubadde tubeera mu kifaananyi ky’Omwana, era nga tukwatagana naye—ku lwa Katonda n’ekitiibwa kye kyokka. Tutwale ekiseera, okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lw’alikitubikkulira, ne tulaba nga bwe tubadde tubulwa mu kino. Okutegeera okw’amazima n’okwatula ekibi lye kkubo ekkakafu erituusa ku kununulibwa. Era oluvannyuma tutunuulire Yesu. Mu ye tuyinza okulaba okufa kwe tuyinza okugulumiza Katonda. Mu kufa yamugulumiza; mu kufa yagulumizibwa wamu naye. Kwe kufa, nga tufudde eri okwefaako ne tuba balamu eri Katonda, lwe tuyinza okumugulumiza. Era kino—okufa kuno eri okwefaako, obulamu buno eri ekitiibwa kya Katonda—Yesu ky’awa era ky’abeera nakyo nga kiramu mu buli muntu ayinza okumwesiga olw’ekyo. Ebitali wansi wa bino—okwegomba, okusalawo okubeera abalamu ku lw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe kyokka, nga Kristo bwe yakola; okumukkiriza n’obulamu bwe n’amaanyi ge nga bikikola mu ffe; okukakasa okw’essanyu nti tuyinza okubeera abalamu olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, kubanga Kristo abeera mu ffe;—bino bibe omwoyo gw’obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku. Yesu ye mweyimirizi w’okubeera kwaffe bwe tutyo; Omwoyo Omutukuvu yaweebwa, era alindirira okukifuula kye tulaba mu bulamu bwaffe, singa tunaamwesiga kyokka ne tumuleka akole; Ayi, tuleme okudda emabega olw’obutakkiriza, naye n’obuvumu tufuule ekigambo kyaffe eky’okulwanirako—Byonna olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda! Kitaffe akkiriza okwagala, ssaddaaka esiimibwa; Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajja kututeekako envumbo munda mu ffe n’okumanya nti tubeera balamu ku lwa Katonda n’ekitiibwa kye. Era olwo nga mu kusaba kwaffe mulimu emirembe egy’akasirise n’amaanyi, bwe tumanya nga tuli, olw’ekisa kye, mu kukwatagana okutuukiridde n’oyo atugamba, bw’asuubiza okukola bye tusaba: ‘Kitange alyoke agulumizibwe mu Mwana.’ Obulamu bwaffe bwonna nga bwewaddeyo mu kumanya eri okuluŋŋamya kw’Ekigambo n’Omwoyo, okwegomba kwaffe tekujja kuba kwaffe nate wabula kukwe; enkomerero yaakwo enkulu nga kye kitiibwa kya Katonda. Nga tweyongera okuba n’eddembe, tujja kusobola okwogera mu kusaba: Kitaffe! Omanyi nti tukisaba olw’ekitiibwa kyo kyokka. Era ekisaanyizo ky’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba, mu kifo ky’okuba ng’olusozi lwe tutayinza kulinnya, kijja kutuwa bwesige busingawo nti tujja kuwulirwa, kubanga tulabye nti okusaba tekulina bulungi oba mukisa businga kino, nti kugulumiza Kitaffe. Era enkizo ey’omuwendo ey’okusaba ejja kweyongera emirundi ebiri okuba ey’omuwendo kubanga etuyingiza mu kukwatagana okutuukiridde n’Omwana Omwagalwa mu bwegassi obw’ekitalo bw’atuteerawo: ‘Mmwe musaba, ne Nze nkola, Kitange alyoke agulumizibwe mu Mwana.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Mukama Yesu Omutendereze! Nzize nate gy’oli. Buli ssomo ly’ompa lyeyongera okunkakasa nga bwe mmanyi kitono okusaba nga bwe kisaanidde. Naye buli ssomo era lindeetera essuubi nti ogenda kunjigiriza, nti onjigiriza, si kumanya kyokka okusaba bwe kuteekwa okuba, wabula okusaba ddala nga bwe kinsaanidde. Ayi Mukama wange! Nkutunuulira n’obuvumu, ggwe Omwegayirizi Omukulu, eyasaba era awulira okusaba, Kitaffe alyoke agulumizibwe kyokka, onjigirize nange okubeera omulamu n’okusaba olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Mulokozi! Olw’ekigendererwa kino nneewaayo gy’oli nate. Saagala kuba kintu. Okwefaako, nga kwakomererwa dda wamu naawe, nkuwaddeyo eri okufa. Ku bw’Omwoyo ebikolwa byakwo bittibwa ne bifuuka bifu; obulamu bwo n’okwagala kwo eri Kitaffe bigenda binfuga. Okwegomba okupya kutandika okujjuza emmeeme yange, nti buli lunaku, buli ssaawa, nti mu buli kusaba ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe kibeere byonna gye ndi. Ayi Mukama wange! Ndi mu ssomero lyo okuyiga kino: kinjigirize ggwe. Era ggwe, Katonda ow’ekitiibwa, Kitaffe ow’ekitiibwa, Katonda wange era Kitaffe, kkiriza okwegomba kw’omwana alabye nti ekitiibwa kyo kye kyokka ddala ekisaanira okubeerera omulamu. Ayi Mukama! Ndaga ekitiibwa kyo. Kinsiikirize. Kijjuze yeekaalu y’omutima gwange. Ka mbeere mu kyo nga bwe kyabikkulirwa mu Kristo. Era ggwe kennyini tuukiriza mu nze ekyo ky’osiima, omwana wo asange ekitiibwa kye mu kunoonya ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe. Amiina. Laba mu bigambo ebikwata ku George Muller ku nkomerero y’ekitabo kino, engeri gye yakulemberwamu okufuula ekitiibwa kya Katonda ekigendererwa kye ekisooka.

fields.title: Akakwakkulizo Akazingiramu Byonna
fields.body_html:
‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’—Yokaana 15:7.

MU nkolagana yonna Katonda gy’alina naffe, ekisuubizo n’obukwakkulizo bwakyo tebyawukana. Bwe tutuukiriza obukwakkulizo, Ye atuukiriza ekisuubizo. Ky’agenda okuba gye tuli kisinziira ku kye tuli abeetegefu okuba gy’ali. ‘Musemberere Katonda, ne Katonda anaabasembereranga.’ Bwe kityo ne mu kusaba, ekisuubizo ekitaliiko kkomo, musabe kyonna kye mwagala, kirina akakwakkulizo kaakyo kamu akangu era ak’obuzaaliranwa, bwe munywerera mu Nze. Kristo y’oyo Kitaffe gw’awulira bulijjo; Katonda ali mu Kristo, era tayinza kutuukibwako wabula nga tuli mu Ye; okuba MU YE lye kkubo ery’okuwulirwa okusaba kwaffe; bwe TUBEERA MU YE ddala era mu bujjuvu, tuba n’obuyinza okusaba kyonna kye twagala, n’ekisuubizo nti kinaatukolerwanga.

Bwe tugeraageranya ekisuubizo kino n’ebyo abakkiriza abasinga obungi bye bayitamu, twewuunya olw’enjawukana ey’entiisa. Ani ayinza okubala okusaba okutabalika okulinnya ne kutaleeta kuddibwamu? Ensonga eteekwa okuba nti oba ffe tetutuukiriza kakwakkulizo, oba Katonda tatuukiriza kisuubizo. Abakkiriza tebaagala kukkiriza na kimu ku ebyo, kyebaava bayiiya ekkubo ery’okuwona obuzibu obwo. Bateeka mu kisuubizo ekigambo ekikikomako Omulokozi waffe ky’ataateekamu—oba nga Katonda bw’ayagala; bwe batyo ne bakuuma obwesigwa bwa Katonda n’obwabwe. Singa bakikkiriza bukkiriza era ne bakinywerera nga bwe kiri, nga beesiga Kristo okulaga nti amazima ge ga nnamaddala, Omwoyo wa Katonda yandibakulembedde okulaba nga kisaanidde ddala mu ngeri ya Katonda okuwa ekisuubizo ng’ekyo abo ababeera ddala mu Kristo mu makulu ge yategeeza, era okwatula nti okulemererwa okutuukiriza akakwakkulizo kye kinnyonnyola ekimala lwaki okusaba tekuddibwamu. Era olwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu yandifudde obunafu bwaffe mu kusaba ekimu ku bisinga amaanyi ebitusindika okunoonya ekyama, n’okufuna omukisa, ogw’okubeera mu Kristo mu bujjuvu.

‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze.’ Omukristaayo bw’akula mu kisa ne mu kutegeera Mukama Yesu, emirundi mingi yeewuunya okulaba ng’ebigambo bya Katonda nabyo bikula, mu makulu amapya era amazito ge bimujjiramu. Ajjukira olunaku ekigambo kya Katonda lwe kyamubikkulirwa n’asanyuka olw’omukisa gwe yakisangamu. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, by’ayitamu ebisingako obuziba ne bikiwa amakulu amapya, ne kiba ng’atalabangako ddala bye kirimu. Era nate, bwe yeeyongera mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, ekigambo kye kimu ne kiyimirira mu maaso ge omulundi omulala ng’ekyama ekinene, okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lwe yaddamu okumuyingiza mu buziba obusingawo obw’obujjuvu bwakyo obwa Katonda. Ekimu ku bigambo ebyo ebikula obutayosa, ebitaggwaamu, ebitubikkulira mpolampola obujjuvu bw’obulamu bwa Katonda, kye kigambo ky’Omusomesa eky’omuwendo ‘Mubeere mu Nze.’ Ng’okwegatta kw’ettabi n’omuzabbibu bwe kuli okw’okukula, okukula n’okweyongera okutakoma, bwe kutyo n’okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo kukula kwa bulamu, obulamu bwa Katonda mwe butwefunira mu bujjuvu obweyongera era obutuukiridde. Omukkiriza omuto era omunafu ayinza okuba ng’abeera ddala mu Kristo okusinziira ku kitangaala ky’alina; naye oyo afuba okutuuka ku kubeera okujjuvu mu makulu Omusomesa ge yategeeza mu bigambo ebyo, ye asikira ebisuubizo byonna ebikwatagana nakwo.

Mu bulamu obukula obw’okubeera mu Kristo, eddaala erisooka lye ly’okukkiriza. Omukkiriza bw’alaba nti, newankubadde nga munafu, ekiragiro kimugenderera ddala, ekigendererwa kye ekikulu kwe kukkiriza bukkiriza nti, nga bw’amanyi nti ali mu Kristo, bwe kityo kaakano, newankubadde nga yalemererwa era nga teyali mwesigwa, okubeera mu Kristo bwe buvunaanyizibwa bwe obw’amangu ago, era mukisa gw’asobola okutuukako. Afaayo nnyo ku kwagala, n’amaanyi, n’obwesigwa bw’Omulokozi: awulira nti ekimwetaagisa kimu kyokka kwe kukkiriza.

Tekirwa n’alaba nti waliwo ekirala ekyetaagisa. Obuwulize n’okukkiriza birina okutambulira wamu. Si nti ku kukkiriza kw’alina kulina okugattibwako obuwulize, wabula okukkiriza kulina okweyoleka mu buwulize. Okukkiriza bwe buwulize nga buli awaka nga butunuulira Omusomesa: obuwulize kwe kukkiriza nga kufuluma okukola by’ayagala. Alaba nga bw’abadde afaayo nnyo ku nkizo n’emikisa egy’okubeera kuno okusinga ku buvunaanyizibwa bwakwo n’ebibala byakwo. Wabaddewo bingi eby’okwerowoozaako n’eby’okwekulembeza by’ayagala ebyabadde tebitegeerwa oba ebigumiikirizibwa: emirembe gye yasobolanga okufuna mu kukkiriza, ng’omuyigirizwa omuto era omunafu, gimuvaako; okubeera kuno kulina kukuumirwa mu buwulize obw’ensonga: ‘Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange.’ Nga bwe kyali edda ekigendererwa kye ekikulu kwe kuyita mu birowoozo, n’amazima ge byakwata, okuwummuza omutima ku Kristo n’ebisuubizo bye; bwe kityo kaakano, mu ddaala lino, ky’asinga okufuba kwe kugatta okwagala kwe n’okwagala kwa Mukama we, n’okussa omutima n’obulamu ddala wansi w’obufuzi bwe.

Naye era kiba ng’ekirina ekibulamu. Okwagala kwe n’omutima biri ku ludda lwa Kristo; agondera Mukama we era amwagala. Naye lwaki obutonde bw’omubiri bukyalina amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo, lwaki entambula n’enneewulira ebyetengerera eby’omunda ennyo mu muntu tebiri nga bwe byandibadde? Okwagala kwe tekubikkiriza wadde okubiganya, naye wano waliwo ekitundu okwagala kw’omuntu we kutatuuka kukifuga. Era lwaki, ne bwe wataba bingi bya kibi ekikoleddwa eby’okusalira omusango, lwaki waba bingi bye tutakoze, okubulwa obulungi obwo obw’obutukuvu, obunyiikivu obwo obw’okwagala, okufaanana Yesu n’okufa kwe, obulamu bw’okwerowooza mwe bubulira, era ebiteekwa okuzingirwa mu kubeera mu Kristo, ng’Omusomesa bwe yakitegeeza? Mazima ddala walina okubaawo ekintu mu kubeera kwaffe mu Kristo ne Kristo mu ffe, ky’atannaba kufuna.

Bwe kiri. Okukkiriza n’obuwulize kkubo bukubo erituusa ku mukisa. Nga tannatuwa lugero lwa muzabbibu n’amatabi, Yesu yali amaze okutegeeza lwatu omukisa omujjuvu okukkiriza n’obuwulize gwe birina okutuusaako. Emirundi esatu yali agambye nti, ‘Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange,’ era n’ayogera ku mukisa ogw’emirundi esatu gw’alitikkira okwagala okuwulize ng’okwo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yandizze okuva eri Kitaffe; Omwana yandyeyolese; Kitaffe n’Omwana bandizze ne babeera mu ye. Bwe kiba nti okukkiriza kwaffe kukula ne kufuuka obuwulize, era mu buwulize n’okwagala obulamu bwaffe bwonna ne bufuluma ne bwesiba ku Kristo, olwo obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda ne bubikkulwa, era munda yaffe ne mubaamu obusobozi obw’okufuna obulamu, omwoyo, bwa Yesu eyagulumizibwa, ng’okwegatta okwa nnamaddala era okumanyiddwa ne Kristo ne Kitaffe. Ekigambo kituukirira mu ffe: ‘Ku lunaku olwo mulitegeera nga Nze ndi mu Kitange, era nga muli mu Nze, nga nange ndi mu mmwe.’ Tutegeera nti, nga Kristo bw’ali mu Katonda, ne Katonda mu Kristo, nga bali omu si mu bye baagala ne mu kwagala kwokka, naye ne mu butonde n’obulamu obumu, kubanga babeera buli omu mu munne, bwe tutyo naffe tuli mu Kristo ne Kristo mu ffe, mu kwegatta okutali kwa bye twagala n’okwagala kwokka, wabula n’okw’obulamu n’obutonde.

Yesu bwe yamala okwogera ku ffe okumanya, okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, nti Ye ali mu Kitaawe, era bwe tutyo naffe tuli mu Ye ne Ye mu ffe, n’alyoka agamba nti, ‘Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe. Mukkirize, mwetegeke okufuna obulamu obwo obwa Katonda obw’okwegatta nange, mwe nnyinza, nga bwe mubeera mu Nze, nange okubeera mu mmwe, nga nange bwe mbeera mu Kitange. Obulamu bwammwe bubeere bwange, n’obwange bubeere bwammwe.’ Kuno kwe kubeera okwa nnamaddala, okutuula mu kifo Kristo w’asobola okujja n’abeera; okubeera mu Ye bwe tutyo ng’emmeeme evudde ku kwerowooza n’esanga nti Ye atutte ekifo ekyo n’afuuka obulamu bwaffe. Kwe kufuuka ng’abaana abato abatalina kye beeraliikirira, era abasanga essanyu lyabwe mu kwesiga n’okugondera okwagala okwabakolera byonna.

Abo ababeera bwe batyo, ekisuubizo kibajjira ng’obusika bwabwe obw’obwenkanya: Musabe kyonna kye mwagala. Tekiyinza kuba kirala. Kristo abeefunidde ddala. Kristo abeera mu kwagala kwabwe, mu bye baagala, mu bulamu bwabwe. Bye baagala tebimala gaweebwayo kyokka; Kristo abiyingiddemu, era abibeeramu n’assiza omukka mu byo olw’Omwoyo we. Oyo Kitaffe gw’awulira bulijjo, asabira mu bo; bo basabira mu Ye: kye basaba kinaabakolerwanga.

Muganda wange omukkiriza omwagalwa! ka twatule nti olw’okuba tetubeera mu Kristo nga bw’ayagala, Ekkanisa kyeva eba ennafu bweti mu maaso g’obutakkiriza, n’okwagala ensi, n’obukaafiiri, wakati mu ebyo Mukama mw’asobola okugifuula ewangula n’okukirawo. Ka tukkirize nti ky’asuubiza ky’ategeeza, era tukkirize omusango okwatula okwo kwe kutusalira.

Naye tuleme okuggwaamu amaanyi. Okubeera kw’ettabi mu Muzabbibu bulamu bwa kukula okutakoma. Okubeera, ng’Omusomesa bwe yakitegeeza, kuli mu buyinza bwaffe, kubanga Ye abeera mulamu okukutuwa. Ka tubeere beetegefu okulaba byonna ng’okufiirwa, n’okugamba nti, ‘Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira, wabula nfuba okufuna ekyo Kristo Yesu kye yagenderera nfune.’ Tuleme kufaayo nnyo ku kubeera kwennyini, wabula ku Ye okubeera gwe kutugattako, n’obujjuvu bwe. Abe Ye, Kristo yenna, mu buwulize bwe n’okwetoowaza kwe, mu kugulumizibwa kwe n’obuyinza bwe, emmeeme yaffe mw’etambulira era mw’ekolera; Ye yennyini alituukiriza ekisuubizo kye mu ffe.

Era olwo, nga bwe tubeera, era nga tweyongera okukula okutuuka ku kubeera okujjuvu, ka tukozese obuyinza bwaffe, okwagala okuyingira mu byonna Katonda by’ayagala. Nga tugondera ebyo Katonda by’ayagala bye biragira, ka tubanje bye bisuubiza. Ka twewe Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyigirize, alage buli omu ku ffe, okusinziira ku kukula kwe n’ekipimo kye, Katonda by’ayagala bye tuyinza okubanja mu kusaba. Era tuleme kumatira na kintu kitali kya kulaba mu bulamu bwaffe ffennyini ekyo Yesu kye yawa bwe yagamba nti, ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA!’

Mukama Omwagalwa! nnyigiriza okutwala ekisuubizo kino buggya mu bwangu bwakyo bwonna, era nkakase nti ekipimo kyokka eky’okugaba kwo okutukuvu kwe kwagala kwaffe okutukuvu. Mukama! Buli kigambo ky’ekisuubizo kyo kino kifuulibwe buggya ekiramu era ekikola mu mmeeme yange.

Ogamba nti: Mubeere mu Nze! Ayi Omusomesa wange, Obulamu bwange, Byonna byange, mbeera mu Ggwe ddala. Mpa nkule okutuuka mu bujjuvu bwo bwonna. Si kufuba kwa kukkiriza, okunoonya okukwesibako, wadde okuwummula kw’okukkiriza, okukwesiga okunkuuma; si buwulize bwa kwagala kwange, wadde okukwata ebiragiro; wabula Ggwe wennyini abeera mu nze ne mu Kitaffe, ekyo kyokka kye kiyinza okummatiza. Ggwe wennyini, Mukama wange, nga tokyali mu maaso gange era waggulu wange, wabula ng’oli omu nange, era ng’obeera mu nze; kino kye neetaaga, kino kye nnoonya. Kino kye nkwesiga okumpa.

Ogamba nti: Musabe kyonna kye mwagala! Mukama! Mmanyi nti obulamu obw’okubeera mu Ggwe okujjuvu era okw’obuziba bulizza buggya, bulitukuza era bulinyweza okwagala kwange, ne mba n’ekitangaala n’eddembe okusaba ebintu ebinene. Mukama! okwagala kwange, nga kufudde mu kufa kwo, nga kulamu mu bulamu bwo, kubeere kwa buvumu era kugazi mu bye kusaba.

Ogamba nti: Kinaakolebwa. Ayi Ggwe Amiina, omujulirwa, omwesigwa, ow’amazima, mpa mu Ggwe wennyini obwesige obw’essanyu nti olifuula ekigambo kino eky’amazima gye ndi mu ngeri ey’ekitalo okusinga bwe kyali bulijjo, kubanga omutima gw’omuntu kye gutalowoozangako Katonda bye yategekera abo abamwagala. Amiina.

OKUNNYONNYOLA

Bwe tugeraageranya n’obwegendereza bye tutera okusanga mu bitabo oba mu bubaka ku kusaba, n’okuyigiriza kw’Omusomesa, tujja kusangamu enjawukana emu nnene: obukulu obuweebwa okuddibwamu kw’okusaba tebuli bumu n’akatono. Mu bisooka tusangamu bingi ku mukisa gw’okusaba ng’okwegezaamu okw’omwoyo ne bwe wataba kuddibwamu, ne ku nsonga lwaki tusaanidde okumatira nga tetukufunye. Okussa ekimu ne Katonda kwandibadde kutusinga ekirabo kye tusaba; amagezi ga Katonda gokka ge gamanyi ekisinga obulungi; Katonda ayinza okutuwa ekisinga ky’atatuwadde. Newankubadde ng’okuyigiriza kuno kulabika nga kwa waggulu nnyo era kwa mwoyo, kya kwewuunya nti tetukisanga n’akamu ku Mukama waffe. Gye tukoma okukuŋŋaanya n’obwegendereza byonna bye yayogera ku kusaba, gye kikoma okweyoleka nti yayagala tulowooze ku kusaba ng’ekkubo bukubo erituusa ku kigendererwa, era nti okuddibwamu kwe kwalina okuba obukakafu nti ffe n’okusaba kwaffe tusiimibwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Si nti Kristo ayagala tutwale ebirabo nga bya muwendo okusinga okussa ekimu ne Kitaffe n’ekisa kye. Nedda n’akatono. Naye Kitaffe ayagala okuddibwamu kubeere akabonero k’ekisa kye n’ak’amazima g’okussa ekimu kwaffe naye. ‘Leero, omuddu wo ategedde ng’alabye ekisa mu maaso go, mukama wange kabaka, kubanga kabaka azeemu okwegayirira okw’omuddu we.’

Obulamu obulimu okuddibwamu kw’okusaba buli lunaku bwe bukakafu obw’okukula kwaffe mu mwoyo; nti ddala tutuuse ku kubeera okwa nnamaddala mu Kristo; nti okwagala kwaffe kuli kumu ddala n’okwagala kwa Katonda; nti okukkiriza kwaffe kukuze ne kunywera okulaba n’okutwala Katonda by’atutegekedde; nti Erinnya lya Kristo n’obutonde bwe bitwefunidde ddala; era nti tusangiddwa nga tusaanira okutwala ekifo mu abo Katonda b’ayingiza mu kuteesa kwe, era okusinziira ku kusaba kwabwe kw’afugira ensi. Bano be bantu abaddiziddwamu ekitundu ku kitiibwa omuntu kye yalina ku lubereberye, era mu bo, nga bwe babeera mu Kristo, obuyinza bwe ng’Omwegayirizi awangula byonna bwe busobola okweyoleka, era mu bo ekitiibwa ky’Erinnya lye mwe kiragibwa. Okusaba kwa mukisa nnyo; okuddibwamu kwa mukisa n’okusingawo, ng’okuddamu okuva eri Kitaffe nti okusaba kwaffe, okukkiriza kwaffe, okwagala kwaffe biri ddala nga bw’ayagala bibeere.

Njogera bino nga nnina okwegomba kumu kwokka: okukulembera abansoma bo bennyini okukuŋŋaanya byonna Kristo bye yayogera ku kusaba, n’okwewaayo eri amazima gano mu bujjuvu: nti okusaba bwe kuba nga bwe kwandibadde, oba okusingawo, ffe bwe tuba nga bwe twandibadde, nga tubeera mu Kristo, okuddibwamu kuteekwa okusuubirwa. Kijja kutuggya mu bifo bye twekwekamu, mwe twebudaabudiranga nga okusaba kwaffe tekuddibwamu. Kijja kutulaga ekifo eky’obuyinza Kristo kye yateekerawo Ekkanisa ye, era ky’etatera kubeeramu. Kijja kutubikkulira obunafu obw’entiisa obw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo ng’ensonga lwaki tetumanyi kusaba n’obuvumu mu Linnya lya Kristo. Kijja kutusindika n’amaanyi okugolokoka tutuuke ku bulamu obw’okwegatta okujjuvu ne Kristo, ne mu bujjuvu bw’Omwoyo, ng’ekyama ky’okusaba okulina obuyinza. Era bwe kityo kijja kututwala okutuuka ku kye twatondebwa okuba: ‘Ku lunaku olwo: Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Bwe munaasabanga Kitange ekintu kyonna, alikibawa mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire.’ Okusaba okuli ddala, mu mwoyo, mu kwegatta ne Yesu, kuddibwamu bulijjo.
fields.body_text: ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’—Yokaana 15:7. MU nkolagana yonna Katonda gy’alina naffe, ekisuubizo n’obukwakkulizo bwakyo tebyawukana. Bwe tutuukiriza obukwakkulizo, Ye atuukiriza ekisuubizo. Ky’agenda okuba gye tuli kisinziira ku kye tuli abeetegefu okuba gy’ali. ‘Musemberere Katonda, ne Katonda anaabasembereranga.’ Bwe kityo ne mu kusaba, ekisuubizo ekitaliiko kkomo, musabe kyonna kye mwagala, kirina akakwakkulizo kaakyo kamu akangu era ak’obuzaaliranwa, bwe munywerera mu Nze. Kristo y’oyo Kitaffe gw’awulira bulijjo; Katonda ali mu Kristo, era tayinza kutuukibwako wabula nga tuli mu Ye; okuba MU YE lye kkubo ery’okuwulirwa okusaba kwaffe; bwe TUBEERA MU YE ddala era mu bujjuvu, tuba n’obuyinza okusaba kyonna kye twagala, n’ekisuubizo nti kinaatukolerwanga. Bwe tugeraageranya ekisuubizo kino n’ebyo abakkiriza abasinga obungi bye bayitamu, twewuunya olw’enjawukana ey’entiisa. Ani ayinza okubala okusaba okutabalika okulinnya ne kutaleeta kuddibwamu? Ensonga eteekwa okuba nti oba ffe tetutuukiriza kakwakkulizo, oba Katonda tatuukiriza kisuubizo. Abakkiriza tebaagala kukkiriza na kimu ku ebyo, kyebaava bayiiya ekkubo ery’okuwona obuzibu obwo. Bateeka mu kisuubizo ekigambo ekikikomako Omulokozi waffe ky’ataateekamu—oba nga Katonda bw’ayagala; bwe batyo ne bakuuma obwesigwa bwa Katonda n’obwabwe. Singa bakikkiriza bukkiriza era ne bakinywerera nga bwe kiri, nga beesiga Kristo okulaga nti amazima ge ga nnamaddala, Omwoyo wa Katonda yandibakulembedde okulaba nga kisaanidde ddala mu ngeri ya Katonda okuwa ekisuubizo ng’ekyo abo ababeera ddala mu Kristo mu makulu ge yategeeza, era okwatula nti okulemererwa okutuukiriza akakwakkulizo kye kinnyonnyola ekimala lwaki okusaba tekuddibwamu. Era olwo Omwoyo Omutukuvu yandifudde obunafu bwaffe mu kusaba ekimu ku bisinga amaanyi ebitusindika okunoonya ekyama, n’okufuna omukisa, ogw’okubeera mu Kristo mu bujjuvu. ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze.’ Omukristaayo bw’akula mu kisa ne mu kutegeera Mukama Yesu, emirundi mingi yeewuunya okulaba ng’ebigambo bya Katonda nabyo bikula, mu makulu amapya era amazito ge bimujjiramu. Ajjukira olunaku ekigambo kya Katonda lwe kyamubikkulirwa n’asanyuka olw’omukisa gwe yakisangamu. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, by’ayitamu ebisingako obuziba ne bikiwa amakulu amapya, ne kiba ng’atalabangako ddala bye kirimu. Era nate, bwe yeeyongera mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, ekigambo kye kimu ne kiyimirira mu maaso ge omulundi omulala ng’ekyama ekinene, okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lwe yaddamu okumuyingiza mu buziba obusingawo obw’obujjuvu bwakyo obwa Katonda. Ekimu ku bigambo ebyo ebikula obutayosa, ebitaggwaamu, ebitubikkulira mpolampola obujjuvu bw’obulamu bwa Katonda, kye kigambo ky’Omusomesa eky’omuwendo ‘Mubeere mu Nze.’ Ng’okwegatta kw’ettabi n’omuzabbibu bwe kuli okw’okukula, okukula n’okweyongera okutakoma, bwe kutyo n’okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo kukula kwa bulamu, obulamu bwa Katonda mwe butwefunira mu bujjuvu obweyongera era obutuukiridde. Omukkiriza omuto era omunafu ayinza okuba ng’abeera ddala mu Kristo okusinziira ku kitangaala ky’alina; naye oyo afuba okutuuka ku kubeera okujjuvu mu makulu Omusomesa ge yategeeza mu bigambo ebyo, ye asikira ebisuubizo byonna ebikwatagana nakwo. Mu bulamu obukula obw’okubeera mu Kristo, eddaala erisooka lye ly’okukkiriza. Omukkiriza bw’alaba nti, newankubadde nga munafu, ekiragiro kimugenderera ddala, ekigendererwa kye ekikulu kwe kukkiriza bukkiriza nti, nga bw’amanyi nti ali mu Kristo, bwe kityo kaakano, newankubadde nga yalemererwa era nga teyali mwesigwa, okubeera mu Kristo bwe buvunaanyizibwa bwe obw’amangu ago, era mukisa gw’asobola okutuukako. Afaayo nnyo ku kwagala, n’amaanyi, n’obwesigwa bw’Omulokozi: awulira nti ekimwetaagisa kimu kyokka kwe kukkiriza. Tekirwa n’alaba nti waliwo ekirala ekyetaagisa. Obuwulize n’okukkiriza birina okutambulira wamu. Si nti ku kukkiriza kw’alina kulina okugattibwako obuwulize, wabula okukkiriza kulina okweyoleka mu buwulize. Okukkiriza bwe buwulize nga buli awaka nga butunuulira Omusomesa: obuwulize kwe kukkiriza nga kufuluma okukola by’ayagala. Alaba nga bw’abadde afaayo nnyo ku nkizo n’emikisa egy’okubeera kuno okusinga ku buvunaanyizibwa bwakwo n’ebibala byakwo. Wabaddewo bingi eby’okwerowoozaako n’eby’okwekulembeza by’ayagala ebyabadde tebitegeerwa oba ebigumiikirizibwa: emirembe gye yasobolanga okufuna mu kukkiriza, ng’omuyigirizwa omuto era omunafu, gimuvaako; okubeera kuno kulina kukuumirwa mu buwulize obw’ensonga: ‘Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange.’ Nga bwe kyali edda ekigendererwa kye ekikulu kwe kuyita mu birowoozo, n’amazima ge byakwata, okuwummuza omutima ku Kristo n’ebisuubizo bye; bwe kityo kaakano, mu ddaala lino, ky’asinga okufuba kwe kugatta okwagala kwe n’okwagala kwa Mukama we, n’okussa omutima n’obulamu ddala wansi w’obufuzi bwe. Naye era kiba ng’ekirina ekibulamu. Okwagala kwe n’omutima biri ku ludda lwa Kristo; agondera Mukama we era amwagala. Naye lwaki obutonde bw’omubiri bukyalina amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo, lwaki entambula n’enneewulira ebyetengerera eby’omunda ennyo mu muntu tebiri nga bwe byandibadde? Okwagala kwe tekubikkiriza wadde okubiganya, naye wano waliwo ekitundu okwagala kw’omuntu we kutatuuka kukifuga. Era lwaki, ne bwe wataba bingi bya kibi ekikoleddwa eby’okusalira omusango, lwaki waba bingi bye tutakoze, okubulwa obulungi obwo obw’obutukuvu, obunyiikivu obwo obw’okwagala, okufaanana Yesu n’okufa kwe, obulamu bw’okwerowooza mwe bubulira, era ebiteekwa okuzingirwa mu kubeera mu Kristo, ng’Omusomesa bwe yakitegeeza? Mazima ddala walina okubaawo ekintu mu kubeera kwaffe mu Kristo ne Kristo mu ffe, ky’atannaba kufuna. Bwe kiri. Okukkiriza n’obuwulize kkubo bukubo erituusa ku mukisa. Nga tannatuwa lugero lwa muzabbibu n’amatabi, Yesu yali amaze okutegeeza lwatu omukisa omujjuvu okukkiriza n’obuwulize gwe birina okutuusaako. Emirundi esatu yali agambye nti, ‘Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange,’ era n’ayogera ku mukisa ogw’emirundi esatu gw’alitikkira okwagala okuwulize ng’okwo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yandizze okuva eri Kitaffe; Omwana yandyeyolese; Kitaffe n’Omwana bandizze ne babeera mu ye. Bwe kiba nti okukkiriza kwaffe kukula ne kufuuka obuwulize, era mu buwulize n’okwagala obulamu bwaffe bwonna ne bufuluma ne bwesiba ku Kristo, olwo obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda ne bubikkulwa, era munda yaffe ne mubaamu obusobozi obw’okufuna obulamu, omwoyo, bwa Yesu eyagulumizibwa, ng’okwegatta okwa nnamaddala era okumanyiddwa ne Kristo ne Kitaffe. Ekigambo kituukirira mu ffe: ‘Ku lunaku olwo mulitegeera nga Nze ndi mu Kitange, era nga muli mu Nze, nga nange ndi mu mmwe.’ Tutegeera nti, nga Kristo bw’ali mu Katonda, ne Katonda mu Kristo, nga bali omu si mu bye baagala ne mu kwagala kwokka, naye ne mu butonde n’obulamu obumu, kubanga babeera buli omu mu munne, bwe tutyo naffe tuli mu Kristo ne Kristo mu ffe, mu kwegatta okutali kwa bye twagala n’okwagala kwokka, wabula n’okw’obulamu n’obutonde. Yesu bwe yamala okwogera ku ffe okumanya, okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, nti Ye ali mu Kitaawe, era bwe tutyo naffe tuli mu Ye ne Ye mu ffe, n’alyoka agamba nti, ‘Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe. Mukkirize, mwetegeke okufuna obulamu obwo obwa Katonda obw’okwegatta nange, mwe nnyinza, nga bwe mubeera mu Nze, nange okubeera mu mmwe, nga nange bwe mbeera mu Kitange. Obulamu bwammwe bubeere bwange, n’obwange bubeere bwammwe.’ Kuno kwe kubeera okwa nnamaddala, okutuula mu kifo Kristo w’asobola okujja n’abeera; okubeera mu Ye bwe tutyo ng’emmeeme evudde ku kwerowooza n’esanga nti Ye atutte ekifo ekyo n’afuuka obulamu bwaffe. Kwe kufuuka ng’abaana abato abatalina kye beeraliikirira, era abasanga essanyu lyabwe mu kwesiga n’okugondera okwagala okwabakolera byonna. Abo ababeera bwe batyo, ekisuubizo kibajjira ng’obusika bwabwe obw’obwenkanya: Musabe kyonna kye mwagala. Tekiyinza kuba kirala. Kristo abeefunidde ddala. Kristo abeera mu kwagala kwabwe, mu bye baagala, mu bulamu bwabwe. Bye baagala tebimala gaweebwayo kyokka; Kristo abiyingiddemu, era abibeeramu n’assiza omukka mu byo olw’Omwoyo we. Oyo Kitaffe gw’awulira bulijjo, asabira mu bo; bo basabira mu Ye: kye basaba kinaabakolerwanga. Muganda wange omukkiriza omwagalwa! ka twatule nti olw’okuba tetubeera mu Kristo nga bw’ayagala, Ekkanisa kyeva eba ennafu bweti mu maaso g’obutakkiriza, n’okwagala ensi, n’obukaafiiri, wakati mu ebyo Mukama mw’asobola okugifuula ewangula n’okukirawo. Ka tukkirize nti ky’asuubiza ky’ategeeza, era tukkirize omusango okwatula okwo kwe kutusalira. Naye tuleme okuggwaamu amaanyi. Okubeera kw’ettabi mu Muzabbibu bulamu bwa kukula okutakoma. Okubeera, ng’Omusomesa bwe yakitegeeza, kuli mu buyinza bwaffe, kubanga Ye abeera mulamu okukutuwa. Ka tubeere beetegefu okulaba byonna ng’okufiirwa, n’okugamba nti, ‘Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira, wabula nfuba okufuna ekyo Kristo Yesu kye yagenderera nfune.’ Tuleme kufaayo nnyo ku kubeera kwennyini, wabula ku Ye okubeera gwe kutugattako, n’obujjuvu bwe. Abe Ye, Kristo yenna, mu buwulize bwe n’okwetoowaza kwe, mu kugulumizibwa kwe n’obuyinza bwe, emmeeme yaffe mw’etambulira era mw’ekolera; Ye yennyini alituukiriza ekisuubizo kye mu ffe. Era olwo, nga bwe tubeera, era nga tweyongera okukula okutuuka ku kubeera okujjuvu, ka tukozese obuyinza bwaffe, okwagala okuyingira mu byonna Katonda by’ayagala. Nga tugondera ebyo Katonda by’ayagala bye biragira, ka tubanje bye bisuubiza. Ka twewe Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuyigirize, alage buli omu ku ffe, okusinziira ku kukula kwe n’ekipimo kye, Katonda by’ayagala bye tuyinza okubanja mu kusaba. Era tuleme kumatira na kintu kitali kya kulaba mu bulamu bwaffe ffennyini ekyo Yesu kye yawa bwe yagamba nti, ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA!’ Mukama Omwagalwa! nnyigiriza okutwala ekisuubizo kino buggya mu bwangu bwakyo bwonna, era nkakase nti ekipimo kyokka eky’okugaba kwo okutukuvu kwe kwagala kwaffe okutukuvu. Mukama! Buli kigambo ky’ekisuubizo kyo kino kifuulibwe buggya ekiramu era ekikola mu mmeeme yange. Ogamba nti: Mubeere mu Nze! Ayi Omusomesa wange, Obulamu bwange, Byonna byange, mbeera mu Ggwe ddala. Mpa nkule okutuuka mu bujjuvu bwo bwonna. Si kufuba kwa kukkiriza, okunoonya okukwesibako, wadde okuwummula kw’okukkiriza, okukwesiga okunkuuma; si buwulize bwa kwagala kwange, wadde okukwata ebiragiro; wabula Ggwe wennyini abeera mu nze ne mu Kitaffe, ekyo kyokka kye kiyinza okummatiza. Ggwe wennyini, Mukama wange, nga tokyali mu maaso gange era waggulu wange, wabula ng’oli omu nange, era ng’obeera mu nze; kino kye neetaaga, kino kye nnoonya. Kino kye nkwesiga okumpa. Ogamba nti: Musabe kyonna kye mwagala! Mukama! Mmanyi nti obulamu obw’okubeera mu Ggwe okujjuvu era okw’obuziba bulizza buggya, bulitukuza era bulinyweza okwagala kwange, ne mba n’ekitangaala n’eddembe okusaba ebintu ebinene. Mukama! okwagala kwange, nga kufudde mu kufa kwo, nga kulamu mu bulamu bwo, kubeere kwa buvumu era kugazi mu bye kusaba. Ogamba nti: Kinaakolebwa. Ayi Ggwe Amiina, omujulirwa, omwesigwa, ow’amazima, mpa mu Ggwe wennyini obwesige obw’essanyu nti olifuula ekigambo kino eky’amazima gye ndi mu ngeri ey’ekitalo okusinga bwe kyali bulijjo, kubanga omutima gw’omuntu kye gutalowoozangako Katonda bye yategekera abo abamwagala. Amiina. OKUNNYONNYOLA Bwe tugeraageranya n’obwegendereza bye tutera okusanga mu bitabo oba mu bubaka ku kusaba, n’okuyigiriza kw’Omusomesa, tujja kusangamu enjawukana emu nnene: obukulu obuweebwa okuddibwamu kw’okusaba tebuli bumu n’akatono. Mu bisooka tusangamu bingi ku mukisa gw’okusaba ng’okwegezaamu okw’omwoyo ne bwe wataba kuddibwamu, ne ku nsonga lwaki tusaanidde okumatira nga tetukufunye. fields.title: Ekigambo n’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
‘Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’—Yokaana 15:7.

ENKOLAGANA enkulu wakati w’ekigambo n’okusaba lye limu ku masomo agasinga obwangu era agasooka mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Nga omukaafiiri oli eyali yaakakyuka bwe yakyogera: Bwe nsaba—njogera ne Kitange; bwe nsoma—Kitange ayogera nange. Nga sinnasaba, ekigambo kya Katonda kye kinteekateeka nga kimbikkulira Kitaffe by’andagidde okusaba. Mu kusaba, ekigambo kya Katonda kye kinnyweza nga kiwa okukkiriza kwange obuyinza bwakwo n’ensonga yaakwo ey’okwegayirira. Era oluvannyuma lw’okusaba, ekigambo kya Katonda kye kindeetera okuddibwamu bwe mmala okusaba, kubanga mu kyo Omwoyo ampa okuwulira eddoboozi lya Kitaffe. Okusaba si kwogera kwa muntu omu yekka, wabula kwogeraganya; eddoboozi lya Katonda nga liddamu erirange kye kitundu kyakwo ekisinga obukulu. Okuwuliriza eddoboozi lya Katonda kye kyama ky’obukakafu nti naye aliwuliriza erirange. ‘Otege okutu kwo owulire;’ ‘Ontegere okutu;’ Wulira eddoboozi lyange;’ bigambo Katonda by’agamba omuntu, era n’omuntu by’agamba Katonda. Okuwuliriza kwe kunaasinziira ku kwaffe; ebigambo bye bwe binaayingira mu nze, ekyo kye kinaaba ekipimo ky’amaanyi g’ebigambo byange gy’ali. Ebigambo bya Katonda kye biri gye ndi, kye kigezo ky’ekyo Ye yennyini ky’ali gye ndi, era bwe kityo eky’obugolokofu bw’okwegomba kwange gy’ali mu kusaba.

Enkolagana eno wakati w’ekigambo kye n’okusaba kwaffe Yesu gy’alaga bw’agamba nti, ‘Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Obukulu obw’amaanyi obw’amazima gano bweyoleka bwe tutunuulira ekigambo ekirala kino kye kyadda mu kifo kyakyo. Emirundi egisoba mu gumu Yesu yali agambye nti, “Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe.’ Okubeera kwe mu ffe kwe kwali okumaliriza n’engule y’okubeera kwaffe mu Ye. Naye wano, mu kifo kya ‘Mmwe mu Nze nange mu mmwe,’ agamba nti, ‘Mmwe mu Nze n’ebigambo byange mu mmwe.’ Ebigambo bye okubeera mu ffe kye kimu n’Oyo yennyini okubeera mu ffe.

Nga kino kitubikkulira bulungi ekifo ebigambo bya Katonda mu Kristo kye birina okuba nakyo mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, naddala mu kusaba kwaffe. Mu bigambo bye, omuntu yeebikkula yennyini. Mu bisuubizo bye yeewaayo yennyini, yeesiba eri oyo akkiriza ekisuubizo kye. Mu biragiro bye alaga by’ayagala, anoonya okwefuula mukama w’oyo gw’ayagala amuwulire, amukulembere era amukozese ng’ali kitundu ku ye yennyini. Mu bigambo byaffe omwoyo mwe gussiza ekimu n’omwoyo, omwoyo gw’omuntu omu mwe guyita ne gwesenza mu mulala. Mu bigambo by’omuntu, ebiwuliddwa ne bikkirizibwa, ne binywezebwa ne bigonderwa, mw’asobola okwewa omulala. Naye bino byonna biri mu ngeri ya kigero era ekkomeddwa ennyo.

Naye Katonda, Oyo ataliiko kkomo, mu ye buli kintu mwe kiri obulamu n’amaanyi, omwoyo n’amazima, mu makulu ag’ebigambo ago agasinga obuziba,—Katonda bw’ayogera nga yeeyoleka mu bigambo bye, ddala awaayo YE YENNYINI, Okwagala kwe n’Obulamu bwe, Ebyo by’ayagala n’Amaanyi ge, eri abo abakkiriza ebigambo bino, mu ngeri ya ddala esukkulumye ku kutegeera. Mu buli kisuubizo yeeteeka Ye yennyini mu buyinza bwaffe tumukwate tumufune; mu buli kiragiro yeeteeka Ye yennyini mu buyinza bwaffe tugabane naye by’ayagala, Obutukuvu bwe, n’Obujjuvu bwe obutaliiko kamogo. Mu Kigambo kya Katonda, Katonda atuwa YE YENNYINI; Ekigambo kye si kirala wabula Omwana Ataggwaawo, Kristo Yesu. Bwe kityo ebigambo byonna ebya Kristo bigambo bya Katonda, ebijjudde obulamu n’amaanyi ga Katonda ebizuukiza. ‘Ebigambo bye njogedde gye muli gwe mwoyo era bwe bulamu.’

Abo abeekeneenyezza bakiggala ne bakasiru batubuulira nti obusobozi bw’okwogera businziira nnyo ku bw’okuwulira, era nti abaana bwe bafiirwa okuwulira, n’okwogera nakwo kubaggwaako. Kino kya mazima ne mu ngeri engazi: nga bwe tuwulira, bwe tutyo bwe twogera. Kya mazima mu ngeri esinga obugulumivu mu nkolagana yaffe ne Katonda. Okusaba essaala—okwogera ebyo bye twagala n’okwesigama ku bisuubizo ebimu—kintu kyangu, era kiyinza okuyigirwa ku bantu mu magezi g’abantu. Naye okusaba mu Mwoyo, okwogera ebigambo ebituuka ku Katonda ne bimukwatako, ebikola ku buyinza bw’ensi etalabika ne bibukyusa,—okusaba okw’engeri eyo, okwogera okw’engeri eyo, kusinziira ddala ku kuwulira kwaffe eddoboozi lya Katonda. Nga bwe tuwuliriza eddoboozi n’olulimi Katonda lw’ayogera, ne mu bigambo bya Katonda ne tusembeza mu mutima gwaffe ebirowoozo bye, endowooza ye, n’obulamu bwe, bwe tutyo bwe tuliyiga okwogera mu ddoboozi ne mu lulimi Katonda lw’awulira. Okutu kw’omuyigirizwa, okuzuukusibwa buli nkya, buli nkya, kwe kuteekateeka olulimi lw’abayigirizibwa, okwogera ne Katonda era n’abantu nga bwe kisaanidde (Isaaya 50:4).

Okuwulira kuno eddoboozi lya Katonda kisinga okusoma Ekigambo n’okufumiitiriza. Wayinza okubaawo okusoma n’okumanya Ekigambo, naye nga mulimu okussa ekimu okwa ddala okutono ennyo ne Katonda omulamu. Naye era waliwo okusoma Ekigambo mu maaso ddala ga Kitaffe, nga Omwoyo y’atukulembera, Ekigambo mwe kitujjira n’amaanyi amalamu okuva eri Katonda yennyini; kiba gye tuli ddoboozi ddala lya Kitaffe, okussa ekimu okwa ddala naye ku bubwe. Lye ddoboozi lya Katonda eriramu eriyingira mu mutima, ne lireeta omukisa n’amaanyi, ne lizuukusa okuddamu kw’okukkiriza okulamu okutuuka nate ku mutima gwa Katonda.

Ku kuwulira kuno eddoboozi amaanyi ag’okugondera n’ag’okukkiriza kwe gasinziira. Ekikulu si kumanya kiki Katonda ky’agambye kye tulina okukola, wabula nti Katonda yennyini ye akitugamba. Si mateeka, si kitabo, si kumanya kituufu, ebireeta obuwulize, wabula Katonda yennyini ng’atukwatako era ng’assa ekimu naffe mu bulamu. Era bwe kityo si kumanya kiki Katonda ky’asuubizza, wabula okubeerawo kwa Katonda yennyini ng’Omusuubiza, okuzuukusa okukkiriza n’okwesiga mu kusaba. Mu maaso ga Katonda mu bujjuvu bwonna mwokka obujeemu n’obutakkiriza mwe bitasobokera.

‘Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Tulaba kye kitegeeza. Mu bigambo Omulokozi yeewaayo yennyini. Tulina okuba n’ebigambo mu ffe, nga bitwaliddwa mu bye twagala ne mu bulamu bwaffe, nga birabikira mu mbeera yaffe ne mu nneeyisa yaffe. Tulina okuba nabyo nga bibeera mu ffe: obulamu bwaffe bwonna nga kunnyonnyola okutakoma okw’ebigambo ebiri munda, ebitujjuza; ebigambo nga bibikkula Kristo munda, n’obulamu bwaffe nga bumulaga ebweru. Ebigambo bya Kristo bwe biyingira ddala mu mutima gwaffe, ne bifuuka obulamu bwaffe ne bibukwatako, olwo ebigambo byaffe ne biyingira mu mutima gwe ne bimukwatako. Okusaba kwange kujja kusinziira ku bulamu bwange; ebigambo bya Katonda kye biri gye ndi ne mu nze, n’ebigambo byange kye binaaba eri Katonda ne mu Katonda. Bwe nkola Katonda ky’agamba, Katonda ajja kukola kye ngamba.

Abatukuvu b’Endagaano Enkadde nga baategeera bulungi enkolagana eno wakati w’ebigambo bya Katonda n’ebyaffe, era okusaba gye bali nga kwali ddala kuddamu kwa kwagala eri ebyo bye baawulira Katonda ng’ayogera! Ekigambo bwe kyabanga kisuubizo, baasuubiranga Katonda okukola nga bwe yayogera. ‘Okole nga bwe wasuubiza;’ ‘Kubanga ggwe Ayi Mukama oyogedde;’ ‘Nga bwe wasuubiza;’ ‘Ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri;’ mu bigambo ng’ebyo baalaga nti Katonda kye yayogera mu kisuubizo kye kyali ekikolo n’obulamu bw’ebyo bye baayogera mu kusaba. Ekigambo bwe kyabanga kiragiro, baakolanga bukozi nga Mukama bwe yayogera: ‘Bw’atyo Ibulaamu n’agenda nga Mukama bwe yamugamba.’ Obulamu bwabwe bwali kussa kimu ne Katonda, okuwanyisiganya ebigambo n’ebirowoozo. Katonda kye yayogeranga baakiwuliranga ne bakikola; bo kye baayogeranga Katonda yakiwuliranga n’akikola. Mu buli kigambo ky’atugamba, Kristo yenna yeewaayo okukituukiriza ku lwaffe. Era ku buli kigambo atusaba, mu ngeri y’emu, okuwaayo omuntu yenna okukwata ekigambo ekyo, n’okufuna okutuukirizibwa kwakyo.

‘Bwe munyweza ebigambo byange;’ obukwakkulizo bwangu era bweyolefu. Mu bigambo bye mwe mubikkulirwa by’ayagala. Ebigambo bwe bibeera mu nze, okwagala kwe kunfuga; okwagala kwange ne kufuuka ekibya ekyereere okwagala kwe kwe kujjuza, ekikozesebwa ekyeteefuteefu okwagala kwe kwe kukozesa; Ye ajjuza omuntu wange ow’omunda. Mu kukozesa obuwulize n’okukkiriza, okwagala kwange kweyongera okuba n’amaanyi, ne kuleetebwa mu kukwatagana okw’omunda okusingawo obuziba naye. Asobola okukwesiga ddala nti tekuliyagala kirala wabula ky’ayagala; tatya kuwa kisuubizo nti, ‘Bwe munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Eri bonna abakikkiriza ne bakikolerako, alikituukiriza ddala nga bwe kiri.

Mmwe abayigirizwa ba Kristo! Tekyeyongera kututangaalira nti bwe tubadde twewolereza olw’okusaba kwaffe okutaddibwamu, n’obunafu bwaffe mu kusaba, nga twefuula abeewaayo eri amagezi ga Katonda n’ebyo by’ayagala, ensonga entuufu ebadde nti obulamu bwaffe obunafu bwe buleeseewo okusaba kwaffe okunafu? Tewali kiyinza kufuula bantu ba maanyi okuggyako ekigambo ekitujjira nga kiva mu kamwa ka Katonda: ekyo kye tulina okubeerako abalamu. Kye kigambo kya Kristo, nga kyagalibwa, nga tukibeeramu, nga kibeera mu ffe, nga kifuuka mu buwulize ne mu bikolwa ekitundu ku ffe, ekitufuula omu ne Kristo, ekitusaanyiza mu mwoyo okukwatako, n’okunyweza Katonda. Ensi n’okwegomba kwayo byonna biggwaawo, naye buli akola Katonda by’ayagala abeerera emirembe gyonna. Ayi, ka tuwaayo omutima n’obulamu eri ebigambo bya Kristo, ebigambo mw’awaayo bulijjo YE YENNYINI, Omulokozi omulamu ow’omuntu ku bubwe, era ekisuubizo kye kinaaba ekyaffe mu bungi: ‘Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA!’

——0———

Mukama Omutendereze! Essomo lyo olwa leero lyongedde okundaga obusirusiru bwange. Ndaba ensonga lwaki okusaba kwange tekubadde kwa kukkiriza n’obuwanguzi okusingawo. Nnali neemalidde nnyo ku kwogera kwange gy’oli okusinga ku kwogera kwo gye ndi. Saategeera nti ekyama ky’okukkiriza kye kino: okukkiriza kuyinza okubaawo kwokka nga bwe kwenkana Ekigambo Ekiramu ekibeera mu mmeeme.

Ate ekigambo kyo kyali kinjigirizza bulungi nnyo: Buli muntu abeerenga mwangu wa kuwulira, kyokka alemenga kubuguutana kwogera; omutima gwo gulemenga okwanguyiriza okwogera ekigambo mu maaso ga Katonda. Mukama, njigiriza nti ekigambo kyo bwe kitwalibwa mu bulamu bwange, olwo lwokka ebigambo byange lwe biyinza okutwalibwa mu mutima gwo; nti ekigambo kyo, bwe kiba amaanyi amalamu munda mu nze, kijja kuba maanyi malamu gy’oli; ky’oyogera n’akamwa ko, okituukiriza n’omukono gwo.

Mukama! Mponya okutu okutali kukomole. Mpa okutu okuggule okw’omuyigirizwa, okuzuukusibwa buli nkya, buli nkya okuwulira eddoboozi lya Kitaffe. Nga ggwe bwe wayogeranga ebyo byokka bye wawuliranga, okwogera kwange kubeere ddoboozi eriddamu okwogera kwo gye ndi. ‘Awo Musa bwe yayingira mu Weema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu okwogera ne Mukama, n’awulira eddoboozi nga lyogera gy’ali nga liva waggulu w’entebe ey’okusaasira.’ Mukama, kibeere bwe kityo nange. Obulamu n’empisa ebiriko akabonero kamu kokka, nti ebigambo byo bibeeramu era birabikiramu, bibe okweteekateeka olw’omukisa ogujjuvu: ‘Buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Amiina.

Asobola okukwesiga ddala nti tekuliyagala kirala wabula ky’ayagala; tatya kuwa kisuubizo nti, ‘Bwe munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Eri bonna abakikkiriza ne bakikolerako, alikituukiriza ddala nga bwe kiri. Mmwe abayigirizwa ba Kristo! Tekyeyongera kututangaalira nti bwe tubadde twewolereza olw’okusaba kwaffe okutaddibwamu, n’obunafu bwaffe mu kusaba, nga twefuula abeewaayo eri amagezi ga Katonda n’ebyo by’ayagala, ensonga entuufu ebadde nti obulamu bwaffe obunafu bwe buleeseewo okusaba kwaffe okunafu? Tewali kiyinza kufuula bantu ba maanyi okuggyako ekigambo ekitujjira nga kiva mu kamwa ka Katonda: ekyo kye tulina okubeerako abalamu. Kye kigambo kya Kristo, nga kyagalibwa, nga tukibeeramu, nga kibeera mu ffe, nga kifuuka mu buwulize ne mu bikolwa ekitundu ku ffe, ekitufuula omu ne Kristo, ekitusaanyiza mu mwoyo okukwatako, n’okunyweza Katonda. Ensi n’okwegomba kwayo byonna biggwaawo, naye buli akola Katonda by’ayagala abeerera emirembe gyonna. Ayi, ka tuwaayo omutima n’obulamu eri ebigambo bya Kristo, ebigambo mw’awaayo bulijjo YE YENNYINI, Omulokozi omulamu ow’omuntu ku bubwe, era ekisuubizo kye kinaaba ekyaffe mu bungi: ‘Naye bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA!’ ——0——— Mukama Omutendereze! Essomo lyo olwa leero lyongedde okundaga obusirusiru bwange. Ndaba ensonga lwaki okusaba kwange tekubadde kwa kukkiriza n’obuwanguzi okusingawo. Nnali neemalidde nnyo ku kwogera kwange gy’oli okusinga ku kwogera kwo gye ndi. Saategeera nti ekyama ky’okukkiriza kye kino: okukkiriza kuyinza okubaawo kwokka nga bwe kwenkana Ekigambo Ekiramu ekibeera mu mmeeme. Ate ekigambo kyo kyali kinjigirizza bulungi nnyo: Buli muntu abeerenga mwangu wa kuwulira, kyokka alemenga kubuguutana kwogera; omutima gwo gulemenga okwanguyiriza okwogera ekigambo mu maaso ga Katonda. Mukama, njigiriza nti ekigambo kyo bwe kitwalibwa mu bulamu bwange, olwo lwokka ebigambo byange lwe biyinza okutwalibwa mu mutima gwo; nti ekigambo kyo, bwe kiba amaanyi amalamu munda mu nze, kijja kuba maanyi malamu gy’oli; ky’oyogera n’akamwa ko, okituukiriza n’omukono gwo. Mukama! Mponya okutu okutali kukomole. Mpa okutu okuggule okw’omuyigirizwa, okuzuukusibwa buli nkya, buli nkya okuwulira eddoboozi lya Kitaffe. Nga ggwe bwe wayogeranga ebyo byokka bye wawuliranga, okwogera kwange kubeere ddoboozi eriddamu okwogera kwo gye ndi. ‘Awo Musa bwe yayingira mu Weema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu okwogera ne Mukama, n’awulira eddoboozi nga lyogera gy’ali nga liva waggulu w’entebe ey’okusaasira.’ Mukama, kibeere bwe kityo nange. Obulamu n’empisa ebiriko akabonero kamu kokka, nti ebigambo byo bibeeramu era birabikiramu, bibe okweteekateeka olw’omukisa ogujjuvu: ‘Buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Amiina.

fields.title: Obuwulize lye Kkubo ery’Obuyinza mu Kusaba
fields.body_html:
‘Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera. Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’—Yokaana 15:16.

‘Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi.’—Yakobo 5:16.

EKISUUBIZO kya Kitaffe eky’okutuwa buli kye tusaba kizzibwa buggya wano omulundi omulala, mu ngeri etulaga abo abaweebwa obuyinza obw’ekitalo bwe butyo mu kisenge eky’okuteesa eky’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo. ‘Nze nabalonda,’ Omusomesa bw’agamba, ‘mulyoke mubale ebibala, ate ebibala eby’olubeerera;’ n’alyoka ayongerako nti, kale ‘olwo buli kye munaasabanga,’ mmwe ababala ebibala, ‘Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ Kino si kirala wabula okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu kye yali ayogedde mu bigambo nti, ‘Bwe munywerera mu Nze.’ Yali ayogedde nti ekigendererwa ky’okunywerera kuno kwe kubala ‘ebibala,’ ‘ebibala ebisingawo,’ ‘ebibala bingi;’ mu kino Katonda mwe yandigulumizibwa, era akabonero k’obuyigirizwa ne kalabika. Kale tekyewuunyisa nti kaakano ayongerako nti, okunywerera okw’amazima bwe kulabikira mu bibala ebingi era eby’olubeerera, ekyo kye kinaatusaanyiza okusaba ne tufuna kye tusaba. Okwewaayo ddala okutuukiriza okuyitibwa kwaffe kye kisaanyiza okusaba okw’amaanyi, era kye kisumuluzo ky’emikisa egitaliiko kkomo egy’ebisuubizo bya Kristo eby’ekitalo ebikwata ku kusaba.

Waliwo Abakristaayo abatya nti ebigambo ng’ebyo bikontana n’enjigiriza y’ekisa eky’obwereere. Naye ddala tebikontana na kisa eky’obwereere bwe kitegeerwa obulungi, wadde n’ebigambo ebingi ebyogera obutereevu mu kigambo kya Katonda ekitukuvu. Laba ebigambo bya Yokaana Omutukuvu (1 Yokaana 3:22): ‘Twagalanenga ne mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu obulabika eri abantu; mu ekyo mwe tutegeerera nga tuli ba mazima, era ne tukkakkanya omutima gwaffe mu maaso ge. Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.’’ Oba laba ebigambo bya Yakobo ebitera okujulirwa: ‘Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi;’ kwe kugamba, ogw’omuntu oyo, ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’annyonnyola, ayinza okwogerwako nti, ‘Buli akola eby’obutuukirivu aba mutuukirivu, nga Katonda bw’ali omutuukirivu.’ Weetegereze omwoyo oguli mu Zabbuli nnyingi, ezikoowoola Katonda n’obuvumu nga zeesigama ku bwesimbu n’obutuukirivu bw’oyo asaba. Mu Zabbuli 18, Dawudi agamba nti: ‘Mukama ankoledde ng’obutuukirivu bwange bwe buli, ansasudde ng’ebikolwa byange ebirungi bwe biri. . . . Sisobyanga mu maaso ge era nneekuuma obutayonoona. Noolwekyo, Mukama ansasudde ng’obutuukirivu bwange bwe buli.’ (Zabbuli 18:20-26. Laba ne Zabbuli 7:3-5; 15:1-2; 18:3, 6; 26:1-6; 119:121, 153.) Bwe tufumiitiriza n’obwegendereza ku bigambo ng’ebyo mu kitangaala ky’Endagaano Empya, tujja kulaba nga bituukagana ddala n’okuyigiriza okutegeerekeka obulungi okw’ebigambo by’Omulokozi eby’okusiibula: ‘Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange;’ ‘Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.’ Ekigambo kino kigendererwa ddala nga bwe kiri: ‘Nabalonda mulyoke mubale ebibala, olwo,’ kale, ‘buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’

Tufube okuyingira mu mwoyo gw’ebyo Omulokozi by’atuyigiriza wano. Mu ddiini yaffe ey’enjiri mulimu akabi ak’okutunuulira ennyo oludda olumu lw’ebyo by’etuwa, ng’obumanyirivu obumu obufunibwa mu kusaba ne mu kukkiriza. Waliwo oludda olulala ekigambo kya Katonda lwe kiteekako essira ennyo: obuwulize, nga lye kkubo lyokka erituusa ku mukisa. Kye twetaaga kwe kutegeera nti mu nkolagana yaffe n’Oyo Atalina kkomo gwe tuyita Katonda, eyatutonda era eyatununula, endowooza esooka esaanidde okutukubiriza y’ey’okugonda wansi we: okwewaayo eri obukulu bwe, ekitiibwa kye, by’ayagala n’ebimusanyusa, kwe kusaanidde okuba ekirowoozo ekisooka era ekisinga mu bulamu bwaffe. Ekibuuzo si kya ngeri gye tunaafunamu ekisa kye ne tukinyumirwa, kubanga mu ekyo ekikulu kiyinza okuba nga kikyali ffe ffennyini. Naye Oyo, olw’obutonde bwe yennyini, ky’agwanira mu butuufu, era ky’asaanira awatali kkomo era mu ngeri etayogerekeka, kiri kino: ekitiibwa kye n’ebimusanyusa bibe ekigendererwa kyange kyokka. Okwewaayo eri by’ayagala ebituukiridde era eby’omukisa, obulamu obw’okuweereza n’obuwulize, bwe bulungi n’essanyu ly’eggulu. Okuweereza n’obuwulize, bino bye birowoozo ebyasinga mu mutima gw’Omwana bwe yali ku nsi. Okuweereza n’obuwulize, bino biteekwa okufuuka gye tuli bye tusinga okwegomba n’okuluubirira, okusinga okuwummula oba ekitangaala, oba essanyu oba amaanyi: mu byo mwe tunaasanga ekkubo erituusa ku mikisa gyonna egy’oku ntikko egitulindiridde.

Laba ekifo ekikulu Omusomesa ky’akiwa, si mu ssuula 15 yokka, ng’ayogera ku kunywerera, naye ne mu ssuula 14, w’ayogerera ku Katonda Omu mu Basatu okubeera mu ffe. Mu lunyiriri 15 tulaba nti: ‘Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange, era Kitange alibawa Omwoyo. Ate olunyiriri 21: ‘Oyo alina ebiragiro byange n’abigondera, y’oyo anjagala;’ era Kitange anaamwagalanga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, era nange nnaamulabikiranga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Era nate, olunyiriri 23, ekimu ku bisuubizo eby’omuwendo ebikulu byonna, era ekisinga obukulu: ‘Omuntu yenna anjagala anaagonderanga ekigambo kyange, era Nze ne Kitange tunajjanga ne tubeera mu ye.’ Ebigambo byandiyinzizza okukyogera mu ngeri etegeerekeka okusinga wano nti obuwulize lye kkubo erituusa ku Mwoyo okubeera mu ffe, ku Ye okubikkula Omwana munda mu ffe, era ku Ye okututegeka okuba ekifo Kitaffe mw’abeera, amaka ge? Katonda Omu mu Basatu okubeera mu muntu bwe busika bw’abo abawulize. Obuwulize n’okukkiriza si birala wabula enjuyi bbiri ez’ekikolwa kimu,—okwewaayo eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala. Ng’okukkiriza bwe kunyweza omuntu okugonda, nakwo kunywezebwa obuwulize: okukkiriza kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa. Kya kutya nti emirundi mingi okufuba kwaffe okukkiriza tekugasizza, kubanga tetwakwata kifo kyokka okukkiriza okunene mwe kusaanira oba mwe kusobokera,—eky’okwewaayo ddala eri ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’eri by’ayagala. Omuntu eyeewaayo ddala eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala y’oyo anaafuna amaanyi okusaba byonna Katonda we bye yasuubiza okumubeerera.

Engeri kino gye kikwatamu ku ssomero ly’okusaba nnyangu nnyo, naye ya buzito nnyo. ‘Nze nabalonda,’ Omusomesa bw’agamba, ‘mulyoke mubale ebibala,’ ebibala bingi (ennyiriri 5, 8), ‘ate ebibala eby’olubeerera,’ obulamu bwammwe bubeere obw’ebibala ebibeerera n’okubala okutakoma, ‘olwo’ bwe mutyo, ng’amatabi agabala ebibala nga ganywerera mu Nze, ‘buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ Emirundi emingi nnyo tufubye okusaba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi nga twagala ekisa kingi okubala ebibala, ne twewuunya nti okuddibwamu tekwajja. Kyali bwe kityo kubanga twali tukyusa enteekateeka y’Omusomesa. Twayagala okusooka okufuna okubudaabudibwa, essanyu n’amaanyi, tulyoke tukole omulimu mu ngeri ennyangu nga tetuwulira buzibu bwonna wadde okwefiiriza. Naye Ye yayagala tukole ky’agamba mu kukkiriza, nga tetwebuuza oba tuwulira nga tuli banafu oba ba maanyi, oba omulimu muzibu oba mwangu, mu buwulize obw’okukkiriza: ekkubo ery’okubala ebibala lyandituusizza ku kifo n’obuyinza obw’okusaba okuwangula. Obuwulize lye kkubo lyokka erituusa ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Si buwulize mu kifo ky’okukkiriza, wadde obuwulize okujjuliza ebibulamu mu kukkiriza; nedda, wabula obuwulize obw’okukkiriza bwe butuyingiza mu mikisa gyonna Katonda waffe gy’atutegekedde. Okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo (14:16), okulabikirwa Omwana (14:21), Kitaffe okubeera mu ffe (14:23), okunywerera mu kwagala kwa Kristo (15:10), enkizo ey’omukwano gwe omutukuvu (15:14), n’obuyinza bw’okusaba okuwangula byonna (15:16),—byonna birindiridde abawulize.

Tuteeke ku mutima ebyo bye tuyize. Kaakano tumanyi ensonga enkulu lwaki tetubadde na buyinza mu kukkiriza okusaba okuwangula. Obulamu bwaffe tebwali nga bwe bwandibadde: obuwulize obwangu era obw’amazima, n’okubala ebibala okw’olubeerera, tebyali kabonero kaabwo akakulu. Era n’omutima gwaffe gwonna tukkiriziganya n’enteekateeka ya Katonda: abantu Katonda b’agenda okuwa obuyinza obwenkanidde awo mu kufuga ensi, ne bakolerwa ku lw’okusaba kwabwe ekyo ekitandibaddewo, abantu ab’okwagala kwabwe kulungamya ekkubo okwagala kwa Katonda mwe kunaayita, bateekwa okuba abantu abo bennyini abayize obuwulize, obwesigwa bwabwe n’okugondera obuyinza nga tebiriimu kubuusabuusa n’akatono. Emmeeme yaffe yonna esiima etteeka lino: obuwulize n’okubala ebibala, lye kkubo erituusa ku kusaba okuwangula. Era n’ensonyi tukkiriza nga obulamu bwaffe bukyalina akabonero kano katono nnyo.

Twewaayo tukkirize omulimu Omulokozi gw’atukwasa. Tuyige enkolagana ye naffe nga Omusomesa waffe. Buli lunaku olupya tuleme kuddamu kusooka kulowooza ku kubudaabudibwa, oba ku ssanyu, oba ku mukisa. Ekirowoozo ekisooka kibeere kino: Ndi w’Omusomesa. Buli kaseera na buli kye nkola, nteekwa okweyisa ng’ekintu kye, ng’ekitundu kya Ye yennyini, ng’oyo anoonya kyokka okumanya by’ayagala n’okubikola. Omuweereza, omuddu wa Yesu Kristo,—guno gwe gubeere omwoyo ogunkubiriza. Bw’agamba nti, ‘Sikyabayita baddu, wabula mmwe muli mikwano gyange,’ tukkirize ekifo ky’emikwano: ‘Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.’

Ekintu kimu ky’atulagira ng’amatabi ge kwe kubala ebibala. Tubeerewo okuwa abalala omukisa, okujulira obulamu n’okwagala ebiri mu Yesu. Mu kukkiriza ne mu buwulize tuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna eri ekyo Yesu kye yatulondera era kye yatuteekerawo—okubala ebibala. Bwe tulowooza nga bwe yatulonda olw’ekyo, ne tukkiriza omulimu gwaffe nga guva gy’Ali, Oyo bulijjo atuwa byonna by’atusaba, tujja kweyongera okuba abavumu nga tukakasa nti obulamu obw’okubala ebibala ebingi era eby’olubeerera tusobola okubutuukako. Era tujja kutegeera lwaki okubala ebibala kuno kwokka kwe kuyinza okuba ekkubo erituusa mu kifo ky’okusaba okuwangula byonna. Omuntu oyo, mu buwulize eri Kristo wa Katonda, alaga nti akola Mukama we by’ayagala, Kitaffe gw’anaakolera buli ky’ayagala: ‘Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Omusomesa Omutendereze! njigiriza okutegeera mu bujjuvu kye ntegeera ekitundu kyokka: nti okuyita mu by’ayagala Katonda byokka, bwe tubikkiriza ne tubikola mu kugondera ebiragiro bye, mwe tufunira obuyinza okukwata by’ayagala mu bisuubizo bye n’okubyefunira mu bujjuvu mu kusaba kwaffe. Era njigiriza nti mu kkubo ery’okubala ebibala, ettabi mwe liyinza okukula ennyo mu Muzabbibu ne lituukirira, era ne tutuuka ku kuba omu naawe mu bujjuvu, mwe tusabira buli kye twagala.

Ayi Mukama! Tubikkulire, tukwegayiridde, nga bwe kiri eri eggye lyonna ery’eggulu, n’eri ggwe wennyini Omwana ng’oli ku nsi, n’eri abantu bonna ab’okukkiriza abaakugulumiza ku nsi, nti okugondera Katonda y’enkizo yaffe esinga obukulu, kubanga kutuyingiza mu kuba omu naye mu ekyo ekisinga okuba ekitiibwa kye—by’ayagala ebituukiridde ddala. Era tubikkulire, tukwegayiridde, nga bwe tunaagonderanga ebiragiro byo ne tubala ebibala nga bw’oyagala, obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo bwe bunaakula okutuuka ku kigera ekijjuvu eky’omuntu atuukiridde, nga tulina obuyinza okusaba n’okufuna buli kye twagala.

Ayi Mukama Yesu! Weebikkule gye tuli, era otubikkulire amazima g’ekigendererwa kyo n’obuyinza bwo okufuula ebisuubizo byo bino eby’ekitalo okuba eby’obulamu obwa buli lunaku eri bonna abeewaayo ddala gy’oli n’eri ebigambo byo. Amiina.

Kye twetaaga kwe kutegeera nti mu nkolagana yaffe n’Oyo Atalina kkomo gwe tuyita Katonda, eyatutonda era eyatununula, endowooza esooka esaanidde okutukubiriza y’ey’okugonda wansi we: okwewaayo eri obukulu bwe, ekitiibwa kye, by’ayagala n’ebimusanyusa, kwe kusaanidde okuba ekirowoozo ekisooka era ekisinga mu bulamu bwaffe. Ekibuuzo si kya ngeri gye tunaafunamu ekisa kye ne tukinyumirwa, kubanga mu ekyo ekikulu kiyinza okuba nga kikyali ffe ffennyini. Naye Oyo, olw’obutonde bwe yennyini, ky’agwanira mu butuufu, era ky’asaanira awatali kkomo era mu ngeri etayogerekeka, kiri kino: ekitiibwa kye n’ebimusanyusa bibe ekigendererwa kyange kyokka. Okwewaayo eri by’ayagala ebituukiridde era eby’omukisa, obulamu obw’okuweereza n’obuwulize, bwe bulungi n’essanyu ly’eggulu. Okuweereza n’obuwulize, bino bye birowoozo ebyasinga mu mutima gw’Omwana bwe yali ku nsi. Okuweereza n’obuwulize, bino biteekwa okufuuka gye tuli bye tusinga okwegomba n’okuluubirira, okusinga okuwummula oba ekitangaala, oba essanyu oba amaanyi: mu byo mwe tunaasanga ekkubo erituusa ku mikisa gyonna egy’oku ntikko egitulindiridde. Laba ekifo ekikulu Omusomesa ky’akiwa, si mu ssuula 15 yokka, ng’ayogera ku kunywerera, naye ne mu ssuula 14, w’ayogerera ku Katonda Omu mu Basatu okubeera mu ffe. Mu lunyiriri 15 tulaba nti: ‘Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange, era Kitange alibawa Omwoyo. Ate olunyiriri 21: ‘Oyo alina ebiragiro byange n’abigondera, y’oyo anjagala;’ era Kitange anaamwagalanga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, era nange nnaamulabikiranga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Era nate, olunyiriri 23, ekimu ku bisuubizo eby’omuwendo ebikulu byonna, era ekisinga obukulu: ‘Omuntu yenna anjagala anaagonderanga ekigambo kyange, era Nze ne Kitange tunajjanga ne tubeera mu ye.’ Ebigambo byandiyinzizza okukyogera mu ngeri etegeerekeka okusinga wano nti obuwulize lye kkubo erituusa ku Mwoyo okubeera mu ffe, ku Ye okubikkula Omwana munda mu ffe, era ku Ye okututegeka okuba ekifo Kitaffe mw’abeera, amaka ge? Katonda Omu mu Basatu okubeera mu muntu bwe busika bw’abo abawulize. Obuwulize n’okukkiriza si birala wabula enjuyi bbiri ez’ekikolwa kimu,—okwewaayo eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala. Ng’okukkiriza bwe kunyweza omuntu okugonda, nakwo kunywezebwa obuwulize: okukkiriza kutuukirizibwa olw’ebikolwa. Kya kutya nti emirundi mingi okufuba kwaffe okukkiriza tekugasizza, kubanga tetwakwata kifo kyokka okukkiriza okunene mwe kusaanira oba mwe kusobokera,—eky’okwewaayo ddala eri ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’eri by’ayagala. Omuntu eyeewaayo ddala eri Katonda n’eri by’ayagala y’oyo anaafuna amaanyi okusaba byonna Katonda we bye yasuubiza okumubeerera. Engeri kino gye kikwatamu ku ssomero ly’okusaba nnyangu nnyo, naye ya buzito nnyo. ‘Nze nabalonda,’ Omusomesa bw’agamba, ‘mulyoke mubale ebibala,’ ebibala bingi (ennyiriri 5, 8), ‘ate ebibala eby’olubeerera,’ obulamu bwammwe bubeere obw’ebibala ebibeerera n’okubala okutakoma, ‘olwo’ bwe mutyo, ng’amatabi agabala ebibala nga ganywerera mu Nze, ‘buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ Emirundi emingi nnyo tufubye okusaba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi nga twagala ekisa kingi okubala ebibala, ne twewuunya nti okuddibwamu tekwajja. Kyali bwe kityo kubanga twali tukyusa enteekateeka y’Omusomesa. Twayagala okusooka okufuna okubudaabudibwa, essanyu n’amaanyi, tulyoke tukole omulimu mu ngeri ennyangu nga tetuwulira buzibu bwonna wadde okwefiiriza. Naye Ye yayagala tukole ky’agamba mu kukkiriza, nga tetwebuuza oba tuwulira nga tuli banafu oba ba maanyi, oba omulimu muzibu oba mwangu, mu buwulize obw’okukkiriza: ekkubo ery’okubala ebibala lyandituusizza ku kifo n’obuyinza obw’okusaba okuwangula. Obuwulize lye kkubo lyokka erituusa ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Si buwulize mu kifo ky’okukkiriza, wadde obuwulize okujjuliza ebibulamu mu kukkiriza; nedda, wabula obuwulize obw’okukkiriza bwe butuyingiza mu mikisa gyonna Katonda waffe gy’atutegekedde. Okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo (14:16), okulabikirwa Omwana (14:21), Kitaffe okubeera mu ffe (14:23), okunywerera mu kwagala kwa Kristo (15:10), enkizo ey’omukwano gwe omutukuvu (15:14), n’obuyinza bw’okusaba okuwangula byonna (15:16),—byonna birindiridde abawulize. Tuteeke ku mutima ebyo bye tuyize. Kaakano tumanyi ensonga enkulu lwaki tetubadde na buyinza mu kukkiriza okusaba okuwangula. Obulamu bwaffe tebwali nga bwe bwandibadde: obuwulize obwangu era obw’amazima, n’okubala ebibala okw’olubeerera, tebyali kabonero kaabwo akakulu. Era n’omutima gwaffe gwonna tukkiriziganya n’enteekateeka ya Katonda: abantu Katonda b’agenda okuwa obuyinza obwenkanidde awo mu kufuga ensi, ne bakolerwa ku lw’okusaba kwabwe ekyo ekitandibaddewo, abantu ab’okwagala kwabwe kulungamya ekkubo okwagala kwa Katonda mwe kunaayita, bateekwa okuba abantu abo bennyini abayize obuwulize, obwesigwa bwabwe n’okugondera obuyinza nga tebiriimu kubuusabuusa n’akatono. Emmeeme yaffe yonna esiima etteeka lino: obuwulize n’okubala ebibala, lye kkubo erituusa ku kusaba okuwangula. Era n’ensonyi tukkiriza nga obulamu bwaffe bukyalina akabonero kano katono nnyo. Twewaayo tukkirize omulimu Omulokozi gw’atukwasa. Tuyige enkolagana ye naffe nga Omusomesa waffe. Buli lunaku olupya tuleme kuddamu kusooka kulowooza ku kubudaabudibwa, oba ku ssanyu, oba ku mukisa. Ekirowoozo ekisooka kibeere kino: Ndi w’Omusomesa. Buli kaseera na buli kye nkola, nteekwa okweyisa ng’ekintu kye, ng’ekitundu kya Ye yennyini, ng’oyo anoonya kyokka okumanya by’ayagala n’okubikola. Omuweereza, omuddu wa Yesu Kristo,—guno gwe gubeere omwoyo ogunkubiriza. Bw’agamba nti, ‘Sikyabayita baddu, wabula mmwe muli mikwano gyange,’ tukkirize ekifo ky’emikwano: ‘Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.’ Ekintu kimu ky’atulagira ng’amatabi ge kwe kubala ebibala. Tubeerewo okuwa abalala omukisa, okujulira obulamu n’okwagala ebiri mu Yesu. Mu kukkiriza ne mu buwulize tuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna eri ekyo Yesu kye yatulondera era kye yatuteekerawo—okubala ebibala. Bwe tulowooza nga bwe yatulonda olw’ekyo, ne tukkiriza omulimu gwaffe nga guva gy’Ali, Oyo bulijjo atuwa byonna by’atusaba, tujja kweyongera okuba abavumu nga tukakasa nti obulamu obw’okubala ebibala ebingi era eby’olubeerera tusobola okubutuukako. Era tujja kutegeera lwaki okubala ebibala kuno kwokka kwe kuyinza okuba ekkubo erituusa mu kifo ky’okusaba okuwangula byonna. Omuntu oyo, mu buwulize eri Kristo wa Katonda, alaga nti akola Mukama we by’ayagala, Kitaffe gw’anaakolera buli ky’ayagala: ‘Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Omusomesa Omutendereze! njigiriza okutegeera mu bujjuvu kye ntegeera ekitundu kyokka: nti okuyita mu by’ayagala Katonda byokka, bwe tubikkiriza ne tubikola mu kugondera ebiragiro bye, mwe tufunira obuyinza okukwata by’ayagala mu bisuubizo bye n’okubyefunira mu bujjuvu mu kusaba kwaffe. Era njigiriza nti mu kkubo ery’okubala ebibala, ettabi mwe liyinza okukula ennyo mu Muzabbibu ne lituukirira, era ne tutuuka ku kuba omu naawe mu bujjuvu, mwe tusabira buli kye twagala. Ayi Mukama! Tubikkulire, tukwegayiridde, nga bwe kiri eri eggye lyonna ery’eggulu, n’eri ggwe wennyini Omwana ng’oli ku nsi, n’eri abantu bonna ab’okukkiriza abaakugulumiza ku nsi, nti okugondera Katonda y’enkizo yaffe esinga obukulu, kubanga kutuyingiza mu kuba omu naye mu ekyo ekisinga okuba ekitiibwa kye—by’ayagala ebituukiridde ddala. Era tubikkulire, tukwegayiridde, nga bwe tunaagonderanga ebiragiro byo ne tubala ebibala nga bw’oyagala, obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo bwe bunaakula okutuuka ku kigera ekijjuvu eky’omuntu atuukiridde, nga tulina obuyinza okusaba n’okufuna buli kye twagala. Ayi Mukama Yesu! Weebikkule gye tuli, era otubikkulire amazima g’ekigendererwa kyo n’obuyinza bwo okufuula ebisuubizo byo bino eby’ekitalo okuba eby’obulamu obwa buli lunaku eri bonna abeewaayo ddala gy’oli n’eri ebigambo byo. Amiina.

fields.title: Ekyesigamizo Ekiwangula Byonna
fields.body_html:
‘Buli kye munaasabanga mu linnya Lyange, nnaakibakoleranga. Bwe munaasabanga ekintu kyonna mu linnya lyange, nnaakikolanga. Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange, anaakibawanga. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Bwe munaasabanga Kitange ekintu kyonna, anaakibawanga mu linnya lyange. Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu na kimu mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’—Yokaana 14:13-14, 15:16, 16:23-24, 26.

OKUTUUSA kaakano abayigirizwa baali tebasabanga mu linnya lya Kristo, era ne Ye yennyini yali tannakozesanga bigambo ebyo. Ekisinga okubisemberera kye kino: ‘banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange.’ Wano mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula, abiddiŋŋana obutayosa ng’abigatta ku bisuubizo ebyo ebitaliiko kkomo, ‘Buli kye munaasabanga,’ ‘Ekintu kyonna,’ ‘Kyonna kye munaayagalanga,’ okubayigiriza bo naffe nti Erinnya lye lye lyokka lye tuyinza okwesigamako nga tusaba, era nti lye limala ddala. Obuyinza bw’okusaba n’okuddibwamu bisinziira ku kukozesa Erinnya eryo mu ngeri entuufu.

Erinnya ly’omuntu kye ki? Kye kigambo ekituleetera omuntu oyo mu birowoozo oba ekimukiikirira gye tuli. Bwe njogera oba bwe mpulira erinnya, lindeetera mu maaso omuntu oyo yenna: bye mmumanyiiko, n’engeri gye yankwatako. Erinnya lya kabaka lizingiramu ekitiibwa kye, obuyinza bwe n’obwakabaka bwe. Erinnya lye kabonero k’obuyinza bwe. Bwe kityo ne buli linnya lya Katonda lirimu era likiikirira ekitundu ky’ekitiibwa ky’Oyo Atalabika. Era Erinnya lya Kristo lye liraga byonna bye yakola, byonna by’ali, ne byonna by’abeerawo omulamu okukola ng’Omutabaganya waffe.

Ate okukola ekintu mu linnya ly’omulala kye ki? Kwe kujja n’amaanyi n’obuyinza bw’oyo omulala, ng’omubaka we era ng’ayimiridde mu kifo kye. Tumanyi nti okukozesa erinnya ly’omulala bwe kutyo bulijjo kulaga nti ababiri abo balina ebigendererwa bye bimu. Tewali yandiwadde munne eddembe okukozesa erinnya lye nga tasoose kukakasa nti ekitiibwa kye n’ebibye tebiriiko bulabe mu mikono gy’oyo omulala, nga bwe bitaba na bulabe mu mikono gye ye.

Kale kiba kitya Yesu bw’atuwa obuyinza ku Linnya lye, n’eddembe okulikozesa, n’atukakasa nti buli kye tunaasaba mu lyo tujja kukiweebwa? Okugeraageranya okwa bulijjo, omuntu omu ng’awa munne, ku mukolo ogumu ogw’enjawulo, eddembe okusaba ekintu mu linnya lye, wano tekutuuka n’akatono,—Yesu mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa awa abayigirizwa be bonna obuyinza obwa bulijjo era obutaliiko kkomo okukozesa Erinnya lye mu ddembe ebiseera byonna olwa byonna bye baagala. Teyandisobodde kukola kino singa teyamanya nti asobola okutwesiga n’ebibye, nti ekitiibwa kye tekyandibadde na bulabe mu mikono gyaffe. Okukozesa mu ddembe erinnya ly’omulala bulijjo kabonero ka kwesigana kunene n’okugattibwa okw’oku lusegere. Oyo awa munne erinnya lye yeggya ku bbali, munne alyoke akole mu kifo kye; n’oyo atwala erinnya ly’omulala aleka erirye ng’eritaliiko mugaso. Bwe ngenda mu linnya ly’omulala, nneegaana nze kennyini; sitwala linnya lye lyokka, wabula ye yennyini ne by’ali, mu kifo kyange nze ne bye ndi.

Okukozesa erinnya ly’omuntu bwe kutyo kuyinza okuva ku kugattibwa okw’amateeka. Omusuubuzi bw’aba agenda okuleka amaka ge n’emirimu gye, awa omuwandiisi we omukulu obuyinza obw’awamu, mw’ayinza okuggya enkumi n’enkumi za pawundi mu linnya ly’omusuubuzi. Omuwandiisi akola kino si ku lulwe, wabula olw’emirimu gyokka. Omusuubuzi aguma okussa erinnya lye n’ebintu bye mu buyinza bw’omuwandiisi oyo kubanga amumanyi era amwesiga nti yeewaddeyo ddala eri ebigendererwa bye n’emirimu gye. Mukama Yesu bwe yagenda mu ggulu, yaleka omulimu gwe, okufuga obwakabaka bwe ku nsi, mu mikono gy’abaddu be. Teyandisobodde kulema kubawa ne Linnya lye, basobole okuggyamu byonna bye beetaaga okutambuza obulungi omulimu gwe. Era balina amaanyi ag’omwoyo okukozesa Erinnya lya Yesu okwenkana nga bwe beewaayo okubeerawo olw’ebigendererwa n’omulimu gw’Omusomesa byokka. Okukozesa Erinnya bulijjo kutegeeza nti tuwaddeyo ebyaffe eri Oyo gwe tukiikirira.

Oba okukozesa erinnya bwe kutyo kuyinza okuva ku kugattibwa okw’obulamu. Ku musuubuzi n’omuwandiisi we, okugattibwa kwa kaseera buseera. Naye tumanyi nti okugabana obulamu obumu ku nsi kuleeta erinnya limu: omwana alina erinnya lya kitaawe kubanga alina obulamu bwe. Era emirundi mingi omwana wa kitaawe omulungi aweebwa ekitiibwa oba ayambibwa abalala olw’erinnya ly’alina. Naye kino tekyandiwangadde singa kizuulibwa nti lyali linnya bwereere, nga empisa za kitaawe tazirina. Erinnya n’empisa oba omwoyo birina okukwatagana. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, omwana aba n’eddembe lya mirundi ebiri eri mikwano gya kitaawe: empisa ze zinyweza era zongera okwagala n’ekitiibwa bye yasooka okuweebwa olw’erinnya. Bwe kiri ne Yesu n’omukkiriza: tuli omu, tulina obulamu bumu, Omwoyo omu naye; kyetuva tusobola okujja mu Linnya lye. Amaanyi gaffe mu kukozesa Erinnya eryo, ka kibe eri Katonda, oba eri abantu, oba eri badayimooni gasinziira ku kigero ky’okugattibwa kwaffe ne Ye mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Okukozesa erinnya kwesigamye ku bumu bw’obulamu; Erinnya n’Omwoyo wa Yesu bye bimu.

Oba okugattibwa okuwa obuyinza okukozesa Erinnya kuyinza okuba okugattibwa okw’okwagala. Omugole eyabadde mu bwavu bw’afumbirwa omugole omusajja, aleka erinnya lye, n’ayitibwa erirye, era kati alina eddembe lyonna okulikozesa. Agula mu linnya lye, era erinnya eryo terigaanibwa. Kino kikolebwa kubanga omugole omusajja yamwerondera, ng’amwesiga okulabirira ebibye: kati bali omu. Bwe kityo n’Omugole Omusajja ow’omu ggulu teyandikoze kitono ku ekyo; bwe yatwagala n’atufuula omu naye, yandikoze ki kirala okuggyako okuwa abo abeetikka Erinnya lye eddembe okulyanjula mu maaso ga Kitaffe, oba okujja nalyo gy’ali olwa byonna bye beetaaga. Era tewali yeewaayo ddala okubeera mu Linnya lya Yesu atafuna, mu kigero ekyeyongera bulijjo, obusobozi obw’omwoyo okusaba n’okufuna mu Linnya eryo ky’ayagala. Okwetikka erinnya ly’omulala kitegeeza nti ndese erirange, era nalyo obulamu bwange obwetongodde; naye era, mu ngeri y’emu ddala, nti mbeera n’ebyo byonna ebiri mu linnya lye ntutte mu kifo ky’erirange.

Ebyokulabirako bino bitulaga nga endowooza eya bulijjo bw’etali ntuukirivu: ey’omubaka atumiddwa okusaba mu linnya ly’omulala, oba ey’omusango eyeekwata ku linnya ly’omweyimirizi we. Nedda, Yesu yennyini ali ne Kitaffe; si wa wala gwe tujja mu linnya lye. Ne bwe tusaba Yesu yennyini, kiteekwa kuba mu Linnya lye. Erinnya likiikirira omuntu; okusaba mu Linnya kwe kusaba nga tuli bumu ddala naye mu bigendererwa, mu bulamu ne mu kwagala, ng’omuntu abeera mu Ye era ku lulwe. Erinnya lya Yesu bwe liba nga lyokka lye lifuga mu mutima gwange ne mu bulamu bwange awatali kye ligabana nakyo, okukkiriza kwange kujja kukula okutuuka ku kukakasa nti kye nsaba mu Linnya eryo tekiyinza kugaanibwa. Erinnya n’obuyinza bw’okusaba bitambulira wamu: Erinnya lya Yesu bwe liba lifuuse amaanyi agafuga obulamu bwange, n’amaanyi gaalyo mu kusaba eri Katonda gajja kulabika.

Bwe tutyo tulaba nti buli kimu kisinziira ku nkolagana yaffe ffe ne Linnya: amaanyi lye liriko ku bulamu bwange ge maanyi lye liribeera nago mu kusaba kwange. Waliwo ebigambo ebisukka mu kimu mu Byawandiikibwa ebiyinza okukitutegeeza. Bwe bigamba nti, ‘Byonna mubikolenga mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu,’ tulaba nga kino kye kituukana n’ekirala, ‘Musabe byonna.’ Okukola byonna n’okusaba byonna mu Linnya lye, bitambulira wamu. Bwe tusoma nti, ‘ffe tunaatambuliranga mu linnya lya Mukama Katonda waffe,’ tulaba nga amaanyi g’Erinnya bwe galina okufuga obulamu bwonna; olwo lwokka lwe galiba n’obuyinza mu kusaba. Katonda tatunuulira mimwa wabula obulamu okulaba Erinnya kye liri gye tuli. Ebyawandiikibwa bwe byogera ku ‘abasajja abeewaddeyo okuweereza Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo nga tebabalirira bulamu bwabwe,’ oba ku muntu ‘eyeetegese okufiira olw’erinnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu,’ tulaba enkolagana yaffe ne Linnya bw’erina okuba: bwe liba buli kimu gye ndi, lijja kumfunira buli kimu. Bwe ndiriwa byonna bye nnina, lijja kumpa byonna bye lirina.

‘BULI KYE MUNAASABANGA mu linnya Lyange nnaakibakoleranga.’ Yesu ekisuubizo kino akitegeeza nga bwe kiri ddala. Abakristaayo bagezezzaako okukikomako: kyalabika ng’ekisukkiridde obugazi; nga si kya bulabe kwesiga muntu bwe kityo awatali kakwakkulizo. Tetwategeera nti ebigambo ‘mu linnya lyange’ bye bikuuma ekisuubizo kyokka. Bwe buyinza obw’omwoyo, era tewali ayinza kubukozesa okusukka obusobozi bw’afuna okuyita mu kubeera n’okukola mu Linnya eryo. Nga bwe twetikka Erinnya eryo mu maaso g’abantu, bwe tutyo bwe tulina obuyinza okulikozesa mu maaso ga Katonda. Ayi, ka twegayirire Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda atulage Erinnya kye litegeeza, n’engeri entuufu ey’okulikozesa. Okuyita mu Mwoyo, Erinnya, erisinga amannya gonna mu ggulu, lijja kufuna ekifo eky’obukulu mu mutima gwaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe nabyo.

Abayigirizwa ba Yesu! Ebyokuyiga eby’olwaleero ka biyingire mu mitima gyammwe ddala. Omusomesa agamba nti: Musabe busabi mu linnya lyange; buli kye munaasaba mujja kukiweebwa. Eggulu ligguddwawo gye muli; eby’obugagga n’amaanyi ag’ensi ey’omwoyo biteekeddwa mu buyinza bwammwe ku lw’abantu ababeetoolodde. Ayi mujje, tuyige okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu. Nga bwe yagamba abayigirizwa, atugamba naffe nti, ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa.’ Buli muyigirizwa wa Yesu afube okukozesa eddembe lye ng’omu ku bakabona bw’obwakabaka, era akozese amaanyi agateekeddwa mu buyinza bwe ku lw’abo b’abeera nabo n’omulimu gwe. Abakristaayo bazuukuke bawulire obubaka buno: okusaba kwammwe kuyinza okufuna ekyandibadde kiziyizibwa, kuyinza okutuukiriza ekyandisigadde nga tekikoleddwa. Ayi muzuukuke, mukozese erinnya lya Yesu okuggulawo eby’obugagga eby’omu ggulu ku lw’ensi eno egenda okuzikirira. Muyige, ng’abaddu ba Kabaka, okukozesa Erinnya lye: ‘BULI KYE MUNAASABANGA mu linnya Lyange, NNAAKIBAKOLERANGA.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Mukama Omutendereze! Kiringa buli kyokuyiga ky’ompa kirimu amakulu agajjudde era ag’ebuziba nnyo, nti singa nsobola okuyiga ekyo kyokka, nja kumanya okusaba obulungi. Njigiriza okubeera n’okukola, okutambula n’okwogera, okukola byonna mu Linnya lya Yesu, okusaba kwange kulemenga kuba kirala kyonna wabula mu Linnya eryo ery’omukisa nakwo.

Newaakubadde nga sinnategeera bulungi, era nga sinnatuuka ddala ku kugattibwa okw’ekitalo kw’otegeeza bw’ogamba nti MU LINNYA LYANGE, kyokka njagala okunywerera ku kisuubizo okutuusa lwe kinajjuza omutima gwange okukakasa okutaliimu kubuusabuusa: Ekintu kyonna mu Linnya lya Yesu.

Ayi Mukama wange! Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu anjigirize kino. Wamwogerako nti, ‘Omubeezi, Kitange gw’alituma MU LINNYA LYANGE.’ Amanyi kye kitegeeza okutumibwa okuva mu ggulu mu Linnya lyo, okubikkula n’okuwa ekitiibwa amaanyi g’Erinnya eryo mu baddu bo, okukozesa Erinnya eryo lyokka, bw’atyo n’akugulumiza. Mukama Yesu! Omwoyo wo abeere mu nze, anjijuze. Njagala, era mpaayo obulamu bwange bwonna mu kufuga kwe n’okukulembera kwe. Erinnya lyo n’Omwoyo wo bye bimu; okuyita mu Ye Erinnya lyo lijja kuba amaanyi g’obulamu bwange n’okusaba kwange. Olwo nja kusobola, olw’Erinnya lyo, okuleka byonna, okwogera n’abantu ne Katonda mu Linnya lyo, n’okukakasa nti lino ddala lye Linnya erisinga amannya gonna.

Mukama Yesu! Ayi onjigirize okuyita mu Mwoyo wo Omutukuvu okusaba mu Linnya lyo. Amiina.

EKIJJUKIZO.

‘Okusaba mu linnya lya Kristo kitegeeza ki? Tekiyinza kutegeeza kulabika bulabisi mu maaso ga Katonda nga tukkiriza obutabaganya bw’Omulokozi. Abayigirizwa bwe baasaba Yesu abayigirize okusaba, yabawa bye basaba. Era oluvannyuma Yesu n’abagamba nti, “Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu na kimu mu linnya lyange.” Okutuusa Omwoyo lwe yajja, ebisabibwa omusanvu eby’Essaala ya Mukama waffe byali ng’ebyebase munda mu bo. Kristo bwe yakka mu mitima gyabwe okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ne beegomba emikisa gyennyini Kristo, nga Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, gy’atufunira okuva eri Kitaffe ng’asaba. Era ebisabibwa ebyo bulijjo biddibwamu. Kitaffe bulijjo ayagala okuwa Kristo by’asaba. Omwoyo wa Kristo bulijjo atuyigiriza era atusikiriza okuwaayo ebisabibwa Kristo by’akakasa n’abitwala eri Kitaffe. N’olwekyo okusaba mu linnya lya Kristo kwe kubeera bumu ne Kristo mu butuukirivu bwaffe, era okubeera bumu ne Kristo mu bye twegomba olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe. Okusaba mu Mwoyo, okusaba nga Kitaffe bw’ayagala, okusaba mu linnya lya Kristo, bigambo ebitegeeza ekintu kye kimu. Kitaffe yennyini atwagala nnyo, era ayagala okutuwulira: abeegayirizi babiri, Kristo Omuwolereza waggulu, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omuwolereza munda, bye birabo by’okwagala kwe.

‘Endowooza eno eyinza okulabika mu kusooka ng’ebudaabuda kitono okusinga endala esinga okubuna, etwala okusaba mu linnya lya Kristo okusinga ng’okwesiga obulungi bwa Kristo. Ekibulamu mu ndowooza eyo kwe kuba nti tegatta kutwegayiririra kw’Omulokozi n’ebyo Kitaffe by’ayagala, n’obuyambi bw’Omwoyo abeera mu ffe mu kusaba. Era tetegeerera ddala butabaganya bwa Kristo; kubanga obutabaganya tebuli mu kuba nti ku lwa Kristo Kitaffe Omutukuvu asobola okuntunuulira nze n’okusaba kwange kwokka; wabula era nti Kristo yennyini anjanjulira ebisabibwa byange ng’ebibye, by’ayagala ku lwange, nga n’emikisa gyonna bwe gyagulibwa ku lwange n’omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo.

‘Mu kusaba kwonna, ekisaanyizo ekimu ekikulu kwe kuba nti tusobola okukuwaayo mu linnya lya Yesu, nga Ye bw’atwagaliza, nga Kitaffe bw’ayagala, nga Omwoyo bw’ayigiriza. Bwe kityo okusaba mu linnya lya Kristo tekisoboka awatali kwekebera, awatali kufumiitiriza, awatali kwegaana; mu bufunze, awatali buyambi bwa Mwoyo.’—Saphiv, Essaala ya Mukama Waffe, empapula 411, 142.
