Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange, anaakibawanga. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Bwe munaasabanga Kitange ekintu kyonna, anaakibawanga mu linnya lyange. Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu na kimu mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’—Yokaana 14:13-14, 15:16, 16:23-24, 26. OKUTUUSA kaakano abayigirizwa baali tebasabanga mu linnya lya Kristo, era ne Ye yennyini yali tannakozesanga bigambo ebyo. Ekisinga okubisemberera kye kino: ‘banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange.’ Wano mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula, abiddiŋŋana obutayosa ng’abigatta ku bisuubizo ebyo ebitaliiko kkomo, ‘Buli kye munaasabanga,’ ‘Ekintu kyonna,’ ‘Kyonna kye munaayagalanga,’ okubayigiriza bo naffe nti Erinnya lye lye lyokka lye tuyinza okwesigamako nga tusaba, era nti lye limala ddala. Obuyinza bw’okusaba n’okuddibwamu bisinziira ku kukozesa Erinnya eryo mu ngeri entuufu. Erinnya ly’omuntu kye ki? Kye kigambo ekituleetera omuntu oyo mu birowoozo oba ekimukiikirira gye tuli. Bwe njogera oba bwe mpulira erinnya, lindeetera mu maaso omuntu oyo yenna: bye mmumanyiiko, n’engeri gye yankwatako. Erinnya lya kabaka lizingiramu ekitiibwa kye, obuyinza bwe n’obwakabaka bwe. Erinnya lye kabonero k’obuyinza bwe. Bwe kityo ne buli linnya lya Katonda lirimu era likiikirira ekitundu ky’ekitiibwa ky’Oyo Atalabika. Era Erinnya lya Kristo lye liraga byonna bye yakola, byonna by’ali, ne byonna by’abeerawo omulamu okukola ng’Omutabaganya waffe. Ate okukola ekintu mu linnya ly’omulala kye ki? Kwe kujja n’amaanyi n’obuyinza bw’oyo omulala, ng’omubaka we era ng’ayimiridde mu kifo kye. Tumanyi nti okukozesa erinnya ly’omulala bwe kutyo bulijjo kulaga nti ababiri abo balina ebigendererwa bye bimu. Tewali yandiwadde munne eddembe okukozesa erinnya lye nga tasoose kukakasa nti ekitiibwa kye n’ebibye tebiriiko bulabe mu mikono gy’oyo omulala, nga bwe bitaba na bulabe mu mikono gye ye. Kale kiba kitya Yesu bw’atuwa obuyinza ku Linnya lye, n’eddembe okulikozesa, n’atukakasa nti buli kye tunaasaba mu lyo tujja kukiweebwa? Okugeraageranya okwa bulijjo, omuntu omu ng’awa munne, ku mukolo ogumu ogw’enjawulo, eddembe okusaba ekintu mu linnya lye, wano tekutuuka n’akatono,—Yesu mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa awa abayigirizwa be bonna obuyinza obwa bulijjo era obutaliiko kkomo okukozesa Erinnya lye mu ddembe ebiseera byonna olwa byonna bye baagala. Teyandisobodde kukola kino singa teyamanya nti asobola okutwesiga n’ebibye, nti ekitiibwa kye tekyandibadde na bulabe mu mikono gyaffe. Okukozesa mu ddembe erinnya ly’omulala bulijjo kabonero ka kwesigana kunene n’okugattibwa okw’oku lusegere. Oyo awa munne erinnya lye yeggya ku bbali, munne alyoke akole mu kifo kye; n’oyo atwala erinnya ly’omulala aleka erirye ng’eritaliiko mugaso. Bwe ngenda mu linnya ly’omulala, nneegaana nze kennyini; sitwala linnya lye lyokka, wabula ye yennyini ne by’ali, mu kifo kyange nze ne bye ndi. Okukozesa erinnya ly’omuntu bwe kutyo kuyinza okuva ku kugattibwa okw’amateeka. Omusuubuzi bw’aba agenda okuleka amaka ge n’emirimu gye, awa omuwandiisi we omukulu obuyinza obw’awamu, mw’ayinza okuggya enkumi n’enkumi za pawundi mu linnya ly’omusuubuzi. Omuwandiisi akola kino si ku lulwe, wabula olw’emirimu gyokka. Omusuubuzi aguma okussa erinnya lye n’ebintu bye mu buyinza bw’omuwandiisi oyo kubanga amumanyi era amwesiga nti yeewaddeyo ddala eri ebigendererwa bye n’emirimu gye. Mukama Yesu bwe yagenda mu ggulu, yaleka omulimu gwe, okufuga obwakabaka bwe ku nsi, mu mikono gy’abaddu be. Teyandisobodde kulema kubawa ne Linnya lye, basobole okuggyamu byonna bye beetaaga okutambuza obulungi omulimu gwe. Era balina amaanyi ag’omwoyo okukozesa Erinnya lya Yesu okwenkana nga bwe beewaayo okubeerawo olw’ebigendererwa n’omulimu gw’Omusomesa byokka. Okukozesa Erinnya bulijjo kutegeeza nti tuwaddeyo ebyaffe eri Oyo gwe tukiikirira. Oba okukozesa erinnya bwe kutyo kuyinza okuva ku kugattibwa okw’obulamu. Ku musuubuzi n’omuwandiisi we, okugattibwa kwa kaseera buseera. Naye tumanyi nti okugabana obulamu obumu ku nsi kuleeta erinnya limu: omwana alina erinnya lya kitaawe kubanga alina obulamu bwe. Era emirundi mingi omwana wa kitaawe omulungi aweebwa ekitiibwa oba ayambibwa abalala olw’erinnya ly’alina. Naye kino tekyandiwangadde singa kizuulibwa nti lyali linnya bwereere, nga empisa za kitaawe tazirina. Erinnya n’empisa oba omwoyo birina okukwatagana. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, omwana aba n’eddembe lya mirundi ebiri eri mikwano gya kitaawe: empisa ze zinyweza era zongera okwagala n’ekitiibwa bye yasooka okuweebwa olw’erinnya. Bwe kiri ne Yesu n’omukkiriza: tuli omu, tulina obulamu bumu, Omwoyo omu naye; kyetuva tusobola okujja mu Linnya lye. Amaanyi gaffe mu kukozesa Erinnya eryo, ka kibe eri Katonda, oba eri abantu, oba eri badayimooni gasinziira ku kigero ky’okugattibwa kwaffe ne Ye mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Okukozesa erinnya kwesigamye ku bumu bw’obulamu; Erinnya n’Omwoyo wa Yesu bye bimu. Oba okugattibwa okuwa obuyinza okukozesa Erinnya kuyinza okuba okugattibwa okw’okwagala. Omugole eyabadde mu bwavu bw’afumbirwa omugole omusajja, aleka erinnya lye, n’ayitibwa erirye, era kati alina eddembe lyonna okulikozesa. Agula mu linnya lye, era erinnya eryo terigaanibwa. Kino kikolebwa kubanga omugole omusajja yamwerondera, ng’amwesiga okulabirira ebibye: kati bali omu. Bwe kityo n’Omugole Omusajja ow’omu ggulu teyandikoze kitono ku ekyo; bwe yatwagala n’atufuula omu naye, yandikoze ki kirala okuggyako okuwa abo abeetikka Erinnya lye eddembe okulyanjula mu maaso ga Kitaffe, oba okujja nalyo gy’ali olwa byonna bye beetaaga. Era tewali yeewaayo ddala okubeera mu Linnya lya Yesu atafuna, mu kigero ekyeyongera bulijjo, obusobozi obw’omwoyo okusaba n’okufuna mu Linnya eryo ky’ayagala. Okwetikka erinnya ly’omulala kitegeeza nti ndese erirange, era nalyo obulamu bwange obwetongodde; naye era, mu ngeri y’emu ddala, nti mbeera n’ebyo byonna ebiri mu linnya lye ntutte mu kifo ky’erirange. Ebyokulabirako bino bitulaga nga endowooza eya bulijjo bw’etali ntuukirivu: ey’omubaka atumiddwa okusaba mu linnya ly’omulala, oba ey’omusango eyeekwata ku linnya ly’omweyimirizi we. Nedda, Yesu yennyini ali ne Kitaffe; si wa wala gwe tujja mu linnya lye. Ne bwe tusaba Yesu yennyini, kiteekwa kuba mu Linnya lye. Erinnya likiikirira omuntu; okusaba mu Linnya kwe kusaba nga tuli bumu ddala naye mu bigendererwa, mu bulamu ne mu kwagala, ng’omuntu abeera mu Ye era ku lulwe. Erinnya lya Yesu bwe liba nga lyokka lye lifuga mu mutima gwange ne mu bulamu bwange awatali kye ligabana nakyo, okukkiriza kwange kujja kukula okutuuka ku kukakasa nti kye nsaba mu Linnya eryo tekiyinza kugaanibwa. Erinnya n’obuyinza bw’okusaba bitambulira wamu: Erinnya lya Yesu bwe liba lifuuse amaanyi agafuga obulamu bwange, n’amaanyi gaalyo mu kusaba eri Katonda gajja kulabika. Bwe tutyo tulaba nti buli kimu kisinziira ku nkolagana yaffe ffe ne Linnya: amaanyi lye liriko ku bulamu bwange ge maanyi lye liribeera nago mu kusaba kwange. Waliwo ebigambo ebisukka mu kimu mu Byawandiikibwa ebiyinza okukitutegeeza. Bwe bigamba nti, ‘Byonna mubikolenga mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu,’ tulaba nga kino kye kituukana n’ekirala, ‘Musabe byonna.’ Okukola byonna n’okusaba byonna mu Linnya lye, bitambulira wamu. Bwe tusoma nti, ‘ffe tunaatambuliranga mu linnya lya Mukama Katonda waffe,’ tulaba nga amaanyi g’Erinnya bwe galina okufuga obulamu bwonna; olwo lwokka lwe galiba n’obuyinza mu kusaba. Katonda tatunuulira mimwa wabula obulamu okulaba Erinnya kye liri gye tuli. Ebyawandiikibwa bwe byogera ku ‘abasajja abeewaddeyo okuweereza Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo nga tebabalirira bulamu bwabwe,’ oba ku muntu ‘eyeetegese okufiira olw’erinnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu,’ tulaba enkolagana yaffe ne Linnya bw’erina okuba: bwe liba buli kimu gye ndi, lijja kumfunira buli kimu. Bwe buyinza obw’omwoyo, era tewali ayinza kubukozesa okusukka obusobozi bw’afuna okuyita mu kubeera n’okukola mu Linnya eryo. Nga bwe twetikka Erinnya eryo mu maaso g’abantu, bwe tutyo bwe tulina obuyinza okulikozesa mu maaso ga Katonda. Ayi, ka twegayirire Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda atulage Erinnya kye litegeeza, n’engeri entuufu ey’okulikozesa. Okuyita mu Mwoyo, Erinnya, erisinga amannya gonna mu ggulu, lijja kufuna ekifo eky’obukulu mu mutima gwaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe nabyo. Abayigirizwa ba Yesu! Ebyokuyiga eby’olwaleero ka biyingire mu mitima gyammwe ddala. Omusomesa agamba nti: Musabe busabi mu linnya lyange; buli kye munaasaba mujja kukiweebwa. Eggulu ligguddwawo gye muli; eby’obugagga n’amaanyi ag’ensi ey’omwoyo biteekeddwa mu buyinza bwammwe ku lw’abantu ababeetoolodde. Ayi mujje, tuyige okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu. Nga bwe yagamba abayigirizwa, atugamba naffe nti, ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa.’ Buli muyigirizwa wa Yesu afube okukozesa eddembe lye ng’omu ku bakabona bw’obwakabaka, era akozese amaanyi agateekeddwa mu buyinza bwe ku lw’abo b’abeera nabo n’omulimu gwe. Abakristaayo bazuukuke bawulire obubaka buno: okusaba kwammwe kuyinza okufuna ekyandibadde kiziyizibwa, kuyinza okutuukiriza ekyandisigadde nga tekikoleddwa. Ayi muzuukuke, mukozese erinnya lya Yesu okuggulawo eby’obugagga eby’omu ggulu ku lw’ensi eno egenda okuzikirira. Muyige, ng’abaddu ba Kabaka, okukozesa Erinnya lye: ‘BULI KYE MUNAASABANGA mu linnya Lyange, NNAAKIBAKOLERANGA.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Mukama Omutendereze! fields.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
‘Mu kiseera ekyo nga temukyansaba kintu na kimu. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga. Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu mu linnya lyange: musabe, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange, so si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange, kubanga Kitange yennyini abaagala nnyo.’—Yokaana 16:23-26.

‘Nga musaba mu Mwoyo Mutukuvu, mwekuumire mu kwagala kwa Katonda.’—Yuda 1:20-21.

EBIGAMBO Yokaana by’agamba (1 Yokaana 2:12-14) abaana abaagalwa, abavubuka, n’abakulu, bituleetera ekirowoozo nti mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo emirundi mingi mubaamu emitendera esatu eminene egy’obumanyirivu. Ogusooka, ogw’omwana nga yaakazaalibwa, ng’alina obukakafu n’essanyu ery’okusonyiyibwa. Ogwokubiri, omutendera ogw’okusomoka, ogw’okulwana n’okukula mu kumanya ne mu maanyi: abavubuka nga bakula mu maanyi, ekigambo kya Katonda nga kikola omulimu gwakyo mu bo era nga kibawa obuwanguzi ku mubi. Ate n’omutendera ogw’enkomerero ogw’okukula n’okweyengera: abakulu, abaayingira ennyo mu kumanya Oyo Ataggwaawo ne mu kussa ekimu naye.

Mu kuyigiriza kwa Kristo ku kusaba nakwo mulabikamu emitendera esatu mu bulamu bw’okusaba, egifaananamu n’egyo. Mu Kubuulira okw’Oku Lusozi tulabamu omutendera ogusooka: okuyigiriza kwe kwonna kuzingirwa mu kigambo kimu, Kitaffe. Musabe Kitammwe; Kitammwe alaba, awulira, amanyi, era alibasasula: talisinga nnyo kitaawe yenna ow’oku nsi! Kyokka mubeere ng’abaana abato era abeesiga. Oluvannyuma ne wajjawo ekifaanana ng’omutendera ogw’okusomoka, ogw’okulwana n’okuwangula, mu bigambo nga bino: ‘Ow’engeri eno tagobeka awatali kusaba na kusiiba;’ ‘Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro?’ Ate mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula tulabamu omutendera ogusingako obugulumivu. Abaana bafuuse bakulu: kaakano be mikwano gy’Omusomesa, b’atakisa kyama kyonna, b’agamba nti, ‘Mbategeezezza byonna Kitange bye yaŋŋamba;’ era b’akwasa ebisumuluzo by’obwakabaka mu ‘buli kye munaasabanga,’ ky’addiŋŋana emirundi mingi. Kaakano ekiseera kituuse amaanyi g’okusaba mu Linnya lye gakakasibwe.

Enjawulo wakati w’omutendera guno ogw’enkomerero n’egyo egyasooka egy’okuteekateeka, Omulokozi waffe agiraga kaati ddala mu bigambo bye tugenda okufumiitirizaako: ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu mu linnya lyange;’ ‘Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange. ‘ Tumanyi ‘mu kiseera ekyo’ kye kitegeeza. Kye kiseera Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw’ayiwibwa. Omulimu omunene Kristo gwe yali agenda okukola ku musaalaba, amaanyi amangi n’obuwanguzi obujjuvu ebyali bigenda okweyoleka mu kuzuukira kwe ne mu kulinnya kwe mu ggulu, byali bya kuvaamu okukka okuva mu ggulu, nga bwe kitabangawo, okw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda okubeera mu bantu. Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa yali wa kujja abeere obulamu bw’abayigirizwa be. Era kimu ku bubonero bw’enteekateeka eyo ey’ekitalo ey’Omwoyo kyali kya kuba amaanyi mu kusaba agaali gatannamanyibwa—okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu, okusaba n’okufuna buli kye baagala, kwe kunaaba okweyoleka kw’amazima g’Omwoyo okubeera mu bo.

Okutegeera engeri okujja kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gye kwali ddala kugenda okutandika omulembe omuggya mu nsi y’okusaba, tuteekwa okujjukira nti ye ani, omulimu gwe gwe guluwa, n’amakulu agali mu kuba nti teyaweebwa okutuusa Yesu lwe yagulumizibwa. Mu Mwoyo Katonda mw’abeerera, kubanga Katonda Mwoyo. Mu Mwoyo Omwana mwe yazaalirwa Kitaffe: mu kussa ekimu okw’Omwoyo Kitaffe n’Omwana mwe bali obumu. Okuwa okw’emirembe n’emirembe okutakoma Kitaffe kw’awa Omwana, nga bwe buyinza bwa Kitaffe, n’okusaba n’okufuna okw’emirembe n’emirembe, nga lye ddembe n’essanyu ly’Omwana—mu Mwoyo okussa ekimu kuno okw’obulamu n’okwagala mwe kukuumirwa. Bwe kityo bwe kibadde okuva emirembe gyonna. Era bwe kiri naddala kaakano, Omwana nga Omutabaganya ng’abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okusaba. Omulimu omunene Yesu gwe yatandika ku nsi ogw’okutabaganya Katonda n’omuntu mu mubiri gwe, agugenderamu mu maaso mu ggulu. Okugutuukiriza yatwala mu bubwe olutalo wakati w’obutuukirivu bwa Katonda n’ekibi kyaffe. Ku musaalaba yakomya olutalo omulundi gumu ogw’olubeerera mu mubiri gwe. Oluvannyuma n’alinnya mu ggulu, alyoke okuva eyo atuukirize mu buli kitundu ky’omubiri gwe okununulibwa, era alage obuwanguzi bwe yali afunye. Kino kye kimuleetera okubeera omulamu ennaku zonna okusaba; mu kwegayiririra kwe okutakoma yeeteeka mu kussa ekimu okulamu n’okusaba okutakoma okw’abanunule be. Oba okusingawo, kwe kwegayiririra kwe okutakoma okweyoleka mu kusaba kwabwe, ne kukuwa amaanyi ge kutaabanga nago.

Era kino akikola ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa, yali tannabaawo (Yokaana 7:39), era yali tayinza kubaawo, okutuusa Yesu lwe yali amaze okugulumizibwa. Ekirabo kino ekya Kitaffe kyali kiggya ddala, kya njawulo ddala ku ekyo abatukuvu b’Endagaano Enkadde kye baali bamanyi. Omulimu omusaayi gwe gwakola mu ggulu, Kristo bwe yayingira munda w’eggigi, gwali gwa mazima era muggya nnyo; okununulibwa kw’obuntu bwaffe okuyingira mu kussa ekimu n’amaanyi g’okuzuukira kwe n’ekitiibwa ky’okugulumizibwa kwe kwali kwa ddala nnyo; okutwalibwa kw’obuntu bwaffe mu Kristo okuyingira mu bulamu bwa Katonda Omu mu Basatu kyali kintu kya makulu agatategeerekeka, ne kiba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu, eyalina okuva mu buntu bwa Kristo obugulumiziddwa okujulira mu mitima gyaffe ku ebyo Kristo bye yatuukiriza, ddala teyali nate ekyo kyokka kye yali mu Ndagaano Enkadde. Kyali kya mazima ddala ng’ekigambo bwe kiri nti ‘Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali tannabaawo, kubanga Yesu yali tannaba kugulumizibwa.’ Kaakano yajja omulundi ogusooka nga Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa. Nga Omwana, eyali Katonda okuva emirembe gyonna, bwe yayingira mu bulamu obuggya ng’omuntu, n’addayo mu ggulu n’ekyo kye yali talina mu kusooka, bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutendereze, Omwana gwe yaweebwa Kitaffe bwe yalinnya mu ggulu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:33) okuyingira mu buntu bwe obugulumiziddwa, yajja gye tuli n’obulamu obuggya, bwe yali talina kugaba mu kusooka. Mu Ndagaano Enkadde yakoowoolwanga nga Omwoyo wa Katonda: ku Pentekoote n’akka nga Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa, ng’atuleetera era ng’atugabira ekibala kyonna n’amaanyi ag’okununulibwa okwatuukirizibwa.

Mu kwegayiririra kwa Kristo okununulibwa kwe mwe kukuumirwa okweyongera okukola n’okutuukirizibwa mu bantu. Era olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akka okuva ewa Kristo gye tuli, tusikibwa ne tuyingira mu mugga omunene ogw’okusaba kwe okulinnya bulijjo. Omwoyo atusabira awatali bigambo: mu buziba bw’omutima, ne birowoozo gye bitera okubulwa enkula, Omwoyo atusitula n’atuyingiza mu kukulukuta okw’ekitalo okw’obulamu bwa Katonda Omu mu Basatu. Ku bw’Omwoyo, okusaba kwa Kristo kufuuka kwaffe, n’okwaffe ne kufuulibwa kwe: tusaba kye twagala, ne tukiweebwa. Olwo tutegeera mu bumanyirivu nti, ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba mu linnya lyange. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’

Ow’oluganda! kye twetaaga okusobola okusaba mu Linnya lya Kristo, okusaba tulyoke tufune, essanyu lyaffe liryoke lituukirire, kwe kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo ono Omutukuvu. Kino kisinga Omwoyo wa Katonda nga bwe yali mu Ndagaano Enkadde. Kino kisinga Omwoyo ow’okukyuka n’okuzaalibwa obuggya abayigirizwa gwe baalina nga Pentekoote tennatuuka. Kino kisinga Omwoyo ng’alina ekigero ekimu eky’okukwata kwe n’okukola kwe. Ono ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa mu maanyi g’okugulumizibwa kwe, ng’ajja ku ffe nga Omwoyo wa Yesu abeera mu ffe, ng’abikkula Omwana ne Kitaffe munda mu ffe. (Yokaana 14:16-23.) Omwoyo ono bw’aba Omwoyo, si wa biseera byaffe eby’okusaba byokka, wabula ow’obulamu bwaffe bwonna n’entambula yaffe, Omwoyo ono bw’agulumiza Yesu mu ffe ng’abikkula obujjuvu bw’omulimu gwe, era ng’atufuula omu naye ddala era abamufaanana, olwo lwe tusobola okusaba mu Linnya lye, kubanga ddala tuli omu naye. Olwo lwe tufuna okutuuka eri Kitaffe butereevu, Yesu kw’ayogerako nti, ‘So si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange.’ Ayi! twetaaga okutegeera n’okukkiriza nti okujjuzibwa Omwoyo ono, Omwoyo w’Oyo eyagulumizibwa, kye kyetaago kimu kyokka eky’abantu ba Katonda abakkiriza. Olwo tulitegeera kye kitegeeza, ‘nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera,’ era kye kitegeeza, ‘nga musaba mu Mwoyo Mutukuvu, okwekuumira mu kwagala kwa Katonda.’ ‘Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’

Bwe kityo essomo lijja nate: Okusaba kwaffe kye kugasa kwesigamye ku kye tuli ne ku bulamu bwaffe bwe buli. Obulamu obubeera mu Linnya lya Kristo kye kyama ky’okusaba mu Linnya lya Kristo; obulamu obubeera mu Mwoyo bwe butusobozesa okusaba mu Mwoyo. Okubeera mu Kristo kwe kutuwa eddembe n’amaanyi okusaba kye twagala: obunene bw’okubeera mu ye kye kigero kyennyini eky’amaanyi mu kusaba. Omwoyo abeera munda mu ffe y’asaba, si mu bigambo na birowoozo bulijjo, wabula mu kussa omukka ne mu kubeerawo okusinga ebigambo obuziba. Ng’Omwoyo wa Kristo bw’akoma okuba mu ffe, n’okusaba okw’amazima bwe kukoma awo. Obulamu bwaffe, obulamu bwaffe, Ayi obulamu bwaffe bujjule Kristo, bujjule Omwoyo we, era ebisuubizo ebitaliiko kkomo eby’ekitalo eri okusaba kwaffe tebiriddayo kulabika ng’ebyewuunyisa. ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu mu linnya lyange. Musabe, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Ayi Katonda wange! mu kutya okutukuvu nfukamira mu maaso go, Ggwe Omu mu Basatu. Nate ndabye nti ekyama ky’okusaba kye kyama ky’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Nsinza Kitaffe awulira bulijjo, n’Omwana abeera omulamu ennaku zonna okusaba, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ava eri Kitaffe n’Omwana, okutusitula okutuyingiza mu kussa ekimu okwo okw’okusaba n’okufuna okw’omukisa ennaku zonna, okutakoma. Nfukamira, Katonda wange, mu kusinza, mu maaso g’okwetoowaza okutaliiko kkomo okututwala bwe kutyo, nga kuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ffe n’okusaba kwaffe, okutuyingiza mu Bulamu bwa Katonda, ne mu kussa ekimu kwabwo okw’okwagala.

Ayi Mukama wange Yesu Omutendereze! Njigiriza okutegeera essomo lyo, nti Omwoyo abeera mu ffe, akulukuta okuva gy’oli, era atugatta naawe, ye Mwoyo ow’okusaba. Njigiriza kye kitegeeza, ng’ekibya ekyereere era ekyawongebwa ddala, okwewaayo gy’ali abeere obulamu bwange. Njigiriza okumussaamu ekitiibwa n’okumwesiga, nga Omuntu omulamu, okukulembera obulamu bwange n’okusaba kwange. Njigiriza naddala mu kusaba okulindirira mu kasirise akatukuvu, n’okumuwa ekifo okussa munda mu nze okwegayirira kwe okutayogerekeka. Era njigiriza nti ku bw’Omwoyo kisoboka okusaba obutayosa, n’okusaba obutalemwa, kubanga ansobozesa okugabana ku kwegayiririra okutakoma era okutalemwa, Ggwe Omwana kw’olabikiramu mu maaso ga Kitaffe. Weewaawo, Mukama, tuukiriza mu nze ekisuubizo kyo, Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ Amiina.

EKYONGEREZO.

Okusaba kutera okugeraageranyizibwa n’okussa omukka: twetaaga kumala kugoberera okugeraageranya kuno okutuuka ku nkomerero okulaba ekifo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’alina bwe kiri eky’ekitalo. Buli lwe tussa omukka tufulumya empewo embi eyanditusse mangu, ne tuyingiza nate empewo empya gye tubeerako abalamu. Bwe tutyo bwe tufulumya okuva mu ffe, mu kwatula, ebibi, ne mu kusaba, ebyetaago n’okwegomba kw’omutima gwaffe. Ate bwe tuyingiza nate omukka, tuyingiza empewo empya ey’ebisuubizo, n’okwagala, n’obulamu bwa Katonda mu Kristo. Kino tukikola ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ye mukka gw’obulamu bwaffe.

Era ekyo ky’ali kubanga ye mukka gwa Katonda. Kitaffe amussa mu ffe, alyoke yeegatte n’obulamu bwaffe. Era nga buli lwe tufulumya omukka bwe wagoberawo nate okuyingiza omukka, bw’atyo Katonda bw’assa nate omukka gwe munda, Omwoyo n’addayo gy’ali nga yeetisse okwegomba n’ebyetaago by’emitima gyaffe. Bwe kityo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mukka gw’obulamu bwa Katonda, era ye mukka gw’obulamu obuggya mu ffe. Nga Katonda bw’amufulumya, tumufuna ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba; nga bwe tumuzzaayo, alinnya eri Katonda ng’ajjudde okwegayirira kwaffe. Nga Omwoyo wa Katonda, Kitaffe n’Omwana mw’ali omu, era okwegayiririra kw’Omwana mwe kutuukira eri Kitaffe, gye tuli ye Mwoyo ow’okusaba. Okusaba okw’amazima kwe kumanya mu bulamu amazima g’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Okussa omukka kw’Omwoyo, okwegayiririra kw’Omwana, n’ebyo Kitaffe by’ayagala, ebisatu bino bifuuka kimu mu ffe.

Nga Omwana, eyali Katonda okuva emirembe gyonna, bwe yayingira mu bulamu obuggya ng’omuntu, n’addayo mu ggulu n’ekyo kye yali talina mu kusooka, bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutendereze, Omwana gwe yaweebwa Kitaffe bwe yalinnya mu ggulu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:33) okuyingira mu buntu bwe obugulumiziddwa, yajja gye tuli n’obulamu obuggya, bwe yali talina kugaba mu kusooka. Mu Ndagaano Enkadde yakoowoolwanga nga Omwoyo wa Katonda: ku Pentekoote n’akka nga Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa, ng’atuleetera era ng’atugabira ekibala kyonna n’amaanyi ag’okununulibwa okwatuukirizibwa. Mu kwegayiririra kwa Kristo okununulibwa kwe mwe kukuumirwa okweyongera okukola n’okutuukirizibwa mu bantu. Era olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akka okuva ewa Kristo gye tuli, tusikibwa ne tuyingira mu mugga omunene ogw’okusaba kwe okulinnya bulijjo. Omwoyo atusabira awatali bigambo: mu buziba bw’omutima, ne birowoozo gye bitera okubulwa enkula, Omwoyo atusitula n’atuyingiza mu kukulukuta okw’ekitalo okw’obulamu bwa Katonda Omu mu Basatu. Ku bw’Omwoyo, okusaba kwa Kristo kufuuka kwaffe, n’okwaffe ne kufuulibwa kwe: tusaba kye twagala, ne tukiweebwa. Olwo tutegeera mu bumanyirivu nti, ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba mu linnya lyange. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’ Ow’oluganda! kye twetaaga okusobola okusaba mu Linnya lya Kristo, okusaba tulyoke tufune, essanyu lyaffe liryoke lituukirire, kwe kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo ono Omutukuvu. Kino kisinga Omwoyo wa Katonda nga bwe yali mu Ndagaano Enkadde. Kino kisinga Omwoyo ow’okukyuka n’okuzaalibwa obuggya abayigirizwa gwe baalina nga Pentekoote tennatuuka. Kino kisinga Omwoyo ng’alina ekigero ekimu eky’okukwata kwe n’okukola kwe. Ono ye Mwoyo Omutukuvu, Omwoyo wa Yesu eyagulumizibwa mu maanyi g’okugulumizibwa kwe, ng’ajja ku ffe nga Omwoyo wa Yesu abeera mu ffe, ng’abikkula Omwana ne Kitaffe munda mu ffe. (Yokaana 14:16-23.) Omwoyo ono bw’aba Omwoyo, si wa biseera byaffe eby’okusaba byokka, wabula ow’obulamu bwaffe bwonna n’entambula yaffe, Omwoyo ono bw’agulumiza Yesu mu ffe ng’abikkula obujjuvu bw’omulimu gwe, era ng’atufuula omu naye ddala era abamufaanana, olwo lwe tusobola okusaba mu Linnya lye, kubanga ddala tuli omu naye. Olwo lwe tufuna okutuuka eri Kitaffe butereevu, Yesu kw’ayogerako nti, ‘So si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange.’ Ayi! twetaaga okutegeera n’okukkiriza nti okujjuzibwa Omwoyo ono, Omwoyo w’Oyo eyagulumizibwa, kye kyetaago kimu kyokka eky’abantu ba Katonda abakkiriza. Olwo tulitegeera kye kitegeeza, ‘nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera,’ era kye kitegeeza, ‘nga musaba mu Mwoyo Mutukuvu, okwekuumira mu kwagala kwa Katonda.’ ‘Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange.’ Bwe kityo essomo lijja nate: Okusaba kwaffe kye kugasa kwesigamye ku kye tuli ne ku bulamu bwaffe bwe buli. Obulamu obubeera mu Linnya lya Kristo kye kyama ky’okusaba mu Linnya lya Kristo; obulamu obubeera mu Mwoyo bwe butusobozesa okusaba mu Mwoyo. Okubeera mu Kristo kwe kutuwa eddembe n’amaanyi okusaba kye twagala: obunene bw’okubeera mu ye kye kigero kyennyini eky’amaanyi mu kusaba. Omwoyo abeera munda mu ffe y’asaba, si mu bigambo na birowoozo bulijjo, wabula mu kussa omukka ne mu kubeerawo okusinga ebigambo obuziba. Ng’Omwoyo wa Kristo bw’akoma okuba mu ffe, n’okusaba okw’amazima bwe kukoma awo. Obulamu bwaffe, obulamu bwaffe, Ayi obulamu bwaffe bujjule Kristo, bujjule Omwoyo we, era ebisuubizo ebitaliiko kkomo eby’ekitalo eri okusaba kwaffe tebiriddayo kulabika ng’ebyewuunyisa. ‘Okutuusa kaakano temunnasaba kintu mu linnya lyange. Musabe, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire. Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Ayi Katonda wange! mu kutya okutukuvu nfukamira mu maaso go, Ggwe Omu mu Basatu. Nate ndabye nti ekyama ky’okusaba kye kyama ky’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Nsinza Kitaffe awulira bulijjo, n’Omwana abeera omulamu ennaku zonna okusaba, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ava eri Kitaffe n’Omwana, okutusitula okutuyingiza mu kussa ekimu okwo okw’okusaba n’okufuna okw’omukisa ennaku zonna, okutakoma. Nfukamira, Katonda wange, mu kusinza, mu maaso g’okwetoowaza okutaliiko kkomo okututwala bwe kutyo, nga kuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ffe n’okusaba kwaffe, okutuyingiza mu Bulamu bwa Katonda, ne mu kussa ekimu kwabwo okw’okwagala. Ayi Mukama wange Yesu Omutendereze! Njigiriza okutegeera essomo lyo, nti Omwoyo abeera mu ffe, akulukuta okuva gy’oli, era atugatta naawe, ye Mwoyo ow’okusaba. Njigiriza kye kitegeeza, ng’ekibya ekyereere era ekyawongebwa ddala, okwewaayo gy’ali abeere obulamu bwange. Njigiriza okumussaamu ekitiibwa n’okumwesiga, nga Omuntu omulamu, okukulembera obulamu bwange n’okusaba kwange. Njigiriza naddala mu kusaba okulindirira mu kasirise akatukuvu, n’okumuwa ekifo okussa munda mu nze okwegayirira kwe okutayogerekeka. Era njigiriza nti ku bw’Omwoyo kisoboka okusaba obutayosa, n’okusaba obutalemwa, kubanga ansobozesa okugabana ku kwegayiririra okutakoma era okutalemwa, Ggwe Omwana kw’olabikiramu mu maaso ga Kitaffe. Weewaawo, Mukama, tuukiriza mu nze ekisuubizo kyo, Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.’ Amiina. ———0——- EKYONGEREZO. Okusaba kutera okugeraageranyizibwa n’okussa omukka: twetaaga kumala kugoberera okugeraageranya kuno okutuuka ku nkomerero okulaba ekifo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky’alina bwe kiri eky’ekitalo. Buli lwe tussa omukka tufulumya empewo embi eyanditusse mangu, ne tuyingiza nate empewo empya gye tubeerako abalamu. Bwe tutyo bwe tufulumya okuva mu ffe, mu kwatula, ebibi, ne mu kusaba, ebyetaago n’okwegomba kw’omutima gwaffe. Ate bwe tuyingiza nate omukka, tuyingiza empewo empya ey’ebisuubizo, n’okwagala, n’obulamu bwa Katonda mu Kristo. Kino tukikola ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ye mukka gw’obulamu bwaffe. Era ekyo ky’ali kubanga ye mukka gwa Katonda. Kitaffe amussa mu ffe, alyoke yeegatte n’obulamu bwaffe. Era nga buli lwe tufulumya omukka bwe wagoberawo nate okuyingiza omukka, bw’atyo Katonda bw’assa nate omukka gwe munda, Omwoyo n’addayo gy’ali nga yeetisse okwegomba n’ebyetaago by’emitima gyaffe. Bwe kityo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mukka gw’obulamu bwa Katonda, era ye mukka gw’obulamu obuggya mu ffe. Nga Katonda bw’amufulumya, tumufuna ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba; nga bwe tumuzzaayo, alinnya eri Katonda ng’ajjudde okwegayirira kwaffe. Nga Omwoyo wa Katonda, Kitaffe n’Omwana mw’ali omu, era okwegayiririra kw’Omwana mwe kutuukira eri Kitaffe, gye tuli ye Mwoyo ow’okusaba. Okusaba okw’amazima kwe kumanya mu bulamu amazima g’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Okussa omukka kw’Omwoyo, okwegayiririra kw’Omwana, n’ebyo Kitaffe by’ayagala, ebisatu bino bifuuka kimu mu ffe.

fields.title: Kristo Omwegayirizi
fields.body_html:
‘Naye ggwe nkusabidde okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu.’—Lukka 22:32.

‘So si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange.’—Yokaana 16:26.

‘Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.’—Abaebbulaniya 7:25.

OKUKULA kwonna mu bulamu obw’omwoyo kwekuusa ku kutegeera obulungi ennyo Yesu ky’ali gye tuli. Gye nkoma okutegeera nti Kristo ateekwa okuba byonna gye ndi era mu nze, era nti byonna ebiri mu Kristo ddala byange, gye nkoma okuyiga okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza obwa nnamaddala, obufa ku nze kennyini ne bubeera mu Kristo yekka. Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo tebukyali kulwana okw’obwereere okugezaako okutambula obulungi, wabula kwe kuwummulira mu Kristo n’okufuna amaanyi mu Ye ng’obulamu bwaffe, tulwane olutalo era tuwangule obuwanguzi bw’okukkiriza. Kino kituufu nnyo naddala ku bulamu obw’okusaba. Bwe bulabibwa nti nabwo bufugibwa etteeka ly’okukkiriza lyokka, ne bulabirwa mu musana gw’obujjuvu n’obutuukirivu obuli mu Yesu, omukkiriza ategeera nti tebukyetaagisa kwezibuwaza na kweraliikirira, wabula kwe kulaba Kristo ky’anaamukolera era ky’anaakola mu ye—okugabana ku bulamu bwa Kristo obwo, obwambuka bulijjo eri Kitaffe nga kye kusaba, mu ggulu nga bwe kyali ku nsi. Era atandika okusaba, si lwa kwesiga kwokka obulungi bwa Yesu, oba okwegayiririra kwe okufuula okusaba kwaffe okutasaana okusiimibwa, wabula olw’obumu obwo obw’okumpi ennyo, mw’ayita okusaba mu ffe naffe ne tusaba mu Ye. Obulokozi bwonna ye Kristo yennyini: atuwadde YE YENNYINI; Ye yennyini abeera mu ffe. Olw’okuba Ye asaba, naffe tusaba. Ng’abayigirizwa bwe baalaba Yesu ng’asaba ne bamusaba abagabane ku ebyo bye yali amanyi ku kusaba, bwe tutyo naffe, kaakano nga tumulaba ng’omwegayirizi ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka, tumanyi nti atugabanya naye mu bulamu obw’okusaba.

Kino kirabikira lwatu nnyo mu kiro ekisembayo eky’obulamu bwe. Mu kusaba kwe nga Kabona Asinga Obukulu (Yokaana 17), atulaga engeri gy’alina okusaba Kitaawe n’ebyo by’alina okumusaba, era by’anaasabanga bw’alimala okulinnya mu ggulu. Kyokka mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula yali ayunze emirundi mingi okugenda kwe eri Kitaawe n’obulamu obuggya obw’okusaba obwa bo. Ebintu ebyo ebibiri byandibadde byegattira ddala: okutandika kwe omulimu gw’okwegayiririra okutaggwaawo kwandibadde ntandikwa n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwabwe obuggya obw’okusaba mu Linnya lye. Okulaba Yesu nga yeegayiririra kye kituwa amaanyi okusaba mu Linnya lye: obuyinza bwonna n’amaanyi gonna ag’okusaba bya Kristo; Ye atugabanya ku kwegayiririra kwe.

Okutegeera kino, sooka olowooze ku kwegayiririra kwe: abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza. Omulimu Kristo gwe yakola ku nsi nga Kabona gwali ntandikwa bwokka. Yayiwa omusaayi gwe nga Alooni; kaakano abeera mulamu munda w’eggigi nga Merukizeddeeki okweyongerayo n’omulimu gwe, ng’amaanyi bwe gali ag’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Nga Merukizeddeeki bw’asinga Alooni ekitiibwa, bwe kityo mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra okutangirira mwe kulabikira amaanyi gaakwo ag’amazima n’ekitiibwa kyakwo. ‘Kristo Yesu yafa: okusinga byonna, ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’atwegayiririra.’ Okwegayiririra okwo kintu kya nnamaddala ddala, omulimu ogwetaagisa ennyo, era awatali gwo okununulibwa tekuyinza kweyongera kukola mu bantu. Mu kufuuka omuntu ne mu kuzuukira kwa Yesu mwe mwabeererawo okutabaganya okw’ekitalo, omuntu mwe yafuukira omugabi ku bulamu n’essanyu bya Katonda. Naye buli omu ku bitundu bye wano wansi okwetwalira ddala okutabaganya kuno tekuyinza kubaawo awatali Mutwe ali mu ggulu kukozesa butakoma maanyi ge aga Katonda. Mu buli kukyuka n’okutukuzibwa, mu buli buwanguzi ku kibi ne ku nsi, mubaamu okukola okwa nnamaddala okw’amaanyi g’oyo ow’amaanyi okulokola. Era okukozesa amaanyi ge kuno kubaawo kuyita mu kusaba kwe kwokka: asaba Kitaawe, era aweebwa Kitaawe. ‘Ayinza okulokolera ddala, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.’ Tewali kye bantu be beetaaga ky’atafuna nga yeegayiririra okuva mu ebyo Katonda by’alina okugaba: okubeera kwe omutabaganya ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka kwa nnamaddala era kwetaagisa ddala nga bwe kwali ku musaalaba. Tewali kibaawo awatali kwegayiririra kwe: kumutwalira obudde bwe bwonna n’amaanyi ge gonna, gwe mulimu gwe ogutakoma ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe.

Era tetugabana ku birungi byokka eby’omulimu gwe guno, wabula ne ku mulimu gwennyini. Kino kiri bwe kityo kubanga tuli mubiri gwe. Omubiri n’ebitundu byagwo bumu: ‘Omutwe teguyinza kugamba bigere nti, Mmwe sibeetaaga.’ Tugabana ne Yesu mu byonna by’ali ne by’alina: ‘Mbawadde ekitiibwa kye wampa.’ Tuli bagabi ku bulamu bwe, ku butuukirivu bwe, ku mulimu gwe: tugabana naye ne mu kwegayiririra kwe; si mulimu gw’akola awatali ffe.

Kino tukikola kubanga tugabana ku bulamu bwe: ‘Kristo bwe bulamu bwaffe;’ ‘Si nze, wabula Kristo abeera mu nze.’ Obulamu obuli mu Ye n’obuli mu ffe bwe bumu, bwe bumu ddala. Obulamu bwe mu ffe bulamu obusaba bulijjo. Bwe bukka ne butwefuga, tebufiirwa mpisa yaabwo; ne mu ffe bwe bulamu obusaba bulijjo—obulamu obusaba obutayosa era obufuna okuva eri Katonda. Era kino tekitegeeza nti waliwo emigga ebiri egy’okusaba egyawukana egyambuka waggulu, ogumu nga guva gy’ali, n’omulala nga guva mu bantu be. Nedda, wabula obumu bw’obulamu obwa nnamaddala era bumu bwa kusaba: by’asaba biyita mu ffe, bye tusaba biyita mu Ye. Ye malayika eyalina ekyoterezo ekya zaabu: ‘YE yaweebwa obubaane bungi nnyo,’ ekyama ky’okusaba okusiimibwa, ‘abuweeyo, wamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu bonna, ku kyoto ekya zaabu.’ Tuli balamu, tubeera mu Ye, Oyo Eyeegayiririra.

Omwana eyazaalibwa omu yekka y’alina obuyinza okusaba: Ye yekka gwe baagamba nti, ‘Nsaba, nange ndikuwa.’ Nga mu bintu ebirala byonna obujjuvu bwe bubeera mu Ye, bwe kityo n’obujjuvu obw’amazima obw’okusaba; Ye yekka y’alina amaanyi g’okusaba. Era nga okukula kw’obulamu obw’omwoyo bwe kuli mu kutegeera obulungi ennyo nti eby’obugagga byonna biri mu Ye, era nti naffe tuli mu Ye, tufune buli kaseera bye tulina mu Ye, ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa, bwe kityo n’obulamu obw’okusaba. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu kwegayiririra kwa Yesu tekulina kuba kwokka nti atusabira mu kifo kyaffe, bwe tutasaba oba bwe tutasobola kusaba, wabula nti, ng’Oyo eyatandika obulamu bwaffe n’okukkiriza kwaffe, atusika okusaba nga tuli bumu naye. Okusaba kwaffe kuteekwa okuba omulimu gw’okukkiriza ne mu ngeri eno: nga bwe tumanyi nti Yesu atuyingizaamu obulamu bwe bwonna, era okuva mu bujjuvu bw’okusaba obuli mu Ye yekka, atufuuyiramu okusaba kwaffe.

Eri omukkiriza omungi, gwali mutendera omuggya mu bulamu bwe obw’omwoyo bwe kyamubikkulirwa nti Kristo ddala era mu bujjuvu bwe bulamu bwe, era nti ye mweyimirizi we nti ajja kusigala nga mwesigwa era nga muwulize. Olwo lwe yasooka okutandika ddala okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Era tekiriba kya mukisa kitono okuzuula nti Kristo ye mweyimirizi w’obulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba nabwo, ye nsibuko era ekifaananyi ky’okusaba kwonna, ky’agabira abantu be ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza’ ng’Omutwe gw’omubiri, ng’Omukulembeze mu ekkubo eriggya era eddamu lye yatuggulirawo, ng’oyo eyatandika okukkiriza kwaffe era y’akutuukiriza. Alabirira obulamu bw’abo be yanunula mu byonna ng’abawa obulamu bwe bwennyini mu bo: alabirira obulamu bwabwe obw’okusaba, ng’abatwala mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba obw’omu ggulu, ng’abawa era ng’anywereza obulamu bwe obw’okusaba munda mu bo. ‘Nkusabidde,’ si lwa kufuula kukkiriza kwo obutaba kwetaagisa, wabula ‘okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu:’ okukkiriza kwaffe n’okusaba kwaffe okw’okukkiriza bisimbye emirandira mu kukkiriza kwe. Kiri nti, ‘bwe munywerera mu Nze,’ Omwegayirizi abeera omulamu ennaku zonna, ne musaba nange era mu Nze: ‘buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’

Ekirowoozo ky’okussa ekimu kwaffe mu kwegayiririra kwa Yesu kitujjukiza ekyo kye yatuyigiriza emirundi egisoba mu gumu edda, nti ebisuubizo bino byonna eby’ekitalo ebikwata ku kusaba ekigendererwa kyabyo era ensonga ebiwa obutuufu kye kitiibwa kya Katonda mu kulabisibwa kw’obwakabaka bwe n’okulokolebwa kw’aboonoonyi. Kasita tusabira bwe ffekka oba okusinga ffe bennyini, ebisuubizo eby’ekiro ekisembayo bijja kusigala gye tuli ng’ekitabo ekisibe. Biweereddwa amatabi agabala ebibala ag’Omuzabbibu; biweereddwa abayigirizwa abatumibwa mu nsi nga Kitaffe bwe yamutuma, okubeerawo ku lw’abantu ababula; biweereddwa abaweereza be abeesigwa ne mikwano gye egy’okumpi abakwata omulimu gw’aleka, abafuuse nga Mukama waabwe empeke y’eŋŋaano, efiirwa obulamu bwayo okubwaza emirundi mingi;—abo nga bwe batyo be baweebwa ebisuubizo. Buli omu ku ffe azuule omulimu kye guli, n’emmeeme ki ezikwasiddwa okusaba kwaffe okw’enjawulo; tufuule okubegayiririra obulamu bwaffe obw’okussa ekimu ne Katonda, era tetujja kukoma ku kulaba bisuubizo by’amaanyi mu kusaba nga bituukirira gye tuli, wabula olwo lwe tulisooka okutegeera engeri okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo n’okubeera kwe mu ffe gye kutugabanya ku ssanyu lye yennyini ery’okuwa abantu omukisa n’okubalokola.

Ayi okwegayiririra okw’ekitalo ennyo okwa Mukama waffe Yesu Omutendereze, kwe tuyita okufuna byonna, era mwe tutwalibwa ng’abakolagana naye abanyiikivu era abakozi awamu naye! Kaakano tutegeera kye kitegeeza okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu, era lwaki kulina amaanyi bwe gatyo. Mu Linnya lye, mu Mwoyo gwe, mu Ye yennyini, mu bumu obutuukiridde naye. Ayi okwegayiririra okw’ekitalo, okukola bulijjo, era okuvaamu ebibala ennyo okw’omuntu Kristo Yesu! Ddi lwe tulitwalibwa ddala mu kwo ne tusaba bulijjo mu kwo?

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Mukama Omutendereze! Njagala okukuvuunamira nate mu kusinza okw’obwetoowaze. Omulimu gwo gwonna ogw’okununula kaakano gufuuse okusaba; byonna by’okola kaakano mu kukuuma n’okugaba ebyo bye wagula n’omusaayi gwo kusaba kwokka. Obeera mulamu ennaku zonna okusaba. Era olw’okuba tuli era tubeera mu Ggwe, ekkubo eriraga butereevu eri Kitaffe liggule bulijjo, obulamu bwaffe busobola okuba obw’okusaba okutayosa, era okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwaffe kukakafu.

Mukama Omutendereze! Oyise abantu bo okubeera abakozi awamu naawe mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Weegasse n’abantu bo era obagabanya naawe, ng’omubiri gwo, mu buweereza obwo obw’okwegayiririra abalala, obwo bwokka ensi mwe yinza okujjuzibwa ebibala by’okununula kwo n’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe. N’eddembe eringi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde, nzija gy’oli, Mukama wange, ne nkwegayirira: Nnyigiriza okusaba. Obulamu bwo kusaba, obulamu bwo bwange. Mukama! nnyigiriza okusaba, mu Ggwe, nga Ggwe.

Era, Ayi Mukama wange! Mpa naddala okumanya, nga bwe wasuubiza abayigirizwa bo, nti ggwe oli mu Kitaffe, nange ndi mu Ggwe, naawe oli mu nze. Amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu agagatta gafuule obulamu bwange bwonna okubeera mu Ggwe ne mu kwegayiririra kwo, okusaba kwange kulyoke kubeere ddoboozi lyakwo eriddamu, era Kitaffe ampulire mu Ggwe naawe mu nze. Mukama Yesu! endowooza yo ebeere mu nze mu buli kintu, n’obulamu bwange bubeere mu Ggwe mu buli kintu. Bwe ntyo ndiba nga neeteeseteese okubeera omukutu okwegayiririra kwo mwe kunaayitira okufukira ensi omukisa gwakwo. Amiina.

EKYONGEREZO.

‘Ekiseera ekiggya eky’okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu Kristo akiraga ng’ekiseera eky’okufukibwa kw’Omwoyo, abayigirizwa mwe batandikira okutegeera mu kitangaala ekisingawo enteekateeka y’okununulibwa, ne bamanya obulungi obumu bwabwe ne Yesu nga bwe bamanyi obumu bwe ne Kitaawe. Kaakano okusaba kwabwe mu Linnya lya Yesu kugenda butereevu eri Kitaffe yennyini. “So si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange, kubanga Kitange yennyini abaagala,” Yesu bw’agamba; so nga yali ayogedde edda ku kiseera Omwoyo nga tannajja: “Ndisaba Kitange n’abawa Omubeezi.” Okusaba kuno bwe kutyo kulina ng’ekirowoozo kyakwo ekikulu okutegeera nti twegattiddwa ne Katonda mu Kristo, Ye nga lwe lukoba olulamu olw’obumu wakati wa Katonda naffe ku njuyi zombi (Yokaana 17:23: “Nze nga ndi mu bo, era naawe ng’oli mu Nze”), ne kiba nti mu Yesu tulaba Kitaffe ng’ali bumu naffe, era naffe nga tuli bumu ne Kitaffe. Yesu Kristo ateekwa okuba ng’atubikkuliddwa, si mu mazima ag’omu birowoozo byokka, wabula ne mu kumanya kwaffe okw’omunda ennyo ng’okutabaganya okulamu okwa nnamaddala, nga Ye oyo obukitaawe bwa Katonda n’okwagala kwe okw’obukitaawe mwe byegattira ddala n’obuntu, n’obuntu ne Katonda. Si nti mu kusaba eri Kitaffe butereevu, omulimu gwa Kristo ogw’obutabaganya guggibwawo; wabula tegukyatunuulirwa ng’ekintu eky’ebweru ekiri wabweru waffe, wabula ng’ekintu eky’omwoyo ekiramu ekya nnamaddala ekiri munda mu ffe, ne kiba nti Kristo ku lwaffe, Omutabaganya, ddala afuuse Kristo mu ffe.

‘Okumanya kuno okw’obumu wakati wa Katonda mu Kristo naffe mu Kristo bwe kuba nga tekunnabaawo, oba nga kuzikiziddwa okuwulira omusango, olwo okusaba okw’okukkiriza kutunuulira Mukama waffe ng’Omuwolereza, asaba Kitaffe ku lwaffe. (Geraageranya Yokaana 16:26 ne Yokaana 14:16-17; 9:20; Lukka 21:32; 1 Yokaana 2:1.) Okutwala Kristo bwe kityo mu kusaba ng’Omuwolereza, okusinziira ku Yokaana 16:26, si kye kimu ddala n’okusaba mu Linnya lye. Okuwolereza kwa Kristo kugendereddwamu okututuusa ku bumu obwo obw’obulamu obw’omunda obwetongodde naye, era ne Kitaffe mu Ye, mwe kiva nti Kristo ye Oyo Katonda mw’ayingirira mu nkolagana ey’obutereevu naffe ne yeegatta naffe, era mwe tuyingirira, mu buli mbeera, mu nkolagana ey’obutereevu ne Katonda. Bwe kityo n’okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu tekuli mu kusaba kwaffe olw’okulagira kwe: abayigirizwa baali basaba bwe batyo okuva Mukama lwe yabawa “Kitaffe” we, kyokka agamba nti, “Mubadde temunnasaba mu linnya lyange.” Olwo lwokka, obutabaganya bwa Kristo bwe bufuuka, okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu okubeera mu ffe, obulamu n’amaanyi munda mu ffe, era bwe kityo endowooza ye, nga bwe yalabikira mu kigambo kye ne mu mulimu gwe, bw’emala okwefuga n’okujjuza okumanya kwaffe okw’omunda n’okwagala kwaffe, ne kiba nti mu kukkiriza ne mu kwagala tulina Yesu mu ffe ng’Omutabaganya eyatufuula ddala omu ne Katonda: olwo lwokka Erinnya lye, eritwaliramu obutonde bwe n’omulimu gwe, lifuuka amazima n’amaanyi mu ffe (si ku lwaffe kyokka), era tulina mu Linnya lya Yesu ekkubo ery’eddembe eriraga butereevu eri Kitaffe, erikakafu okuwulirwa. Okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu ye ddembe ly’omwana eri kitaawe, nga Yesu bwe yalina kino ng’Omubereberye. Tusaba mu kifo kya Yesu, si nga bwe tuyinza okwessa mu kifo kye, wabula nga bwe tuli mu Ye naye mu ffe. Tugenda butereevu eri Kitaffe, naye nga Kitaffe bw’ali mu Kristo kyokka, si nga bw’ayawukana ku Kristo. N’olwekyo omuntu ow’omunda w’atabeera mu Kristo era nga tamulina ng’Omulamu, ekigambo kye we kitafugira mu mutima mu maanyi g’Omwoyo, amazima ge n’obulamu bwe we bitafuukidde bulamu bwa mmeeme yaffe, kya bwereere okulowooza nti ebigambo nga “ku lw’Omwana wo omwagalwa” bijja kugasa.’—Christliche Ethik, von Dr. I. T. Beck, Tubingen, 3:39.
fields.body_text: ‘Naye ggwe nkusabidde okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu.’—Lukka 22:32. ‘So si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange.’—Yokaana 16:26. ‘Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.’—Abaebbulaniya 7:25. OKUKULA kwonna mu bulamu obw’omwoyo kwekuusa ku kutegeera obulungi ennyo Yesu ky’ali gye tuli. Gye nkoma okutegeera nti Kristo ateekwa okuba byonna gye ndi era mu nze, era nti byonna ebiri mu Kristo ddala byange, gye nkoma okuyiga okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza obwa nnamaddala, obufa ku nze kennyini ne bubeera mu Kristo yekka. Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo tebukyali kulwana okw’obwereere okugezaako okutambula obulungi, wabula kwe kuwummulira mu Kristo n’okufuna amaanyi mu Ye ng’obulamu bwaffe, tulwane olutalo era tuwangule obuwanguzi bw’okukkiriza. Kino kituufu nnyo naddala ku bulamu obw’okusaba. Bwe bulabibwa nti nabwo bufugibwa etteeka ly’okukkiriza lyokka, ne bulabirwa mu musana gw’obujjuvu n’obutuukirivu obuli mu Yesu, omukkiriza ategeera nti tebukyetaagisa kwezibuwaza na kweraliikirira, wabula kwe kulaba Kristo ky’anaamukolera era ky’anaakola mu ye—okugabana ku bulamu bwa Kristo obwo, obwambuka bulijjo eri Kitaffe nga kye kusaba, mu ggulu nga bwe kyali ku nsi. Era atandika okusaba, si lwa kwesiga kwokka obulungi bwa Yesu, oba okwegayiririra kwe okufuula okusaba kwaffe okutasaana okusiimibwa, wabula olw’obumu obwo obw’okumpi ennyo, mw’ayita okusaba mu ffe naffe ne tusaba mu Ye. Obulokozi bwonna ye Kristo yennyini: atuwadde YE YENNYINI; Ye yennyini abeera mu ffe. Olw’okuba Ye asaba, naffe tusaba. Ng’abayigirizwa bwe baalaba Yesu ng’asaba ne bamusaba abagabane ku ebyo bye yali amanyi ku kusaba, bwe tutyo naffe, kaakano nga tumulaba ng’omwegayirizi ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka, tumanyi nti atugabanya naye mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Kino kirabikira lwatu nnyo mu kiro ekisembayo eky’obulamu bwe. Mu kusaba kwe nga Kabona Asinga Obukulu (Yokaana 17), atulaga engeri gy’alina okusaba Kitaawe n’ebyo by’alina okumusaba, era by’anaasabanga bw’alimala okulinnya mu ggulu. Kyokka mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula yali ayunze emirundi mingi okugenda kwe eri Kitaawe n’obulamu obuggya obw’okusaba obwa bo. Ebintu ebyo ebibiri byandibadde byegattira ddala: okutandika kwe omulimu gw’okwegayiririra okutaggwaawo kwandibadde ntandikwa n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwabwe obuggya obw’okusaba mu Linnya lye. Okulaba Yesu nga yeegayiririra kye kituwa amaanyi okusaba mu Linnya lye: obuyinza bwonna n’amaanyi gonna ag’okusaba bya Kristo; Ye atugabanya ku kwegayiririra kwe. Okutegeera kino, sooka olowooze ku kwegayiririra kwe: abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza. Omulimu Kristo gwe yakola ku nsi nga Kabona gwali ntandikwa bwokka. Yayiwa omusaayi gwe nga Alooni; kaakano abeera mulamu munda w’eggigi nga Merukizeddeeki okweyongerayo n’omulimu gwe, ng’amaanyi bwe gali ag’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Nga Merukizeddeeki bw’asinga Alooni ekitiibwa, bwe kityo mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra okutangirira mwe kulabikira amaanyi gaakwo ag’amazima n’ekitiibwa kyakwo. ‘Kristo Yesu yafa: okusinga byonna, ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’atwegayiririra.’ Okwegayiririra okwo kintu kya nnamaddala ddala, omulimu ogwetaagisa ennyo, era awatali gwo okununulibwa tekuyinza kweyongera kukola mu bantu. Mu kufuuka omuntu ne mu kuzuukira kwa Yesu mwe mwabeererawo okutabaganya okw’ekitalo, omuntu mwe yafuukira omugabi ku bulamu n’essanyu bya Katonda. Naye buli omu ku bitundu bye wano wansi okwetwalira ddala okutabaganya kuno tekuyinza kubaawo awatali Mutwe ali mu ggulu kukozesa butakoma maanyi ge aga Katonda. Mu buli kukyuka n’okutukuzibwa, mu buli buwanguzi ku kibi ne ku nsi, mubaamu okukola okwa nnamaddala okw’amaanyi g’oyo ow’amaanyi okulokola. Era okukozesa amaanyi ge kuno kubaawo kuyita mu kusaba kwe kwokka: asaba Kitaawe, era aweebwa Kitaawe. ‘Ayinza okulokolera ddala, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza.’ Tewali kye bantu be beetaaga ky’atafuna nga yeegayiririra okuva mu ebyo Katonda by’alina okugaba: okubeera kwe omutabaganya ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka kwa nnamaddala era kwetaagisa ddala nga bwe kwali ku musaalaba. Tewali kibaawo awatali kwegayiririra kwe: kumutwalira obudde bwe bwonna n’amaanyi ge gonna, gwe mulimu gwe ogutakoma ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Kitaffe. Era tetugabana ku birungi byokka eby’omulimu gwe guno, wabula ne ku mulimu gwennyini. Kino kiri bwe kityo kubanga tuli mubiri gwe. Omubiri n’ebitundu byagwo bumu: ‘Omutwe teguyinza kugamba bigere nti, Mmwe sibeetaaga.’ Tugabana ne Yesu mu byonna by’ali ne by’alina: ‘Mbawadde ekitiibwa kye wampa.’ Tuli bagabi ku bulamu bwe, ku butuukirivu bwe, ku mulimu gwe: tugabana naye ne mu kwegayiririra kwe; si mulimu gw’akola awatali ffe. Kino tukikola kubanga tugabana ku bulamu bwe: ‘Kristo bwe bulamu bwaffe;’ ‘Si nze, wabula Kristo abeera mu nze.’ Obulamu obuli mu Ye n’obuli mu ffe bwe bumu, bwe bumu ddala. Obulamu bwe mu ffe bulamu obusaba bulijjo. Bwe bukka ne butwefuga, tebufiirwa mpisa yaabwo; ne mu ffe bwe bulamu obusaba bulijjo—obulamu obusaba obutayosa era obufuna okuva eri Katonda. Era kino tekitegeeza nti waliwo emigga ebiri egy’okusaba egyawukana egyambuka waggulu, ogumu nga guva gy’ali, n’omulala nga guva mu bantu be. Nedda, wabula obumu bw’obulamu obwa nnamaddala era bumu bwa kusaba: by’asaba biyita mu ffe, bye tusaba biyita mu Ye. Ye malayika eyalina ekyoterezo ekya zaabu: ‘YE yaweebwa obubaane bungi nnyo,’ ekyama ky’okusaba okusiimibwa, ‘abuweeyo, wamu n’okusaba kw’abatukuvu bonna, ku kyoto ekya zaabu.’ Tuli balamu, tubeera mu Ye, Oyo Eyeegayiririra. Omwana eyazaalibwa omu yekka y’alina obuyinza okusaba: Ye yekka gwe baagamba nti, ‘Nsaba, nange ndikuwa.’ Nga mu bintu ebirala byonna obujjuvu bwe bubeera mu Ye, bwe kityo n’obujjuvu obw’amazima obw’okusaba; Ye yekka y’alina amaanyi g’okusaba. Era nga okukula kw’obulamu obw’omwoyo bwe kuli mu kutegeera obulungi ennyo nti eby’obugagga byonna biri mu Ye, era nti naffe tuli mu Ye, tufune buli kaseera bye tulina mu Ye, ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa, bwe kityo n’obulamu obw’okusaba. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu kwegayiririra kwa Yesu tekulina kuba kwokka nti atusabira mu kifo kyaffe, bwe tutasaba oba bwe tutasobola kusaba, wabula nti, ng’Oyo eyatandika obulamu bwaffe n’okukkiriza kwaffe, atusika okusaba nga tuli bumu naye. Okusaba kwaffe kuteekwa okuba omulimu gw’okukkiriza ne mu ngeri eno: nga bwe tumanyi nti Yesu atuyingizaamu obulamu bwe bwonna, era okuva mu bujjuvu bw’okusaba obuli mu Ye yekka, atufuuyiramu okusaba kwaffe. Eri omukkiriza omungi, gwali mutendera omuggya mu bulamu bwe obw’omwoyo bwe kyamubikkulirwa nti Kristo ddala era mu bujjuvu bwe bulamu bwe, era nti ye mweyimirizi we nti ajja kusigala nga mwesigwa era nga muwulize. Olwo lwe yasooka okutandika ddala okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Era tekiriba kya mukisa kitono okuzuula nti Kristo ye mweyimirizi w’obulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba nabwo, ye nsibuko era ekifaananyi ky’okusaba kwonna, ky’agabira abantu be ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘Abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza’ ng’Omutwe gw’omubiri, ng’Omukulembeze mu ekkubo eriggya era eddamu lye yatuggulirawo, ng’oyo eyatandika okukkiriza kwaffe era y’akutuukiriza. Alabirira obulamu bw’abo be yanunula mu byonna ng’abawa obulamu bwe bwennyini mu bo: alabirira obulamu bwabwe obw’okusaba, ng’abatwala mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba obw’omu ggulu, ng’abawa era ng’anywereza obulamu bwe obw’okusaba munda mu bo. ‘Nkusabidde,’ si lwa kufuula kukkiriza kwo obutaba kwetaagisa, wabula ‘okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu:’ okukkiriza kwaffe n’okusaba kwaffe okw’okukkiriza bisimbye emirandira mu kukkiriza kwe. Kiri nti, ‘bwe munywerera mu Nze,’ Omwegayirizi abeera omulamu ennaku zonna, ne musaba nange era mu Nze: ‘buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Ekirowoozo ky’okussa ekimu kwaffe mu kwegayiririra kwa Yesu kitujjukiza ekyo kye yatuyigiriza emirundi egisoba mu gumu edda, nti ebisuubizo bino byonna eby’ekitalo ebikwata ku kusaba ekigendererwa kyabyo era ensonga ebiwa obutuufu kye kitiibwa kya Katonda mu kulabisibwa kw’obwakabaka bwe n’okulokolebwa kw’aboonoonyi. Kasita tusabira bwe ffekka oba okusinga ffe bennyini, ebisuubizo eby’ekiro ekisembayo bijja kusigala gye tuli ng’ekitabo ekisibe. Biweereddwa amatabi agabala ebibala ag’Omuzabbibu; biweereddwa abayigirizwa abatumibwa mu nsi nga Kitaffe bwe yamutuma, okubeerawo ku lw’abantu ababula; biweereddwa abaweereza be abeesigwa ne mikwano gye egy’okumpi abakwata omulimu gw’aleka, abafuuse nga Mukama waabwe empeke y’eŋŋaano, efiirwa obulamu bwayo okubwaza emirundi mingi;—abo nga bwe batyo be baweebwa ebisuubizo. Buli omu ku ffe azuule omulimu kye guli, n’emmeeme ki ezikwasiddwa okusaba kwaffe okw’enjawulo; tufuule okubegayiririra obulamu bwaffe obw’okussa ekimu ne Katonda, era tetujja kukoma ku kulaba bisuubizo by’amaanyi mu kusaba nga bituukirira gye tuli, wabula olwo lwe tulisooka okutegeera engeri okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo n’okubeera kwe mu ffe gye kutugabanya ku ssanyu lye yennyini ery’okuwa abantu omukisa n’okubalokola. Ayi okwegayiririra okw’ekitalo ennyo okwa Mukama waffe Yesu Omutendereze, kwe tuyita okufuna byonna, era mwe tutwalibwa ng’abakolagana naye abanyiikivu era abakozi awamu naye! Kaakano tutegeera kye kitegeeza okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu, era lwaki kulina amaanyi bwe gatyo. Mu Linnya lye, mu Mwoyo gwe, mu Ye yennyini, mu bumu obutuukiridde naye. Ayi okwegayiririra okw’ekitalo, okukola bulijjo, era okuvaamu ebibala ennyo okw’omuntu Kristo Yesu! Ddi lwe tulitwalibwa ddala mu kwo ne tusaba bulijjo mu kwo? ‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’ Mukama Omutendereze! Njagala okukuvuunamira nate mu kusinza okw’obwetoowaze. Omulimu gwo gwonna ogw’okununula kaakano gufuuse okusaba; byonna by’okola kaakano mu kukuuma n’okugaba ebyo bye wagula n’omusaayi gwo kusaba kwokka. Obeera mulamu ennaku zonna okusaba. Era olw’okuba tuli era tubeera mu Ggwe, ekkubo eriraga butereevu eri Kitaffe liggule bulijjo, obulamu bwaffe busobola okuba obw’okusaba okutayosa, era okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwaffe kukakafu. Mukama Omutendereze! Oyise abantu bo okubeera abakozi awamu naawe mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Weegasse n’abantu bo era obagabanya naawe, ng’omubiri gwo, mu buweereza obwo obw’okwegayiririra abalala, obwo bwokka ensi mwe yinza okujjuzibwa ebibala by’okununula kwo n’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe. N’eddembe eringi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde, nzija gy’oli, Mukama wange, ne nkwegayirira: Nnyigiriza okusaba. Obulamu bwo kusaba, obulamu bwo bwange. Mukama! nnyigiriza okusaba, mu Ggwe, nga Ggwe. Bwe kityo n’okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu tekuli mu kusaba kwaffe olw’okulagira kwe: abayigirizwa baali basaba bwe batyo okuva Mukama lwe yabawa “Kitaffe” we, kyokka agamba nti, “Mubadde temunnasaba mu linnya lyange.” Olwo lwokka, obutabaganya bwa Kristo bwe bufuuka, okuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu okubeera mu ffe, obulamu n’amaanyi munda mu ffe, era bwe kityo endowooza ye, nga bwe yalabikira mu kigambo kye ne mu mulimu gwe, bw’emala okwefuga n’okujjuza okumanya kwaffe okw’omunda n’okwagala kwaffe, ne kiba nti mu kukkiriza ne mu kwagala tulina Yesu mu ffe ng’Omutabaganya eyatufuula ddala omu ne Katonda: olwo lwokka Erinnya lye, eritwaliramu obutonde bwe n’omulimu gwe, lifuuka amazima n’amaanyi mu ffe (si ku lwaffe kyokka), era tulina mu Linnya lya Yesu ekkubo ery’eddembe eriraga butereevu eri Kitaffe, erikakafu okuwulirwa. Okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu ye ddembe ly’omwana eri kitaawe, nga Yesu bwe yalina kino ng’Omubereberye. Tusaba mu kifo kya Yesu, si nga bwe tuyinza okwessa mu kifo kye, wabula nga bwe tuli mu Ye naye mu ffe. Tugenda butereevu eri Kitaffe, naye nga Kitaffe bw’ali mu Kristo kyokka, si nga bw’ayawukana ku Kristo. N’olwekyo omuntu ow’omunda w’atabeera mu Kristo era nga tamulina ng’Omulamu, ekigambo kye we kitafugira mu mutima mu maanyi g’Omwoyo, amazima ge n’obulamu bwe we bitafuukidde bulamu bwa mmeeme yaffe, kya bwereere okulowooza nti ebigambo nga “ku lw’Omwana wo omwagalwa” bijja kugasa.’—Christliche Ethik, von Dr. I. T. Beck, Tubingen, 3:39.

fields.title: Kristo, Kabona Asinga Obukulu
fields.body_html:
‘Kitange, bano be wampa njagala mbeere nabo we ndi.’—Yokaana 17:24.

MU kwogera kwe okw’okusiibula, Yesu abikkulira abayigirizwa be mu bujjuvu Obulamu Obuggya bwe bwali bugenda okuba, Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwe bunaamala okujja n’amaanyi. Mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu okubeera mu bo, mu kwegatta naye, Omuzabbibu ow’omu ggulu, ne mu kugenda kwabwe okumuwa obujulirwa n’okubonaabona ku lulwe, mwe baali bagenda okusanga omulimu gwe baayitirwa n’essanyu lyabwe. Wakati mu kubannyonnyola obulamu bwabwe obuggya obw’omu maaso, Mukama yali abawadde emirundi mingi ebisuubizo ebitaliiko kkomo ku maanyi okusaba kwabwe ge kuyinza okuba nago. Era kaakano ng’akomekkereza, Ye yennyini atandika okusaba. Abayigirizwa be balyoke babe n’essanyu ery’okumanya okwegayiririra kwe ku lwabwe mu ggulu nga Kabona waabwe Asinga Obukulu bwe kunaabanga, abaleka obusika buno obw’omuwendo: okusaba kwe eri Kitaawe. Akola kino era kubanga bo, nga bakabona, balina okugabana naye mu mulimu gwe ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, bo naffe tulyoke tumanye engeri y’okukolamu omulimu guno omutukuvu. Mu kuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe mu kiro kino ekisembayo, tuyize okutegeera nti ebisuubizo bino eby’ekitalo eby’okusaba tetwabiweebwa ku lwaffe ffekka, wabula ku lwa Mukama n’Obwakabaka bwe: era Mukama yekka gwe tuyinza okuyigirako okusaba mu Linnya lye kye kulina okuba ne kye kulina okufuna. Tutegedde nti okusaba mu Linnya lye kwe kusaba nga tuli bumu naye ddala: okusaba kuno okwa Kabona Asinga Obukulu kujja kutuyigiriza byonna okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu bye kuyinza okusaba n’okusuubira.

Okusaba kuno kutera okugabanyizibwamu ebitundu bisatu. Mukama waffe asooka kwesabira Yekka (olunyiriri 1-5), n’alyoka asabira abayigirizwa be (6-19), era ku nkomerero n’asabira abantu bonna abakkiriza mu mirembe gyonna (20-26). Omugoberezi wa Yesu eyeewaayo eri omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala, era ayagala okugezaako omukisa gw’ayinza okussa ku b’omu kibinja kye ng’asaba mu Linnya lya Yesu, ajja, mu bwetoowaze bwonna, okukkiriza Omwoyo amukulembere okuyiga okusaba kuno okw’ekitalo ng’erimu ku masomo agasinga obukulu mu ssomero ly’okusaba.

Okusookera ddala, Yesu yeesabira Yekka, agulumizibwe, alyoke agulumize Kitaffe. ‘Kitange! Gulumiza Omwana wo. Kale kaakano, Kitange, ngulumiza.’ Era aleeta ensonga z’asinziirako okusaba bw’atyo. Endagaano entukuvu yali yakolebwa wakati wa Kitaffe n’Omwana mu ggulu. Kitaffe yali amusuubizza obuyinza ku balina omubiri bonna ng’empeera y’omulimu gwe: yali amaze omulimu, yali agulumizizza Kitaffe, era ekigendererwa kye ekimu kaakano kwe kwongera okumugulumiza. N’obuvumu bungi ddala asaba Kitaffe amugulumize, alyoke kaakano abeere era akolere abantu be byonna bye yeetikka.

Muyigirizwa wa Yesu! lino lye ssomo erisooka mu mulimu gwo ogw’obwakabona ogw’okwegayiririra abalala, ly’olina okuyigira ku kyokulabirako kya Kabona wo omukulu Asinga Obukulu. Okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu kwe kusaba ng’oli bumu naye, ng’owulira nga bw’awulira. Ng’Omwana bwe yatandika okusaba kwe ng’alaga bulungi enkolagana ye ne Kitaffe, ng’aleeta omulimu gwe n’obuwulize bwe n’okwegomba kwe okulaba Kitaffe ng’agulumizibwa, naawe kola bw’otyo. Sembera olabike mu maaso ga Kitaffe mu Kristo. Leeta omulimu gwe ogwaggwa. Gamba nti oli bumu nagwo, nti ogwesiga, nti obeera mu gwo. Gamba nti naawe weewaddeyo okumaliriza omulimu Kitaffe gwe yakuwa okukola, n’okubeerawo olw’ekitiibwa kye yekka. Olwo saba n’obwesige Omwana agulumizibwe mu ggwe. Kuno kwe kusaba mu Linnya, mu bigambo byennyini, mu Mwoyo wa Yesu, ng’oli bumu ne Yesu yennyini. Okusaba okw’engeri eyo kulina amaanyi. Bw’ogulumiza Kitaffe wamu ne Yesu, Kitaffe ajja kugulumiza Yesu ng’akola ky’osaba mu Linnya lye. Olwo lwokka, enkolagana yo ku bubwo ne Katonda ku nsonga eno bw’eba ng’etegeerekeka bulungi nga eya Kristo, bw’oba ng’omugulumiza era ng’onoonya byonna olw’ekitiibwa kye, lw’olifuna, nga Kristo, amaanyi okwegayiririra abo abakwetoolodde.

Oluvannyuma Mukama waffe asabira ekibinja ky’abayigirizwa be. Aboogerako ng’abo Kitaffe be yamuwa. Akabonero kaabwe akakulu kwe kuba nti baakkiriza ekigambo kya Kristo. Agamba nti kaakano abatuma mu nsi mu kifo kye, nga Kitaffe bwe yamutuma Ye. Era abasabira ebintu bibiri: Kitaffe obakuume eri omubi, era abatukuze mu Kigambo kye, kubanga Ye neetukuza ku lwabwe.

Nga Mukama bwe yali, buli mwegayirizi akkiriza alina ekibinja kye ekimuli okumpi ky’asooka okusabira. Abazadde balina abaana baabwe, abasomesa abayizi baabwe, abasumba ebisibo byabwe, buli mukozi abo b’akwasibwa, buli mukkiriza abo b’alumirwa mu mutima. Kikulu nnyo okwegayiririra abalala okubeera okw’omuntu ku bubwe, okutunuulidde ekintu kimu, era okutegeerekeka. Era okusaba kwaffe okusooka kuteekwa bulijjo okuba nti bakkirize ekigambo. Naye okusaba kuno tekujja kugasa okuggyako nga wamu ne Mukama waffe tusobola okugamba nti, ‘Mbawadde ekigambo kyo:’ kino kye kituwa eddembe n’amaanyi mu kwegayiririra emmeeme. Tobasabira kyokka, naye yogera nabo. Era bwe bamala okukkiriza ekigambo, ka tubasabire nnyo bakuumibwe eri omubi, era batukuzibwe mu kigambo ekyo. Mu kifo ky’okuggwaamu essuubi, oba okubasalira omusango, oba okwabulira abo abagwa, ka tusabire ekibinja kyaffe, ‘Kitaffe! Bakuume mu linnya lyo;’ ‘Obatukuze mu mazima.’ Okusaba mu Linnya lya Yesu kubeera n’obuyinza bungi: ‘Buli kye munaayagalanga kinaabakolerwanga.’

Awo ne kuddako okusaba kwa Mukama waffe olw’ekibinja ekisingawo obugazi. ‘Sisabira bano bokka naye nsabira n’abo abanzikiriza olw’ekigambo kyabwe.’ Omutima gwe ogw’obwakabona gugaziwa okuzingiramu ebifo byonna n’ebiseera byonna, era asaba bonna ababe babeere bumu buli wamu, ng’obukakafu Katonda bw’awa ensi nti okutumibwa kwe kwava eri Katonda, n’oluvannyuma babeerenga naye bulijjo mu kitiibwa kye. Okutuusa olwo, ‘okwagala kwo kw’onjagala, kulyoke kubeerenga mu bo, era nange mbeere mu bo.’

Omuyigirizwa wa Yesu, amaze okukakasa amaanyi g’okusaba mu kibinja kye, tayinza kusigala munda mu nsalo zaakyo: asabira Ekkanisa yonna n’ebitundu byayo eby’enjawulo. Asabira nnyo obumu obw’Omwoyo n’obw’okwagala. Asaba Ekkanisa ebeere emu mu Kristo, ng’obujulirwa eri ensi nti Kristo, eyakola ekyamagero ekyenkana awo eky’okufuula okwagala okuwangula okwefaako n’okwawukana, ddala ye Mwana wa Katonda eyatumibwa okuva mu ggulu. Buli mukkiriza asaanidde okusaba ennyo obumu bw’Ekkanisa bulabisibwe, si mu bibiina eby’okungulu, wabula mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.

Ebyo bye bikwata ku ekyo ekisabibwa. Kaakano ku ngeri gye kusabibwamu. Yesu agamba nti, ‘KITANGE! NJAGALA.’ Ng’asinziira ku ddembe lye ng’Omwana, ku kisuubizo Kitaffe kye yamuwa, ne ku mulimu gwe ogwaggwa, yali asobola okwogera bw’atyo. Kitaffe yali amugambye nti, ‘Nsaba, nange ndikuwa.’ Yakozesa bukozesa ekisuubizo kya Kitaffe. Yesu atuwadde ekisuubizo ekifaanana bwe kityo: ‘Buli kye munaayagalanga kinaabakolerwanga.’ Ansaba mu Linnya lye njogere kye njagala. Bw’abeera mu Ye, ng’ali bumu naye mu bulamu omuntu mw’aba nga si kintu, Kristo n’aba byonna, omukkiriza alina eddembe okutwala ekigambo ekyo ekya Kabona we Asinga Obukulu, era, ng’addamu ekibuuzo nti ‘Oyagala ki?’ okugamba nti, ‘KITANGE! NJAGALA byonna by’osuubizza.’ Kino si kirala wabula okukkiriza okw’amazima; kuno kwe kussa Katonda ekitiibwa: okukakasa nti obwesige obw’engeri eyo mu kwogera kye njagala bumusanyusa ddala. Mu kusooka, omutima gwaffe gwekanga ekigambo ekyo; tetuwulira nga tulina ddembe newakubadde amaanyi okwogera bwe tutyo. Kigambo ekiweebwa ekisa mu kwewaayo okujjuvu okw’okwagala kwaffe kwokka, naye ekisa ekyo ddala kijja kuweebwa buli muntu afiirwa okwagala kwe mu kwa Mukama we. Oyo afiirwa okwagala kwe alikufuna; oyo awaayo okwagala kwe kwonna alikuddizibwa nga kuzziddwa buggya era nga kunywezeddwa n’Amaanyi ag’Obwakatonda. ‘KITANGE! NJAGALA:’ lino lye ddoboozi ekkulu ery’okwegayiririra kwa Mukama waffe mu ggulu okutaggwaawo, okukola obutayosa, era okuwangula byonna. Okusaba kwaffe kubeera n’obuyinza nga tuli bumu naye mwokka; nga tuli bumu naye kubeera n’obuyinza bungi. Singa tubeera mu Ye, nga tuli balamu, nga tutambula, era nga tukola byonna mu Linnya lye; singa tujja ne tuleeta buli kye tusaba, nga kigezeddwa era nga kikwatiddwako Ekigambo kye n’Omwoyo we, ne tukisuula mu mugga ogw’amaanyi ogw’okwegayiririra ogulinnya okuva gy’ali, kitwalibwe waggulu era kiweebweyo mu maaso ga Kitaffe;—tujja kuba n’obwesige bwonna nti tufuna bye tusaba: ekigambo ‘Kitaffe! Njagala’ kijja kufuuyibwa mu ffe Omwoyo yennyini. Tujja kwebula mu Ye, ne tufuuka busa, ne tuzuula nti mu bunafu bwaffe tulina amaanyi era tuwangula.

Abayigirizwa ba Yesu! Abayitibwa okufaanana Mukama wammwe mu kwegayiririra kwe okw’obwakabona, ddi, ayi ddi! Lwe tulizuukuka ne tulaba ekitiibwa, ekisukkulumye ku kulowooza kwonna, eky’ekigendererwa kyaffe kino eky’okwegayirira Katonda n’okumuwangula ku lw’abantu abazikirira? Ayi, ddi lwe tulyekunkumulako obugayaavu obwekweka mu kifaananyi ky’obwetoowaze, ne twewaayo ddala eri Omwoyo wa Katonda, ajjuze okwagala kwaffe omusana n’amaanyi, tulyoke tumanye, tutwale, era tufune byonna Katonda waffe by’alindirira okuwa okwagala okumunyweza.

‘MUKAMA, TUYIGIRIZE OKUSABA.’

Ayi Kabona wange Asinga Obukulu Omutendereze! nze ani ggwe okumpita bw’otyo okugabana naawe mu maanyi go ag’okwegayiririra okuwangula! Era lwaki, ayi Mukama wange! ndi wa mutima omunafu bwe gutyo okutegeera, n’okukkiriza, n’okukozesa enkizo eno ey’ekitalo gye wanunulira abantu bo. Ayi Mukama! mpa ekisa kyo kino kyeyongere okuba omulimu gw’obulamu bwange obutakoma—okusaba obutayosa nga nsikiriza omukisa gw’eggulu ku byonna ebinneetoolodde ku nsi.

Mukama Omutendereze! Nzize kaakano okukkiriza okuyitibwa kwange kuno. Olw’ekyo ndeka byonna ne nkugoberera. Mu mikono gyo, n’okukkiriza, nkwewaddeyo nzenna: mbumba, ntendeka, nzijuza Omwoyo wo, mbe omu ku ggye lyo ery’okusaba, abameggana abatunula era abafuba mu kusaba, aba Isirayiri, abalangira ba Katonda, abalina amaanyi era abawangula. Twala omutima gwange, ogujjuze okwegomba okumu: ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu kukuŋŋaanya, mu kutukuzibwa, ne mu bumu bw’abo Kitaffe b’akuwadde. Twala ebirowoozo byange era kino kibe kye nsoma era amagezi gange: okumanya okusaba we kuyinza okuleeta omukisa. Ntwala ddala nzenna, ontereeze mbeere kabona, bulijjo okuyimirira mu maaso ga Katonda n’okuwa omukisa mu Linnya lye.

Mukama Omutendereze! Kibeere bwe kityo wano, nga bwe kiri mu bulamu bw’omwoyo bwonna: Ggwe byonna, nze busa. Era wano nange kino nkirabe mu bulamu bwange: oyo atalina era atanoonya kintu kyonna ku lulwe, afuna byonna, okutuuka ne ku kisa eky’ekitalo eky’okugabana naawe mu buweereza bwo obutaggwaawo obw’okwegayiririra abalala. Amiina.
